title: enable() rolls back wrapped files after some OS-store keys were already deleted, losing database keys
trigger: Two or more accounts signed in. Settings > Passcode > Turn on. Every account's key is wrapped and written, the config is saved, then the loop `for account in &written { inner.delete(account)? }` runs. The first account's key is deleted from the OS secret store, the delete for the second fails (keychain locked/denied, secret service error).
effect: `rollback(&written)` removes every wrapped file and passcode.json, but the first account's key is already gone from the OS store and its wrapped copy is now deleted too. Its TDLib database can never be opened again: the account is lost (forced re-login, local data unreadable). Contradicts the doc comment 'no database key is ever lost'.
fix: Make the migration a staged value (Wrapped -> Committed -> StoreCleared) and on a delete failure do not roll back files for accounts whose OS copy is already deleted: either re-put the deleted keys into `inner` before removing wrapped files, or keep passcode enabled and retry the remaining deletes.

title: Manage Topics dialog Delete button deletes a topic and all its messages with no confirmation
trigger: Open a forum's Manage Topics dialog (admin), click Delete on any non-General topic row.
effect: deleteForumTopic is sent at once and the topic with every message in it is gone; the context-menu path asks GroupConfirm::DeleteForumTopic first, this one does not. The note says 'Topic updated'.
fix: Route ForumTopicAction::Delete through open_group_confirm(DeleteForumTopic) like the topic menu; keep forum_topic_action for the non-destructive actions.

title: Quick reply `/` row sends to the main window's open chat, not the chat of the window it was picked in
trigger: Main window has private chat A open; open private chat B in its own chat window; type `/` in B's composer (the menu is built from session.open_chat = A) and pick a shortcut
effect: The shortcut's messages are sent to chat A instead of B (or nothing when the main window has no chat open)
fix: Resolve the target with viewed_chat() (window scope) in send_quick_reply_row, command_menu_state and sync_command_menu, or carry the ChatId in the menu item.

title: read_zip accumulates one inflated copy per central-directory entry; a crafted theme zip exhausts memory
trigger: Import (or open) a .tdesktop-theme under 5 MB whose central directory lists ~65535 entries that all point at one local header holding a 4 MB deflate stream (about 4 KB compressed, size field 4 MB). Each entry passes the per-entry size check and is inflated and pushed into `out`.
effect: Memory grows by about 4 MB per entry (hundreds of GB total) until the allocator aborts: the whole app crashes (import runs on a background thread, but an OOM abort kills the process; store::load on the UI thread freezes it first).
fix: Keep a running total of inflated bytes (cap it near BACKGROUND_LIMIT + SCHEME_LIMIT), reject duplicate local-header offsets, and only inflate the entries ThemeFile::parse asks for by name.

title: Close-friends editor opened before the list is loaded starts from an empty base; Save then overwrites the server list with only the toggled users
trigger: open Edit close friends right after sign-in or on a slow link, tick one contact before getClosefriends answers, press Save
effect: tick_close_friends adopts the loaded list only while !edit.changed(); the edit is already changed so it is never rebased, and setCloseFriends sends just the ticked ids, dropping all existing close friends
fix: CloseFriendsStage { Loading, Editing(edit) }: no checkboxes or Save until the list arrived

title: Login review counter stays above zero when a send fails mid-loop
trigger: Two or more unconfirmed logins are listed; the user presses 'Yes, it's me' / 'No' and the sender fails on the 2nd or later confirmSession/terminateSession.
effect: review_pending is set to ids.len() but the error path calls finish_login_review once (decrements by 1) and returns; the ids never sent never answer, so review_pending stays > 0, the alert shows busy for good and review_unconfirmed_sessions is refused (needs restart).
fix: Track the review as one enum (Idle / Reviewing{outstanding: BTreeSet<RequestId>} / Failed / Done) keyed by request ids; a failed send removes every unsent id.

title: Sign-in screen re-asks getCountries/getCountryCode every frame when the answer is empty or an error
trigger: Open the sign-in phone screen (WaitPhoneNumber) with no network, a TDLib error, an empty country list, or a getCountryCode text that is not two letters.
effect: frame_upkeep runs sync_signin every frame, which calls fetch_countries and fetch_country_code. The guards are 'countries.is_some()' / 'guessed_country_iso.is_some()' and have_purpose; the Countries arm only stores a non-empty list, the Text arm only a valid ISO, and GetCountries/GetCountryCode have no error arm, so after each answer the next frame sends the request again (request loop at round-trip rate).
fix: Hold both as Fetch<T> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) so a finished-but-empty or failed answer is not 'ask again'.

title: An existing but unreadable accounts.json loads as the default registry, and the next save overwrites the real file
trigger: accounts.json exists but fs::read fails once (AV lock on Windows, EIO, permission blip); then add account / switch account / toggle notify-from-all calls load_registry then save_registry
effect: load_registry hits `None => return AccountRegistry::default()` (stamp is Some), the caller saves [primary] plus its change over the real list: every other account and any pending_deletes vanish from the registry, their folders are orphaned and need a fresh sign-in
fix: Make load return Result<Loaded, Unreadable>/an enum {Missing, Corrupt, Unreadable, Ok}; read-modify-write callers refuse to save on Unreadable instead of starting from the default.

title: Closing a chat window that hosts the account notice box dismisses up to 8 queued notices unseen, including a force-logout one
trigger: Click anything in a chat window; two or more service notices arrive (updateServiceNotification), the first a force-logout (AUTH_KEY_DROP_*) notice; the AccountNotice box shows in that chat window; close the chat window with its title-bar close or Cmd-W.
effect: close_window_boxes runs the box's close (dismiss_account_notice) while account_notice() is Some, up to 8 times: every queued service notice, the login-prevented box and the frozen/age boxes are popped without being shown, and the force-logout notice (whose own box cannot be dismissed) goes away without the log out it demands.
fix: Give AccountNotice a close that closes the box view, not the notices (a front-notice cursor that is only advanced by its own buttons), or register it without a close so it is freed to the window of the last press like the call swap prompt; never dismiss a force-logout notice from a close.

title: download_file copies a chat's file to the agent's path after access was revoked or turned off during the download
trigger: An agent calls download_file on a large file (waits up to 5 minutes). While it downloads the user turns Agent access off, revokes that chat's grant, or revokes the agent's connection. The download finishes.
effect: The file is copied to the agent's chosen folder although the user withdrew access. Only a lock is checked (locked_since_call_began); still_allowed (access generation, grants generation, revoked connection) is never called, unlike every write tool.
fix: Call still_allowed() after call_waiting returns and before copy_new, and treat download_file as a write-class call (or re-run require(Scope::Read) after the wait).

title: KeyFilter keeps its own held flag; a missed key-up leaves it stuck and the microphone open
trigger: Join a group call with push-to-talk and the system-wide hook on; hold the key; the hook misses the release (macOS event tap disabled by timeout and re-enabled in on_event, Windows on_key try_lock fails because CONTEXT is locked by a starting/stopping hook thread, X11 record gap); release the key. Because the hook is active, group_call_ptt_release_all returns early and never resets.
effect: KeyFilter.held stays true and PushToTalk.held/talking stay true: the microphone stays open (transmitting to the call) with no key down. The next press is swallowed (held == pressed returns None), the next release finally sends Up.
fix: Resync on hook gaps: drop the filter and send a synthetic Up when the tap is re-enabled or an event is skipped, or poll the real key state; one KeyState enum owned by the hook with a reset edge.

title: Save in the edit-folder box while the folder is still loading sends editChatFolder with an empty editor
trigger: Settings > Folders > click a folder whose cached spec is stale (or while offline / slow), type a name in the name field shown under 'Loading folder', click Save before getChatFolder answers.
effect: save_folder_editor validates only the name, then edit_chat_folder(id, FolderEditor::new().to_spec()) replaces the folder with no included chats, no pinned chats and no type rules: the folder's contents are wiped on the server. Save is never disabled by fetch_pending.
fix: Make the editor an enum Loading/Failed/Ready(FolderEditor) (or Fetch<ChatFolderSpec>); Save exists only in Ready.

title: Pinned drag with a lost mouse-up never ends and redraws at 60 Hz
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat and release the mouse outside the window, or lose the release to a menu/alert/window deactivation, so neither on_mouse_up nor on_mouse_up_out on #chat-rows fires.
effect: PinReorder::animating() stays true while dragging is Some, so sidebar_chats never clears it and calls request_animation_tick(60) every frame; the list stays in the swapped order and the grabbing cursor stays. The `!window_active && dragging().is_none()` escape does not cover the dragging case.
fix: Cancel the reorder on drag end/cancel (GPUI drag-ended hook), window deactivation and Esc; treat Reordering as an enum stage with those exits.

title: drive_folder_invite re-sends getChat for unresolved link chats on every poll
trigger: Open an addlist link whose missing/added chats TDLib cannot return from getChat (inaccessible chat, error answer).
effect: fetch_chats_for_folder_invite is called from every poll tick while info is set; its only dedup is has_purpose_for_chat for requests still pending, and GetFolderInviteChat has no error arm or tombstone, so a failed getChat is re-sent at poll rate for as long as the box is open.
fix: Record asked chat ids in the dialog (HashSet or per-chat Fetch) and ask once.

title: A failed older page of a forum topic is re-requested in a loop
trigger: Open a forum topic with messages loaded, scroll to the top so GetTopicHistory asks for an older page, and have it fail (network error, a 408 from the sweep, or a persistent error).
effect: fail_topic_page marks topic_load_failed, but topic_history_load_failed only counts it while the topic has no messages, so fetch_topic_history's guard ignores it and maybe_auto_load_older (called each render while row 0 is shown) sends the page again as soon as the error lands. The pane shows no error and the request repeats while the user stays at the top.
fix: Track the older end's fetch as one value per topic window (Idle | Loading | Failed) and stop auto-paging in Failed until a Retry, instead of a failure set that only the first page reads.

title: updateChatPendingJoinRequests with a null pending_join_requests is a parse error, so the join-requests bar never clears
trigger: Be an admin of a group or channel with 'Approve new members' on and one pending join request, so the bar shows '1 request to join'. Approve or dismiss that request in Quill (one request, not 'all'), or let another admin or your phone handle it, or let the requester cancel. TDLib sends updateChatPendingJoinRequests with pending_join_requests: null (schema td_api.tl:11466 'may be null').
effect: The parser calls int53(None)? on total_count, returns MissingField, and copy_and_parse drops the update (an update has no @extra to recover). groups.pending_join_request_counts keeps the old count, so the bar stays with the old count and avatars. Opening it shows an empty list. Only 'approve all' (ProcessAllChatJoinRequests, session_apply_ok.rs:719) or a new request clears it; a single approve (forget_join_request) never touches the count. The bar stays until restart.
fix: Parse a null or absent pending_join_requests as total_count 0 with no user ids (UpdateChatPendingJoinRequests { total_count: 0, user_ids: vec![] }), and treat only a missing chat_id as a parse error.

title: Promote picker keeps a selection that the search results no longer show
trigger: Open Promote admin, tick member A, type another name and press Search so A is not in the new page, then press Promote.
effect: No radio is selected (selected_ix is None) but selected_user is still A and the Promote button stays enabled, so A is promoted to administrator with the rights shown, unseen.
fix: Clear selected_user in search_promote_members, and enable Promote only when selected_user is among the candidates shown (derive from the page, not stored).

title: Statistics panel spins forever when the fetch is skipped because can_get_statistics is not known yet
trigger: Open the Statistics panel on a channel before supergroupFullInfo has loaded (or via the message menu 'Statistics' on a fresh chat). fetch_chat_statistics returns Ok(None) without inserting any entry; nothing refetches when the full info arrives.
effect: 'Loading statistics, it can take a few minutes' forever; also for a chat whose full info says can_get_statistics=false.
fix: Idle/Unavailable variants in ChatStatisticsFetch; draw None as 'not available' or retrigger the fetch when the full info arrives.

title: Refresh (or Retry) removes the cached statistics before the send can fail, leaving a spinner with no retry
trigger: Open channel statistics, lose the connection (chats_path inactive) or have the request refused, press Refresh. refresh_chat_statistics removes the entry first, then fetch_chat_statistics returns Err.
effect: Panel shows 'Loading statistics' spinner forever (None is drawn like Loading, no Retry button) until the panel is closed and reopened; the loaded numbers are gone.
fix: Do not remove the entry; set it to Loading only after a successful send, or to Failed on Err. Draw None as Idle with a Load button.

title: Bulk 'Delete chats' confirmation deletes the live selection at submit time, not the chats shown when asked
trigger: Select several chats, press Delete (confirm shows 'N chats'), change the selection (Enter on the focused list toggles a row via chat_list_keys.rs:461, or an agent/other path) before pressing Delete in the box.
effect: The ids are read from chat_list.selected at confirm (groups/open_custom_title_dialog.rs:288-301), so chats the user never saw in the question are removed from the list and their history deleted.
fix: Carry the ids in the action (RemoveSelectedChats{ids: Vec<ChatId>} snapshotted at ask) so the answer is matched to what asked.

title: A timed-out export request leaves WorkerLink::pending set, so its late answer is handed to the worker's next call
trigger: Run a full account export with several chats; one chat's getChatHistory/searchChatMessages/download takes over 300 s (QUERY_TIMEOUT) to answer. ChannelTdlib::call returns Tdlib("the request timed out"), export_chats counts that chat as failed and carries on (account/worker.rs:482). The driver still has pending=Some(A) and forwards nothing else; when A's answer arrives WorkerLink::reply sends it down the id-less replies channel, where the next chat's first call takes it as its own answer.
effect: The next chat is exported with the previous chat's messages (or every later answer is shifted by one), so a chat folder holds another chat's content under the wrong name; later calls misparse until the export ends.
fix: Make the reply channel carry the RequestId and have ChannelTdlib::call discard replies that are not its own request; on timeout also clear/abandon the link's pending entry (an enum ExportCall {Idle, Awaiting(RequestId), Abandoned(RequestId)}).

title: Paid-chat guard cannot price media, album, voice/video note, checklist or plain forward sends: their builders write options:null and set_paid only fills an existing options object
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who charges Stars per message (or a paid channel DM). Attach a photo (or record a voice note, send a checklist, or forward messages from the share box without Silent/Schedule) and press Send. Confirm the 'Pay N Stars' box (or have 'Don't ask again' trust stored).
effect: PaidGuard::screen holds the request; release_paid_send sends HeldSend::with_price(), but set_paid (src/paid_messages_guard.rs:81-85) skips because options is null, so the send goes out with no paid_message_star_count. TDLib refuses it (payment required), and the message the user agreed to pay for fails. The trusted path (screen, :140-142) has the same no-op. Only text/dice/sticker/game sends, which build a messageSendOptions object, work. Tests (connect/tests/paid_messages_guard.rs) use hand-written JSON with an options object, so they miss it.
fix: Make set_paid write a full messageSendOptions object when options is null (or have every send builder always emit message_send_options), and test the guard with JSON from the real builders.

title: Music row play button uses the main window's open chat, not the message's chat
trigger: Open a chat with a music file in a chat window (pop-out) while the main window shows another chat or none; press play on the music row.
effect: With no main chat open the button does nothing. With another chat open, playback starts under that other chat's id (player.chat, positions key), so the row never shows as playing and a same-numbered message of the other chat is toggled.
fix: Pass the message's ChatId into audio_row (as voice_note_row does) and use it; never read open_chat_id inside a row that can draw in a chat window.

title: Edited-photo render never lands after an account switch: tray card stays 'rendering' and a held Send waits forever
trigger: In account A attach a photo, open the editor, press Done (render starts, tray card gets photo_render=Some(n)); before the PNG lands switch to account B. The task's screen epoch is stale, so update_in fails and the fallback app.main().update (which keeps the same stale screen epoch) also fails; the PNG is deleted. Press Send in A first so a Send is held, or switch back to A later.
effect: Back in A the card is stuck rendering (photo_render never cleared anywhere else), tray_renders_an_edit() is true so every Send is parked as held_send with 'Preparing the files' and never goes, and Edit on the card defers forever (photo_editor_after). Only removing the card frees it.
fix: Make the card's state an enum (Ready / Rendering{token}) owned by the tray, and settle it from the dropped continuation: on Gone fall back to ScopedApp::app() (no screen) to land_attachment_edit(None) instead of main(), which keeps the stale epoch.

title: Login-URL button context is one session slot, not matched to the request that asked
trigger: Press login-URL button A in a bot message, then button B (same or another chat) before A's getLoginUrlInfo answers.
effect: send_login_url_info/send_login_url overwrite bots.login_url_request; the answer for A is paired with B's chat/message/button_id/raw_url, so the confirmation box shows A's domain but 'Allow' calls getLoginUrl for B's button (authorises the wrong link). Errors and last_login_url_info are single slots too; a failed send leaves a stale request in the slot.
fix: Put the LoginUrlRequest into the RequestPurpose (GetLoginUrlInfo{request}) so the answer carries its own context, and keep at most one box per button.

title: Hidden translate bars are app-wide and keyed by bare chat id, so hiding one leaks to other accounts
trigger: On account A, hide the translate bar in a channel or private chat (set_translate_bar_hidden -> TranslatePrefs::set_bar_hidden(chat_id)). Switch to account B and open the same peer, for example the same public channel, or B's private chat with A's user (which has the id of A's Saved Messages).
effect: B's translate bar for that chat is hidden too, although B never hid it. TranslatePrefs is the app's file (ui/translate_ui/mod.rs:118, settings/app_prefs.rs), while tdesktop keeps the hidden flag per account on the server.
fix: Key the hidden chats by owner (`Vec<AccountChat>` / `HashMap<AccountKey, Vec<ChatId>>`), or move them into the account's own prefs file.

title: Report spam with unarchive also leaves the chat
trigger: Archived group shows a ReportSpam bar with can_unarchive: the button reads 'Report spam' (no leave). Press it and confirm OK.
effect: submit_bar_report always calls leave_channel after report_chat, so the user silently leaves the group/channel; for a private chat leaveChat is wrong or errors and the note says the report failed although it went out.
fix: Carry the bar variant into the confirm: an enum ReportSpamAction { ReportOnly, ReportAndLeave } chosen when the button is built and passed to submit_bar_report.

title: begin_edit while already editing overwrites the stashed draft and reply
trigger: Type a draft (with a reply bar) in chat A, press Up or choose Edit on message M1, then right-click message M2 and choose Edit (no is_editing guard in message_menu_overlay.rs:463 or scheduled.rs:805).
effect: begin_edit reads the field (M1's edit text) as 'current', calls note_open_draft(false) and enter_edit replaces edit_mode whole: the real draft and stashed reply are gone, M1's edited text becomes the stashed draft. Esc/finish restores M1's text as the chat draft; the original draft is lost.
fix: begin_edit on an active edit first leaves the old edit (clear_edit) or carries the old EditMode's stash into the new one; make enter_edit take the previous EditMode and keep its stash.

title: begin_inline_return is set before the bot chat resolves and is never cancelled when that fails
trigger: Tap the inline results button 'Start' while the lookup fails (resolve_deep_link Err, or the username later fails to resolve), then later open the bot's chat by any route.
effect: take_inline_start finds the stale pending_start and sends '/start <parameter>' to the bot unprompted; the origin chat may also be navigated back to when a switch-inline message arrives hours later.
fix: InlineReturn becomes an enum Opening{..} -> Started{baseline}; clear it on resolve failure, chat change, account switch or a timeout of the open request.

title: advance_thread notifies every frame while a thread page request is in flight
trigger: Open a comment thread, click the root bar (ScrollGoal::ThreadRoot) while older replies are unloaded, or have reload_needed set after an own send; go slow/offline so the getMessageThreadHistory answer is late.
effect: fetch_thread_history returns Ok(None) when the request is already pending (dedupe) and does not clear reload_needed / scroll goal, so is_ok() is true and cx.notify() runs each render: a redraw loop (render calls advance_thread, notify schedules another render) for as long as the page is in flight, and forever if the answer never comes.
fix: Make fetch_thread_history return an enum (Sent, AlreadyPending, Done) and notify only on Sent; or let the answer, not the poll, drive the redraw.

title: Dropping a folder on the FolderFiles zone walks the directory tree on the UI thread
trigger: Drag a folder that lives on a slow or disconnected network share over the conversation and drop it on the 'files in folder' zone.
effect: drop_on_zone calls folder_files_for_sending (read_dir of the folder and of every subfolder, plus file_type per entry) synchronously in the click handler; the window freezes until the share answers. The drag probe a few lines up was moved off the UI thread for the same reason.
fix: Run folder_files_for_sending through run_off_ui_scoped_then and apply the plan when it lands, keyed by the slot.

title: Failed next-page inline query is re-asked on every poll batch
trigger: Scroll an inline results panel to its end; the next_offset request fails (first_page=false error leaves the slot Loaded).
effect: should_load_more is still true and nothing is in flight, so progress_inline_mode_here (every poll_live batch, including the error's) sends it again: a request loop while the panel is open.
fix: Record a failed offset on the slot (as inline_members does with failed_offset) and retry only on the next scroll.

title: Delete-selection and single-delete alert boxes are not tied to the account/chat that opened them
trigger: Select messages in account A, click Delete N so the alert opens, then switch account (shortcut, notification click, deep link) and press Delete
effect: The on_ok closure applies the captured chat_id/ids to whatever live driver is on screen; a private chat id shared by two accounts deletes message ids in the wrong account (the kit alert is not a registered DialogKind, so no Farewell closes it)
fix: Register the alert as a DialogKind owned by OnScreen (or carry an AccountKey and compare on ok) so a switch closes it.

title: Similar-channels strip re-requests getChatSimilarChats every frame after a failed fetch
trigger: Open a joined channel whose getChatSimilarChats fails (flood wait, API error). Render calls similar_channels_strip, similar_strip_tiles returns None for ProfileChatsFetch::Failed, request_similar_chats defers fetch_similar_chats, and fetch_profile_chats skips only Loading and Loaded, so Failed is sent again.
effect: Each failure notifies, redraws and sends the request again: a request loop paced by the round trip, which deepens a flood wait. The strip never shows.
fix: Treat Failed as terminal in the draw path: ask only when the fetch is absent, and retry only from an explicit action or after a changed key.

title: Ownership transfer answer is not matched to the dialog that asked
trigger: Transfer ownership of chat A (Change owner, answer slow). Close the box, then open Leave on chat B and press Appoint another owner then pick a user, so B's dialog is Confirm{leave_after:true}. A's transferred answer lands.
effect: leave_after is read from whatever dialog is open now, not from the transfer's chat. Quill leaves chat A the user meant to keep, drops B's dialog, and the note names A.
fix: Carry the chat id and the leave_after choice in the in-flight transfer (one Transfer{chat, user, leave_after} value) and apply the answer only to it; a dialog for another chat is untouched.

title: Starting another purchase (or opening another resale) overwrites a buy whose sendResoldGift is still out
trigger: Confirm a resale purchase (sending=true), press Back (after_market_pop keeps a sending buy), tap a second listing in the still open Resale list, or open another gift's resale list (market.buy = None).
effect: The first purchase's answer is dropped (buy.request mismatch): Stars are spent but no 'Gift Sent' toast, the listing stays in the list, a craft purchase never fills its slot, and a failure is silent.
fix: Keep in-flight purchases as Vec<ResaleBuy> keyed by request id, or refuse start_gift_resale_buy/open_gift_resale while a buy is sending.

title: Star pack answer for one gift recipient is applied under another recipient (answer not matched to what asked)
trigger: Gift Stars: pick contact A (getStarGiftPaymentOptions in flight), press Back, pick contact B (second request); A's answer lands after B's, or Back is pressed and A's answer lands on the contact list
effect: B's checkout page lists the packs fetched for A (apply.rs:274 sets options and loading=false for any GetStarGiftOptions answer; RequestPurpose::GetStarGiftOptions carries no user id); loading=false is cleared by the first answer while B's is still outstanding. Stars are bought for B with A's pack amounts
fix: Carry the target user id in the purpose (GetStarGiftOptions { user_id }) and apply the answer only when stage is Packs for that user; the enum from the IS entry holds the key.

title: A finished gift transfer reports the contact of the picker's current stage, not of the request
trigger: Transfer a collectible to Ann (confirm). While transferGift is out, press Cancel (allowed: back() only refuses during export), pick Bob so the picker shows Confirm for Bob; the answer for Ann arrives.
effect: The toast says the gift went to Bob and Quill opens Bob's chat; if the picker was left on the list or closed, no toast and no chat at all. The gift went to Ann.
fix: Keep the recipient in the in-flight request (PaymentsPurpose::TransferGift { user_id, gift_name }) and build GiftTransferred from it, or make the picker stage Transferring { user_id } that back() refuses.

title: Auction info box re-sends getGiftUpgradePreview on every render after it fails
trigger: Open a gift auction's info box (link or tile) for a gift whose upgrade preview request fails (error from TDLib, or offline).
effect: auction_info_box calls fetch_gift_upgrade_preview each render; the error arm for UpgradePreview stores nothing (gift_market.rs apply error is a no-op), so `previews` never gets the key and the request goes out again every redraw, at least once a second from the box's 1 fps tick, for as long as the box is open.
fix: Keep the preview as `Fetch<GiftPreview>` per gift id (failed is a stage), ask from an open action not from render, and do not retry a failed fetch until the box reopens.

title: Raising a bid placed for a channel from Active Auctions re-places it for the user
trigger: Have a bid whose owner is a channel (MessageSender::Chat); open the chat-list auction bar or Active Auctions and tap Raise, then Place Bid.
effect: raise_active_bid sets gift_market.recipient = None for a Chat owner, auction_recipient() falls back to the user, bid_gift_auction sees a different owner and sends placeGiftAuctionBid for the user: the Stars go to a bid for the wrong recipient and the channel bid is replaced.
fix: Carry the bid's owner as the recipient (an enum of User/Chat) and refuse or route a Chat owner to ChangeRecipient instead of dropping to None.

title: Esc or close during the forge drops the craft session and the craft's outcome
trigger: Press Craft (craftGift sent, gifts burn), then Escape or the dialog close button while the forge animation runs.
effect: market_back pops the Craft box, after_craft_pop sets market.craft = None; the CraftResult answer is filtered out (craft_request mismatch), so the user never learns whether the craft succeeded or the gifts were lost.
fix: Refuse the pop while craft.crafting (CraftStage::Crafting), or keep the session until its answer and show the result as a toast when the box is gone.

title: Form stays open after a new giveaway is paid, so Start can be paid a second time
trigger: Open a channel's boosts page > Get Boosts via Gifts > pick a Premium/Stars option > Start Giveaway > pay in the checkout > close the paid screen.
effect: The Giveaway dialog (is_open = form.is_some() && !payment_dialog_visible) comes back with the same draft and an enabled Start Giveaway; nothing sets launch=Launched or takes the form after a payment (pay_new_giveaway only sets a note). The user can open the checkout again and buy a second giveaway.
fix: Make the form an enum (Editing, AwaitingPayment{invoice}, Paid, Launching, Launched) and move it to Paid/close it when the checkout's paid answer for that invoice arrives.

title: Checkout pays with a stale validated order after the fields are edited
trigger: Open an invoice that needs a shipping address, fill it, press Continue (shipping options appear), then edit the street or country and press Pay without pressing Continue again.
effect: Pay is enabled (order_ok only checks validated.is_some()) and submit_payment sends the old order_info_id and shipping option, so the order is charged and shipped against the address and price that were validated, not the ones shown.
fix: Make order state one enum on the dialog: Unvalidated, Validating, Validated{order_info_id, shipping options, snapshot of the OrderInfoData}; Pay requires Validated whose snapshot equals the current fields, and any field edit drops back to Unvalidated.

title: open_send_gift_to replaces the whole send state while a sendGift is in flight
trigger: Press Send in the send-gift dialog, close the dialog (close_send_gift keeps sending=true), reopen the dialog for any user before the answer.
effect: SendGiftState is reset (sending=false, request=None), so the Send button is live again and the first answer is dropped by waits_for; a second Send spends Stars again and the first outcome is never shown.
fix: Refuse to open (or keep the in-flight purchase) while send is Sending{request}; model send as enum Idle/Sending/Done/Failed.

title: open_boost_box replaces the box but leaves boost_intent and stashed slots of the old chat
trigger: In the boost box of channel A press Boost (getAvailableChatBoostSlots out, boost_intent=A), then open a t.me/B?boost link so open_boost_box(B) swaps the box before the slots answer arrives.
effect: The slots answer is stashed for A (intent still A) and maybe_continue_boost sends boostChat for A with a free slot while the user is looking at B's box: a boost is spent on a chat the screen no longer shows.
fix: Fold intent into the box state (BoostPhase::Working carries the chat and request id) or clear boost_intent and boost_slots_by_chat whenever boost_box is replaced, as close_boost_box does.

title: Undo forgets the waiting Stars locally even if removePendingPaidMessageReactions was not sent
trigger: Tap a Star reaction, press Undo while the sender refuses (send_json_request Err).
effect: paid.undo() already dropped the entry, TDLib still holds the pending Stars and may commit them later; the toast says undone while Stars can still be spent.
fix: Remove the local entry only after the send succeeds, or keep an Undoing stage until TDLib answers.

title: submit_payment_form has no in-flight guard, so a double Pay can send sendPaymentForm twice
trigger: Open a Stars checkout, click Pay twice quickly (two click events before the next render). submit_stars_payment (src/ui/invoice_checkout.rs:193) checks form_paid but not checkout_sending; the driver does not check is_paying(invoice) either.
effect: Two sendPaymentForm requests for one invoice: Stars may be spent twice.
fix: Refuse in the driver when is_paying(invoice) (one Payment stage enum per checkout: Idle, Forming, Validating, Paying, Paid).

title: Local pending Star reactions are dropped before TDLib confirms commit/undo, so TDLib's pending total can exceed what the user saw
trigger: Tap the Star reaction (addPending sent, local entry kept). When the 5.5 s timer ends, take_due removes the entry and the commit request fails (send error or error answer), or tap Undo and removePendingPaidMessageReactions fails. Tap the same message again.
effect: Only a note is set ('Stars were not sent' / 'Couldn't undo the Stars'). TDLib still holds the earlier pending Stars for that message, local state says none, so the next tap shows a toast and balance check for the new amount only while the commit that follows spends old + new Stars. The user pays more Stars than the toast showed. The refusal/balance check (total_pending) also ignores the lost reservation.
fix: Make each pending item an enum PendingPaid { Waiting, Committing(request), Undoing(request) } that leaves the list only on TDLib's ok; on error return it to Waiting (or issue removePending) so local and TDLib totals agree.

title: submit_stars_payment has no in-flight guard; only the render disables the button
trigger: Double-click Pay on a Stars/gift/giveaway form faster than a frame
effect: Two sendPaymentForm for a non-message invoice (payment_extra does not dedupe); Stars may be charged twice if the server accepts both
fix: Check checkout_sending()/Paying stage in submit_stars_payment itself

title: The Star reaction box (chat_id, message_id) lives on QuillApp and is not reset on an account switch
trigger: Open the Send Stars box in account A, switch to account B (shortcut or menu) and press Send.
effect: send_paid_box uses A's chat and message ids with B's driver: Stars from B may go to the wrong or missing message. Only closers in paid_reaction_ui.rs set boxed = None; no Farewell closer was found.
fix: Move the box into OnScreen (per account) so the swap replaces it, with an OfAccount owner key.

title: switch_language sets state.switching then returns early on a send error and nothing clears it
trigger: Pick a language while the TDLib sender fails once (closing/unavailable client): add_custom_server_language_pack, set option or getLanguagePackStrings send returns Err via ?
effect: settings.language.switching stays Some with no strings coming; language_ui.rs:204 treats it as 'in flight' so picking the same language again returns early; the reload path (drain_language) also waits for switching.is_none(). Stuck until restart/account switch
fix: Set switching only after all requests are sent, or clear it (and drop the generation) in the Err arm; model as enum Switch { Idle, Switching{generation,..} }

title: Appearance page re-sends getInstalledBackgrounds on every render after it fails (request loop, 'Loading wallpapers' forever)
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance while getInstalledBackgrounds answers with an error (e.g. a FLOOD_WAIT or any TDLib error) and keep the page open.
effect: The error arm (state/domains/chats/error.rs:37-46) only sets chats_state.background_error; installed_backgrounds stays None. ensure_wallpapers_loaded is called from the page's render (settings_window/pages.rs:98) and re-sends whenever installed_backgrounds is None and none is pending, so each error answer re-renders the page and sends the request again, while the gallery shows 'Loading wallpapers...' next to the 'Couldn't update wallpapers' line indefinitely.
fix: Hold the gallery as Fetch<Vec<Background>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) and request only from Idle (and on an explicit retry), not from render; background_error for the other eight purposes stays separate.

title: finished is set by the caller after the worker returns, so a panicking worker leaves the manager polling forever
trigger: Download a dictionary whose files make spellbook or ureq panic in the background task (malformed upstream data).
effect: Row stays at Downloading n% and the 120 ms poll loop notifies every tick; start_dictionary_download returns early because download is Some, so no dictionary can be downloaded until restart.
fix: Set finished from a drop guard in the worker, or drive the row from the worker's Result (JoinHandle) rather than a flag; clear download on any task end.

title: recheck_spelling asks the spell backend on the UI thread
trigger: On macOS with the NSSpellChecker worker stuck, use Add to Dictionary, Remove from Dictionary or Ignore. recheck_spelling calls checker.is_correct for every underlined word of every window after the cache was cleared; the macOS backend waits CHECK_WAIT (5 s) per uncached word on the main thread. build_composer_menu also calls is_correct and suggestions there.
effect: The window freezes for seconds per word.
fix: Drop the word from the list by its text and let schedule_spellcheck re-check in the background.

title: Video-note story reply runs ffmpeg synchronously on the UI thread
trigger: Record a round video as a story reply and press Send (ui/story_viewer/reply_media.rs:457 calls this inside this.update_in).
effect: write_video_note_thumbnail waits for ffmpeg (up to PROBE_LIMIT*3 = 30 s) on the main thread; the whole window freezes during the wait, and with a hung ffmpeg for half a minute.
fix: Make the thumbnail with the capture finish on the background task and pass it in the draft; the driver only sends.

title: A text reply to a story sends clear_draft: true, so TDLib deletes the draft the user has in the poster's chat
trigger: 1. Open the private chat with Alice, type a message and leave it as a draft. 2. Open Alice's story from the story tray. 3. Type a reply in the story viewer's reply field and send it (ConnectDriver story reply, connect/stories/posting.rs:115 -> send_text_story_reply).
effect: The reply is sent to the chat with Alice, and TDLib also deletes that chat's draft (schema td_api.tl:6726 'Pass true to delete message draft in the chat'). The text typed in step 1 is gone. The story reply field is not that chat's composer; Quill already keeps the draft for sends that are not the composer's content (SendOptions::literal_text, composer/send.rs:104-107).
fix: Send clear_draft: false from send_text_story_reply (as the sticker/GIF/voice story replies and the dice already do), so only a send of the chat's own composer content clears its draft.

title: Viewers list re-requests a failed page every frame
trigger: open Viewers on a story with more than one page, scroll to the end so page 2 fails (network drop, flood wait)
effect: fail_story_viewers sets error and loading=false but keeps next_offset, so story_viewers_scrolled (run each frame from story_frame_upkeep and on scroll) sees more==true and sends the same request again, and again after each failure: a request loop at round-trip rate
fix: Fetch-like enum for the page (Idle|Loading|Failed) so a Failed page waits for scroll or Retry

title: sync_live_story marks the live story as watched before the join, and a failed join is never rolled back or retried
trigger: Open a live story while the join cannot start (no call engine, the story not cached as Live yet, or any join_live_story Err such as InvalidRequest/CallsUnavailable). sync_live_story sets stories.live.watching = target, then join_watched_live_story only sets a note on Err.
effect: watching == the shown story, so live_story_media draws the empty live frame (spinner state, no player) and the 'Join live' button in story_viewer_overlay never shows; sync does not rejoin because watching.is_some(); the Retry overlay only appears for a tracked failed call (join_failed), which never exists. The user sees a stuck opening spinner until they step away or close the viewer.
fix: Make the live join one enum on LiveStoryUi (Idle, Joining{story}, Joined{story}, Failed{story,err}); set Joining only when join_live_story returns Ok, set Failed on Err so the overlay shows Retry/Join, and let sync retry from Idle.

title: A failed older page of a comment thread is re-requested at round-trip speed
trigger: Open a channel post's comments (or a group reply thread), scroll to the top of the loaded replies so the older page is requested, and have getMessageThreadHistory fail (network error, swept as lost after its TTL, or a persistent TDLib error such as losing access to the discussion group).
effect: fail_thread only records a failure for the newer side (newer_failed) or for a thread that is not Ready yet. An older-page failure of a Ready thread leaves no mark, loaded_complete stays false, and fetch_thread_history (called from maybe_auto_load_older on every render with row 0 shown, and from preload_history_by_scroll) sends the same page again as soon as the answer lands: a request loop with no Retry row, unlike the main history's load_failed.
fix: Give each end of the thread window a page state (Idle | Loading{request} | Failed) on TopicHistory, set Failed in fail_thread for the older end and have fetch_thread_history wait for an explicit Retry, as the main history's load_failed does.

title: Instant View is session-wide state drawn in every window
trigger: Open a chat in its own window, click an Instant View link there.
effect: session.messages.instant_view is drawn by both app_render/mod.rs:580 and chat_window/body.rs:149, so the page covers the main window and every chat window; Escape in any window (it is in WINDOW_LAYERS) closes it in all; instant_view_fallback_url is taken and opened by whichever window renders first.
fix: Record the asking window with the page (InstantViewOpen{window, page}) or move the open page into the WindowSlot, and draw/close it only there.

title: request_passkeys clears stale and error before the send; a failed send loses the stale refetch
trigger: Remove a passkey (marks list stale), the refetch send fails.
effect: state.stale=false and requested_at set before send_json_request; on Err the list stays showing the removed passkey and the 5 s throttle blocks the next attempt.
fix: Fetch<Passkeys> with Stale cleared by the answer; set requested_at only after a successful send.

title: A failed or cancelled account export leaves a truncated, unterminated result.json and no export_results.html
trigger: Start a JSON-format account export of many chats, press Cancel (or lose the connection so a section call fails) midway.
effect: The DataExport folder keeps result.json cut off mid-array (ResultJson::finish and the index page are only written on the success path), so a later tool reading it fails or silently sees a partial export, and the folder holds private account data with no marker that it is incomplete.
fix: On Err/Cancel finish the ResultJson (close arrays) or write an 'incomplete' marker; better, write to result.json.part and rename on success.

title: Passkey creation options that arrive after the user cancelled still start a system sheet
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Passkeys > Create Passkey, then Cancel/Esc (close_passkey_ceremony) before getPasskeyParameters answers.
effect: close_passkey_ceremony only clears the UI ceremony; the request is not cancelled and the driver's `passkeys.ceremony` is not cleared. apply_passkey_parameters then stores `ceremony`, the still-running ticker (passkey_creation_busy is true while the request is in flight) takes it in tick_passkey_ceremony and starts a hardware-key/system ceremony with a box the user already closed.
fix: Tie the options to a request id held in the registration enum; closing the box moves the stage to Idle so a late answer is ignored.

title: A theme save that fails after the QR box closed is dropped without a word
trigger: Pick a new backdrop in your QR box, close the box (Closing sends setProfileShareTheme), then the request fails (offline, rights lost)
effect: The box is gone and the poll step clears save_answers when no box is open (ui/peer_qr/mod.rs drain_peer_qr), so no toast; the person believes the theme was saved but the server still has the old one
fix: Report a save failure through the app's note (set_note) when no box is open to take the answer, or keep the failed pick in the session until the next box shows it.

title: A hidden account export pops its progress box open again after switching accounts and back
trigger: Settings > Data & Storage > Export Telegram data > Start, press Hide; switch to account B; switch back to account A while the export still runs.
effect: DialogUi (OnScreen) is rebuilt on each switch, so account_export_progress_hidden is back to false while A's Session still holds settings.account_export; the AccountExport is_open (`!hidden && export.is_some()`) is true and the progress box opens unasked over A's main window.
fix: Keep whether the progress is shown with the export itself (an AccountExport view stage in the Session next to account_export, or derive 'shown' from an explicit Open request), not in a screen flag whose default means 'shown'.

title: A failed account switch has already torn down the screen, and a failed set_active_account leaves no account on screen
trigger: Accounts > Switch to another account when the app root is unavailable or credentials are missing (screen wiped, old account kept), or when writing the active-account record fails (read-only or full disk).
effect: end_account_surfaces (farewell + replace_screen, new epoch) runs before the safe_app_root/credentials checks, so the first failures close the open chat and every box while self.live stays the same account. If set_active_account fails, retire_live_to_background already moved the client away and the function returns with self.live None: the window shows no account, and the Accounts dialog still marks the old account Active (from disk) with no Switch button for it, so only a restart brings it back.
fix: Check everything that can fail (root, credentials, the active-account write) before end_account_surfaces/retire_live_to_background, or roll back by adopting the retired client; put_on_screen should be the one place where live and the screen change together.

title: Registration form is cleared when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: On the sign-up step enter a name, accept the terms, press Create Account; the server rejects it (invalid name, flood) and auth stays WaitRegistration.
effect: submit_registration clears first and last name and accepted_registration_terms on a successful send; the answer is an error, the form is empty and the terms checkbox is unticked again, so the user retypes everything. submit_email does the same for the email (auth_ui.rs:44).
fix: Clear on the accepted answer (auth leaves WaitRegistration), or keep the values and only clear when the step changes.

title: Background accounts get the raw window focus as app_active, not the lock-aware value the on-screen account gets
trigger: Have two accounts. Lock Quill with a passcode and leave its lock screen focused (or just use Quill in the foreground). A message or reaction arrives on the account that is not on screen.
effect: poll_background copies frame.window_active (OS focus of any Quill window) into every background session's app_active. decide_notification_sound and decide_reaction_notify return nothing while app_active is true, so the background account makes no sound and no reaction notification while Quill is locked but focused. poll_live uses !refused_while_locked() && main focus for the on-screen account, and lock-is-a-render-state.md section 4 says background sessions get the same value.
fix: One 'looked at' value (focus and not locked) computed in one place and used by poll_live and poll_background; a background account is never looked at, so consider false for it.

title: Terms prompt step and age tick are never reset, so the next terms update opens on a stale step with the age box pre-ticked
trigger: Accept terms (age box ticked) or tap Decline then Decline and Delete; later the server sends another updateTermsOfService (or the first prompt is cleared from another device while the step is DeclineSorry/DeleteWarning)
effect: The new terms prompt opens straight on the Decline sorry / Delete account step instead of the terms text, or with the minimum-age confirmation already ticked so the user never confirms their age for the new terms
fix: Hold one TermsPrompt { terms_id, stage: Terms{age_ok, age_error}|DeclineSorry|DeleteWarning } keyed by the terms id; replace it whole when notices.terms changes or clears.

title: Agree and Continue ignores a failed acceptTermsOfService send, so the locked terms box does nothing and says nothing
trigger: Terms box open (not closable), network/sender down so driver.accept_terms returns Err (terms_in_flight reset to false)
effect: Tap Agree and Continue: button flashes back to idle, no error text, no toast; the box cannot be closed, user is stuck without feedback
fix: On Err set notices.terms_error (or a status note) from the send error; model terms acceptance as Fetch<()> with the error shown in the box.

title: Force-logout notice is dismissed before the logout request is sent, and a failed logout send is dropped
trigger: AUTH_KEY_DROP service notice shown; press Log out while request_logout returns Err (auth not Ready, sender error)
effect: The locked notice vanishes, the account stays on screen as if usable though the server dropped its key, no error shown, no way to get the notice back
fix: Dismiss the notice only after request_logout returns Ok (or when the LogOut answer lands); on Err keep the notice and show an error.

title: A color or emoji pick saved on close fails silently
trigger: In your own or a public group's QR box pick a color, close the box at once while offline or without the right to change info.
effect: close_qr_box runs QrAction::Closing, which sends the save, then drops the box. The answer arrives later and drain_peer_qr clears data.save_answers when no box is open, so the failure never reaches a toast and the user believes the share theme was saved.
fix: Report a failed close-time save through the app's status note (an owner that outlives the box) instead of discarding the answer.

title: A finished passkey ceremony is dropped silently when finish_register / finish_login refuses
trigger: Create Passkey, touch the key; between the ceremony start and its end `chats_path_active()` turned false (reconnect) or `adding` is still true from the previous try. For sign-in, the authorization state moved on.
effect: `let _ = live.driver.finish_register(&registration)` ignores the Err: the dialog closes as if saved but no passkey is added and no message is shown; the user touched the key for nothing.
fix: Surface the Err as a note and keep the dialog on an error sheet, or queue the registration until the connection is back.

title: Code step shows the rejected new number after a failed Wrong number resend
trigger: On the code step press Wrong number?, type a number TDLib rejects (invalid, flood, banned) and press Continue. submit_phone (auth_ui.rs:79-80) sets submitted_phone and clears editing_phone as soon as the request is sent, not when TDLib accepts it.
effect: TDLib stays in WaitCode for the old number, the screen flips back to the code step, and its body says the code was sent to the new, rejected number (signin_view reads submitted_phone) with the error line under it.
fix: Hold the number as a SignInStep enum (EnterPhone, Sending{phone}, CodeSentTo{phone}) advanced by the auth state change, so a rejected send returns to EnterPhone with the old CodeSentTo intact.

title: claim treats an unreadable or missing owner.json as no previous owner, so a different user inherits the old user's data
trigger: Sign in as user A, owner.json write fails (full disk, read-only) or the file is corrupt or deleted; A logs out without forget finishing or the folder predates owner.json; user B signs in on the same account-N slot
effect: previous is None, so claim returns false and nothing is forgotten: B sees A's agent grants, mini app trust, recent hashtags, widget storage and mini app web data
fix: Make the owner a typed `Owner::{Unknown, Known(user_id)}`; Unknown with leftover per-account files counts as someone else and forgets, and a failed owner write is reported instead of only logged.

title: An export worker that panics ends without publishing a settled stage; the progress box never gets Done
trigger: The account (or chat) export worker thread panics inside spawn_guarded (any future indexing/unwrap bug, or the debug_assert in ResultJson::field in debug builds). guarded() swallows it, the closure's trailing publish(Failed) never runs, only the alive sender drops.
effect: Progress stays at e.g. 'Chats: 3 of 40' for ever, the Done button (only shown when settled) never appears, a new export is refused with 'already running', and every Quit shows 'Stop and quit?'. worker_ended() is not read anywhere outside tests to settle it.
fix: Settle on worker end: a drop guard in the thread body that publishes Failed('stopped unexpectedly') when no final stage was written, or poll worker_ended() and map it to a Failed stage.

title: adding sticks when the addLoginPasskey answer cannot be parsed or its continuation is dropped
trigger: Create Passkey; complete the ceremony; the server's `passkey` answer has no id (Passkey::parse returns None, parse_payload returns None) or the request is dropped by a reconnect/closed client.
effect: `adding` is cleared only by accept_added and the Add error arm. Otherwise passkey_creation_busy() stays true and begin_register/finish_register refuse (`state.adding`), so Create Passkey stays disabled for the rest of the session.
fix: One enum Registration { Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(options), Sending(request), Done } with the request id; clear Sending on any answer to that id and when the request is dropped.

title: An in-flight list answer undoes a removal and clears the stale mark
trigger: Open Passkeys (getLoginPasskeys in flight), delete a passkey before the list answer lands. removeLoginPasskey ok sets stale=true but request_passkeys skips because the List is in flight; then the older list answer arrives.
effect: accept_list replaces the list (the deleted passkey is back), sets known=true and stale=false, so no refetch happens and the deleted passkey shows until the user leaves and returns after more than 5 s.
fix: Carry a list generation (bumped by finish_remove) in the List request and apply the answer only when it matches; otherwise keep stale=true.

title: Quarantining a corrupt accounts.json forgets pending_deletes, so a requested wipe is not finished
trigger: lock-screen Log out records every account in pending_deletes, Quill quits or crashes, accounts.json is found unparsable on the next start
effect: the file is renamed aside and the default registry (primary, no pending deletes) is used; the folders the user asked to wipe stay on disk and primary opens its old database
fix: On a corrupt registry, recover pending_deletes from the quarantined text (or a separate wipe marker file) before starting any client.

title: After a partly failed review, retry re-sends confirmSession/terminateSession for sessions already reviewed
trigger: Two unconfirmed sessions; one confirmSession answers ok and the other errors; user presses Yes again
effect: unconfirmed_entries is kept whole on error (only cleared on a fully clean review), so the retry includes the already confirmed session and errors again; the banner keeps the old error text until the next press
fix: Remove an entry when its own request succeeds; keep per-entry result in the Reviewing stage.

title: Lock-screen log out ignores Deletion::Done { error } and reconnects as if the wipe worked
trigger: Lock Quill, press Log out on the lock screen while one account folder cannot be deleted (file held open, permissions).
effect: The passcode is already forgotten (forget_passcode runs before the wipe). The done closure matches Deletion::Done { .. }, drops the error, clears wiping, calls disk_accounts_wiped and start_connection. The user sees a fresh sign-in with no note while the old account's data is still on disk until the next start.
fix: Handle Done { error: Some(_) } like Deferred: keep a note that the data is still there, and do not report the wipe as complete.

title: dismiss_account_notice pops a force-logout service notice although its dialog is meant to be undismissable
trigger: Force-logout (AUTH_KEY_DROP_*) notice open (Esc, backdrop and close button disabled); any programmatic close of the AccountNotice kit dialog runs the registered close (agent-blocked layer close, close_window_boxes, left-dialog close in shell)
effect: The notice that must end in Log out is popped and never shown again; user is left in a dead session
fix: The Service arm of dismiss_account_notice should do nothing when the front notice is_force_logout, as the comment above it says.

title: Passcode job result is thrown away when its window closed
trigger: Type the passcode on a chat window's lock screen (or press Turn on/off in the settings box) and close that window during the PBKDF2 run.
effect: run_passcode_job's Err branch only ends the job: a correct unlock leaves the global master key set but the app still locked and every window on the lock screen; a finished Turn off leaves enabled = true on a disk with no passcode, so the next lock cannot be opened. (system_unlock_wait handles this case, this path does not.)
fix: Run the result handler on the main window when the asking window is gone (as unlock_in_main_window does) so the answer always lands once; store the job as PasscodeJob::Running{kind, asker}.

title: Gifts grid can ask for the next page on every frame
trigger: Open the gifts panel of a box with more than one page while the driver refuses the request (auth not Ready, shutdown, or the owner not known).
effect: Each build of the last row defers QrAction::MoreGifts when gifts.wants_more is true. fetch_share_theme_gifts returns Err before gifts.start() sets loading, so wants_more stays true; the effect makes qr_act notify, the grid builds again and asks again.
fix: Set a retry deadline (or Fetch::Failed) in the early-Err path of fetch_share_theme_gifts, and make ThemeGifts one enum.

title: QR box clock keeps asking for a contact link while Quill is locked
trigger: Open your own QR box (hidden number, temporary contact link with a countdown), lock Quill and wait past expiry.
effect: The box stays open under the lock (the lock drops what is drawn, close_for_lock does not close it). The 1 s qr_clock loop keeps running: ensure_qr_contact_link calls ensure_own_contact_link, which sends getUserLink, and qr_act(Tick) runs the reducer, with no refused_while_locked check.
fix: Gate qr_clock and ensure_qr_contact_link on lock_waits(), or close the QR box in close_for_lock.

title: Two-step password/email form clears and returns to Status even when the send failed
trigger: Change/enable/disable 2FA, press submit while set_two_step_password or set_recovery_email returns Err (connection not ready/shutdown).
effect: All inputs are emptied, the view goes to Status with no error line; the change was never sent and the typed password/hint/email are lost, so the box looks saved.
fix: Keep the form until the driver accepts; on Err set twofa.notice and stay on the form (a Submit stage enum: Editing/Sending/Failed).

title: `added` flag is only consumed by the ticker, which the lock ends: it sticks and closes the next Create box
trigger: Create a passkey, lock Quill while addLoginPasskey is in flight (ticker ends via close_passkey_ceremony_for_lock), the answer lands and sets PasskeysState::added; unlock, open Protect your account, press Create Passkey.
effect: The first tick of the new ticker takes the old added=true and sets about_open=false: the Protect your account box closes at once under the new ceremony.
fix: Turn adding/added/ceremony into one PasskeyAdd enum (Idle, Options, Adding, Added) consumed by whichever frame sees it, or reset added when the ticker starts.

title: Recovery and login-email forms clear the typed code, new password and hint right after sending, whatever the outcome
trigger: Forgot password > enter a wrong code and a new password > Save (or enter a bad login email > submit)
effect: The server rejects it but the inputs are already empty, so the user retypes everything; also cleared when the driver call itself returned Err (error ignored with let _)
fix: Clear inputs when the success answer arrives, and show the error when the send fails.

title: Revoke refuses an agent by its self-declared client name, so it is both evadable and too broad
trigger: Settings > Agent access: Disconnect an agent connected as 'Claude Code' (or one that sent no client name, shown 'An agent'). server.rs authenticate() takes the name from the unauthenticated-by-identity 'client' param; revoke() pushes that name into REFUSED and serve() checks activity::refused(&agent).
effect: The revoked process still holds the valid token and reconnects under any other --client name and is accepted; meanwhile every other agent that reports the same name (a second Claude Code session, or every nameless agent as 'An agent') is refused until the user clicks Allow again or restarts.
fix: Make the connection identity an id minted by Quill (and a token per client, or revoke = reset token); refuse by that identity, and show name only as a label.

title: Chat class cache (OwnChannel/Bot/Saved) is process-wide, never invalidated and never pruned
trigger: An agent reads the user's channel (class OwnChannel, covered by the own-channels default). The user then transfers ownership or leaves it. The agent calls again.
effect: classify returns the cached OwnChannel, so the grant default keeps applying to a channel the user no longer owns until Quill restarts. The maps also keep an entry per (client, chat) for every closed client.
fix: Key the cache by the live Client and drop it with the client (or do not cache OwnChannel and re-read the supergroup status per call).

title: Failed save of agent grants is only logged, the cache keeps the new value
trigger: User removes a chat grant (or turns All chats off) while agent_grants.json cannot be written (disk full, read-only); the Settings page shows it revoked
effect: Agents are refused this run; after restart the old grant is read back from disk and the revoked chat is readable again with no sign to the user
fix: Make change_all return Result and have the Settings page show the save error; keep the cache equal to what is on disk.

title: resources/subscribe is lost silently when the bridge reconnects
trigger: Agent subscribes to quill://unread; Quill restarts or Agent access is toggled off and on; the next forwarded call opens a new link
effect: The old server-side watcher stopped with its connection and nothing resubscribes, so the agent believes it is subscribed and never hears about new messages
fix: Keep the subscription as bridge state (subscribed: Set<Uri>) and replay it on open_link, or tell the agent with an error when the link it subscribed on died.

title: A write that already went out is reported to the agent as 'Agent access is off'
trigger: Agent calls send_message; the user turns Agent access off (or presses Revoke) while the tool runs; the tool finishes the send, then Reply::drop replaces its result with the ACCESS_OFF error
effect: The agent is told its action did not run though the message was sent, and may retry it after access is back on, sending twice
fix: Let a finished tool result win for write tools (send the result with a note that access went off) or make Reply carry whether the call had side effects.

title: A write waits up to two minutes for a click after the agent has gone away
trigger: Agent calls send_message with Confirm each send on, then cancels the request or disconnects (not revoked); the user later clicks Allow within 120 s
effect: The message is sent for a call nobody waits on; the agent never sees the result and may send it again
fix: Tie the prompt to the call: withdraw it when the connection closes or the request is cancelled and check that in still_allowed.

title: One failed message in an album or forward fails the whole call although the others were delivered
trigger: Agent calls send_file with 3 to 10 files or forward_messages with many ids and one slot ends Sent::Failed while others succeed
effect: The call returns an error, the log records ok=false with no message_ids (so nothing can be undone), and the agent retries, sending duplicates
fix: Return a per-message outcome list (Delivered/Failed) and log the delivered ids; error only when none was delivered.

title: A send that Telegram has not delivered in 30 s is reported and logged as sent with its temporary message id
trigger: Agent sends a message while the network is slow (no updateMessageSendSucceeded within DELIVERY_WAIT), then the user opens the activity log and clicks undo or the agent edits/deletes by the returned id
effect: The tool answers ok with a local temporary id; the activity row stores that id in message_ids, so undo/open acts on a stale id (nothing, or an error) after the message gets its final id, and a later failure of the send is never reported
fix: Make the send result an enum Delivered(final) / Failed / StillSending(temp id) and log StillSending as such, resolving the id when the update arrives instead of storing the temp id.

title: Adding a chat to a folder rewrites the whole folder from a read taken before the queue turn
trigger: User edits the folder (renames it, adds chats) in Quill or another device while the agent runs set_chat_folder (getChatFolder happens before take_write_turn, which can wait on the paced queue)
effect: editChatFolder sends the stale folder back and silently undoes the user's folder change
fix: Do the read inside the same queue turn as the write, or send only a delta; re-read right before editChatFolder.

title: A command the UI already ran is reported as a timeout and the agent retries it
trigger: UI thread injects a click or keys, then takes more than 15 s to settle or answer; Ticket::wait sets cancelled after the injection and returns Timeout
effect: Tool says the window did not answer; the agent retries, so a toggle or a send click runs twice
fix: Make the stage one enum (Queued, Running, Answered, Abandoned) and report 'ran, answer lost' when Running at timeout.

title: A lost output device silently ends system audio while the call still says it is sharing it
trigger: Share a screen with system audio on Windows, then unplug headphones or change the default output
effect: The error callback calls StreamErrors::check and discards the Fatal result; the stream goes dead, the mix queue drains, and CallScreen::sharing_audio() stays true with no event or toast
fix: Report a fatal stream error back to the opener (a channel or DeviceRun::Failed) so SharedAudio leaves its running stage and the UI shows audio off.

title: connect_group marks the call connected before its fallible steps, so a retry reports success without finishing the join
trigger: Join a voice chat with the camera on while the camera cannot be opened (in use by another app or unplugged), or while qc_group_set_requested_video refuses the sources. connect_group sets connected=true, then apply_group_camera/sync_group_videos returns Err. connect/group_calls/mod.rs:157 stores transport_error and leaves transport_ready false; on the next poll it calls connect_group_call again.
effect: The second call hits `if call.connected { return Ok(()) }`, so the driver sets transport_ready=true, clears transport_error and records group_camera_state=Some(camera). The UI shows camera on and no error while the engine never opened the camera (and the mute/video setup after the failed step never ran).
fix: Make the join a typestate (Created, Joining, Connected{mode}) and enter Connected only after every step succeeded, or run the steps first and flip the stage last; a failed step leaves the stage at Joining so the retry redoes it.

title: CreateJoinAs answer is Option<Result<_,()>> in the session, consumed only by a waiting box
trigger: Start video chat in a group, then close the 'Start' box (or switch chat) before getUserAvailableParticipants answers; or the request is dropped without an answer/error
effect: The answer stays in calls.create_join_as until the next request overwrites it; if no answer or error ever arrives the box sits in CreateStep::Waiting with no way out except the user cancelling. In-flight, answered and failed are one Option<Result> plus a separate failed_creates side list
fix: Make the create flow one enum on the box (Asking(request) / Answered(list) / Failed) owned by GroupCallCreate via the Asker seam, so closing the box drops the request and an answer is matched to it; remove the session-level create_join_as.

title: Level tap error closes the source but leaves 'speaking' true and never sends is_speaking=false
trigger: Join a group call, unmute and talk, then unplug or lose the microphone so source.error() returns Some
effect: pump_call_audio closes the tap and returns early; speaking and the tracker are not reset, deadline() returns None (no source), and the open retry path (line 344) returns Ok(false) too, so the self tile keeps showing 'speaking' and TDLib is never told false until a reopen succeeds or the call is muted
fix: Route the error arm through the same 'cannot speak' teardown as the wanted==None arm (reset tracker, send false), or make the tap one enum (Closed, Opening, Open{speaking}, Failed{at,error}).

title: rating_sent is set before the answer and the SendCallRating error arm never clears it
trigger: End a call, rate it, TDLib sendCallRating fails (offline, flood)
effect: summary.rating_sent stays true so the rating card is gone (call_ui hides on rating_sent) and send_call_rating refuses; only a calls.error line shows; the rating cannot be retried
fix: Rating as enum Rating{Asking, Sending(RequestId), Sent}; the error arm returns to Asking (as SendCallLog does for log_sent).

title: Link confirmed after leaving a call loses live_stream and the stream join intent
trigger: In a voice chat, open a channel live stream link (?livestream=), confirm 'Leave and join live stream'. call_link_after_leave stores only (chat_id, hash) and maybe_offer_pending_call_link calls offer_call_link(.., false).
effect: The UI path (ui/call_link_ui.rs offer_call_link) that calls note_stream_join_intent(StreamJoinIntent::Call) and shows 'Opening the live stream' is skipped, so the stream does not open in its window and no note shows; a repeated Busy would also word the question as a voice chat.
fix: Keep the whole CallLinkConfirm (or a LinkTarget{chat,hash,live_stream}) in the Leaving stage and report the resulting CallLinkStep back to the UI so it records the join intent.

title: extras_requested is set before the three live-story requests; a send failure aborts the rest and an error answer is never retried
trigger: Watch a non-stream live story; getLiveStoryStreamer errors or its send fails
effect: streamer stays None for the whole watch, so live_story_live_key returns None and no picture is drawn; top donors/senders may never load; only reopening the story retries
fix: Three Fetch<T> fields on LiveStoryState, requested while Idle, retried from Failed on a user action.

title: A failed presentation connect clears the local screen-share flags but never ends the screen share TDLib already started
trigger: Start screen share in a joined group call; startGroupCallScreenSharing answers, then engine.connect_screen_share fails
effect: Quill shows not sharing (and stops the native presentation) while other participants still see you as sharing a dead screen; no endGroupCallScreenSharing is sent
fix: One ScreenShare enum (Idle, Offering, Answered, Sharing, Failed) whose Failed exit sends endGroupCallScreenSharing.

title: A failed call rating is marked sent and the rating card is dismissed
trigger: Rate a call from the end screen while the sendCallRating request fails (flood wait, offline)
effect: send_call_rating sets rating_sent=true after the send; the SendCallRating error arm (domains/calls/error.rs) only sets calls.error and never clears rating_sent, so the card is gone and the rating is lost with only a status line; the UI note said Thanks for your feedback because the send itself returned Ok
fix: Upload enum with Sending then Sent on ok or Failed on error, keyed by the request id; show the card again on Failed.

title: A failed busy-decline or swap-prompt decline shows 'Could not hang up the call' on the active call
trigger: In a call, a second caller rings and is declined as busy (or the swap prompt's Decline is used); the caller already cancelled so discardCall errors (e.g. 400)
effect: The error banner 'Could not hang up the call' appears on the ongoing call's overlay although nothing about that call failed. All three discardCall senders use the same RequestPurpose::DiscardCall and the arm sets calls.error whenever hang_up does not match
fix: Give the decline discard its own purpose (DeclineCall{call_id}) and set calls.error only for the request that owns HangUp

title: A failed sendCallRating still shows Thanks for your feedback
trigger: End a call, rate it and Submit while the request fails (flood, network error).
effect: send_call_rating sets rating_sent=true before the answer; apply_calls_error for SendCallRating sets only calls.error and never reverts rating_sent. The card shows Thanks, the rating was lost, and the error appears only after the card is dismissed (the summary branch does not draw it). Debug upload and log reset their sent flag on error, the rating does not.
fix: Per-upload enum NotNeeded/Offer/Sending{request}/Sent/Failed(err); rating moves Sending to Sent only on ok and to Failed on error.

title: redial dismisses the end summary before the offline check
trigger: Go offline, end a call whose summary offers a rating or diagnostics upload, press Call again in the call window or end card.
effect: The summary (rating prompt, upload buttons) is dropped, the call is refused with the offline note, so the rating can no longer be given. redial and call_again also skip refuse_without_call_engine and end in a generic Could not start the call.
fix: Run the offline and engine checks first and dismiss the summary only once the dial is accepted.

title: Engine refusals of capture frames are counted but never shown
trigger: Join a call where the engine rejects external frames (qc_external_frame error, e.g. after the transport drops): every frame fails.
effect: FeederStats::failed/rejected/last_error are read nowhere outside tests (only stats().sent() is used), so the microphone or screen share looks live while nothing reaches the call; the failure is only an eprintln once a second. last_error is also never cleared after recovery.
fix: Have the driver poll the stats and turn a run of failures into CaptureEvent::Failed / an ActiveCapture error stage.

title: A start that times out leaves the SCStream possibly capturing with no owner
trigger: Start a screen share while macOS is slow to answer startCapture (over 5 s)
effect: recv_timeout fails and start returns Err, but stopCapture is never called and the stream is only dropped; if the handler fires late the system may keep the stream and the recording indicator on while Quill shows the share as failed
fix: On the timeout and error arms call stream.stopCaptureWithCompletionHandler(None) and mark StreamShared stopped before returning.

title: X11 record thread can end while the Controller still reports Active
trigger: Joined with push-to-talk on under X11; the record data connection errors (X server restart, reply Err) or record_enable_context fails in the thread; thread returns without telling anyone.
effect: Handle is still held by Controller (HookState::Active, status note 'Works system-wide'), but no key edges ever arrive: system-wide push-to-talk silently stops until the call or setting changes. If the key was down at that moment the microphone stays open (see key filter entry).
fix: Hook thread reports its end through the Sink or a shared HookLife enum (Running/Ended(reason)); Controller.sync treats an ended handle as Failed and restarts or surfaces it.

title: Playback watch falls back only once, even when the reopen failed
trigger: Watch a live stream whose output device vanishes; observe() returns OutputFailed and sets fell_back; reopen_stream_sound fails (device not back yet, stream.rs:251).
effect: fell_back is never cleared (entry removed only when the feeder closes), so the stream stays silent for the rest of the call with no further retry, though the device may return.
fix: enum WatchStage { Watching{live_since}, Reopened{attempts}, GaveUp } reset by the driver when reopen returns Ok or a new output is built.

title: Share wanted and source chosen but no frame sender: stays 'sharing' with nothing sent and no error
trigger: Start screen share in a call whose engine is unavailable or has not created external sources (external_frame_sender returns None)
effect: pump_shared_screen returns silently every pump; the session says screen_sharing, the call window shows the share as live, but no capture is opened and call_screen.error is never set
fix: Waiting-for-engine as an explicit Share stage with a timeout/error that ends the share via stop_sharing_screen.
