title: Stopping a screen share clears the local flags before TDLib answers endGroupCallScreenSharing
trigger: Stop sharing while the end request fails (flood, call already gone)
effect: UI shows not sharing and the native presentation is stopped, while the server may still list the screen as shared; no way back into the Sharing state
fix: ScreenShare::Stopping(request) that becomes Idle on ok and Sharing/Failed on error.

title: Self mute flag is flipped locally but Telegram is told only when your own participant row exists
trigger: Mute or unmute right after joining, before the participant list contains the current user
effect: is_muted_self changes and the engine follows, but toggleGroupCallParticipantIsMuted is never sent; other participants keep the old icon and the next server row can flip the button back
fix: Keep an intended-mute value to send once the row arrives, or send it by group call id for self.

title: call_link_after_leave is never cleared on a failed leave, a cancel, a new call or an account switch
trigger: In a call, open a voice chat link, confirm 'End call and join'. discard_call/leave_group_call errors are discarded (`let _ =`) so the call stays up (network down). Keep using the app; later hang up the call normally.
effect: maybe_offer_pending_call_link runs from ingest once no call is on and silently offers/fetches the old link's call, opening a join screen the user abandoned long ago; nothing else ever clears the Option.
fix: Fold call_link/call_link_confirm/call_link_after_leave into one CallLinkStage enum (Idle, Asking(confirm), Leaving{chat,hash,since_call}, Offered(link)) whose Leaving arm exits on the leave error, on a different call starting, and in CallBoxes::farewell.

title: A failing connect_group_call is retried after every reducer update because join_payload stays set while transport_ready is false
trigger: Join a call where the engine rejects the join answer (bad device, engine error); any group-call update then arrives
effect: pump_group_call_transport calls pump_one_group_call per update, which re-runs refresh_call_devices, connect_group_call and note_stream_rtmp_info each time; you stay joined on the server with no media and no leave
fix: Transport::Failed(err) consumes the payload; only a rejoin or the Join button starts a new attempt.

title: A stream reply of Left stops the transport and clears the payload but starts no rejoin and leaves the call tracked and joined
trigger: A stream part request answers GROUP_CALL_LEFT while TDLib still reports the call joined
effect: No media and no automatic recovery; transport_ready false, join_payload empty, so neither the connect pump nor auto rejoin acts until an updateGroupCall
fix: Route Left through rejoin.want() or a Transport::Lost variant the UI shows with Rejoin.

title: Settings > Calls spawns a fetch and notifies every frame while the sessions list stays idle
trigger: Open Settings > Calls while the session is not Authorization Ready or ShutdownPhase is not Running (for example while logging out, or the first moments after a reconnect), or while send_json fails. call_device_prefs_section runs in render; sessions.is_idle() is true, so it spawn_screen's a task that calls maybe_fetch_active_sessions (returns Err(InvalidRequest) before sessions.begin(), so the state stays Idle) and then cx.notify()s unconditionally when live is Some. The notify re-renders the section, which spawns again.
effect: A redraw plus task-spawn loop at frame rate for as long as the page is open and the fetch cannot start; CPU/battery drain.
fix: Start the fetch from upkeep keyed on the Fetch state (Idle -> Loading) and notify only when the request was actually sent (Ok(Some(_))); never notify from a no-op.

title: A failed call-window open is retried by every frame and posts its error each time
trigger: A call rings in (or is placed) and cx.open_window fails (display gone, OS refusal). open_call_window clears calls.window_opening and sets the 'Couldn't open the call window' note, but sets nothing that stops sync_call_window: wanted stays Some(id) with calls.window None, so the next sync_call_windows (the poll and every window's frame; the note/notify re-renders) calls open_call_window again.
effect: A loop of open attempts and repeated error toasts (a request/redraw loop) for the length of the call.
fix: Make the call window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call_id)) so a failure records the call it failed for and sync does not retry until the call changes.

title: Dial answer not matched to the dial that asked: one shared dialing slot read by a generic continuation
trigger: Place a voice call to A while the microphone prompt is open (access Undetermined), then press video call to B (dialing is overwritten with (B,true)). Grant the microphone: the first continuation re-checks only the microphone, passes, and dial_allowed takes (B,true).
effect: A video call to B is sent although camera access was never granted or was still being asked, and A is never called. After a denied prompt dialing also stays Some with nothing to clear it.
fix: Carry (user_id,is_video) inside the continuation (or a DialStage enum Idle/AwaitingAccess{request}/Sent with a request token) and clear it on the denied arm and on cancel; do not read a shared slot from a generic callback.

title: A failed call window open re-notes the error on every sync
trigger: Join a voice chat on a platform/state where cx.open_window returns Err; sync_call_windows runs every frame/poll, window stays None while the call is wanted, so open_group_call_window runs again
effect: The 'could not open the video chat' note is raised again and again, and an open attempt is made on every sync
fix: Make the window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call id)) so a failed open for a call is remembered and not retried until the call changes.

title: ArchiveMute::reload_pending is cleared only by a successful settings answer; the error arm leaves it set
trigger: Server sends suggestedActionEnableArchiveAndMuteNewChats while the network is flaky (or send_json fails in reload_archive_chat_list_settings), so getArchiveChatListSettings fails. chat_list/error.rs resets archive_settings_loading but not archive_mute.reload_pending. Cached settings exist, so nothing reloads again.
effect: suggestion_due stays false for the rest of the session: the 'Hide new chats?' box never appears and the reload is never retried.
fix: Make the reload a stage enum (Idle, Reloading, Failed) owned by ArchiveMute and leave Reloading in the error arm and the send-failure arm of reload_archive_chat_list_settings.

title: reorderChatFolders and toggleChatFolderTags are applied optimistically with no rollback and no error arm
trigger: Drag a folder tab / flip folder tags while TDLib refuses or errors
effect: apply_folder_order / are_folder_tags_enabled stay at the refused value (no PendingRequest.rollback set, no arm in chat_list/error.rs) and no error line shows, until a later updateChatFolders
fix: Attach RequestRollback::{FolderOrder, FolderTags} like ChatPinOrder and add error arms.

title: maybe_finish_leave_deletes takes the whole queue and drops the rest on the first error
trigger: Delete and leave several basic groups; leaveChat answers; the first removeChatFromList send returns Err (chats path inactive or native send failure)
effect: delete_after_leave was emptied with mem::take and `?` returns, so the failing chat and all later ones are never deleted: the group is left but stays in the chat list
fix: Peek/drain one at a time, or put unsent chat ids back on error (as maybe_finish_folder_removals does).

title: set_top_chats_disabled is optimistic and a refused setOption is never rolled back
trigger: Settings > turn off 'Suggest frequent contacts' while the setOption call fails (server error).
effect: top_chats_disabled=true and the strip is cleared locally; the error handler only sets a chat_action_error note, so the toggle shows the wrong value until restart and no refetch happens.
fix: Make the toggle a Pending{wanted}/Confirmed value; on error go back to the confirmed value and refetch top chats.

title: A failed RemoveRecentlyFoundChat / RemoveTopChat does not restore the optimistic removal
trigger: Search > Recent: remove a recent chat or a frequent contact while the request fails.
effect: The row is gone locally and an error line is set, but the server still has it; it reappears only on the next refetch (restart).
fix: Carry the removed row in the purpose (like SetInactiveSessionTtl { previous }) and put it back in the error arm, or refetch the list on error.

title: A failed older page of in-chat search ends the results silently, no retry
trigger: Open in-chat search with more hits than one page, scroll to load the next page, drop the connection or get a flood error.
effect: next_from_message_id is zeroed so can_load_more is false for good: the list ends at N of M with no error and no Retry until the search is rerun.
fix: Keep the cursor and add a more_failed stage (as global search's SearchTabs::more_failed does) so the page can be retried; make the paging one enum (Idle, Loading, Failed, End).

title: Jump-to-date calendar flag lives in the Session and no farewell or chat leave closes it
trigger: Open a chat, open Jump to date, switch account (or leave the chat by another path), switch back.
effect: The session comes back with history_calendar still Some, so the JumpToDate dialog opens again over a chat that is no longer open; picking a day asks getChatMessageByDate for the old chat. date_jump and date_jump_note stay too.
fix: Close it in leave_open_chat (clear history_calendar, date_jump, date_jump_pending, date_jump_note) and in SearchUi's Farewell via close_jump_date_ui; better, hold the calendar in the open chat's view value.

title: Choosing a folder or entering community mode while the Calls tab is open leaves the Calls tab showing
trigger: Open the Calls tab, then click a folder in the folder rail (open_folder_tab) or 'View chats' in the community hub (enter_community_chat_list_mode).
effect: Both clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open, so sidebar_ready keeps drawing the calls list; the folder/community filter changes underneath with no visible effect.
fix: enum SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls } set in one function; the folder and community starters set Chats.

title: Folder step and community mode clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open, so the Calls tab stays over a folder switch
trigger: Open the sidebar Calls tab, then press the Next/Previous Folder shortcut (NextFolder/PrevFolder -> step_folder_by_key -> open_folder_tab), or click a community row's View chats (enter_community_chat_list_mode, line 294)
effect: The folder or community view changes invisibly under the Calls list; the same step from the Contacts tab returns to the chats, from Calls it does nothing visible. open_archive_folder (archive_row.rs:114) and open_chats_tab clear both flags, these two clear only one
fix: Replace the two bools with one `SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls }` enum so any view change sets `Chats` in one write.

title: open_folder_tab and enter_community_chat_list_mode clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open
trigger: Open the Calls tab in the sidebar, then press the folder-switch shortcut (shortcut_pack.rs:617 -> open_folder_tab) or Escape (chat_list_keys.rs:618 -> open_folder_tab(None)) or enter a community chat-list mode from the hub
effect: The folder/filter changes underneath but the sidebar keeps drawing the Calls panel and the Calls tab stays highlighted; the chat list the user asked for is not shown until the Chats tab is clicked
fix: Replace the two bools with SidebarTab; open_folder_tab and enter_community_chat_list_mode set SidebarTab::Chats.

title: Bulk pin passes the pin-limit pre-check for every chat because the session count lags the in-flight requests
trigger: Select 5 chats with 2 free pin slots and press Pin: toggle_selected_pins calls toggle_chat_pin per chat; each pre-check counts only server-confirmed pins.
effect: Five setPinned requests are sent; the extra ones fail on the server, each with its own note overwriting the previous (set_note), so the user sees one or no error and a partly pinned result with the selection already cleared.
fix: Count the requested-but-unanswered pins in the pre-check (pending pin set in the session) and stop the batch with the limit box at the first refusal.

title: Add Contact box closes when addContact is sent; a TDLib error is silently dropped
trigger: Open a user's profile > Add Contact, enter a phone number TDLib refuses (or hit a server error), press Add Contact.
effect: The box closes with 'Contact add requested' and nothing else. apply_users_error has no arm for RequestPurpose::AddContact (only AddContactByPhone), so the user never learns that the add failed.
fix: Keep the box open in a Saving stage until the answer (match by request id), then close on ok or show the error in the box.

title: Folder editor stays on 'Loading folder' forever when getChatFolder fails
trigger: Edit a folder whose spec is not cached (or stale) while getChatFolder is refused (folder removed on another device) or the send fails (driver not active).
effect: The editor shows the name field and 'Loading folder...' with no form and no error; fetch_pending is cleared only by prefill_from_spec on success. The GetChatFolder error arm (state/domains/chat_list/error.rs:87) only prunes folder_remove_queue and never reaches dialog.error; the send-failure arm only sets a status note. Closing and reopening is the only way out.
fix: Replace fetch_pending/error with an enum FolderForm { Loading(RequestId), Ready, Failed(String) }; the GetChatFolder error and send Err move it to Failed.

title: Share Folder stays on 'Loading folder...' / 'Loading links...' when the fetch fails
trigger: Open Share Folder for a folder without a fresh cached spec while getChatFolder fails (connection drop, folder removed on another device) or the send itself errors.
effect: folder_link_list shows 'Loading folder...' forever: the GetChatFolder error arm stores nothing and the send error only toasts. Only Done gets out.
fix: Track the share box's spec and links as Fetch<T> per folder (Loading/Ready/Failed) so the error arm leaves Loading and the box can show the error and retry.

title: Add-folder-by-link box shows 'Checking link...' forever when checkChatFolderInviteLink cannot be sent
trigger: Click a t.me/addlist link while the chats path is not active yet (just after connect) or while sending fails.
effect: open_folder_invite only toasts the send error; folder_invite_info and folder_invite_error stay None so the box spins 'Checking link...' with only Close. When chats_path_active() is false the driver returns before resetting folder_invite_info, so info left from an earlier link (e.g. a box dropped by an account switch, which has no Farewell clearing the session fields) can be shown under the new link.
fix: Keep the check as one enum on the dialog (Checking{request}/Checked(info)/Failed(err)/Adding{request}/Done) set from the send result too; the session answers keyed by request id.

title: Folder editor closes and toasts 'Folder updated/created' when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Open Edit Folder (or New Folder), choose a state the server refuses (name TDLib rejects, a limit the local check does not know such as FILTER_*_TOO_MUCH / DIALOG_FILTERS_TOO_MUCH, or go offline), press Save.
effect: save_folder_editor sets folders.editor = None and shows the silent 'Folder updated' note as soon as driver.edit_chat_folder/create_chat_folder returns Ok(request id). The failure arrives later through state::domains::chat_list::error (limit box or generic error) after the editor and its typed input are gone, so the person sees a success note followed by an error and loses the edits.
fix: Keep the editor as a Saving(request) stage of one enum (Editing, Saving(RequestId), Failed(text)); close it only on the matching answer and show the error inside it.

title: select_chat_open sets session.open_chat before send_open_chat; a send error leaves the chat 'open' without openChat
trigger: Select a chat while the TDLib send fails once (native error)
effect: `?` returns Err but session.open_chat is set; re-selecting the same chat takes the 'already open' branch (line 56) and never sends openChat, so TDLib does not deliver open-chat updates/read marks for it
fix: Open as a stage (Opening/Open) with the TDLib openChat result, or roll back open_chat on error. Same in open_chat_window (chat_window.rs:29).

title: process_folder_new_chats removes the new-chats bar before the answer and nothing restores it on failure
trigger: Tap 'Add' or dismiss on the shared-folder new-chats bar and the request fails.
effect: The bar is gone, chats not joined, no error shown; fetch_folder_new_chats is also stamped once per period (asked is set before the send), so it does not come back for the period.
fix: Remove the bar on success only (or keep it Processing{request}) and stamp asked on answer.

title: Chat search, history calendar and date jump are session-wide and resolve their chat as chat_search.chat_id or open_chat
trigger: Search or jump to a date in a chat window while the main window has another chat open.
effect: send_chat_search, load_more_chat_search, search_from_members and fetch_history_around use session.open_chat (the main window's chat) when chat_search.chat_id is None; fetch_history_around (line 644) always uses open_chat while reset_history_window in jump_to_message_with may use chat_search.chat_id, so the window reset and the around-fetch can target different chats.
fix: Own the search and calendar in the chat's ChatUi and pass the chat id explicitly.

title: FolderEditor saves a snapshot of the folder spec taken when the box opened, overwriting later pin/include/exclude changes
trigger: Open Edit Folder (getChatFolder answered, editor prefilled from_spec), then while the box is open the folder changes (a chat is pinned in the folder from another window or device, a chat is removed through the remove-from-folder chain, the shared folder adds chats), then press Save.
effect: to_spec sends the old pinned_chat_ids, included/excluded sets and color_id in editChatFolder, silently undoing the newer change. ChatList already tracks folder_specs_stale so edits start from a fresh spec for removals, but the editor ignores it.
fix: Store the editor's base spec with its fetch generation as part of one stage enum and, on Save, refetch (or merge only the fields the person touched) when folder_specs_stale contains the folder.

title: folder_link_saved is a one-shot bool not tied to the folder or dialog that asked
trigger: Open the share dialog of folder A, create a link, close it, open folder B's share dialog before A's answer; or the answer lands after the dialog was reopened
effect: The answer sets folder_link_saved for any pending folder_id and the next drain flips whichever dialog is open back to the list view and clears busy
fix: Return the saved result as an event carrying the folder id, and apply it only when the open dialog is for that folder

title: getChatFolder failure gives no feedback when it was asked for the edit dialog or an edit chain
trigger: Edit a folder whose cached spec is stale; getChatFolder fails (offline/flood)
effect: Only the remove-from-folder queue case sets an error; the edit dialog waits on fresh_spec that never arrives (no failed stage), until reopened
fix: Fetch<ChatFolderSpec> per folder id, so Failed is a stage the dialog can show and retry.

title: Failed preview fetch overwrites the single preview slot of a different chat
trigger: Hover/peek chat A (getChatHistory out), then peek chat B; B answers, then A's request fails (or A answers late)
effect: The slot now holds A's failure/messages; B's preview finds no data for its chat and shows a spinner or error although it loaded
fix: Key previews by ChatId (HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<..>>) or drop an answer whose chat is not the one currently previewed; fetch_chat_preview_history only dedupes per chat but clears the shared slot.

title: Pinned order is sent from the ids snapshotted at drag start
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat, meanwhile unpin another chat (or pin one) on another device, then release.
effect: finish_pin_drag sends set_pinned_chat_order(archived, reorder.ids) built from the pre-drag list, re-pinning the chat that was unpinned (or dropping the new pin); an Err leaves the displayed order until the slide settles with only a note.
fix: Re-read session.pinned_chat_ids at release and reapply the dragged move to it; reject the drop when the set differs.

title: Share Folder save answer is not matched to the form that sent it
trigger: Edit a link and press Save (busy), press Cancel (busy cleared, back to List), start 'Create link' (view Edit), then the first save's answer lands.
effect: drain_folder_share applies the unkeyed session flag folder_link_saved (and folder_share_error) to whatever the dialog shows now: the view is reset to List and the new form is dropped, or the error text is shown on the wrong form.
fix: One enum Link { Idle, Saving(RequestId) } on the dialog; the answer carries the request id and is applied only to the matching Saving.

title: A folder-limit hit clears the busy/adding state of every open folder dialog, not the one that hit it
trigger: Folder invite dialog adding chats and a folder share dialog busy creating a link are both open (share from a chat window, invite in main); the invite request hits the limit
effect: share.busy is cleared too, so the share dialog's Create can be pressed twice; the limit box goes to whichever dialog the invite-first guess picks
fields: FoldersUi::share.busy, FoldersUi::invite.adding, ChatListState::folder_limit_hit (single Option, no request key)
fix: Carry the asker (FolderInvite/FolderShare/Editor and request id) in folder_limit_hit and fail only that dialog's Fetch/Busy stage.

title: Share Folder dialog applies session-wide one-shot flags (folder_link_saved, folder_share_error) to whatever view is on screen
trigger: Save a new invite link (busy), press Cancel (view = List, busy cleared), click New link again and start filling the form; the earlier save answer arrives. Or a GetRecommendedChatFolders / delete-link error arrives while the dialog is open.
effect: drain_folder_share takes folder_link_saved/folder_share_error unmatched to folder, link or request and sets view = List and clears the form being edited, or shows an unrelated error in the dialog and clears busy of a request still in flight.
fix: Carry the request id in FolderShareDialog::Saving{request} and match the answer's id; make errors a per-request result, not a shared Option.

title: Recommended folder 'Add' can be clicked twice and creates two folders
trigger: Settings > Folders: click Add on a recommended folder twice (or double-click) before updateChatFolders adds the folder to the list.
effect: The row is hidden only once a folder with that name exists in chat_folders; until then each click sends createChatFolder again, giving duplicates (or a limit box). The index ix is also captured at render and read against recommended_folders at click time, so a refreshed list between render and click adds a different recommendation.
fix: Track recommended adds as a per-recommendation Adding stage keyed by the recommendation's name; resolve by key, not index.

title: Add to folder box spins 'Loading folder options...' forever when getChatListsToAddChat fails
trigger: Open a chat's Add to folder box while the request fails (offline, error answer).
effect: folder_menu_panel shows the loading line until chat_lists_for_add has the chat; no error arm handles GetChatListsToAddChat, and the send error only toasts. Only closing the box gets out.
fix: Hold the box's destinations as Fetch<Vec<ChatList>> keyed by chat, with the error arm moving it to Failed.

title: Opening a found chat/message proceeds in the UI when the driver refused
trigger: Click a search result while select_search_chat_open/select_search_message fails (flush_leaving_composer or select_chat returns Err, e.g. not Ready).
effect: Error note is shown, but enter_chat_ui, restore_open_draft and clearing the search field still run: the chat UI is entered for a chat that is not open (fixed up later by sync_chat_ui), the search stays open in the session with an emptied field and stale results.
fix: Return early on Err (or make the open an enum result) and only then enter the chat UI and clear the field.

title: Render-driven load-more asks every frame when the request is refused (no more_failed set)
trigger: Search results open with a next page (has_more) scrolled near the end while the client is shutting down or not Ready (chats_path_active false), e.g. during log out/close.
effect: Each frame defers maybe_load_more_search -> load_more_search_ui -> load_more_search_results returns Err(InvalidRequest) without begin_more/fail_page, so loading_more/more_failed never change; every frame sets an error note and cx.notify(): a redraw/request loop and repeated error toasts. In a demo session (no live) load_more_search_ui only notifies, same loop if has_more.
fix: Make paging a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading/Failed) on SearchTabsState and have the UI path set Failed on any Err, not just on a send error.

title: Optimistic pause/resume and remove of the business bot are not rolled back on error
trigger: In a private chat managed by a business bot press Stop (or Remove bot) while TDLib rejects the request (offline, flood, bot already removed).
effect: The bar shows 'bot paused' (or disappears) although the bot still runs; the error path only sets chats_state.chat_action_error, so the wrong bar stays until a later updateChatBusinessBotManageBar or reopening the app.
fix: Keep the bar as a Toggling{from,to} / Removing stage keyed by the request, and restore the previous bar in the ToggleBusinessBotPaused/RemoveBusinessBotFromChat error arms (src/state/domains/chats/error.rs:58).

title: Business bot bar flips/disappears locally and stays that way when the request fails
trigger: Pause/resume or remove the business bot in a chat and the request errors.
effect: toggle_business_bot_paused and remove_business_bot_from_chat call set_business_bot_bar right after sending; the ToggleBusinessBotPaused/RemoveBusinessBotFromChat error arms only set chat_action_error, so the bar shows the wrong paused state (or is gone) until the chat is re-parsed.
fix: Keep the old bar in the pending request and restore it on the error arm, or wait for updateChatBusinessBotManageBar.

title: Failed chat link delete keeps the row removed from the list
trigger: Delete a business chat link; deleteBusinessChatLink fails
effect: delete_chat_link removes the row optimistically; the error arm (business_extra.rs MutateChatLink) only sets the error text for Delete (no saving decrement, no re-ask: chat_links_requested stays true), so the link is hidden though it still exists
fix: Rollback of the removed row, or reset chat_links_requested in the Delete error arm so the list is asked again.

title: Protected-content rollback restores the flag but not the private_sharing disabled record
trigger: In a private chat turn sharing off and the request fails.
effect: set_chat_protected(previous) restores the flag, but private_sharing.record_disabled stays, so the chat shows 'you disabled sharing' for an unchanged chat.
fix: Put the record into the rollback or record it on success only.

title: check_pending/check_failed/check_generation are set before checkChatUsername and not cleared when the send fails
trigger: Type a link in the Type box when the send fails (client closing)
effect: The field shows checking with no request to answer it until the next keystroke
fix: enum UsernameCheck { Idle, Checking{generation,text}, Result{..}, Failed } set only after a successful send.

title: Require Monthly Fee can be switched on while editing an ordinary link and Save then wipes its limits
trigger: In a private channel edit an existing normal invite link, switch on Require Monthly Fee, press Save.
effect: offers_subscription ignores editing, so request() falls to InviteLinkRequest::Edit with expiration 0, member_limit 0 and no approval: the link silently loses its expiry, usage limit and approval and no fee is created.
fix: offers_subscription returns false when link.is_some() and locked_stars is None (tdesktop offers it for new links only).

title: A failed setChatMemberStatus / setChatMemberTag replaces the loaded administrators list with Failed
trigger: Open the Administrators page (list loaded), remove or restrict a member or set a custom title and the request fails (no rights, flood).
effect: admin_lists[chat] becomes AdminListFetch::Failed, so the page that showed administrators now shows 'Could not update member status' instead of the list, until it is refetched; the mutation error should go only to member_action_error.
fix: Keep the mutation error in member_action_error only (as invite_link_error does for link mutations) and leave admin_lists as Fetch<T>::Ready.

title: A refused chat-link delete leaves the row gone and nothing refetches
trigger: Business > Chat Links: delete a link while offline or when TDLib refuses; connect delete_chat_link already dropped the row optimistically.
effect: The link vanishes from the list although it still exists; chat_links_requested stays true so the list is not asked for again until restart/reopen; only a toast-less error line appears.
fix: On the Delete error arm set chat_links_requested = false (or hold chat_links as Fetch<Vec<ChatLink>> and refetch on error) instead of keeping the optimistic removal.

title: Closing the Business box from a sub-screen drops the parent screen's draft unsaved
trigger: Business > Opening Hours, toggle days / change zone, open a weekday (Day) or the time zone list, press Esc or click the backdrop. Same from the recipients Picker (Greeting/Away/Chatbots) or the sticker picker (Start Page).
effect: close_business_saving runs business_leave for the current view only; Day/TimeZone/Picker/StickerPick/LinkEdit are not saves_on_leave, so Go(None) and close_business drops hours/greeting/away/chatbot/start_page drafts. Closing from the parent screen would have saved. Edits vanish with no note.
fix: Make business_leave walk up View::parent chain (save the nearest saving ancestor) or hold a stack of screens whose drafts each save on close.

title: 'Chat link saved.' shown before TDLib answers; a refused create/edit keeps the success note and loses the draft
trigger: Links to Chat > New link, fill it, Save when the link limit is reached or the server refuses.
effect: save_business_link goes back to the list and sets note 'Chat link saved.' as soon as the request is queued (doc says 'once TDLib answers'). The failure arrives later as a separate red line, the note stays, and the typed message/name draft (link_edit) is gone.
fix: Keep the LinkEdit view in a Saving stage (enum) until the apply_chat_link / error answer; show the note only on the ok arm.

title: Failed getBusinessConnectedBot leaves 'Loading…' forever with no Retry
trigger: Chat Automation opened while getBusinessConnectedBot fails (offline / server error other than 404).
effect: apply error sets connected_bot_requested=false; business_bot_pump reads that as failed, returns done and stops watching, but draft.loaded stays false so the body shows only 'Loading…' (business_waits_for_info excludes Chatbots, so no Retry button). Only leaving and re-entering retries. Also: failure is inferred from a bool going false, and SaveConnectedBot ok sets the same bool false, so the same signal means 'failed' and 'refetch wanted'.
fix: Make connected_bot a Fetch<Option<ConnectedBot>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) and draw the error with Retry like business_info_error.

title: Closing the Business box drops the failed-send line of the screen it saved
trigger: Open Settings > Business > Away message, change it, press Esc (or the box's close button / backdrop) while the connection is down or the driver refuses the send. close_business_saving calls business_leave, whose business_send returns Leave::Go(Some("Could not send ...")); only Leave::Stay is looked at, so the Go note is dropped and the dialog closes. Same in demo mode (DEMO_LINE).
effect: The box closes as if the settings were saved; no toast, no status line. The edit is lost silently.
fix: Have close_business_saving post a StatusNote for Leave::Go(Some(line)) (as it does for Stay), or make Leave carry Saved / NotSent(line) and match both arms.

title: Confirm Ban, Remove, Create and Add close or stay silent when the driver refuses with Ok(None)
trigger: Community lost access (known_community false) while the box is open, then press Ban, Remove or Add; Create when the chat is no longer in the model
effect: confirm_community_ban and confirm_remove_from_community take the box then ignore Ok(None): the box closes as if done and nothing happened, no note; submit_new_community and send_add_community_chat likewise show no error and the button is not busy
fix: Treat Ok(None) from a send as a refused step: keep the box and post a note (as start_community_ban does with BanStart::Refused).

title: A failed chat list or joined-communities fetch is drawn as an empty list
trigger: Open Add a Chat to Community or the community picker while offline or with a TDLib error on getSuitableCommunityChats, getOwnedBots or getJoinedCommunities
effect: ProfileChatsFetch::Failed and Fetch::Failed map to an empty list: the chooser says no chats found and the picker shows only Create, with no error or retry
fix: Read the Fetch states into the view (Loading, Failed(error), Ready) and draw the error with a retry.

title: Recent actions search box keeps the previous chat's text when opened from Manage group
trigger: Type 'foo' into Recent actions of group A, close the box, open Manage > Recent actions of group B (group_edit_box/manage.rs only calls ensure_event_log_search, only the info-panel path syncs the value)
effect: Box shows 'foo' while B's list is unfiltered; the empty state/list do not match the visible text, and apply_event_log_search compares against B's stored empty query
fix: Sync the input value to the opened chat's stored query inside open_group_settings_view/RecentActions (one place), or own the search input per opened log.

title: Recent actions auto-load of older events is skipped when a new page has the same length as an earlier one (event_log_autoload never reset)
trigger: Open Recent actions, apply a search or filter that yields a short page with has_more (not scrollable), so autoload records its length; change the filter/search or reopen another chat or the same chat to get a page of the same length with has_more
effect: The older-events page is never requested (short lists never scroll, so the scroll hook cannot fire); the list shows a 'Loading older' spinner forever
fix: Key the marker by (ChatId, query/filter generation, len) or make it part of the per-page state and clear it in event_log_reset_list when the fetch leaves Loaded.

title: Edit box state ignores failures that record no error: photo upload, username premium limit, unknown username problems, type edits
trigger: Edit a group, pick a new photo (or a link that needs Premium) and Save; TDLib refuses the photo or link
effect: record_group_info_edit_error returns without storing for those purposes and state() excludes GroupInfoField::Photo, so the box counts as Saved and closes; nothing anywhere shows the photo error
fix: Track each sent request's result in the box (per-request outcome enum) rather than inferring success from the absence of an error entry.

title: Edit box closes as saved when a second Save fails to send
trigger: Save the group (title refused, box shows Failed), fix nothing and press Save again while save_group_type/save_group_info returns Err (InvalidRequest, no rights, send error)
effect: The first lines of save_group_type clear info_edit_errors; the Err arm keeps the old saving ids, which are answered; state() is now requests gone and no error = Saved, so group_edit_box() reports the box closed (shell closes it) with only an error toast and the edits lost
fix: Make saving an enum field Editing/Saving(ids)/Failed(reason); Err sets Failed in the box itself instead of leaving the old ids to be re-derived.

title: Promote picker 'searched' is set when the search is sent, not when the page lands
trigger: Open Promote admin, type a query and press Search while offline or slow.
effect: The panel switches to the Search page key at once; it shows the previous Search page (cache key is chat+filter, not the query) or Loading, so rows of an older query appear under the new text. Not matched to the query that asked.
fix: Key the member page by (chat, filter, query) and set searched from the answer's query.

title: Promote, edit-rights and demote treat Ok(None) (driver refused) as success
trigger: Demote the owner or press Demote twice quickly (duplicate in flight); promote without the right
effect: submit_admin_dialog matches Ok(_): the dialog is dropped and the note says 'Admin demoted' / 'Member promoted' though nothing was sent (Restrict handles Ok(None) correctly)
fix: Match Ok(Some(_)) as success and keep the dialog with an error on Ok(None), as submit_restrict_dialog does.

title: Permissions Save closes silently when nothing was sent
trigger: Change a permission and Save when set_chat_permissions refuses (no right, same request in flight)
effect: save_permissions_box returns Ok(false) for 'nothing differs or the viewer may not save'; the box closes with no note, the change is lost
fix: Distinguish Unchanged from Refused in the return type and keep the box with an error on Refused.

title: Username toggle error from an earlier try shows when the Type box is reopened
trigger: Toggle a username to active when at the limit (error shown), close the Type box, reopen it for the same chat.
effect: Session group_type.toggle_error is a single global slot, cleared only when a new toggle starts, so the old 'too many usernames' line appears on reopen.
fix: Clear the error in open_group_type_box and when the box closes, or keep it inside GroupTypeBox.

title: New community box closes as created on dispatch
trigger: Fill the New community box and press Create; create_community returns Ok(Some) but TDLib then refuses.
effect: The dialog is taken and dropped on the send result, the note says 'Community created'; a later refusal leaves the user with no box and the typed name lost.
fix: Keep the box as Submitting{request} and close it on the answer.

title: Custom title / community name box closes as saved on dispatch
trigger: Edit an admin custom title and press Save; TDLib then rejects the change.
effect: Dialog is dropped when the request is sent and the note says 'Custom title updated'; the rejection arrives later and the typed title is lost.
fix: Hold the box as Editing/Saving{request}/Failed and close it on the answer.

title: Leave/Delete chat reports success and closes the Edit box when the request was only sent
trigger: Confirm Delete chat or Leave chat while TDLib then refuses (not allowed, flood).
effect: Note says 'Chat deleted' / 'Left the chat' and the Edit box is closed at dispatch; the failure (if surfaced) arrives later as a separate error and the box is gone.
fix: Show 'Deleting...' and close the Edit box from the chat's removal update, not from the send result.

title: Topic editor closes as saved when the create/edit request failed
trigger: In the topic editor type a name, press Create/Save while the send fails (driver Err, or no live client).
effect: editor is set to None after the error note, so the typed name and chosen icon are lost and the list shows again as if saved.
fix: Clear the editor only in the Ok arm (or hold it as an enum Editing/Saving/Failed); keep it on Err.

title: Welcome message text cleared even when the add failed
trigger: Type a welcome message, press Add while the request fails (driver Err or no live client).
effect: new_input is reset to empty after the error note, so the typed message is lost.
fix: Clear the input only in the Ok arm.

title: Welcome message edit closes as saved when the edit failed
trigger: Press Edit on a welcome message, change the text, press Save while the request fails.
effect: editing is set to None after the error note, the edit text is dropped and the row shows the old text as if saved.
fix: Leave editing set on Err; model the dialog row as Viewing/Editing{id}/Saving{id}.

title: failed_offset is set when the page is requested, so a request that fails to send blocks paging for good
trigger: Scroll the group info members list to its end while the driver call returns Err (no connection).
effect: fetch_supergroup_members_more result is ignored (let _ =) and failed_offset=Some(offset) stays; member_more_failed is never set so retry_at_scroll is not armed. next_more returns Nothing for that offset; the Retry button only shows for an empty list. Cleared only by a membership change or a different group.
fix: enum PageState { Idle, Requested{offset}, Failed{offset} } set to Failed on the Err arm too.

title: Cancel and Esc stay live while the create request is in flight, and the chat is made anyway
trigger: New Channel (or Group), Create, then press Cancel/Esc/X before TDLib answers (the Create button shows loading, Cancel is not disabled: steps.rs new-chat-cancel).
effect: close_new_chat drops the dialog but the request stays out: the chat is created with no Type step (a supergroup/channel never gets its link choice or subscribers step) and, for a channel, with no feedback at all. The Cancel did not cancel.
fix: Disable Cancel/dismiss while the stage is Creating with no outcome, or keep the dialog as a Creating stage that finishes the flow when the answer lands.

title: Edit profile Save closes the box as saved before the server answers; a rejected name or bio error is shown nowhere
trigger: Open Edit profile, type a bio TDLib rejects or a name it refuses, press Save. save_profile_form only checks that the request was queued, sets the 'Name update requested' note and calls close_edit_profile_dialog.
effect: The dialog disappears and the user believes the edit was saved. The failure lands in users_state.profile_edit_error (state/domains/users/error.rs), which only the edit-profile and peer-colour dialogs draw, so it is never seen and the old values come back.
fix: Keep the dialog in a Saving(requests) stage that leaves on the answer (close) or the error (stay open with the error), instead of closing on enqueue.

title: Every redraw of the statistics panel deep-clones the whole ChatStatistics, so the parsed-chart cache never hits and every graph is re-parsed
trigger: Hover or drag over any chart (ChartState notifies and redraws the panel): chat_statistics.get().cloned() copies every graph's JSON string, so parsed_chart's key (pointer,len) is new each time.
effect: Re-parse of up to ~10 graphs plus deep ChatStatistics equality in ChartState::sync on every hover frame (wasted work on the UI thread).
fix: Hold the loaded statistics in an Rc/Arc and key the chart cache by Rc identity or a content hash.

title: An async graph whose load failed disappears from the panel with no message or retry
trigger: Open statistics; a getStatisticalGraph request fails (flood wait, network). stat_graph_section re-requests only on None; GraphFetch::Failed hits '_ => return None'.
effect: The chart section is silently missing until the whole panel is refreshed (load_stat_graph itself would resend on Failed but is never called).
fix: Render Failed as a section with the error and a Retry button that calls load_stat_graph.

title: Opening a story's statistics sets the page before the request and keeps it when the send fails
trigger: Click a recent story row with the connection gate inactive; set_page(Story) runs, fetch_story_insights returns Err (note shown).
effect: Story page shows 'Loading statistics' with no state to ever answer it and no retry; only Back leaves.
fix: Set the page only after the fetch is accepted, or insights becomes Fetch with Failed and a Retry.

title: Story statistics Failed state has no Retry (message statistics has one); a failed Retry send is dropped silently
trigger: Story statistics request fails; or Retry on message statistics when the send is refused.
effect: Error text only; user must go back and reopen. Retry Err result is discarded with 'let _ ='.
fix: Retry button for story page; surface Err from retry_message_statistics as a note.

title: Topic selection and history paging are keyed by session.open_chat/open_topic, single slots shared by every window
trigger: Open a forum topic in a chat window while the main window has another chat/topic open
effect: select_topic/fetch_topic_history/fetch_topic_history_newer/topic_jump_to_latest act on the main window's chat or fail with InvalidRequest, so the chat window's topic never pages
fix: Take (ChatId, topic) from the caller's ChatUi, not from the session.

title: Revoke of a public link: if the second request fails to send, the first (username cleared) is already out and no revoke is recorded
trigger: Limit box > Revoke on a public community while the sender fails on the second send_json_request (disconnect between the two sends).
effect: setSupergroupUsername('') goes through but groups.group_type.revoke stays None and public_chats is not reset, so the list still shows the chat with a link it no longer has; the 'disable' pending entry leaks.
fix: Record PublicLinkRevoke before sending (or send both through one fallible step that rolls back) and reset public_chats on a partial send failure.

title: The rest of a basic-group Save is silently dropped when the upgraded chat is not known yet
trigger: Save the Type/Edit box of a basic group; the upgrade answers before upgraded_chat_for resolves
effect: Title, description, photo and link edits queued in EditAfterUpgrade are discarded with no error; the box already closed as saved
fix: Keep the EditAfterUpgrade until upgraded_chat_for resolves, or report an error when it cannot.

title: Channel membership probe runs only for session.open_chat, the main window's chat
trigger: Open a channel or supergroup in a chat window while the main window shows another chat
effect: my_member_status / my_rights_fetched are never fetched for it, so the composer gate and join/leave affordance use defaults
fix: Drive the probe from the set of chats shown in any window (ChatUi / WindowSlot).

title: A create guarded by purpose, not by dialog: closing the dialog mid-create leaves a silent no-op Create and an unexpected chat open
trigger: New group: fill name and members, press Create, close the dialog before TDLib answers, reopen New Group and press Create again
effect: create_new_chat returns Ok(None) while the first request is out and the UI ignores it (button does nothing); when the first answer arrives run_new_chat_created calls select_chat for the group although its dialog is gone; NewChatState.creations entries are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight create to the dialog (a Creating stage the closing dialog cancels or hands to a toast) and drop the creations entry when its answer is applied.

title: Saving the permissions box while an earlier setChatPermissions is in flight reports nothing sent and drops the new values
trigger: Change permissions, Save, reopen the box quickly, change again and Save before the first answer.
effect: set_chat_permissions returns Ok(None) on has_purpose_for_chat dedupe, so send_permissions_save reports Ok(false) (same as nothing differs) and the box closes as saved while the newer permissions were never sent.
fix: Return a distinct Busy outcome and keep the box open, or queue the second save.

title: The shared-media gallery and profile tabs are one session-wide SharedMediaState keyed by a single chat_id
trigger: Open the gallery in the main window, then open the gallery (or its profile tabs) in a chat window of another chat.
effect: fetch_profile_tabs, fetch_profile_tab and fetch_more_shared_media all read session.media.shared_media.chat_id; opening it in a second window replaces the first window's tabs and the answers are matched to the one chat only.
fix: Move the gallery into the per-window WindowSlot / per-chat ChatUi.

title: A ringing conference invitation has no local expiry or way out except TDLib content updates
trigger: Receive an invitation, lose connection or miss the updateMessageContent for was_missed
effect: calls.conference_invite stays Some: ringtone keeps looping, further calls and invitations are declined as busy
fix: Store the ring start and drop the invite on tick after CONFERENCE_INVITE_RING_SECS (manual clock in tests)

title: revoke_public_link can leave a half-sent revoke with no PublicLinkRevoke to settle it
trigger: In the public-links limit box press Revoke; setSupergroupUsername goes out, then the second send (disableAllSupergroupUsernames) fails.
effect: The function returns the error before group_type.revoke is set, so the first request's ok is unmatched: public_chats is not refreshed, the box still lists the chat as public although its link is gone, and the limit stays marked reached.
fix: Set revoke with the first request id before the second send and let a failed send settle it as failed.

title: The New Channel type step treats a lost or non-username failed save as success
trigger: Create a channel, in the Type step press Save; a request in saving (e.g. the join-by-request or no-forwards edit) errors, or is dropped without an answer.
effect: new_chat_facts only reads type_failed from info_edit_errors with field == Username and type_pending from requests.get; when all requests are gone and the error is of another field, the dialog advances to Subscribers as if saved.
fix: Record each Save request's outcome (Pending, Done, Failed) in NewChatCreation or the stage and derive the view from that, not from absence of a pending request.

title: Save error of a Business screen is lost when the box is closed right after leaving it
trigger: Business > Greeting, change and Back (save sent, hub shows 'Saving'), press Close before TDLib answers; TDLib refuses.
effect: The refusal goes to settings.business.error, drawn only inside the Business box. close_business_saving(true) closes at once on the hub and open_business clears the error, so the user never learns the save failed; the draft is gone too.
fix: Surface a failed save as a StatusNote when the box is closed (or keep Close disabled while saving is non-empty); one Save stage enum per screen.

title: Start page full-info fetch is re-sent on every render while the info is absent
trigger: Open an empty private chat with a user whose getUserFullInfo fails or never answers (deleted/restricted user), then move the mouse / any redraw.
effect: Comment says 'ask once' but no state records the ask: each render calls defer_screen -> fetch_user_full_info. It dedupes only while the request is pending or the info is stored; after an error nothing is stored, so each redraw sends the request again (request storm, no failure state).
fix: Track user full info as Fetch<UserFullInfo> per user with a Failed stage that stops re-asking until retry.

title: Dropped files or messages vanish silently when the chat does not open after the topic is picked
trigger: Drop files on a forum row, pick a topic; select_listed_chat is refused (agent_may_open false, route_chat_open returns None) or the forum has no window and the chat does not become open.
effect: choose_drop_topic has already set drop_topic = None and the box closes; enter_drop_topic returns false without a note on the 'chat not open' path, so the payload (paths or forward draft) is discarded with no feedback.
fix: Keep the payload until the open succeeds (a Choosing -> Opening -> Done enum) and set an error note on the false path.

title: A waiting ban has no way out and opens its warning over whatever is on screen
trigger: Choose Ban for a member, then close the moderation UI and open another box (or the member-chats ask never answers, e.g. reconnect leaves the Fetch Loading/Idle); later the answer lands
effect: drain_pending_ban calls show_community_box, replacing the unrelated open community box (an armed Requests undo is flushed), or the ban_wait stays set forever and pops the warning when that member's chats are asked again
fix: Make the wait a stage of the flow enum with a cancel (box close, chat change, lock) and a timeout/failed arm that ends it; open the warning only when no other box is open.

title: A failed fetch for the Invite Links, Join Requests or Administrators page shows the loading spinner for good
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite Links (or Join Requests / Administrators) when the driver cannot send the request (Err is dropped by `let _ = match view`).
effect: The session never gets a Loading/Failed entry, and the sections draw None the same as Loading (spinner). Only the small refresh icon recovers; no error and no Retry button.
fix: Treat an Err from the fetch as Fetch::Failed in the session, and draw None as 'not asked' (ask again) rather than as Loading.

title: Partial send on Save error leaves some edits applied but untracked
trigger: Save a title change plus a photo where the first request is sent and the next send returns Err
effect: save_group_info stops at the failed edit; what was sent stays sent but the box does not track those ids (saving not set on Err), so no Failed/Saving state shows for them and a retry resends
fix: Return the ids sent so far with the error and keep them in saving.

title: Restrict, ban, promote and demote dialogs close on send, so a server refusal is not shown in the box
trigger: Ban or restrict a member who cannot be restricted (admin, rights changed); TDLib answers with an error
effect: Box has already closed with 'Member banned' note; failure surfaces only in member_action_error of the member dialog if it happens to be open
fix: Hold the dialog in a Sending(request id) stage and close it on the matching answer.

title: Stops slider thumb stays on a value the save refused
trigger: Drag the slow mode (or boosters) slider and release; the change request fails or the permission is refused and the caller's value does not change.
effect: on_change fires once on release; reported equals the caller's value so no resync happens, the thumb and the highlighted label stay on the unsaved stop while the real value is the old one.
fix: Resync the thumb whenever the caller's value differs from the slider's stop, not only when the caller's value changes; or make the pending drag an explicit variant.

title: close_info_panel does not close the pieces opened with the panel
trigger: Open a supergroup info panel (inline members, event-log search field), close it, open a user panel.
effect: Only the driver target and common_groups are reset; inline_members and admin.event_log_search keep their state and the event-log field keeps the old chat's query until the next open syncs it.
fix: Have one InfoPanelUi value that is replaced on open/close and owns these sub-states.

title: Dialog builder asks for topic icon downloads on every build while the editor is open
trigger: Open the topic editor and leave it open.
effect: download_forum_topic_icons runs inside the dialog builder, a render-time side effect; each rebuild re-requests downloads for every icon file.
fix: Request the downloads once in begin_topic_editor (or when the icon list lands), not in the builder.

title: The block is reset only when the group changes, not each time the panel opens
trigger: Open the info panel of group A, scroll and fail a page, close it, reopen A.
effect: shown, failed_offset, admins_asked and the snapshot are kept from the last visit (inline_members.chat is never cleared on close), so a failed page or the administrators fallback stays latched.
fix: Reset (or drop) InlineMembersUi when the info panel target closes; key it by AccountChat.

title: Delete-revoked-by-admin alert acts on a bare chat_id and relies on whichever admin page is still open
trigger: Open the alert on another admin's links page, switch account or go back, press Delete
effect: Deletes revoked links on the wrong account/admin, or errors silently
fix: Owned confirmation keyed by OfAccount+admin page; closed by Farewell

title: details_link is set before the members request and the Err of open_chat_invite_link_members is ignored
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite links, tap a link's details while offline/driver refuses
effect: Block shows Loading... forever (no members page, no error); also two stores (dialog.details_link and session invite_pages.members) kept in step by hand
fix: Make details one enum owned by the page (Closed/Loading/Loaded/Failed) set from the driver result

title: Delete-all-revoked alert is not owned by the account/box and acts on a bare chat_id
trigger: Open Delete all alert, switch account (or close the settings box) then press Delete
effect: delete_all_revoked_chat_invite_links(chat_id) runs against the new account's driver; alert returns true (closes) regardless of result
fix: Open the confirmation through the Asker seam owned by (account, chat); drop it in Farewell

title: Box closes as saved once the request is queued; a later TDLib error loses the typed form
trigger: Create a link that the server rejects (limit, rights)
effect: Box is already gone, error only as a status note; name, dates and fee must be retyped
fix: Keep the box in a Saving stage until the answer, reopen on error

title: Send Request clears the request box before the send and still jumps to the chat when the send failed
trigger: Open Enable Sharing request box on a private chat, press Send with the connection down.
effect: send_sharing_request: driver.send_sharing_request clears private_sharing.enable before sending; on Err the note shows but the box is gone and select_listed_chat still opens the chat as if the request was sent.
fix: Clear the box only on Ok; keep it open with the error on Err.

title: premium_flooded is a sticky bool beside CardState and is never cleared
trigger: A free user opens the AI compose box and a request fails with AICOMPOSE_FLOOD_PREMIUM; they then buy Premium from the Increase Limit button (or switch to Fix/another tab and get a good result) without closing the box.
effect: footer() keeps returning IncreaseLimit for the life of the box, so a Ready result cannot be applied, and dialog.rs hides the loading spinner for later requests (loading && !premium_flooded).
fix: Make the flood a CardState::Failed(AiBoxError) variant (or derive it from the last card) so the next request or accepted result leaves it.

title: Emoji-status switch moves before the send and is not put back when the send fails
trigger: Open a mini app's permission box, flip 'allow emoji status' while the client cannot send (closing, native send error).
effect: The bot's can_manage_emoji_status stays flipped though no request went out and no error answer will ever restore it (apply_web_app_error is the only rollback).
fix: Stage the change as a pending request with a RequestRollback (as set_forum_topic_muted does), or flip only after a successful send.

title: Venue search generation restarts at 0 for every opened picker, so a late answer of a closed picker is accepted by the next one
trigger: Open Send Location, pan/search so a getInlineQueryResults is in flight (generation N), close the box, reopen Send Location in the same or another chat and make the same number of venue queries (generation N again) before the old answer lands.
effect: venues_answered matches only on generation, so the old picker's venues (another place or chat) appear and are cached under the new picker's request point.
fix: Make the generation a LocationSharing-wide counter that is never reset (or carry a picker id in the purpose and compare chat_id and point).

title: Closing the venue search after a failed list lookup leaves the venue list on Loading
trigger: Open Send Location while the venue bot lookup fails (offline or bot error, list shows nothing found), type one letter in the search field, close the search within 900 ms
effect: The venue list shows the loading spinner and nothing is pending; it stays until the map is moved or Places in this area is pressed
fix: On search close, always re-request or restore the last list; a failed lookup must clear request so request_venues does not early-return, or cache a Failed entry; derive list from one query stage enum.

title: A pending linked media timestamp seeks and plays/opens media while the app is locked
trigger: Click a t.me/c/..?t=30 link to a voice note whose message is not loaded yet, then lock Quill (auto-lock or manual) within 12 s.
effect: pump_deep_link calls tick_media_seek before the refused_while_locked return; when the message loads under the lock, seek_media_timestamp starts voice/audio playback or opens the media viewer behind the lock screen.
fix: Move tick_media_seek after the refused_while_locked check (the seek stays pending and runs after the unlock), or hold it as a lock intent.

title: A failed Fix request has no retry: set_mode(same mode) returns None and the card stays Failed
trigger: Open the box, switch to the Fix tab, the request fails (network error, TooLong or an empty answer); click the Fix tab again.
effect: Card shows the original text with a disabled Apply and no spinner; the only way to ask again is to switch to another tab and back (or close and reopen).
fix: Give CardState::Failed a retry transition (re-clicking the active tab or a Retry action calls request() when the card is Failed).

title: bound_style_name is app-wide but custom styles are per account
trigger: Account A binds its custom style 'pirate' to the apply-in-place shortcut; switch to account B (no such style) and press the shortcut in a chat.
effect: The request fails with a style-invalid error, apply_in_place.rs clears the binding for the whole app, so account A's binding is lost; with a same-named different style in B the wrong style rewrites the text.
fix: Key the binding by AccountKey (map AccountKey -> style name) or store it in the account's settings.

title: A finished deep-link flow (ShowText / ChatReady) blocks every later link until the UI consumes it
trigger: A launch link ends in ShowText or ChatReady while the surface that consumes it is not drawn (locked, window closed), then another tg:// link is opened.
effect: request_deep_link_info returns Ok(None) for each new link; links silently do nothing until the stale state is consumed.
fix: Let a new launch link replace any non-ResolvingInfo stage, or give every stage an owner window and a Farewell closer.

title: gift_text_length_max fetch error is ignored and a comment then silently blocks the purchase
trigger: getOption send fails once (or answers an error), then buy with a comment
effect: buy_marketplace_gift returns InvalidRequest (max.is_none_or) without setting a note; the Buy button does nothing
fix: Set gift.note on the Err return, and refetch the limit when None

title: A new launch clears the unconsumed open result without closing the app TDLib already started
trigger: Open mini app A; its answer lands in open_result as Opened{launch_id}; before the UI poll takes it (or while its window is locked/refused) open mini app B.
effect: mark_web_app_pending sets open_result=None (and finish_web_app_open overwrites it) without pushing A's launch_id to dropped_launches, so closeWebApp is never sent for A and the bot keeps a live session.
fix: Make open results a per-request map or queue keyed by RequestId, and route every discarded Opened through dropped_launches.

title: VenueBot::Resolving has no exit except an answer; open() resets only Failed
trigger: Open Send Location with the venue bot not yet resolved, drop the searchPublicChat request (connection restart / request purge) or have it answered before the bot user is cached (then Missing is final).
effect: Venue list stays on Loading (Resolving arm sends nothing) for every later picker of the session, or shows no venues for the whole session after Missing.
fix: Reset Resolving and Missing to Unknown in open() (as Failed is), and when the session's requests are dropped.

title: Apply-in-place answer rewrites a byte range (or the whole field) recorded at the press, with no check that the draft is unchanged
trigger: In a chat, type a draft, select a word and press the AI apply shortcut; before the answer lands, keep typing earlier in the field (or select-all and type a new draft). The answer arrives.
effect: The answer replaces the stale range (now covering different text) or, with no selection, the whole field, so text typed while waiting is overwritten without a word.
fix: Keep the field's text (or a revision) in ApplyInPlace and drop the answer (with a toast) when the composer no longer holds it, as the conversation key is already checked.

title: load_ai_style_example returns after start_next with no driver, leaving the example loading forever
trigger: Open the style preview (addstyle link) and press 'Another example' while self.live is None (account closing, client gone, demo session). start_next() has set loading and example_asked_at, then `let Some(live) = self.live.as_mut() else { return; }` exits without failed().
effect: The refresh icon spins forever, 'Another example' stays disabled, and ai_style_preview_upkeep requests an animation tick every 60 ms (redraw loop) until the box is closed.
fix: Make the example an enum (Idle, Asked{token, at}, Failed) so every early return goes through one place that leaves Asked, or call failed() on the live-None path.

title: A pending media-timestamp seek outlives the chat it was for and plays or opens media after the reader left
trigger: Click a t.me/c/<chat>/<post>?t=90 link to a voice note or video that is not loaded yet, then open another chat at once. Within 12 s the linked message loads (the history answer that was in flight).
effect: tick_media_seek still runs seek_media_timestamp for the old chat. It starts the voice note or audio playing, or opens the media viewer on the video, over the chat the reader moved to. PlaybackUi::pending_media_seek is cleared only when the seek runs or its deadline passes, never on a chat change.
fix: Make the pending seek part of the chat's ChatUi (replaced whole by sync_chat_ui), or carry the ChatMessage owner and the window and drop the seek when that chat is no longer shown there.

title: A deep link resolved for an account that left the screen stays in that account's session and fires when the user switches back
trigger: Click a t.me link in account A (or a Join link), immediately switch to account B; the lookup finishes in A's background session (ChatReady/Ui/Info/ShowText). Switch back to A minutes later.
effect: On return, the next poll consumes the stale terminal state: a chat opens, a settings page or an info box appears unasked, in the main window (the flow_window was lost with the old OnScreen). Only the queued link is filtered by account (for_screen); the in-flight/terminal DeepLinkState in the session is not cleared on switch.
fix: Make the flow an OnScreen-owned value (one enum with origin account, window and agent flag) and clear or ignore session.deep_link answers whose screen epoch differs when the account leaves the screen.

title: A thread/media link for a chat that has its own window opens the thread in the asking window's state
trigger: Have chat C open in its own window W and the main window showing another chat; click a t.me/c/C/msg?thread=T link in the main window.
effect: finish_typed_link runs open_thread_view in the asking frame (main) after route_chat_open sent the chat to W: flush_leaving_draft saves main's composer as leaving, and the driver's single thread slot is opened for C while main shows another chat, so main's advance_thread may jump to C duplicating W.
fix: Run finish_typed_link inside in_window_scope(Some(chat_id)) in the windowed branch, like attach_shared_qr_card.

title: Locate times out after 30 s while the macOS permission prompt may still be open
trigger: On macOS first use, open Send Location and leave the system 'Allow location' prompt unanswered for over 30 s, then allow.
effect: poll_answer returns None after LOCATE_TIMEOUT and the picker records Unavailable; the later fix goes to a dropped receiver, so the picker stays 'unavailable' until My Location is pressed.
fix: Let the platform lookup report a Waiting-for-permission state and time out only after the permission is decided; cancel the manager when the receiver is dropped.

title: Phone share answer is matched by bot only; a timed-out send's late answer is reported for the next request
trigger: Mini app requests phone, Share; TDLib takes over 30 s (slow network) so the flow times out and tells the app 'cancelled'; later the app (or the same bot reopened) requests phone again and Share.
effect: The app was told cancelled though the contact card was sent; the stale phone_share (bot, done) then finishes the next request immediately with the old outcome.
fix: Keep the send's RequestId in PhoneFlow::Sending and accept only that answer; clear phone_share when the flow leaves Sending.

title: A cover picked for one replacement video is kept for the next video or the original
trigger: Edit a video message: Replace with video X, Edit Cover, then replace with video Y or press Clear replacement, then Save.
effect: media_edit.cover is never cleared when the replacement changes (copy_inline_text.rs:60-84 only resets video_extras for a different path); effective_cover only checks that a video applies, so the old cover is sent with Y, or with the original video after the replacement is cleared.
fix: Put cover and extras inside EditMediaReplacement so replacing or clearing it replaces them whole.

title: Disk recovering drains disk_paused then aborts with ? on the first toggle error
trigger: Disk was Low and paused several downloads; disk becomes Healthy while one toggleDownloadIsPaused send fails
effect: disk_paused.drain() and forget_disk_pause already ran for all ids, so the downloads after the failing one stay paused and are never resumed by the disk logic; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped too
fix: Remove each id from disk_paused only after its resume was sent; keep going or leave the rest in the set on error

title: set_default_reaction is optimistic and nothing rolls it back
trigger: Settings, Quick reaction: pick a reaction; TDLib answers an error (e.g. not premium for custom emoji)
effect: session.stickers.default_reaction keeps the failed choice and shows it as set; SetDefaultReactionType has no error arm anywhere (grep only finds purpose.rs)
fix: Store the previous value on the pending request (RequestRollback) like toggle_sign_messages does

title: A failed searchFileDownloads for disk-paused downloads is never handled, so the once-per-session flag stays set
trigger: Disk gets low and downloads are paused and saved; restart Quill on a healthy disk; the startup searchFileDownloads (SearchDiskPausedDownloads) answers with a TDLib error (or the pending request is settled without an answer).
effect: disk_resume_searched stays true (it is reset only when the synchronous send fails in connect/disk_paused.rs), disk_search_keys stays filled, so the paused downloads are never resumed until the next restart; no error is shown.
fix: Make the search one enum (NotAsked, Asked{request, keys}, Done) and add an error arm in apply_media_error that returns it to NotAsked (or Done) when the request id matches.

title: A late Gifts page for another chat overwrites the open gallery's Gifts next_offset
trigger: Open the shared media gallery of user A on the Gifts tab, then before its receivedGifts page lands open the profile gallery of user B (or another channel); A's page lands after B's first page.
effect: accept_profile rejects A's items (chat mismatch), but apply_profile_gifts writes page.next_offset into the in-place gallery's Gifts tab unconditionally, so B's tab pages on with A's offset: Load more in B fetches from the wrong offset (skipped or repeated gifts, or the list ends early).
fix: Move next_offset into accept_profile behind the same chat check (or carry the gallery generation on GetProfileGifts like the message tabs) so a rejected page writes nothing.

title: Headroom poll notifies every second forever once edr_lost is set on an HDR-capable screen
trigger: Open an HDR picture on a display with EDR headroom where the renderer cannot build its float pipelines (edr_lost = true), and leave the viewer open.
effect: viewer_hdr_element stores hdr.headroom = SDR.effective() = 1.0 while edr_lost, but the poll compares super::headroom(window).effective() (e.g. 2.0+) against that 1.0, sees 'changed' every tick and calls cx.notify(): a full app redraw 10 times a second for the first second and once a second after, for as long as the viewer is open.
fix: Compare against the same value the draw uses (the display headroom unless edr_lost, then SDR), computed in one function shared by draw and poll, or skip the headroom comparison when edr_lost.

title: Account switch leaves the GIF panel gate and status-choices gate open on the outgoing session
trigger: Open the composer panel on its GIFs tab (or the emoji status selector), then switch to another account from the account list.
effect: PickerUi's Farewell is empty and leave_for_background only deselects the chat, so the retired session keeps stickers.gifs.open (and emoji.status_open) true. The background client keeps downloading GIF panel files and running GIF searches (sync_shown_media, maybe_search_gifs) until the user switches back, where sync_gif_downloads closes it.
fix: Give PickerUi a real Farewell that calls close_gif_panel and close_emoji_status_choices on the client being left, or make the gate a function of the on-screen panel mode only.

title: Closing the editor from Stickers mode leaves the mask strip wanted
trigger: Open the photo editor, press Stickers (sets masks.strip_wanted), then Cancel or Done, or send the tray so the editor is dropped, or lock/switch account.
effect: load_editor_masks sets session.stickers.masks.strip_wanted; release_editor_masks runs only when another mode button is pressed. close_photo_editor, save_photo_editor and the composer_sends drop never call it, so pump_masks keeps loading mask sets after every envelope with nothing on screen, and the flag stays on the account's session after a switch.
fix: Release the strip from the editor's drop (a guard value held while Stickers mode is active) rather than from the mode button.

title: Removing or reordering a saved track reports success before (and whatever) the driver result; errors are discarded
trigger: On your own Playlist page choose Delete on a track and confirm while the request cannot be sent (connection lost, client not ready); or drag a track to reorder.
effect: 'Saved music removed' toast shows immediately, remove_profile_audio_track/move_profile_audio_track Err is dropped with `let _`, and the track stays; no error is ever shown.
fix: Set the toast from the Result (Ok -> removed, Err -> error note) as the other pin/poll starters do, and carry a request id so a later failure from TDLib can surface.

title: Recording chat action (recording voice/video) goes to the main window's open chat, not the recording's chat window
trigger: Start a voice note in a chat window for chat B while the main window shows chat A
effect: Chat A's members see 'recording voice message' while the user records in B; B shows none; cancels when main has no chat open
fix: Pass the recording's origin chat (Capture::origin chat) to sync_voice_recording/sync_video_note_recording instead of reading session.open_chat.

title: Gallery scroll position and paging mark survive close and reopen of the same chat
trigger: Open the shared-media gallery of chat A, scroll the Media (or Files) tab down, press the close button, open it again for A. close() clears the tabs and restamps them, but PageKey (chat, anchor_day, query) is unchanged and nothing drew another page in between.
effect: The freshly loaded first page opens at the old scroll offset (or at its end, firing the Load more row at once); a list tab's Asked still holds the old length, so the first automatic page is skipped until the reader scrolls.
fix: Add the tab's generation stamp (SharedMediaTabState::generation) to PageKey so a cleared tab is a new page.

title: A finished old encode clears the encoding handle of a newer encode
trigger: Press Done on a video sticker, cancel the box (cancel flag only stops between quality steps), open Create Sticker again and press Done before the first encode returns
effect: The old continuation sets sticker_box.encoding = None unconditionally; the new encode then finds encoding None, so current is false and its result is dropped. Done is enabled again, the box stays open, nothing is uploaded and the new encode can no longer be cancelled
fix: Make encoding an enum Idle|Encoding{token,cancel} and clear it only when the finishing job's token still matches

title: A failed encode of a tray or edit-box video leaves the editor with no player for good
trigger: Attach a video, open Edit Video, trim it so it needs encoding, press Done; the ffmpeg encode fails (for example the disk is full or the codec is refused).
effect: finish_video_editor sets editor.player = None before encoding; the Err arm only clears busy and sets the note. start_video_editor_player runs only from video_editor_probed, so the editor stays open showing a still picture: the loop does not play, a click on the picture does not pause or resume (toggle_video_editor_pause needs a player), and the playhead does not move. The user has to cancel and reopen the editor.
fix: Make the editor's stage one enum (Reading, Unreadable, Ready { player }, Encoding { serial }), with the player inside Ready. The encode's error arm then goes back to Ready and reopens the player. The avatar path in profile_photo_sources/video.rs already keeps the player.

title: still_busy sticks after a failed tray encode, so the cover still and the rotate/flip preview never update again
trigger: Open Edit Video on a tray video and drag the cover head, which starts a still cut. Press Done (Enter) before the cut lands, then let the encode fail.
effect: Done bumps editor.serial. The in-flight cut's answer no longer matches the serial, so it is dropped before still_busy = false runs. The encode's Err arm (video_editor.rs:504-509) does not clear still_busy, unlike the avatar path (profile_photo_sources/video.rs:111). Every later refresh_video_preview only stores still_wanted and returns, so the cover bubble, the still and the turned/mirrored preview stay frozen until the editor is reopened.
fix: Make the still cutter one value, enum StillCut { Idle, Cutting { serial, next: Option<i64> } }, matched by its own token instead of the editor-wide serial, so an encode does not orphan it. At minimum, clear still_busy in the tray/edit Err arm as the avatar path does.

title: Voice encoder thread failure mid-recording is never surfaced: the bar keeps recording and the preview waits forever
trigger: Start a voice note; while recording, the encoder's push/pause fails (disk full, the capture folder removed, an Opus encode error). Keep talking, press Pause, then press the preview Play button; finally press Send.
effect: VoiceCapture::failure only reads the mic error slot and the zero-samples idle check, never whether the worker thread already returned Err.
