The timer keeps counting and the bars freeze; Pause never sets Control::flushed, so toggle_record_preview shows 'Getting the recording ready' on every press forever; only Send reports the error, after which the whole recording is deleted.
fix: Let failure() also report a finished worker (JoinHandle::is_finished, or an encoder error slot the thread writes before returning), so check_recording ends the recording with the reason at once.

title: ffprobe/ffmpeg run synchronously on the UI thread when the snapshot was not prepared
trigger: Send media whose background preparation has not finished (or edit with a replacement video: edit.rs:86 probe_local_video)
effect: media_send_path/video_probe/video_note/local_animation fall back to send_path_for / probe_local_video / probe_with_ffprobe / write_video_note_thumbnail; doc comment itself says 'can wait on ffmpeg'. UI freeze for large videos
fix: Make unprepared snapshots a not-ready stage that waits for the background job instead of computing inline

title: fetch_chat_photos re-sends the full-info request every call while chat_current_photos stays empty
trigger: Open the photo viewer for a chat whose full-info answer errors or has no photo.
effect: chat_current_photos is only filled by a successful answer, so each open (and any retry) sends getSupergroupFullInfo / getBasicGroupFullInfo again; chat_photo_history is Loading-keyed but current photo has no stage.
fix: Fetch<Option<Photo>> for the current photo.

title: An OS media key pressed while nothing plays is queued and replayed on the next track
trigger: Play a voice note or song, let it end (or close the bar), press the media key or playerctl play-pause (macOS remote commands and MPRIS stay registered), then start another voice note minutes later
effect: The queued Toggle or Pause lands on the first playback tick and pauses or stops the new track at once; a queued Next skips
fix: Drop commands when no player owns the session (take_commands in the inactive branch of the playback tick, or stamp each command with the time and ignore old ones); keep a CommandQueue owned by the active player.

title: Clips keep being assigned to a sticker worker that has ended
trigger: A sticker worker or opener thread ends (a panic in decode or packing caught by spawn_guarded).
effect: WorkerEnd only sets worker_gone, which wait_idle reads; open() still picks workers from the fixed `live` list, so new clips land on the dead worker and stay Opening with busy set forever, and clips it owned never get frames. Stickers and custom emoji on that worker stay blank until restart.
fix: Track each worker's liveness in State (Running | Gone) and, when one ends, mark its clips Failed (or reassign them) and leave it out of open()'s choice.

title: Streaming rows hash changes every render for empty or rich drafts
trigger: Bot sends a draft with no text yet (Thinking placeholder) or a RichMessage draft in the open chat
effect: stream_rows_hash treats revealing = reveal.draft_id != draft.draft_id; StreamReveal::advance (which sets draft_id) runs only for non-empty Text drafts, so for an empty or Rich draft revealing stays true and the hash carries a fresh nanosecond tick each call: the history rows are rebuilt on every frame that renders for the whole life of the draft
fix: Derive 'revealing' from the draft content (Text with shown<total) not from draft_id equality, or have StreamReveal track the draft for every content kind

title: The decoded image for Edit Image opens the editor without checking that the message edit it was started for is still the current one
trigger: While editing photo message A choose Edit Media > Edit Image on a large photo, then cancel the edit or start editing another message before the decode ends. The callback only tests viewer.photo_editor.is_none(). PhotoEditor::for_message_edit carries no edit key, and save_photo_editor reads edited_message() at Done, not at open.
effect: An editor of A's pixels opens over no edit (Done is dropped silently) or over message B's edit, where A's picture is staged as B's replacement.
fix: Carry the (chat, message) of the edit in EditorPurpose::MessageEdit and compare it in the decode callback and at Done.

title: The picked video cover is applied to whatever edit is pending when the file dialog returns
trigger: Choose Edit Media > Edit Cover for video message A, leave the native file dialog open, cancel the edit and start editing video message B (or switch chats), then pick a file.
effect: set_edit_cover stages the cover on B's edit (or does nothing without a note after a chat switch), so B is saved with A's cover.
fix: Capture edited_message() when the picker starts and apply the result only if it is still the pending edit.

title: HDR JPEG XL decode holds up to three full-size float copies at once (about 2.3 GB at the 48 Mpx cap)
trigger: On Windows, open a 40+ megapixel HDR JPEG XL in the media viewer.
effect: samples (f32 x channels), the pixels Vec<[f32;4]> and then the resize buffer in scaled() are alive together; with MAX_PIXELS = 2 x HDR_MAX_PIXELS this can exhaust memory in the background job and abort the app (allocation failure is not catchable by contained()).
fix: Convert row by row from the stream into the final buffer (or downscale during conversion) and cap MAX_PIXELS at the memory the three copies need, returning Ok(None) (SDR) above it.

title: A chat window's media viewer draws HDR frames but never switches its window to extended range
trigger: Open a chat in its own window, open an HDR picture file (gain-map JPEG / HEIC) in that window's media viewer (ViewerPart::Inline draws viewer_hdr_element via overlay.rs).
effect: sync_viewer_hdr runs only from the main window's render (app_render/mod.rs), so the chat window's layer stays 8-bit while the surface frame is tone-mapped for the display headroom: the picture is drawn dim/clipped, yet the badge says 'HDR shown' because edr_on is never true and edr_lost is therefore never detected.
fix: Run the EDR sync in the per-window upkeep (window_upkeep.rs) for whichever window's ViewerUi is in place, with the EDR mode stored per window slot.

title: A click demand outlives a row that never renders it and fires later
trigger: Click a downloaded round video, then switch chat before the row renders; return later
effect: The round video starts with sound from the start unprompted (forget() only runs for dropped slots, frame_start leaves do not clear on_demand)
fix: Expire the demand when its window's history pass ends (frame_start/leave) or tie it to the visit it was asked in

title: start_demand consumed in render even when toggle_sound returns false, so the click is lost
trigger: Click a round video the moment its player opens, before it can toggle sound
effect: Next frame start_demand is false and the player is muted so end_demand drops the demand: nothing plays with sound, no feedback
fix: Make the demand a stage the player advances (Asked -> Playing) and only leave Asked when sound actually started; do not mutate it from render

title: A channel photo gallery click that fails to send waits forever with no message
trigger: Click a group or channel avatar while the chats path is not active (fetch_chat_photos returns Err, ignored by let _).
effect: open_peer_photos treats PhotoOwner::Chat as sent, calls wait_for_profile_gallery, nothing is requested and no Failed entry exists, so the click does nothing and pending_profile_gallery stays set until another click replaces it (and may open late if photos arrive for it).
fix: Use the fetch_chat_photos result like the User branch: on Err show the note and do not set the pending gallery; clear the pending gallery on request end.

title: Edit contact, birthday, personal channel, photo and share-contact boxes close and toast success on enqueue, not on the answer
trigger: Save an edited contact or birthday, pick a personal channel, confirm a personal photo, or send a shared contact while Telegram rejects the request (flood, privacy, invalid value).
effect: The box closes and shows 'Contact saved' / 'Birthday saved' at once; a server error has no place to show, so the user sees success and the old value reappears.
fix: ProfileDialog variants carry a Saving stage that closes on the answer and shows the error in the box on failure.

title: Secret-chat layer check for round video uses the main window's open chat
trigger: Chat window on an old-layer secret chat, main window on a normal chat: record a video note in the chat window
effect: Video note allowed to an old-layer secret chat (or blocked wrongly in the opposite case)
fix: Use viewed_chat() in open_secret_chat_peer_layer.

title: 'Play once' offered by the main window's chat kind, not the recording window's chat
trigger: Main window on a private chat, chat window on a group; record a voice note in the group, toggle Play once, send (send_finished_voice applies recording.once without re-checking chat kind)
effect: Group voice note sent as one-time message / refused, or the toggle missing in a private chat window when main has a group open
fix: Compute once_allowed from the capture's origin chat and re-check it at send time.

title: A row ticked before its message properties arrive can stay unable to forward or delete
trigger: Hover a gallery row and tick it at once, then move to another row. The tick stores allow-nothing (SelectedMedia::from_actions(None)); the answer lands in the single shared messages.message_menu_actions slot, refresh_from_answer runs only on later hover events, and the next row's request overwrites the slot.
effect: Forward and Delete in the selection bar stay disabled for the whole group until that row is unticked and ticked again.
fix: Send a properties request per ticked message keyed by message id and apply each answer to its selection entry, instead of reading one shared slot on hover.

title: Gallery row menu acts on the gallery chat at click time, not the chat the menu was built for
trigger: Right click a gallery row (menu captures message_id and file only), then change the gallery chat before choosing an item (keyboard chat switch, notification click). shared_media_menu_action reads session.media.shared_media.chat_id when the item is clicked.
effect: Forward runs begin_forward_one(new chat, old message id), and ids collide across private chats and basic groups, so a different message can be forwarded. Delete is gated by the actions slot and mostly refused.
fix: Capture an AccountChat/ChatMessage owner key in the menu closure and drop the action when it no longer equals the open gallery chat.

title: Media spoiler tile (60 frames of 3000 specks) is built inside paint on the UI thread and rebuilt after every 3 s idle release
trigger: Scroll to a chat with a spoiler photo, scroll away for 3+ s, scroll back.
effect: Frame hitch of tens of ms (about 4.5M speck stamps and 16 MB allocation) each time.
fix: Build off-thread into a Loading/Ready tile, and release only under memory pressure.

title: Export writes a workbook that silently lacks graphs that are still loading or failed, and then reports success
trigger: Open channel statistics while async graphs (mute graph etc.) are loading or one failed, press Export to File.
effect: File saved with missing sheets; the toast says the export is done.
fix: Refuse (or warn) while any async graph of the page is Loading or Failed.

title: The pump redraws the whole app on every drained batch, not only for a first frame
trigger: Any animated sticker or emoji playing
effect: The doc says it redraws when a clip opened or its first frame is ready, but drain()'s first-frame result is ignored and cx.notify() runs for every worker wake, so layered emoji (meant to avoid rebuilding slices) still rebuild the app per decoded frame
fix: Notify only when drain() returned true

title: A chosen video that fails to download leaves pending_video set with no progress or error
trigger: In Adapt from a Sticker, pick a WEBM (or a saved GIF) that is not downloaded and let the download fail or the app be offline
effect: The chooser closed, nothing is shown, no editor ever opens; pending_video stays until the set box closes. Without a live driver it never resolves
fix: Add a Downloading stage that shows progress and has an error exit when the file's download ends without a path

title: Pasted clipboard images are written to a guessable world-readable temp file that is never deleted
trigger: Paste an image into the composer (or export a peer QR through the same helper), send or discard it, keep using Quill.
effect: The image bytes stay in the system temp dir as quill-paste-<nanos>-<seq>-<pid>.<ext> (default umask, usually readable by other local users) until the OS clears temp; the startup sweep in scratch.rs only covers the quill-send-photos/quill-edits... subfolders, not these files. A guessable name in a shared temp dir is also open to a pre-placed symlink.
fix: Write into the swept per-process work dir (scratch) with create_new and mode 0600, and delete the file when the tray entry is sent, removed or the app exits.

title: A failed draft send leaves the slot marked dirty with nothing pending
trigger: Type in the composer; the debounced or flushed setChatDraftMessage send returns Err
effect: mark_draft_dirty ran, pending_draft/draft_clock were cleared before send_draft (Write arm line 117-119, commit_debounced_draft take()), the error is returned and dropped by callers; the slot stays dirty so drafts saved from other devices are ignored (per the deselect_chat comment) and the draft is never retried
fix: Keep the pending draft until send_draft succeeds (Draft stage: Clean, Dirty, Debouncing{token}, Sending).

title: Deferred caption: row is rewritten to the new caption and the edit error is discarded
trigger: Edit the caption of a pending upload, then the send succeeds and editMessageCaption fails to send (or is refused)
effect: set_caption mutates the local row first and `let _ = self.edit_snapshot` drops the Err: the row shows a caption the server never got. Also an entry in deferred_captions whose message disappears without a send outcome (chat deleted, account state reset) is never removed
fix: Keep the old caption on the pending record and restore it (with a toast) when the edit fails; drop entries when the message leaves history

title: begin_bot_edit leaves a half-started edit when the second load send fails
trigger: Open the bot edit dialog while the sender refuses between the name and about requests (or the first fails).
effect: edit is already Some with loads holding RequestIds that never get answers (send_json_request ? returns early); the dialog keeps waiting for texts and the about request is never sent.
fix: Edit stage enum Loading{waiting}/Ready/Failed, set after both sends, with Failed on the Err arm.

title: stop_poll looks the poll up in histories only, while the other poll calls use loaded_message
trigger: Stop an own poll from a forum topic or comment thread view where the poll is not in the main history.
effect: stop_poll returns InvalidRequest (can_stop false) because histories.get(chat).messages has no such row; send_poll_answer, retract_poll_vote and fetch_poll_voters use session.loaded_message, which also searches topic histories and saved views.
fix: Use session.loaded_message in stop_poll.

title: sticker_categories_asked is set before the request and reset only when the send fails; an error answer leaves it true
trigger: Open the sticker panel while getEmojiCategories fails (error response).
effect: No error handler resets the flag, fetch_sticker_categories returns early for the whole session, and the category strip stays empty until restart.
fix: enum CategoriesFetch { Idle, Asking{request}, Loaded, Failed } reset by the error path.

title: advance_manager_commit clears the whole commit queue on a send error, so queued removals and reorders are silently lost after the box has closed
trigger: Close the stickers manager box after removing sets and reordering; the second step's send fails.
effect: All later commits are dropped; the box already closed as if saved, the order/removal never reaches the server.
fix: Keep failed commits in the queue as Failed with a visible retry, drop only the failed step.

title: One shared stickers.failed flag is cleared by every sticker_request start and set by any failure
trigger: Open the sticker panel; a getTrendingStickerSets fails; another list request starts.
effect: The next request sets failed=false, hiding the earlier failure; a failure of an unrelated request marks the visible tab failed.
fix: A per-list fetch enum (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of shared failed/loading_* bools.

title: refresh_stale_panels takes the recent/favorites/trending/emoji/reaction stale flags first, then returns early on an inactive path or on the first send error
trigger: updateRecentStickers arrives while locked or while the first refetch's send fails.
effect: The remaining stale flags are already cleared, so those panels stay out of date until another update arrives.
fix: Clear each stale flag only when its refetch is sent.

title: status_open stays set after an account switch with the status picker open
trigger: Open the emoji status picker (Premium status), switch account without closing it
effect: OnScreen is replaced whole, so pickers.media_panel.panel_mode resets without set_media_panel_mode, and PickerUi's Farewell is empty (ui/pickers_state.rs:107); close_emoji_status_choices is never called for the retired account. Its Session keeps status_open=true in the background, so every envelope of that hidden client runs maybe_resolve_emoji_status_choices and keeps resolving status choices; on switch back the flag is set with the picker closed
fix: Add a Farewell for the media panel that calls close_emoji_status_choices, or derive 'resolving statuses' from the panel mode instead of a Session flag

title: Any getMessageEffect error (rate limit, network, timeout) marks the effect gone for the whole session
trigger: Open a private chat that has messages sent with effects while the connection is flaky or TDLib answers 429 to getMessageEffect; the error arm in state/domains/stickers/error.rs:21 calls MessageEffects::fail(id) for every TdError without looking at the code.
effect: The effect id sits in `failed` for the life of the Session: wanted() never asks again, is_gone() makes message_effects_pass drop the waiting play, the badge never gets its icon and the effect never plays, until the account is re-added. The message was already marked watched, so it is lost for good.
fix: Hold each effect as Fetch<MessageEffect> (idle, loading, ready, failed) where only a real not-found is a terminal Gone and other errors return to idle so the next frame can ask again.

title: A failed game button press (GetCallbackQueryAnswerGame) gives no feedback
trigger: Press a game button in a bot chat while the bot does not answer (TDLib 502) or offline
effect: Nothing happens: apply_bots_error notes an answer for GetCallbackQueryAnswer and ...WithPassword only, the Game purpose falls to the default arm
fix: Handle the Game purpose in the same arm as the plain callback

title: A failed getSharingProtection turns private-chat sharing protection off without the confirm box
trigger: Profile menu of a private chat: Enable Sharing, while getMessageProperties fails (offline blip, TDLib error)
effect: The error arm sets private_sharing.enable = TurnOff(chat_id) unconditionally, so the driver proceeds to turn protection off; if the other person protects the chat TDLib sends them a request the user never confirmed (AskToRequest is skipped). Also not checked that the flow is still for chat_id
fix: On error go to a Failed/Unknown stage that shows the Send Request? box (or an error), never to TurnOff.

title: A forced reply arms only the main window; one aimed at a chat window's chat is lost, and a second in the same poll batch overwrites the first
trigger: Open a bot chat in its own window; the bot sends a message with force-reply markup (or two bots do in one batch). The poll drains Session::bots::pending_force_reply once in the main window (ui/notifications/mod.rs drain_force_reply, commented 'not routed there yet').
effect: The chat window's composer is not put into reply mode; the force-reply of another chat is dropped by the single Option slot.
fix: Keep force-reply targets per chat (or in the chat's ChatUi/WindowSlot) and drain them in per_window_upkeep of whichever window shows the chat.

title: Report flow answers are matched by chat only, so an answer for a closed flow applies to a new flow in the same chat
trigger: Report message A (choose a reason so the flow is Sending), press Esc (clear_message_report), open Report on message B in the same chat before TDLib answers. The old reportChat answers Ok.
effect: accept_message_report matches pending.chat_id only (ReportMessages carries no flow identity), so B's flow becomes Reported although B was never sent; an old error likewise turns the new flow into Failed.
fix: Give each flow an id (or store the in-flight RequestId in Checking/Sending) and apply an answer or error only when it matches; clearing the flow drops the id.

title: Any getRepliedMessage error marks the reply 'Deleted message' for good
trigger: Open a chat with a reply whose original is outside the window while the network drops or TDLib answers 429/500 (error arm messages/error.rs:19 calls reject_replied_message unconditionally).
effect: ReplyTarget::Missing is stored, reply_fetch_candidates skips every key that is in reply_targets, and reply_header reports ReplyState::Deleted with 'Deleted message' until the chat is pruned; the strip is never refetched although the message exists.
fix: Only 400/404 produce Missing; other errors remove the Loading entry (or store Failed{retry_at}) so the pass asks again after a wait, as GetStory does with story_retry.

title: accept_sticker_set clears loading_set for an answer that is not the selected set
trigger: In the sticker panel select set A, then select set B before A answers (select_sticker_set resets loading_set and maybe_load_selected_sticker_set is skipped because a GetStickerSet is in flight).
effect: A's answer sets loading_set=false and is then discarded (selected is B); B has no request, loaded_set_id is None, so the panel shows an empty grid with no spinner until the next per-update pass resends. If A's request fails, panel.failed=true is shown for B.
fix: StickerPanel.set: enum { Idle, Loading{request,set_id}, Ready{set_id,stickers}, Failed{set_id} }; apply and fail only when request id matches and clear loading only for it.

title: Cancel while 'Creating...' loses the result of a createBot that then succeeds
trigger: Press Create, then Cancel (button stays enabled while submitted) before TDLib answers
effect: close_bot_create takes the dialog and reset_create_bot bumps CreateBotState::generation and clears creating; the late createBot answer no longer matches creating==Some(generation) (state/domains/bots/owned.rs:apply_created_bot), so the bot is created on the server but the user gets no toast, no chat and no share_users_with_bot for a keyboard-button request; retrying the same username then says taken
fix: Disable Cancel (or keep a Creating stage that outlives the box) so the answer still reports and shares the new bot

title: Add-bot and Share-game boxes close as if saved when the request was only queued
trigger: Profile of a bot > Add to group > pick chat > Add as admin, when the server later refuses (no right) ; or share a game to a chat the bot cannot post in.
effect: submit_add_bot/send_shared_game return true on Ok(Some)/Ok(_) (request queued), so the box closes and the chat is selected; the refusal only arrives later as a generic error. For Plan::Admin the start message is also sent right after the promote without waiting for its answer.
fix: Keep the box in a Sending stage and close on the answer matched by request id; send the start payload on promote ok.

title: Join group note overwrites join_channel's own error, and 'Join request sent' is shown before any answer
trigger: Open a group with the Join / Apply to join bar while offline (join_channel returns Err), press the button.
effect: join_channel sets StatusNote::error('could not join'); press_bottom_action then sets set_note('Joining group'/'Join request sent') unconditionally, replacing it. User is told the request was sent when the send failed; success of the join is also never matched back.
fix: Have join_channel return the send result and let press_bottom_action set the note only on Ok.

title: Join-requests box spins forever when the first fetch or a search cannot be sent
trigger: Open the join-requests box (or type in its search) while the request cannot be sent: refresh_chat_join_requests / search_chat_join_requests return Err (removes groups.join_requests[chat]) or Ok(None) (not ready, entry never created). The results of both calls are dropped with `let _ =`.
effect: build_join_requests_dialog maps `None | Some(Loading)` to the spinner 'Loading join requests', so the box shows a spinner with no way out and no error note; closing and reopening is the only exit.
fix: Make the box read a Fetch-like value with an explicit Failed/Idle arm: on Err or Ok(None) store JoinRequestFetch::Failed(message) (and show a note) so None means 'not asked', not 'loading'.

title: A stale background_error from a closed dialog or another feature shows in the next chat look dialog
trigger: Apply in chat A, close the dialog, the setChatBackground error arrives later (close_chat_look_dialog cleared the field before it landed); open the look dialog for chat B (or Settings -> Telegram wallpapers also writes the field)
effect: chat B's dialog opens with 'Couldn't change the chat look: <error>' drawn at once (chat_look_ui.rs:781); open_chat_look_dialog never clears it
fix: Make the error part of the in-flight stage of the open dialog (see P-004) instead of a session-wide field shared by the wallpaper pickers.

title: Picked /command is removed from the field before the send gates run
trigger: Type /st in a chat with slow mode active (or a frozen account, a chat where text sending is denied, an unsupported chat type) and click or Enter on /start.
effect: send_command_menu_index closes the menu and replaces the token with '' first; send_menu_command then returns true after slow_mode_blocked/deny_send/frozen/unsupported with only a note. Nothing was sent and the typed command is gone from the composer. The doc comment of send_menu_command also promises the paid-Stars confirmation, but the function never calls paid_send_waits.
fix: Run the gates first (a 'can send now' check returning a Refused variant) and remove the token only when the send was issued; in paid chats route through the paid guard.

title: begin_edit silently discards the attachment tray
trigger: Attach files to the composer in chat A, then choose Edit on any own message from its context menu or the scheduled box.
effect: clear_pending_attachments runs unconditionally with no note; the tray the user built is lost (only the Up-key path checks the tray is empty).
fix: Refuse Edit with a note while a tray exists, or keep the tray stashed in EditMode and restore it on leave_edit.

title: clear_draft_on_success is per-window ComposerUi but its only reader runs on the main window
trigger: In a chat window, send a text message. submit sets that window slot's composer_ui.clear_draft_on_success. The ack is handled by poll_live -> finish_successful_sends (notifications/mod.rs:526), which takes session.messages.draft_clears and reads self.composer_ui / chat_ui / composer of the window in place (the main window).
effect: The chat window's flag is never matched and stays Some for the life of the slot; the draft_clears entry was already taken, so the cloud draft of the sent text is not cleared (reappears on other devices / after restart). A later ack in the main window for the same chat can also consume the stale flag of another window's send.
fix: Make the pending clear a per-account/chat-keyed entry (e.g. a map keyed by (AccountKey, ChatId, DraftTopic) in ComposerSends) consumed by the ack whichever window sent, not a field of the window's ComposerUi.

title: Secret-chat inline-bot alert stash is per window, not per chat: a SwitchInline query pressed in one secret chat is inserted into another
trigger: In secret chat A press a bot's SwitchInline button (first inline use this session): the privacy banner shows and the query is stashed. Without confirming, open secret chat B in the same window. The banner is still shown in B; press its confirm.
effect: A's bot query text is inserted into B's composer and the inline query runs in B. The only guard (open_chat_is_secret) passes for any secret chat; nothing on chat change clears ComposerUi::pending_inline_bot_alert (writers: inline_mode.rs:111/123, close_chat_preview.rs:860/866/885).
fix: Move the stash into ChatUi (replaced on chat change) or store it as Option<(ChatId, String)> and drop it when the chat differs.

title: A one-time bot keyboard is dismissed and deleted at TDLib even when the button's text was not sent
trigger: In a slow-mode group (or while the send fails) press a button of a one_time reply keyboard.
effect: press_custom_keyboard_text dismisses the keyboard locally and calls deleteChatReplyMarkup before send_command_text, which returns early on slow_mode_blocked or no session and notes an error on send Err. The command is unsent and the keyboard is gone for good.
fix: Dismiss only after send_snapshot returned Ok (make send_command_text return whether it sent).

title: A one-time keyboard's poll-request button deletes the keyboard when the poll box is opened, not when a poll is sent
trigger: Press a one_time RequestPoll keyboard button, then cancel the poll box.
effect: dismiss_custom_keyboard (local hide + deleteChatReplyMarkup) runs on click before open_poll_dialog_locked; cancelling leaves no keyboard and no poll.
fix: Carry the keyboard key in the poll dialog and dismiss when the poll is sent.

title: Emoji packs box reopens with the old search text while listing Installed
trigger: Settings > Emoji sets, type 'cat' in the search field, close the box, reopen it
effect: Search field still reads 'cat' but the list shows the Installed tab (open_emoji_sets resets tab and return tab, never the input); field and list disagree until the user edits it
fix: Clear the input and bump emoji_set_keystroke in open_emoji_sets, or keep the view as one enum EmojiBoxView {Tab(tab), Search{query}} that the field is drawn from.

title: A finished emoji set download switches to its set even after the user chose another set
trigger: Settings > Chat > Choose emoji set: click Twemoji (not downloaded, download starts), then click an already downloaded set or the system font while the download runs; wait for the download to finish.
effect: The set the user picked last is replaced by the downloaded one when it lands (also the startup fallback download overrides a choice made meanwhile). choose_emoji_set -> switch_emoji_set never cancels state.download, and the download task calls switch_emoji_set(id) unconditionally on Ok.
fix: One EmojiSetStage enum {Idle, Switching{id,task}, Downloading{id,progress,task}, Failed{id,why}}: any new choice replaces the stage, which cancels the download, and the download continuation switches only while its stage is still current.

title: 'Suggest Emoji' does nothing and shows no note when the keyword lookup fails
trigger: Right-click a word, choose Suggest Emoji while offline or after searchEmojis failed ATTEMPTS times
effect: asked stays Some (only a text change clears it); no answer arrives so no bar and no 'no emoji' note; if an answer arrives later from another lookup the bar pops open unprompted
fix: Make asked an enum {Idle, Waiting(word), Done} that leaves Waiting on answer, on failure (with a note) and on timeout; KeywordLookups should expose a failed(query) state.

title: A force-reply target is dropped when its chat is not the open one, and chat windows never arm or show it
trigger: A bot sends a force-reply message in chat B while chat A is open (or B is shown in a chat window, or the message is outside the loaded history).
effect: poll takes bots.pending_force_reply (single slot, a second target overwrites the first), apply_force_reply returns when session.open_chat != target.chat_id or reply_target is None, and nothing re-arms it; drain_force_reply still dismisses B's custom keyboard. Opening B later shows no reply bar. open_chat_force_reply keys off session.open_chat so a chat window's own chat never shows the bar.
fix: Keep pending force-replies per chat (ChatMessage key) and arm when that chat is shown in any window, instead of one drained slot.

title: A forward's answer wipes a newer forward being built in the same conversation
trigger: Forward messages from chat A, then immediately select messages in the same chat/topic and open the forward box (or have the bar up); the first forward's TDLib answer then arrives.
effect: present_forward_result treats any draft from the same chat and topic as 'this forward' and sets ForwardStage::None, closing the new box/selection and losing the draft; its doc says another forward stays but only a different topic is distinguished.
fix: Give each forward a token (request id) stored on the stage and in ForwardResult; clear only when the tokens match.

title: send_inline_pick clears the composer before the send and does not restore it on failure
trigger: Pick an inline result while disconnected (driver.send_inline_query_result returns Err).
effect: The '@bot query' text is gone and only an error note shows; nothing was sent.
fix: Clear the composer when the send is acknowledged (a Sending stage on the pick), or restore the text on the error arm.

title: Chat-row menu becomes invisible but stays open when its chat is removed (also the top-person menu)
trigger: Right-click a chat row (or a top-people tile); the chat is deleted/left from another device while the menu is open.
effect: chat_menu_overlay and top_person_menu_overlay return an empty div without the dismiss layer, but chat_list.menu stays Some: arrows are swallowed (context_menu_key), the sidebar stays peeked, Escape needed.
fix: Drop chat_list.menu when the chat leaves the session (same sync that closes other chat-bound boxes).

title: Secret-chat inline-bot warning stash is not bound to the chat that asked
trigger: In secret chat A press a switch-inline button (stash set, banner shown), open secret chat B without confirming, press Confirm on the banner.
effect: pending_inline_bot_alert survives the chat change (never cleared on sync_chat_ui) and the banner/confirm check only that the open chat is secret, so A's query text is inserted into B's composer.
fix: Store the stash with its chat: `pending_inline_bot_alert: Option<(ChatId, String)>` and drop it in replace_chat_ui / compare on confirm.

title: Message menu becomes invisible but stays open when its message is removed
trigger: Right-click a message; the sender deletes it (or the history window drops it) while the menu is open.
effect: The overlay returns an empty div (no DismissLayer), but message_ui.menu stays Some: context_menu_open() is true, arrow keys are swallowed by context_menu_key, the sidebar peek is held, until Escape is pressed.
fix: Close the menu when its message goes (check in the frame sync) or build the menu stage from a snapshot so it never depends on the live message; draw/dismiss from the same value that says open.

title: Pinned list panel flag is not reset when the chat changes, and a lone pin has no toggle to close it
trigger: Open the pinned list in chat A (several pins), open chat B that has exactly one pin.
effect: pinned_list_open is a HistoryUi bool never reset on chat change (grep: only set in the bar/list handlers), so chat B shows its list open; with count==1 the bar shows the unpin/hide X instead of the list toggle, so the list can only be closed by clicking a row or unpinning.
fix: Move it to ChatUi (replaced per chat) or key it by AccountChat: `pinned_list_open: Option<AccountChat>`.

title: A late report answer is applied to a newer report of the same chat
trigger: Report message A, press Cancel while the box says Reporting, report message B in the same chat at once; the answer for A arrives.
effect: accept_message_report and fail_message_report match only the chat id, not the request or the stage: the box for B jumps to A's option list (or to Failed/Reported), and A's option ids are then sent with B's message ids.
fix: Give each flow a token (the RequestId of its current step) and apply an answer only when it equals the flow's token and the stage is the one waiting for it.

title: Closing a location request box leaves its lookup running
trigger: In a bot chat press a request-location keyboard button, then Cancel the box (request_share.rs:295/309/464 set request_share = None).
effect: request_locate (the lookup Task) is only ever overwritten (request_share.rs:125), never dropped on close, so the device location lookup the user cancelled runs to the end and writes its outcome into whatever request_share is open next.
fix: Put the lookup Task inside RequestShare as enum Locate { Searching(Task<()>), Found(..), Failed(..) } so closing the box drops it.

title: A typed inline reply is taken from the store and lost when it cannot be sent
trigger: Type a reply in an OS notification, then Quill is locked (or the chat refuses the send: no rights, closed topic).
effect: send_typed_notification_reply removes the text first; plan_inline_reply returns None when locked and send_text_snapshot can return Err, so the function returns false, the chat is opened instead and the typed text is gone.
fix: Take the text only after the send is accepted, or put it into the opened chat's composer draft.

title: A background account's failed file preparation or missing client toasts an error on the account on screen
trigger: Account A: attach a large photo and tap Send (files are being prepared). Switch to account B before preparation finishes, with ffmpeg failing or timing out for the photo (or A's client gone).
effect: B's screen shows an error note ('could not send' / the prepare error) that belongs to A's send; A's draft and tray stay. deliver_live_send guards its success/failure notes with on_screen, but finish_media_prep's Err arm (line 302) and deliver_live_send's missing-client arm (line 324) set the note unconditionally.
fix: Route the note through the origin account: set it only when origin.slot.account is the screen's account (the on_screen test already in deliver_live_send), else drop it or queue it for that account.

title: upload_created_sticker drops the New Sticker box as if uploaded when the send failed
trigger: Press Done on a New Sticker with the driver channel failing (or no longer owning the set: owned_set_name None gives InvalidRequest)
effect: An error toast shows but create is cleared, the box closes and the user's edited image and chosen emoji are lost; the editor PNG (create.path) is also never removed
fix: Clear create only on Ok; on Err stay in the Naming stage

title: Install/remove of the viewed set treats Ok(None) (request skipped as busy) as success
trigger: Open a set box, press Add/Remove Stickers while a ManageStickerSet or reorder request for that set is still pending (double click, or right after the manager box closed)
effect: manage_sticker_set returns Ok(None) without sending; the box closes and the toast says 'Sticker set added/removed' though nothing was sent. With Ok(Some) the same success note and close happen before TDLib answers, so a later failure leaves a wrong note
fix: Match Ok(Some)/Ok(None)/Err separately; keep the box in an 'Installing' stage (button disabled, as sticker_set_action does) until the answer, close on success only

title: Archive of the viewed set closes the box and notes 'archived' on Ok(None)
trigger: Press Archive Stickers while a request for the same set is pending
effect: Same as install: nothing sent, box closes and 'archived' note shown
fix: Same stage enum for the set action; answer-driven close

title: Manager box closes and clears its edits as if saved; later commit steps fail silently
trigger: Mark sets removed and drag a new order, close the box; the removal succeeds but the reorder step fails, or the connection is down
effect: finish_manager clears the edits first; commit errors after the first step are discarded by pump_sticker_manager (let _) and commits.clear() drops the rest, so removals/order are lost with no note after the first step
fix: Keep edits until the commit queue reports done, or report the failing step with a toast and reopen offer

title: A failed widget storage write is not retried: `unsaved` is cleared before the write
trigger: Use a widget that writes localStorage while the disk is full or the widget folder is not writable; free the space; quit Quill (or let the widget be pruned).
effect: save_widget_storage takes `unsaved` with mem::take before storage::save; on error it only logs. The entry is clean, so the farewell, the debounce timer and prune_hidden_widgets never write it again; the widget's local storage is lost at the next start unless it changes again.
fix: Clear `unsaved` only after storage::save succeeds (or keep a `Storage { Clean | Dirty | Failed }` value per entry and retry on the next timer).

title: status_open / chat_status_open are only cleared by the media panel mode setter on the current account
trigger: Open the emoji-status selector, then switch accounts (or lose the panel) without leaving Status mode through set_media_panel_mode.
effect: The old session keeps status_open=true, so every ingest of that background account keeps resolving status emoji (getCustomEmojiStickers) and a later failure writes status_note.
fix: Move the open flag into OnScreen/WindowSlot state and close it in the Farewell.

title: load_message_effects marks an id requested before the send; a failed send or dropped answer leaves it requested forever
trigger: Open a chat with effect messages while the JSON sender fails (channel closed during a reconnect) or the request is dropped without an answer or error; mark_requested(effect_id) already ran and the `?` on send_json_request returns early.
effect: wanted() filters on `requested`, so that effect and the ids after it in the loop are never asked for again: no badge icon, no effect, and the send-menu picker cell never loads, until restart.
fix: Make `requested` part of a per-id Fetch stage set only after the send succeeded, and leave Loading on the error arm, a dropped request and a reconnect.

title: AI text answers go through one single-slot Option and replace whatever the draft is now
trigger: Press Fix with AI, keep typing (or start another AI action in a second chat window) before the answer lands
effect: MessagesState::ai_composer_text (core/mod.rs:793) holds one (chat, text): a second answer overwrites the first, the answer replaces the newer draft, and an answer for a chat whose window closed stays forever (window_upkeep.rs:229 only takes it when ours)
fix: Carry a draft revision/token (as AiComposePurpose::BoxCompose{token} does) and queue answers per chat

title: send_quick_reply has no in-flight dedupe, so a double tap sends the shortcut's messages twice
trigger: Pick a quick reply for a customer chat and double click.
effect: Each call allocates a new sending_id and sends sendQuickReplyShortcutMessages; the same messages arrive twice in the chat. Also add_quick_reply_text (line 76) and delete/rename have no dedupe: a double click on Add creates the message twice.
fix: A Sending stage per (chat, shortcut) and a Mutating stage that disables the buttons.

title: One session-wide slot for message_menu_actions is shared by every window and every consumer, and a failed getMessageProperties has no error arm
trigger: Open a message context menu in a chat window while the main window hovers a shared-media row (shared_media_select.rs) or the media viewer fetches actions; or getMessageProperties fails
effect: The slot holds one (chat,message); the other consumer's fetch overwrites it, the menu falls back to the permissive local guess (allows(local,..) in message_menu_overlay.rs) and may offer Delete/Edit rows TDLib would refuse. On error (error.rs has no GetMessageMenuActions arm) the menu stays on the guess for good
fix: Key actions by (ChatId,MessageId) in a map owned by the consumer (per window) and add a Failed state that hides gated rows.

title: One-shot error notes are single Option<String> slots overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two message actions fail (for example resend and delete-by-sender, or two poll option edits) between two UI drains, or a failure lands while the main window is hidden or locked
effect: The first note is replaced and never shown; a lost toast. Writers: error.rs lines 69, 75, 81, 87, 124-143, 188-211 all assign Some(..) over any undrained value
fix: A Notes queue (Vec<Note>) drained whole, or push to the shared toast queue directly.

title: AI composer answer is matched only by chat id, not by draft, topic or request
trigger: Ask AI to fix text in a forum chat topic A, switch to topic B of the same chat (or type more text), the answer arrives
effect: window_upkeep.rs:229-246 applies the answer to the composer of open_chat==chat_id and set_composer_markup replaces the whole draft: it overwrites topic B's draft or text typed after the request. A second answer overwrites the first undrained slot
fix: Carry (RequestId, DraftKey incl. topic, draft revision) in the answer and apply only when the composer still shows that key and revision.

title: One shared StickerPanel::failed flag is set by 11 unrelated sticker requests
trigger: Open the sticker panel with loaded sets, then fail a favorite add/remove, clear recent, or a search request.
effect: stickers.failed = true turns the loaded panel into the failure state although the shown list is fine; it clears only on the next successful load.
fix: Per-list Fetch<T> stages; a failed mutation reports a note, not the list failure.

title: createForumTopic drops the cached topic list but forum_row_asked stays set
trigger: Create a topic in a forum that the chat list preloaded (forum_row_asked has the chat). The ForumTopic answer removes forum_topics for the chat.
effect: preload_topics (connect/subsection_tabs.rs:97) never asks again for the chat, so its chat-list row reads loaded = false ('Loading...') until the forum is opened.
fix: Per-forum enum TopicsFetch { Idle, Loading, Ready(list), Failed } so removing the list also leaves Asked.

title: resendMessages always sends paid_message_star_count 0 and goes around the paid-message guard
trigger: In a chat that charges Stars per message, a send fails with a retryable state (for example the price went up: messageSendingStateFailed.required_paid_message_star_count > 0). Right-click the failed message and choose Retry send.
effect: resend_failed_message (connect/messages/edit.rs:266) builds resendMessages with paid_message_star_count 0. PaidGuard::screen only looks at '"@type":"send' and 'forwardM', so 'resendMessages' is never priced or confirmed. In a paid chat the retry fails again every time, and nothing asks the user to pay.
fix: Put resendMessages through the paid guard (count = message_ids.len()) or pass the failed state's required_paid_message_star_count after a confirmation.

title: Send To switch stats the Send To folder on the UI thread every render, and concurrent toggles can finish out of order
trigger: Windows: open Settings > General (rendered each frame calls is_enabled -> SHGetKnownFolderPath + is_file); click the switch twice quickly (two background_spawn set_enabled tasks)
effect: per-frame blocking shell/disk IO on the UI thread while the page is open; the two background tasks can finish in either order so the shortcut ends in the state of the first click, not the last
fix: Read once into a Fetch<bool>/enum {Known(bool), Applying{want}, Failed} on the settings screen; refuse or queue a click while Applying.

title: START parameter is removed before TDLib confirms sendBotStartMessage
trigger: Open a bot via t.me/bot?start=param, press Start while the request will fail (flood, offline right after send)
effect: press_bot_start removes Session bots.bot_start_params[chat] as soon as the request is queued; the error arm only sets chat_action_error, so the Start bar and the parameter are gone and the bot is later started without the parameter or not at all
fix: Remove the parameter in the reducer on the sendBotStartMessage success (or keep a Starting{param} stage restored on error)

title: Add-bot box shows 'Loading…' forever when the bot's full info never arrives
trigger: Open Add to group from a bot profile with fetch_user_full_info failing, or in a session without live.
effect: bot_invite_facts needs session.bots.bot_info for the bot; the fetch result is discarded (let _ =), and the box has no error or retry stage, only Cancel.
fix: Fetch<BotInfo> for the bot with a Failed arm and Retry in the box.

title: Add-all / Dismiss-all confirm alert outlives its account and uses a stale count
trigger: Open the join-requests box, click 'Add all', leave the kit alert open, switch account (or the list changes from another device), press OK.
effect: on_ok calls process_all_join_requests(chat_id, approve) on whatever live account is current (a chat id of the old account), and the confirm text shows the count captured when the box was rendered.
fix: Open the confirm through a registered DialogKind owned by OnScreen (closed by the switch) and re-read count/chat on OK, checking ScreenEpoch.

title: A send error on one change marks Apply failed while the other changes are still in flight; Apply again resends them
trigger: Pick a theme and a wallpaper; the driver rejects the second send (Err) so background_error is set while sent=1 stays awaiting
effect: drain_chat_look sees the error at once, clears awaiting and keeps the dialog open; the theme request is still running and Apply sends the theme again (sent twice, or CHAT_NOT_MODIFIED error on the repeat)
fix: Per-request stage (Sent(id) / Done / Failed(err)) so Failed leaves only the failed change to retry.

title: Apply's acknowledgement is a global counter and a global error string, not matched to the requests it sent
trigger: Press Apply in chat A's look dialog, close it before the answers (Cancel/Esc), open chat B's look dialog and press Apply; or a GetInstalledBackgrounds/SearchBackground error (same background_error field, state/domains/chats/error.rs:32,46) lands while Apply waits
effect: A late ok from the earlier apply is counted toward B's LookWait (chat_look_oks), so the dialog closes as Done before B's change was acknowledged; a foreign background error makes B's Apply show 'Couldn't change the chat look' although its requests succeeded
fix: Keep the RequestIds Apply sent in LookWait (awaiting: Vec<RequestId>) and settle each on its own answer or error, with the error stored per request instead of the shared background_error.

title: Re-selecting the open chat cancels a running recording
trigger: Record a voice or round video in the open chat, click the same chat's row in the list (or open it from a link/notification).
effect: enter_chat_ui calls cancel_recording_here before the same-chat early return, so the recording is discarded although the doc says choosing the open chat again keeps its bars; recorded voice message is lost.
fix: Move cancel_recording_here (and the ttl/forward upkeep) below the chat==Some(chat) check, or into the branch that replaces the value.

title: sync_chat_ui's chat-changed fallback skips the goodbyes enter_chat_ui owes
trigger: The open chat changes by a path that bypasses enter_chat_ui (chat upgraded/replaced by the reducer, another device) while a recording runs or a forward selection is made in the old chat.
effect: Only the ChatUi value is replaced: the recording keeps running with origin = this window and its send target is resolved from the new open chat (voice note goes to the wrong chat); the forward draft/bar of the old chat and the old chat's TTL picker stay (only the topic branch calls dismiss_forward_for_view).
fix: Make sync_chat_ui call the same single function enter_chat_ui uses for a chat change (recording, forward, ttl, profile modal) instead of two partial lists.

title: Edit-replacement and attach pickers answer into whatever edit state is current
trigger: In an edit, click Replace attachment (pick_edit_replacement, spawn_scoped) or the attach button (pick_attachments); the Linux portal picker is not modal. Before it answers, press Esc to cancel the edit, or start Edit on another message in the same chat.
effect: pick_edit_replacement applies the file to the new edit's media_edit (wrong message). pick_attachments: attach_picked_in matches only send_slot (account/chat/topic), so with the edit cancelled the picked files land in the normal send tray and go out on the next Send.
fix: The ask carries an edit token (chat, message id, EditMode generation) and the answer is dropped when ChatUi's current edit differs.

title: Edit mode is left as soon as editMessage is sent; a later server error loses the edited text
trigger: Edit an old message (outside the edit window, or deleted by the other side), press Enter.
effect: submit_edit calls finish_edit_restore_draft on request-sent, restoring the old draft; when TDLib answers with an error only a note shows and the edited text is gone from the composer.
fix: Keep EditMode as Sending{request id} until the answer; leave it on ok, return to Editing on error.

title: Rich composer clears the editor on request-sent, not on success
trigger: Send a rich message that TDLib later rejects (flood wait, Premium lapsed, chat closed).
effect: submit_rich_composer sets the field to '' and forgets the local draft on Ok from the driver; the later failure only shows a note and the blocks are lost (doc says 'the editor keeps its text').
fix: Clear the field when the send acks (like clear_draft_on_success consumers) or keep a per-send Sending state with the text.

title: send_menu_command sends a command in a paid chat without the Stars confirmation its doc promises
trigger: Pick a /command in a chat that charges Stars per message (send_gate(chat).stars() > 0).
effect: The send skips paid_send_waits; with no trusted price TDLib refuses it (per paid_messages_send.rs) so the command is lost with a generic error, or the driver's held_paid_send holds it with no matching composer confirm.
fix: Call paid_send_waits(chat_id, command) before send_snapshot and resume the command from the confirm.

title: AI composer answer replaces the draft with no check that the draft is unchanged
trigger: Press Fix/Rewrite in the rich editor, keep typing or send the message before the answer arrives.
effect: apply_ai_composer_answer matches only the chat (open_chat == chat_id) and calls set_composer_markup: text typed meanwhile is overwritten, and a message already sent is restored as a new draft (can be sent twice). Also applied into an edit field when an edit was started after the ask.
fix: Carry the draft revision / edit token with the ask (RequestPurpose) and apply only if the field still holds the asked text.

title: clear_draft_on_success holds one pending send; a second send in another chat overwrites it
trigger: Send a message in chat A and, before its updateMessageSendSucceeded arrives, open chat B and send there (send_prep.rs:453 / composer/mod.rs:571 overwrite the Option). A's ack then compares flag.matches(A, ..) against B's flag.
effect: A's draft is not cleared on ack (draft_clears already taken), B's flag is cleared only by B's ack; A keeps a stale cloud draft.
fix: Key the pending clears by slot (HashMap<(ChatId,DraftTopic), DraftClear>) so each ack finds its own entry and every entry has an exit (ack, send failure, owner gone).

title: Link-preview prefetch debounce is restarted every frame, not every keystroke
trigger: Type or paste a URL in the composer while any frame is drawn at least every 500 ms (caret blink, typing indicator, playing animation). window_upkeep.rs:46 calls maybe_prefetch_link_preview each frame; while the URL has no composer_previews entry it bumps preview_token and spawns a new 500 ms timer each time, so every earlier timer finds a newer token and returns.
effect: The preview request is starved while frames keep coming: the chip stays without 'Getting link info' / title until the UI goes idle for 500 ms. One task is spawned per frame meanwhile.
fix: Make the prefetch an enum on the slot (PreviewPrefetch::Idle | Waiting{url, token}) that is armed only when the chosen URL changes, so a frame with the same waiting URL does nothing.

title: Emoji set download/switch can loop forever when an installed pack does not load
trigger: A hash-valid pack installs but SpritePack::load fails (version mismatch, unwritable or partial dir); the user clicks the set
effect: download Ok -> switch_emoji_set -> load_state falls back to System -> ready.remove + download_emoji_set -> download Ok -> ... repeating a network download with no error shown
fix: After a fresh install that fails to load set failed = Some(id, why) and stop; retry the download only for a pack that was ready before.

title: inline_view trusts the session's single bot resolution without checking it is for this trigger's bot or window
trigger: Window A has '@botA q' in its composer, window B (or a quick edit) resolves '@botB q'.
effect: The shared inline_bot_resolve slot is replaced by the later resolve; the other window's panel shows 'Loading results...' forever (its progress sees the wrong username and drops inline_query_waiting) until the user edits its text.
fix: Key the resolve/query slots by (window, chat) (an owner key) and compare the trigger's username in inline_view.

title: InlineReturn never expires if the round trip is abandoned
trigger: Press switch-PM, close the bot chat or never open it, later open that bot chat by hand
effect: pending_start still Some so the start is sent unprompted; or after the start any later bot message with a switch button jumps the user back to the old origin chat
fix: Clear it on chat change away from the bot chat, on cancel and after a timeout/visit change

title: baseline is 0 when the bot chat history is not loaded at start time
trigger: Press the switch-PM button for a bot whose chat was never opened; the start goes out before history loads
effect: When history loads, an old bot message with a switch-inline button has id > 0 and sends the user back to the origin chat immediately
fix: Take the baseline from the sent start message id (the send ack), not the loaded history

title: Pinned-bar Hide / Unpin all confirm closures run outside the window scope of the bar
trigger: In a chat window click Hide on the pinned bar (or open the pinned list and Unpin all / hide) and confirm in the kit alert.
effect: confirm() calls app.update without in_window_scope, so `this.history.hidden_pinned` / `pinned_list_open` are written to the main window's HistoryUi instead of the chat window's slot: the chat window's bar does not hide and its list stays open; the note also lands in the main window.
fix: Capture `self.windows.scope` when opening the alert and run the closure through in_window_scope / spawn_scoped (Asker).

title: Report flow is session-wide but its open flag is per window
trigger: Open Report on a message in a chat window, then Report another message in the main window (or a second chat window) before closing the first.
effect: report_open is set in each window's own MessageUi but begin/report_messages overwrite the single session flow, so the first window's box now shows the second report's options/text and its Send reports the other messages; closing either calls clear_message_report and blanks the other box.
fix: Key the flow by window/asker (MessageReportFlow carries WindowKey) and let each window show only its own, or refuse a second open while one is live.

title: Rapid taps on a multiple-answer poll lose the first choice
trigger: In a poll that allows multiple answers tap option 1 then option 2 before the first setPollAnswer is applied by updatePoll.
effect: send_poll_answer builds the new set from the poll's current is_chosen (poll_answer_for_tap), which has not changed yet, so the second request sends only option 2 and replaces the first; the UI shows no pending state. A quiz can also get a second answer sent.
fix: Keep a per-poll vote stage (Idle | Sending{chosen, request}) in the session and build the next set from the pending chosen set; ignore taps while a quiz answer is in flight.

title: A held history press that never sees its mouse-up keeps a 15 ms poll loop and a stale drag alive
trigger: Press and hold on a history row, then lock with the hotkey (or switch chat by keyboard) and release. The MouseUp listener (history_message_list.rs:608) is registered only while the history list paints, so a locked or repainted-elsewhere window never delivers it.
effect: selection_drag stays Some, so the loop in selection_drag.rs:352 wakes every 15 ms for as long as it stays set (also under the lock). After a chat switch the next release applies the old drag to drag.chat, building the selection from loaded_selectable_ids(old chat). After unlock, a button-down move continues the old drag.
fix: Own the drag in a ChatUi value that sync_chat_ui replaces, clear it in close_for_lock, and end it on a MouseMove with no button pressed.

title: One-shot session outcomes are drained by whichever screen is on screen later
trigger: Start a payment needing 3-D Secure, a Copy Message Link or a forward on account A, switch to B before the answer, switch back to A.
effect: The answer landed in A's background session. poll_drains takes verification_url, message_link_result, last_forward and the error Options on the next pass of the new screen: a bank page opens, the clipboard is overwritten or an old error note appears minutes later. put_on_screen forgets only communities outcomes.
fix: Tag each outcome with the ScreenEpoch/ask that made it (as CommunityOutcome) and drop untagged or older ones in put_on_screen; or hold them in OnScreen so the drop is free.

title: begin_jump enters Jumping before the jump can start or finish; several paths leave the machine in Jumping with no exit
trigger: Pull and release on a ready channel/topic pull when (a) pull.window is None, (b) select_topic_ui(next) does not change the topic, or (c) select_chat_request returns true but the chat does not change; machine.jumping() stays true
effect: The next-channel indicator stays at full height with the photo and the history stays lifted; handle() returns early while jumping so no new pull can start in this chat or topic until the user changes chat/topic
fix: Make Jumping carry the awaited ChatId/topic and a deadline; the frame clears it when the target is shown, when it times out, or when the jump task ends without opening it (task completion calls reset).

title: pull_jump_when_ready continuation opens the next chat without asking the lock gate
trigger: Pull and release to jump to the next unread channel, then lock Quill within the 1.5 s wait
effect: select_chat_request runs under the passcode lock: the next channel's chat is selected (and read marking/draft flush runs) behind the lock screen, and shows after unlock; the jump task polls driver state while locked
fix: Check refused_while_locked at the start of the continuation (drop the jump and reset the machine) per lock-is-a-render-state.

title: Save as HTML with 'Ask where to save' clears whatever selection/forward exists after the picker, and a second click opens a second picker
trigger: Select one rich message, click Save as HTML (folder picker opens), change the selection or start a forward, then pick a folder; or click Save as HTML twice
effect: clear_forward drops an unrelated selection/forward draft; two pickers lead to two exports of the same message; the export uses the captured chat/message, not the current selection
fix: Make the picker a stage (ForwardStage::SavingHtml{chat,msg}) and apply the answer only if the stage is still that one.

title: The send-as menu shows a spinner whenever the sender list is empty, loaded or not
trigger: Open the send-as menu when get_chat_available_message_senders fails or returns nothing
effect: Spinner forever; no error or close
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableMessageSender>> so failed shows an error row.

title: Tray read state lives in the per-window SendBoxUi but trays are account-wide, so another window can start, miss or forget a tray's reads
trigger: A chat window and the main window are open on the same account; the main window's chat has a tray whose photo/video read is still running. Send or attach in the chat window: check_tray_videos/check_tray_media loop over every tray of the account and record jobs in the chat window's send_box. Or send from a chat window whose preparation finishes after it closed: forget_tray_checks clears self.screen.composer_ui.send_box (whatever window is in place), not the window that read the file.
effect: The other window's tray_videos_checking / tray_media_checks_pending / tray_thumbnails_pending see no job for those paths, so its Send can go before the read ends (a soundless video not turned into a GIF, a HEIC not converted). Reads are also duplicated. media_checked/sound_checked entries remain in the window that did not forget them, so the same file attached again later reuses a stale answer (an old temp JPEG path).
fix: Key the read stages by tray (SendSlot) and keep them in ComposerSends next to the attachments they describe, not in the window's ComposerUi.

title: Picking a not-downloaded still sticker to adapt never requests the file
trigger: In Adapt from a Sticker (or Add existing), choose a webp sticker whose file is not on disk (library set never opened)
effect: local_media_path is None, the off-thread job returns None, edit_pixels_for_set shows 'Could not load image' (the WEBM branch downloads, this one does not)
fix: Download the file and wait in the DownloadingStill stage like pending_video

title: Thread start is adopted by whichever window renders first
trigger: Open a comment/reply thread from a chat window while the main window is also drawing (or the reverse).
effect: session.threads.thread is one session-wide slot but advance_thread runs from per_window_upkeep in every window and only branches on windows.scope.is_some(); the main window can take a chat window's thread (select_chat_with in the main window) and the chat window can close a thread the main window opened. restore_open_draft(window) then restores the thread draft into whichever composer rendered first.
fix: Record the asking window in the thread slot (owner key) and only that window's upkeep starts it.

title: One-slot offer cache thrashes when two windows show different chats
trigger: Main window shows chat A with a translate bar, a chat window shows chat B; both redraw (typing, new messages, animations).
effect: TranslateScreen::offer holds a single (OfferKey, language) keyed by chat; each window's translate_bar_model/translate_offer overwrites it, so every render re-walks the whole loaded history and runs offer_language on all texts. The key also lacks the `automatic` input (chat_auto_translate), so a toggle of automatic translation without a message change keeps a stale answer.
fix: Key the cache by chat (HashMap<ChatId, ..>) and include `automatic`; drop entries for chats no window shows (as pump does).

title: A failed selection translation leaves the box on the loading placeholder
trigger: Select text, Translate Selected Text, with the send failing (translate_selection returns Err), or change the language after an earlier job.
effect: request_dialog_translation takes the old job (dropped) and on Err leaves dialog.job = None; dialog_translation then returns None, which the body draws as the grey 'pending' lines, while only a status note says it failed. The box never shows the error text.
fix: Put the job into the dialog stage as Requested(Result<job, error>) and draw Failed for an Err instead of treating no translation as pending.

title: Message widgets in a locked, minimized or tray-hidden window stay 'visible': their runtimes keep running and their public data keeps being polled
trigger: Open a chat with a bot widget that watches its public data (RuntimeEvent::Watch(true)) in a chat window; press Lock (or minimize the main window showing it, or hide it to the tray). Leave it for minutes.
effect: WidgetEntry::visible is cleared only by a drawn history pass (reconcile_widgets), by the main window's next drawn frame without a conversation, or by closing a chat window. A locked chat window runs no upkeep (render_locked) and a hidden window draws no frame, so the widgets stay visible: their QuickJS runtimes keep running timers on their threads, schedule_widget_polls keeps sending getWidgetPublicData every period and background queries still go to the bot while Quill is locked or nobody can see them.
fix: Make a widget's on-screen state follow the window's own state (a per-window `Shown { window, view } | Hidden { since }` set from the lock, occlusion and hide events): close_for_lock and the window hide call widgets_left_window, and polls start only for widgets shown in an unlocked, visible window.

title: A hidden widget whose runtime still wants frames notifies its view on every landing, and is not ticked again when it comes back
trigger: Open an animated widget (CSS animation / requestAnimationFrame) in a chat window and scroll it off screen; keep another animated widget visible in the main window. Then scroll the first one back into view.
effect: hide_widgets sets entry.wants_frames = false but the runtime's Outbox::wants_frames stays true (a hidden runtime is never ticked, so its frame request stays). land_widgets compares the masked entry value with the runtime's, so every landing (60 per second from the other widget) marks the hidden entry changed and notifies the chat window's history view: that window redraws at the animation rate while showing nothing that moves. When the widget comes back, reconcile_widgets does not restore wants_frames, so it is not ticked until its own runtime happens to poke again.
fix: Keep the runtime's wish as its own field (`runtime_wants_frames`) and derive tick eligibility as `visible && runtime_wants_frames` where widgets_frame_start reads it; compare only the runtime value in land_widgets.

title: testmode adds the account first and marks it test second; a failed marker write leaves a production account named 'Test environment'
trigger: On the sign-in screen of the only account type testmode; the account store is added (add_account saves the registry), then the marker write fails (disk full, read-only folder, antivirus lock). The user gets the 'could not switch the environment' note.
effect: The registry keeps a second, signed-out account called 'Test environment' that connects to production (no marker). The account count is now 2, so plan_test_mode returns None and the testmode code never works again until the user removes that account by hand; signing in there puts a production login under a test name.
fix: Write the marker before the account is registered (or roll back with remove_account on error), so 'registered' and 'environment known' are one step; better, store the environment in the AccountRecord as an enum Environment{Production,Test}.

title: Release sends the pinned list as it was when the drag began, not as it is now
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat; while holding, another device unpins chat X (or pins Y); release
effect: finish_pin_drag sends setPinnedChats with the begin-time snapshot: X is pinned again, Y is unpinned
fix: On release merge the dragged order into session.pinned_chat_ids (drop ids no longer pinned, keep new ones in place), or cancel the drag when the pinned set changes.

title: Partial forward failure clears the whole selection, so the failed chats cannot be retried
trigger: Tick three chats; one send fails (failed == 1 < 3). The note says 'could not forward to 1 chat' but forward stage and selection are cleared. When only the comment sent and the forward failed, a retry from scratch repeats the comment.
effect: The user must start the forward again from the message list and cannot tell which chat failed.
fix: Track per-destination outcome (Queued/Failed) in the selection; clear only queued ones and keep the box with the failed chats ticked.

title: A drag whose release never reaches the list keeps dragging set and asks a frame every 60 ms
trigger: Begin a pinned drag, then Alt-Tab or lose the pointer capture so neither mouse_up nor mouse_up_out fires
effect: settled() stays false and sidebar upkeep (chat_list/sidebar.rs:325) keeps calling request_animation_tick(60) while dragging is Some, even when the window is inactive; the row stays lifted
fix: Cancel the reorder (release without saving) on window deactivation or when no button is down in the next move event.

title: Permission continuation re-runs a plain starter and is not matched to the ask
trigger: On macOS with the microphone undetermined, press Answer on a ringing call twice (or toggle the call camera twice) while the system prompt is up, then allow.
effect: Each press spawns a poller; after the grant each runs the starter. answer_call runs accept_call twice (second gives 'Could not answer the call'), flip_call_camera flips twice (camera ends off). If the caller hung up or another call rings meanwhile, answer_call accepts whatever call is tracked now, not the one asked.
fix: A PermissionAsk { what, call_id } value held in one Option; a second press while it is Some is ignored and the continuation checks the same call id is still current before starting.

title: Country box says Loading countries forever when getCountries fails
trigger: Open the poll Allowed countries or the shipping country box while offline or when getCountries errors.
effect: fetch_countries result is dropped (let _ =) and an error answer leaves auth_state.countries None; an empty list renders as Loading countries... with no retry or error until the box is reopened.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<Country>> for the list so failed shows an error row with Retry.

title: The tag-name box is not per_window, so a tag menu used in a chat window opens the box in the main window
trigger: Open Saved Messages in a chat window, right-click a tag chip on a message, Add Name.
effect: dialogs.saved_tag_dialog is account-level and the SavedTagName spec has no per_window(), so the box appears over the main window (and Save acts from there) instead of the window that asked.
fix: Own the tag-name box in the asking window's state (ChatUi/message_ui) and mark the spec per_window.

title: Debug mode switch keeps three copies (in-memory flag, withdebug file, TDLib native stream) in step by hand and ignores failures
trigger: Type 'debugmode' and confirm. Turning on: debug_mode::set_enabled(true) runs before start_tdlib_log; if TDLib rejects the stream the error note shows but the flag stays on and the file is persisted '1'. Turning off: stop_tdlib_log result is discarded (let _), so if secure_native_logging fails TDLib keeps writing debug-level tdlib.log.
effect: UI says debug logs are off (or on) while TDLib still writes (or does not write) its debug log, which the confirm text says can hold account data; next launch repeats the mismatch because hub.rs also drops the start error.
fix: One DebugLog enum {Off, On, OnButTdlibClosed(error)} owned by the app, set only after the TDLib call answered, with the failure shown and the persisted flag following the enum.

title: Share box drops the forward as if it was sent when there is no live client
trigger: Select messages, open the share box, tick a chat, press Send while self.live is None and demo_session is None (connection closed, remote logout, between accounts). Neither branch runs, failed stays 0, and failed < dests.len() clears the stage and the selection.
effect: The forward draft and ticked chats vanish with no note; nothing was sent.
fix: Make submit_share return a Result and clear the stage only for destinations actually queued; with no live client keep the box and say so.

title: A collectible lookup answer or error is applied to whichever lookup is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username/phone row on profile A, then before the answer arrives tap one on profile B (second tap replaces hub.collectible and sends a second request). A's answer (or COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND) lands.
effect: The box for B shows A's purchase date and price under B's name and owner; or A's not-found error marks B failed, so B's link is copied and its real answer is dropped. Applies by purpose only (state/domains/payments/apply.rs:25, error.rs:64); CollectibleLookup holds no request id.
fix: Make the lookup an enum Loading{request: RequestId} / Ready(info) / Failed(reason) and apply an answer or error only when its extra equals the Loading request id.

title: open_earn_page leaves ton and stars in Loading when a later send fails
trigger: Open Monetization or Stars Balance and a send_earn returns Err (client closing, send error): the first `?` returns after the page was stored with ton/stars = Loading
effect: The page spinner stays; stars Load::Loading is never settled because no request was sent for it (only TON history gets inspect_err). The UI shows a toast but the page itself never leaves loading until it is reopened
fix: Set Load::Loading only after the send succeeds, or on Err set both Loads to Failed

title: fetch_earn_balances records the peer as asked before sending and an error answer never clears it
trigger: Open a channel/bot profile when the balance request fails (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance/StarBalance) or the send fails.
effect: The balance row never loads again for that peer in this session; balances_asked only grows.
fix: Fetch<T> per peer balance (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of a visited Vec.

title: balances_asked is pushed before the request is sent and never cleared on failure
trigger: Open a channel or bot profile while the send fails or the TON/Stars balance request errors (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance and StarBalance)
effect: The peer stays in balances_asked, so fetch_earn_balances returns early forever; the profile Monetization or Stars row never shows its balance this session. Also the Vec is a started flag with no way back
fix: HashMap<EarnPeer, BalanceFetch> with Asking(RequestId) / Known / Failed, cleared on error so a reopen asks again

title: fetch_earn_balances marks the peer asked before the requests are sent, so a failed send is never retried
trigger: Open a bot or channel profile (earn_balances_upkeep runs per frame) at a moment send_earn fails (driver busy or closed); the peer is already pushed to balances_asked. Also a TonBalance/StarBalance error answer is ignored (apply_earn_error arm is empty).
effect: The Monetization / Stars Balance rows on that profile never show their balance for the rest of the session; nothing asks again.
fix: Replace the Vec<EarnPeer> with a per-peer enum (Unasked, Asked(RequestId), Ready, Failed) set after a successful send and reset by the error arm.

title: Program-list answers are not keyed to the sort or request that asked them
trigger: In the affiliate join page change 'Sort by' twice quickly, or scroll for more while changing sort.
