effect: SearchPrograms{for_box,append} is the only key: an older answer lands in the reset list (wrong order shown until the later answer; a stale append adds old-sort rows to the new list). fetch_found_programs also sends a second non-append page while one is loading.
fix: Carry a generation in SearchPrograms and in ProgramList, drop mismatched answers, and gate non-append starts on is_loading.

title: One failed send of the two recipient requests caches a partial recipient list for the session
trigger: Open an affiliate program as the user while the chats send works and the bots send fails (or the reverse, e.g. a send error between the two)
effect: request_earn_recipients resets recipients_loading to 0 and recipients to None and returns Err, but the request that did go out still answers: add_earn_recipients makes recipients Some(me + channels). From then on recipients.is_some() makes request_earn_recipients return early, so owned bots (or channels) are never offered as commission recipients until the account is reopened
fix: Recipients enum with a Failed stage that ignores late answers of the abandoned attempt (match by request id) and allows a retry

title: limits_asked is set before the limit requests and never cleared when they fail
trigger: Open a gifts list when getOption sends fail (offline moment); GetGiftOption errors are swallowed.
effect: For the rest of the session pin/collection/resale limits stay at their defaults and are never asked again.
fix: Fetch<GiftLimits>: Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed with retry on the next gifts open.

title: Closing Send a Gift while sendGift is out loses its result
trigger: Press Send on a Stars gift, close the dialog before the answer.
effect: close_send_gift clears done/error but leaves sending/request; the OK sets done on a closed dialog and an error is never shown, so the user is not told whether Stars were spent.
fix: SendStage::Sending(request) that closing keeps, with the answer posted as a toast (ok or error) when the dialog is no longer open.

title: followed is set before openGiftAuction is sent and a failed follow is never retried
trigger: Open an auction bid box while the connection drops (send error or TdError on openGiftAuction).
effect: gift_market.followed stays Some(new) so the per-frame follow_gift_auction(same) returns early forever: the bid box never receives live updates, and OpenAuction/CloseAuction errors are ignored in apply_gift_market_error.
fix: enum Follow { None, Opening(gift_id), Following(gift_id) } that returns to None on the error arm so the next frame retries.

title: Appending a boosts page never sets BoostsListState::loading
trigger: Open a channel's Boosts list, click 'Show more'; the button stays because loading is still false, click again
effect: No spinner, a second getChatBoosts with the same offset is sent and the first answer is dropped (request id no longer matches); wasted requests
fix: Make the list a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{request,append}/Ready/Failed) so request and loading cannot disagree; derive loading from the request

title: A failed send of a next-page request deletes the already loaded list
trigger: Scroll to 'Show more' in boosts / invite-link members / link join requests / join request search while the sender is down
effect: The loaded rows vanish (list removed or closed) instead of keeping them with an error; same pattern at invite_admin.rs:294 (members), links_boosts.rs:219 (join requests), invite_admin.rs:69 (search drops the previous list)
fix: On append failure only clear the in-flight request and set error on the existing Ready state; remove the entry only for the first page

title: release_paid_send takes the held send out of the guard before the send and loses it if the send fails
trigger: Confirm the paid-message price while the sender refuses.
effect: take_held removed the request; send_json Err is returned to the caller and the user's message is gone with no way to retry from the box (the pending entry is also never taken).
fix: Peek the held send, send, and take it only on success; or return it to the guard on Err.

title: A Star reaction whose commit request fails is dropped with an unseen note
trigger: Tap the Star chip and let the Undo window end while the commit request cannot be sent (send_json_request returns Err).
effect: take_due already removed the pending Stars, so the toast vanishes and the Stars are never committed; the 'Stars were not sent' note is written to paid.note, which only the next add_paid reads, so the user is never told.
fix: Keep the pending entry in a Committing/Failed stage until TDLib answers CommitPaidReaction; on failure surface a toast through the status note and offer retry or drop.

title: payments.request, form_request and validate_request are set before the send and not cleared when the send fails
trigger: Tap Buy or Validate while the sender refuses (client closing, send_json_request Err). send_payment_form_request (lines 36-45) and validate_payment_order_info (49-62) store request/form_request/validate_request first and return the Err without clearing them.
effect: The checkout keeps an invoice and a request id that never get an answer; the dialog can wait on a form that never comes and later answers are matched to a dead id.
fix: One Checkout stage enum (Idle, FetchingForm(RequestId), Validating(RequestId), Ready, Paying) set only after the send succeeds.

title: refresh_star_subscriptions_if_stale clears stale before the send and ignores an in-flight fetch
trigger: Cancel a subscription; the ok marks the list stale; the refetch send fails (or a fetch_more page is in flight when it runs).
effect: On a failed send stale is already false, so the list stays old with no retry; with a page in flight a second first-page request races the append page and answers are matched only by the append flag, not by a key.
fix: Keep Stale until the answer lands (Fetch::Stale) and key the answer by RequestId.

title: refresh_received_gifts_if_stale clears stale before the send and ignores an in-flight page
trigger: Convert or hide a gift; the refetch send fails or runs while a next page is in flight.
effect: On Err stale is false so the gifts list keeps showing a converted gift with no retry; with a page in flight the first-page request overwrites gifts_request and the older answer is ignored, leaving gifts_loading true until the new answer.
fix: Fetch<Gifts> with Stale variant cleared only by the answer.

title: getStarGiftPaymentOptions answer is not matched to the contact or request that asked it
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick contact A (request 1 in flight), tap Back, pick contact B (request 2); answer 1 lands after the target changed, or lands after Back/close.
effect: apply StarPackOptions writes options/loading=false into stars_gift for whatever target is current (even none), so B's pack list can be A's, and an answer after close fills a closed dialog. Requests are never dropped by clear_target or close_stars_gift.
fix: Carry the asking RequestId inside the LoadingPacks stage and accept an answer only when it matches; drop the pending request in clear_target/close.

title: PaidMessages::forget_answers is never called, so the Premium gate stays stale after the viewer buys Premium
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who restricts new chats (composer shows 'only accepts messages from contacts and Premium users'). Buy/receive Premium (updateOption is_premium / user update). The doc says 'After the viewer's Premium changes, old answers are wrong'.
effect: `forget_answers` has no caller outside its test (grep). The cached CanSend::RestrictsNewChats answer is only refreshed by `should_ask` after GATE_REFRESH_MS (5 minutes) and only on a chat open, so the composer stays blocked by the Premium prompt although the viewer now has Premium (send_gate reads viewer_premium only when it rebuilds, but PremiumRequired is computed live from my_is_premium; the opposite case, a Premium that lapses, keeps Free for up to 5 minutes and the send is rejected by the server). Price answers for other users are not re-asked either.
fix: Call forget_answers (and sync_paid_guard) from the Session's is_premium change, or key the cached answer by the viewer's Premium flag so a change makes it stale by construction.

title: Premium gift message is cut to nothing when gift_text_length_max is not known yet
trigger: Sign in, open a user's profile > Gift Premium before the gift_text_length_max option arrives (or it failed: error arm sets it to None), type a message and pay. invoice_checkout.rs:138 passes `gift_text_length_max.unwrap_or(0)`.
effect: `text.trim().chars().take(0)` yields an empty string, so a paid Premium gift (Stars or card) is sent without the message the sender wrote, with no warning.
fix: Treat an unknown limit as 'ask first' (disable Pay until Fetch<usize> is Ready) or as no cut, never as 0.

title: Closing the checkout while sendPaymentForm is in flight leaves the payment's outcome unreported
trigger: Press Pay on a non-paid-media invoice (Stars or card) and close the checkout before TDLib answers
effect: close_checkout (checkout.rs) clears request, so shows(invoice) is false: apply.rs:75-98 sets nothing for success, and error.rs:37-43 sets no note for failure; note_paid_media_unlocked only reports paid media. Money may be spent (or refused) with no toast or note
fix: A PaymentInFlight outcome that is always pushed to the status-note queue when the checkout is not showing it.

title: Receipt answer reopens a closed receipt dialog and is not matched to the invoice that asked
trigger: View receipt, press Esc before it arrives (receipt_open=false, receipt=None), or tap View receipt on invoice A then B
effect: apply.rs:163-166 sets receipt and receipt_open=true for any GetPaymentReceipt answer: the dialog pops back open after the user dismissed it, and A's receipt can show for B until B's answer replaces it. receipt_error (error.rs:44) is also unmatched
fix: enum Receipt{Closed,Loading{request,invoice},Open(data),Failed}; answers apply only to Loading with the same request.

title: Stale Stars-history and received-gifts errors are not matched to the live request
trigger: Open Stars, tap Incoming then Outgoing (or open gifts of channel A, close, open gifts of user B). The first request fails or is swept after its TTL (408) after the second was sent.
effect: The older failure sets tx_loading=false and tx_error (or gifts_loading=false, gifts_error) while the newer request is in flight, or over an already loaded list. The dialog shows an error, the spinner stops, and maybe_fetch_star_transactions can send a duplicate. Answers are matched by tx_request/gifts_request, errors are not (Grams does match them).
fix: Apply GetStarTransactions/GetReceivedGifts errors only when pending.id equals tx_request/gifts_request, as apply_grams_error does; better, hold the history as Fetch<Page> keyed by request id.

title: Errors of resale search, auction state and craft candidates are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Change a resale filter twice quickly (or tap auction A then auction B, or reopen the craft box) while the older request fails.
effect: The older error clears loading on the newer search (search.loading / auction_loading / candidates_loading), marks loaded with an error, and for auctions clears pending_auction so B's box never opens; a resale error also hits the craft market search when both are loading.
fix: Compare the failed request id with request_id / auction_request / candidates_request before touching the stage, as the Buy and Craft arms already do.

title: Bank card lookup answer is applied to whichever card is current
trigger: Tap card number A, then card number B before A answers (request_bank_card_info replaces bank_card)
effect: apply.rs:17-24 only checks the purpose, so A's info lands in B's lookup; entity_links.rs:486-495 compares only lookup.number == the tapped number, so B's popup shows A's issuer title and open-URL actions (a different bank's links). Error arm error.rs:56-61 also clears B's loading
fix: Store the RequestId in the lookup (Fetch<info> enum Loading{request}/Ready/Failed) and apply only on a match, as GiftCodeLookup does.

title: Boosts Show more does not set loading, so a double click sends the page twice and the button shows no progress
trigger: Open Boosts as an admin of a channel with more than 25 boosts, then double-click Show more.
effect: request_chat_boosts only sets state.request (not loading) on the append path, and load_more_chat_boosts guards on state.loading, so the guard never fires; two getChatBoosts go out for the same offset, the first answer is dropped as stale, and no spinner shows while the page loads. A failed send on the append path also removes the whole list.
fix: Replace loading/error/request with one enum Page { Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed(String) } (or Fetch) so the guard and the stale check read the same value.

title: Payment receipt Total leaves out the tip and the shipping cost
trigger: Pay a bot invoice with a tip (or a flexible invoice with a paid shipping option), then open the receipt from the 'Payment successful' service message.
effect: The receipt's Total row shows only the sum of invoice.price_parts; the tip is listed on its own row but not added, and shipping_option.price_parts are dropped entirely, so the Total is less than what the card was charged.
fix: In parse_payment_receipt sum invoice.price_parts + shipping_option.price_parts + tip_amount (as tdesktop does), or keep the parts and let the dialog compute the total from all three.

title: Wallet transaction lookup answer is not matched to the transaction that was clicked
trigger: In a chat, click a Gram transfer card A whose transaction is not in the loaded Money history (open_wallet_transaction sends getTonWalletTransaction, tx_loading = true). Before it answers, click transfer card B (also not in history): a second lookup goes out with tx_loading still true. Alternatively, click a row B in the history list (select_wallet_tx shows B but leaves tx_loading true).
effect: A's answer lands first, passes the only guard (purpose == Transaction && tx_loading, src/state/domains/payments/ton_wallet.rs:72-77) and shows A's details. B's answer then finds tx_loading false and is dropped, or in the history-row case A's late answer replaces B's details. The user clicked B and sees A's amount, address and date.
fix: Make the lookup one value, e.g. `TxDetail { None, Loading { id: String }, Shown(WalletTx), Failed(String) }`. Put the transaction id on the pending request or purpose, and apply an answer only when it matches the `Loading` id.

title: A failed getApplicationConfig for the wallet leaves explorer_url_requested set for the whole session
trigger: Open Settings > Money while getApplicationConfig fails (network error, flood wait). fetch_ton_explorer_url sets explorer_url_requested=true after the send, and RequestPurpose::GetTonExplorerUrl has no error arm that clears it: only purpose.rs and connect/ton_wallet.rs name it. Close and reopen Money.
effect: The request is never asked again this session. ton_usd_rate stays None, so every fiat line on the Money page reads a dash until restart (unless another feature's app-config answer happens to bring the rate). Related: open_money_page sets state_requested and rates_requested before send_wallet(..)?, so a failed send leaves them true too and returns early, skipping the history fetch.
fix: Make the app-config fetch a `Fetch` stage whose error arm (add GetTonExplorerUrl to the payments error routing) moves it back to retryable. Set the flags only after a successful send, or reset them on Err.

title: Reassign click that fails to send leaves the boost box stuck in Working
trigger: Open boost box for a chat with no free slot, reach the Reassign list, tick a slot, click Reassign while the TDLib send fails (connection down / sender error)
effect: driver.reassign_boosts sets phase=Working, note=None, reassigning=Some(..) before send_boost_chat; on Err it returns without restoring, so the box shows the Main body with the Boost button loading+disabled and only Close left. The toast says it could not reassign but the box cannot retry or go back
fix: Set Working only after the send succeeds, or restore the previous phase (Reassign{..}) and clear reassigning on the Err arm (src/connect/groups/boost_flow.rs:61)

title: A failed collectible lookup other than a missing username gives no error
trigger: Tap a phone number row while offline or when TDLib answers any error other than COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND
effect: pump_collectible_info takes the lookup and returns; nothing opens, no note, the tap seems dead
fix: Post StatusNote::error for every failed lookup except the username-not-found copy fallback.

title: Checkout never prefills saved order info or selects the saved card: prefill runs only at open, before the form exists
trigger: Pay once with 'save order info' and a saved card; later press Buy on another invoice. start_invoice_checkout (invoice_checkout.rs:52) sets payments.form = None and opens the dialog right away; open_payment_dialog (payments/mod.rs:33) calls prefill_from_form only if the form is already there, and nothing calls it when the form lands.
effect: Name/phone/email/address fields are empty and the credential choice is 'New card' although TDLib returned saved_order_info and saved_credentials; the user has to retype or reselect everything. The `prefilled` flag is set nowhere else.
fix: Make the checkout a stage value (`Checkout::Loading { dialog } | Ready { dialog, form }`) whose Loading->Ready transition on the form answer runs the prefill; delete the `prefilled` bool.

title: Earn balances are marked asked before the request and never cleared when it fails
trigger: Open a bot or channel profile while offline or while getChatRevenueStatistics/getStarTransactions fails (flood wait, network error), then reopen the profile later.
effect: fetch_earn_balances pushes the peer into balances_asked before sending; the TonBalance/StarBalance error arm is a no-op (payments/earn.rs:473), nothing removes the peer, so the profile's Balance row and the bot-edit Toncoin/Stars rows never appear for that peer until the session is recreated. A send Err after the push has the same effect.
fix: Make the per-peer balance a Fetch<BalanceAmounts> (idle/loading/ready/failed) so an error returns it to idle and the upkeep can retry on reopen.

title: A join box parked for the recipients (EarnState::pending_join) is not dropped by the switch Farewell or by leaving the earn layer, and opens later unasked
trigger: Fresh session: open your own bot's profile, click 'Affiliate Program' (open_bot_affiliate_join, connect/earn.rs:630-652) so the box parks in pending_join while getCreatedPublicChats/getOwnedBots load; before both answer, switch to another account (or close the profile/earn layer and go to another chat). close_earn_boxes only clears pending_join through close_join_box, which runs only when join_box is Some.
effect: When the recipients land (state/domains/payments/earn.rs:407-411) pending_join becomes join_box: the 'Join program' box pops up later on its own, over an unrelated screen, or on switching back to the account.
fix: Make the join box one value, enum JoinBoxStage { Closed, AwaitingRecipients(JoinBox), Open(JoinBox) }, closed whole by close_join_box/Farewell and by leaving the earn surface that asked.

title: Stars withdrawal sends the typed amount without capping it to the available balance or the option maximum
trigger: On a Stars Balance page type an amount above the available Stars (or above star_withdrawal_max) and press Withdraw; earn_withdraw_stars only checks typed < min, while the label already shows 'withdraw all' for typed >= available.
effect: TDLib rejects the URL request; the password-less try then opens the password box for an invalid amount (apply_withdrawal_error 'any other answer'), the user types the 2FA password and gets a 'Failed' toast.
fix: Clamp or reject typed against withdraw_max(limits, available) before start_withdrawal, with the same toast as the minimum.

title: 'Items bought' box says Loading forever when getGiftAuctionAcquiredGifts fails
trigger: Open an auction where you won gifts, click 'N items bought' while the request fails (offline, server error).
effect: The error arm for AcquiredGifts does nothing, `acquired` never gets the gift id, and the box shows 'Loading...' until closed; no error toast.
fix: Store `acquired` as `HashMap<i64, Fetch<Vec<AcquiredGift>>>` so the error lands in a Failed stage the box shows.

title: Failed listing purchase start in Select Gifts is silent
trigger: In Select Gifts tap a listing while another buy is sending or the driver refuses.
effect: pick_craft_listing ignores Err from start_gift_resale_buy: nothing happens, no note.
fix: Show StatusNote::error on the Err arm.

title: Craft 'Select Gifts' shows 'none on sale' when the listings search failed
trigger: Craft Gift > + (Select Gifts) while searchGiftsForResale fails (offline, server error).
effect: The SearchResale error arm sets search.loading=false, loaded=true, error=Some(..) and pushes no note; craft_select_box never reads `market.error`, so the user is told there are no suitable gifts on sale instead of an error with retry.
fix: Make ResaleSearch's page state `Fetch<..>` and render the Failed stage (message and retry) in the select box.

title: Cancel / Esc on the transfer confirmation while the transfer is in flight loses the success handling
trigger: Pick a contact > Transfer (a paid transfer) > press Cancel or Esc before the answer lands.
effect: TransferPicker::back() only refuses while export_busy(), not while TransferGift is out, so the stage goes ConfirmPeer -> Pick. apply_gift_manage_ok then finds no ConfirmPeer stage, leaves manage.transferred None and clears the flow: no 'Gift transferred' toast, the recipient's chat is not opened, and the user is shown the list as if nothing happened.
fix: Add a TransferStage::Transferring{user_id,name} variant entered by confirm_picked_transfer; back/Esc are refused there and the answer matches it.

title: A pending 'learn more' value lookup opens its box after the user left the gift
trigger: Open a collectible's gift box or the resale buy box > tap 'learn more' on the Value row > close the box (or switch to another gift/box) before the answer lands.
effect: hub.gift_value is owned by nobody: no close path clears it, GiftValueLookup::land sets open=true for the matching request, and the GiftValue dialog is_open only reads lookup.open. The value box pops up later over whatever is on screen. A failed lookup's error also stays on the row until another click.
fix: Scope the lookup to its host box (gift id) and drop it when that box closes or the gift changes; make loading/ready/failed one Fetch-like enum.

title: Direct Messages box closes as if saved; the failure has nowhere to show
trigger: Channel owner opens Direct messages, turns it on or sets a price, presses Save, and TDLib refuses setChatDirectMessagesGroup.
effect: save_direct_messages takes the box and the button handler closes the dialog at once. PaidSave::Failed is drawn only inside that dialog (error_for(Channel)), so the refusal is never seen and the person thinks it saved.
fix: Keep the box open as a Saving stage of one enum (Editing / Saving / Failed) and close it from the answer; show the failure in the box.

title: Star reaction box closes as sent when the add failed or was refused after render
trigger: Open the Star amount box, then the balance drops or the connection path goes inactive before Send is pressed; press Send.
effect: send_paid_box clears the box first, add_paid ignores the driver Err. The refusal case sets a note, but the InvalidRequest/send_json_request failure paths leave paid.note stale or empty: the box closes, no Stars are added and no error shows (or a stale earlier refusal note shows).
fix: add_paid returns Result<(), PaidRefusal|SendError>; send_paid_box closes the box only on Ok and otherwise keeps it with the error in its own enum stage, instead of the shared PaidReactions::note channel.

title: Premium sticker examples are downloaded only during a fixed 6 second timer poll; a slower answer is never downloaded
trigger: Open a Premium sticker preview (click a Premium sticker without Premium) on a slow connection so getPremiumStickers answers later than 10 x 600 ms.
effect: The loop ends before preview_stickers() has any file id, so no download is requested and the stage keeps the emoji fallback tiles until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Download the stickers from the reducer when the premium_stickers answer lands (answer-driven), not by a wall-clock poll bounded by a loop count.

title: Preview clip is fetched only if the Premium state arrives within 24 x 250 ms
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview before premium_state is known, on a connection where getPremiumState takes longer than 6 s.
effect: fetch_preview_clip gives up, the animation file is never downloaded and the stage shows the star placeholder for as long as the preview page is open.
fix: Trigger the clip download when premium_state is applied (reducer effect keyed by the shown feature) instead of polling for a fixed time.

title: A withdrawal in WithdrawStep::Checking has no visible UI and no way out; Collect and Withdraw then do nothing silently
trigger: Press Collect or Withdraw; while the first request is unanswered the dialog predicate is false for Checking, and start_withdrawal returns Ok(()) early when withdraw is Some. If the answer is slow or lost, every later click is ignored with no toast until an account switch or reopen of the dialog (nothing cancels it).
effect: Collect/Withdraw buttons appear dead; the user cannot cancel or retry.
fix: Show the box (or a spinner on the button) for Checking with a Cancel, and make a repeated click tell the user a withdrawal is pending; cancel it when the earn layer closes.

title: start_gift_resale_buy / open_gift_resale / open_gift_craft replace buy and craft sessions that have a request in flight
trigger: Start a purchase (buy.sending, Stars spent), then start another buy, open another resale list, or open the craft box before the answer.
effect: The old ResaleBuy/CraftSession is dropped: its answer is ignored (outcome unseen) and the new buy is not sending, so the user can pay twice.
fix: Refuse to replace while sending/crafting; make ResaleBuy a stage enum.

title: follow_gift_auction sets followed before the open request and never unfollows on logout or account switch
trigger: Open an auction box when the follow send fails; or leave the box open and switch accounts.
effect: followed = new id, so the retry returns early (updates never start); the old account stays subscribed to auction updates.
fix: Set followed after the send succeeds; close the follow in the owner's Farewell.

title: A failed commit send drops the pending reaction and only sets a note
trigger: Undo window ends while the sender refuses.
effect: take_due already removed the entry; the note says Stars were not sent but TDLib still holds the pending Stars with no local entry to undo or retry.
fix: Put the entry back (Committing stage) when the send fails.

title: Collectible lookup answer is not matched to the entity that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username, then before the answer tap another collectible phone/username.
effect: hub.collectible is replaced by the second lookup, but RequestPurpose::GetCollectibleInfo carries no entity, so the first answer is applied to the second lookup and shows the wrong info; dedupe only compares the stored entity.
fix: Carry the lookup entity (or a generation) in the purpose and apply the answer only when it equals the current lookup.

title: open_received_gifts resets gift_mutating while a toggle or sell for the previous owner is in flight
trigger: Tap Convert to Stars on own gifts, immediately open another owner's gifts (or reopen the own list).
effect: gift_mutating=false lets a second mutation start while sellGift/toggleGiftIsSaved is in flight; its answer then marks the new owner's list stale and shows the old mutation's result against the new list.
fix: Key the mutation by (owner, RequestId) and keep it until its own answer; reset only the list stage.

title: A send failure on the first page of gifts or Stars after a tab switch leaves an empty list with no spinner and no error
trigger: Be briefly disconnected (chats_path_active false is checked first, but send_json_request can fail), open someone's gifts or switch the Stars tab; the UI ignores the Err for the tab switch (set_star_transactions_filter).
effect: open_received_gifts has already set gifts_open and cleared the list; fetch_received_gifts_page resets gifts_loading=false and sets no gifts_error. The box shows neither loading nor error nor rows. set_star_transactions_filter likewise clears transactions and tx_error stays None. set_grams_filter in connect/grams.rs does the same (error only set in open_grams).
fix: Fetch<T> with a Failed variant written on the send-failure arm, so every first-page start ends in Loading or Failed.

title: Reopening the gifts dialog resets gift_mutating while a mutation is in flight
trigger: Gifts dialog > confirm Upgrade (or Transfer/Pin) > close the dialog and reopen My Gifts before the answer.
effect: open_received_gifts sets hub.gift_mutating=false, which the UI uses to enable Upgrade/Transfer/Resale/Delete buttons (gift_owner_actions.rs busy), so a second request can be sent for the same gift; the first answer then clears the flag for the new list.
fix: Make the mutation an enum (Idle, Mutating{request, gift}) owned by the session and not reset by open; match answers by request id.

title: One-shot gift results (deleted, transferred, export_url) are consumed by whichever window runs the transfer upkeep
trigger: Delete or transfer a gift from a gifts box hosted in a chat window.
effect: deleted/transferred/export_url sit in the Session until a window whose dialog_may_show_in(GiftTransfer) runs gift_transfer_frame_upkeep; the toast, Fragment page or the recipient's chat may open in the main window or late; reset_for_owner leaves them set.
fix: Post these as events naming the asking window and clear them in reset_for_owner.

title: A failed canSendMessageToUser leaves the chat ungated and blocks a retry for 30 s
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who charges Stars while the request fails (flood wait, network error). apply_privacy_data_error for CanSendMessageToUser does nothing and never calls ask_failed (only a failed send does).
effect: `asking` keeps the user for ASK_TIMEOUT_MS (wall clock) so re-opening the chat does not ask again; the composer shows no price and PaidGuard has no price for the chat, so the send goes to TDLib unannounced and fails with a server error instead of the Stars confirmation. The stage (none / asking / answered / failed) is split over `gates`, `asking` and two timestamps.
fix: enum GateFetch { Unknown, Asking{at}, Known{answer,at}, Failed{at} } per user; the error arm moves Asking to Failed and the send path refuses while the gate is not Known.

title: rollback after a refused addPending is matched by chat+message, not by the tap that failed
trigger: Tap Star reaction on a message (request E1 fails slowly, e.g. flood), tap again after the timer fired so a new entry for the same message exists, then E1's error arrives.
effect: rollback subtracts E1's stars from the newer entry (or removes it), so the toast and the reserved total differ from what TDLib holds, and a later commit sends a different amount than shown.
fix: Give each tap an id (the request id) stored in the pending item and roll back only that tap.

title: Program list answers are not matched to the sort or offset that asked
trigger: Scroll the programs list (an append page is in flight) then change Sort by; or change Sort twice quickly
effect: set_starref_sort resets join.found, but SearchPrograms{for_box,append} answers carry no sort/offset/request id: an older answer that lands after the newer one (or an old append landing on the fresh list) shows programs in the old order with the old next_offset, and later pages continue from the wrong offset
fix: Carry the RequestId (or a list generation) in ProgramList::load = Loading { request } and apply only the answer of that request

title: getGiftCollections answer is applied to whichever owner's list is open
trigger: Open your own gifts, then at once a channel's gifts (reset_for_owner + new fetch); the first fetch answers after the second.
effect: Collection tabs of the wrong owner show (and collections_loading drops early); picking one asks the channel for a collection id that is not its own.
fix: Carry the owner in PaymentsPurpose::GetGiftCollections and apply only when it equals hub.gifts_owner.

title: state_requested and rates_requested are set before the send and cleared only in the error arm
trigger: Open the Money page when the send fails (closed channel, client closing) or the answer is lost to a dropped continuation
effect: connect/ton_wallet.rs:80-92 sets the flag then uses `?` on send_wallet; a send failure returns early with the flag still true, so later opens never request the wallet state or rates and the page shows no balance until restart. Only TDLib errors reach ton_wallet.rs:130-131 which reset them
fix: Fetch<WalletState>/Fetch<Rates> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) where a send failure returns to Idle.

title: currency_exponent misses zero-decimal currencies Telegram uses (ISK)
trigger: Open an invoice, checkout or receipt priced in Icelandic krona (ISK), which Telegram's currency table lists with exponent 0.
effect: The amount is divided by 100 and shown as e.g. 'ISK 19.99' instead of 'ISK 1999', so the price shown before paying is wrong.
fix: Take the exponent table from Telegram's currencies.json (the list tdesktop and the Bot API use) instead of a hand-kept ISO list, and test it against that file.

title: Upgrade-preview fetch is issued from render and retried every second after a failure
trigger: Open an auction info box when getGiftUpgradePreview fails persistently.
effect: auction_info_box calls fetch_gift_upgrade_preview each render; previews stays empty and the error arm is a no-op, so the 1 s animation tick re-sends the request forever while the box is open.
fix: Record a Failed(gift) entry in previews (Fetch<T>) and move the request to the box opener.

title: pending_auction opens the auction box after the user closed the send box
trigger: Send-gift box > tap an auction tile (fetch_gift_auction sent, pending_auction=true) > close the send box before the state arrives.
effect: pending_auction is cleared only when the stack empties or the answer lands; it is not tied to the box that asked. When auction_ready arrives the bid/info box opens over nothing, with a recipient captured from the closed send box.
fix: Replace pending_auction with an enum on the market UI (Idle, Opening{auction_id, request}) cancelled when the asking box closes and matched to the answer's request.

title: Reopening the form resets a launch that is still in flight, so Start can be sent twice
trigger: Prepaid giveaway > Start Giveaway > confirm (launch Launching) > close the dialog > open the same prepaid giveaway again before the answer.
effect: open_giveaway_form sets launch=Idle unconditionally, so launching() no longer matches the old request; the Start button is enabled and a second launchPrepaidGiveaway goes out. The server rejects it and the form shows 'Couldn't start the giveaway' although the first one launched.
fix: Keep Launching{chat,request} across form reopen for the same prepaid id (form opens in a Launching state) instead of resetting it.

title: Countries page shows 'Loading countries' forever when the list fails to load
trigger: Giveaway form > Choose countries while getCountries fails or the send fails (error ignored with let _).
effect: session.auth_state.countries stays None; the page has no error or retry arm, so it shows the loading text until the form is closed.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<Country>> for the list so the failed arm shows the error and a Retry.

title: The Premium bot auto-start survives until some later visit to that bot
trigger: Press Subscribe (Bot route) so auto_start is set, then lose the resolve (switch account before the answer, or the resolve never reaches the chat), and later open the Premium bot by link or search.
effect: hub.auto_start is in the Session, cleared only by the send error and the chat-resolve error arms; take_premium_auto_start matches only the username, so Quill sends '/start <ref>' to the bot with no user action. The background account keeps it too.
fix: Tie it to the resolve request (an Option<RequestId> with the username) and drop it when that request answers or the screen epoch changes.

title: Files chosen for forwarding are taken from the chooser before the chat is known to have opened
trigger: Pick a chat in the Forward to chooser while select_listed_chat does not open it (chat not in the list, filtered or folder-hidden)
effect: choose_start_files_chat does mem::take on choosing, then select_listed_chat; if open_chat_id() != chat it posts a silent Open the chat to attach note and the files are gone, with the chooser closed
fix: Take the files only after open_chat_id() == Some(chat); otherwise keep the chooser open.

title: Files picked for a chat are dropped when that chat does not open synchronously
trigger: Choose a chat in the Forward-to chooser while select_listed_chat cannot open it (open_chat_id() != chat): files were already taken from choosing.
effect: Chooser closes, note 'Open the chat to attach' and the files are lost.
fix: Keep the files until the chat is open (Choosing -> Attaching{chat}), attach on open, restore on failure.

title: Recover waits on request_windowing with no way out
trigger: GPU lost on Windows with no windows left; the windowing request future never completes.
effect: QuitMode::Explicit and no window: the process stays alive invisible, nothing quits.
fix: Give the await an exit (platform error, quit-asked, or a manual-clock deadline) that ends in give_up.

title: Wallpaper deletions are applied locally and not rolled back when TDLib refuses
trigger: Delete the account wallpaper / an installed wallpaper / a chat wallpaper while offline-ish or when the server errors.
effect: delete_default_background (94), remove_installed_background (119) and delete_chat_background (264) remove the entry on send; the error arm in chats/error.rs only sets background_error, so the wallpaper stays gone locally until a refetch/reopen although the server kept it.
fix: Apply on the answer (or keep a Removing stage that the error arm reverts).

title: A failed privacy set marks the key Failed whichever of several sets failed, and drops the real value
trigger: Change a privacy rule twice in quick succession (the second applies optimistically, both are in flight); the first one fails, or one fails on its own.
effect: The key becomes PrivacyKeyState::Failed ('Couldn't load') although the server kept the old or the second value; the row is not editable until the screen is reopened and refetched. A late getPrivacyRules answer for the same key also overwrites a newer optimistic Ready because answers are not matched to the newest request for the key.
fix: Per-key state {Loading(RequestId), Ready{detail, saving: Option<RequestId>}, Failed}; a set failure restores the previous detail and shows an error, and answers apply only for the key's live request id.

title: A failed privacy set leaves the optimistic call privacy mirrored in calls state
trigger: Settings > Calls (or Privacy > Calls), change Who can call me; setUserPrivacySettingRules fails (e.g. PRIVACY_TOO_LONG).
effect: set_privacy_rules calls mirror_call_privacy(key, &detail) before the answer; the error arm only sets PrivacyKeyState::Failed, so calls.privacy_allow_calls / privacy_p2p keep the rejected value and the older call code reads it.
fix: Derive the call fields from settings.privacy on read instead of mirroring them, or restore them from the previous detail in the SetPrivacyRules error arm.

title: Old Apply error stays after editing the draft; error is not tied to a chat
trigger: Apply a change that TDLib refuses (not enough boosts server side). Error line shows. Change a swatch.
effect: edit_chat_appearance resets sent and needs_boosts but not the session-wide appearance_error, so the stale refusal stays under the new draft until the next Apply. The error is also unkeyed by chat: a late refusal for chat A shows in the box opened for chat B.
fix: Store the error in the Apply stage enum with the chat id and request id; clear it when the draft changes.

title: Apply sends part of a plan, reports failure, and a pack request is not tracked as busy
trigger: Change name colour and group emoji pack in a supergroup, Apply. Name request goes out, then set_supergroup_custom_emoji_sticker_set refuses (no rights / full info missing) and returns Err.
effect: Part of the plan is already applied but the note says could not change and dialog.sent=false. Conversely when the pack request is sent, busy covers only three purposes, so 'Appearance updated' shows while the pack request is in flight and its error never reaches appearance_error.
fix: Validate the whole plan before sending any part, and make the Apply stage one enum (Editing, NeedsBoosts, Applying{requests}, Applied, Failed(reason)) that counts all four request purposes.

title: Boost-level message for the wallpaper is written into the shared background_error
trigger: In a boosted supergroup open Appearance > Choose wallpaper, pick a wallpaper the chat has too few boosts for, Apply (blocked), close the box, open Settings > Wallpapers.
effect: boosted_look_blocked writes chats_state.background_error, which wallpaper_preview and telegram_wallpapers also render, so 'Level N required' or 'Checking the boost level' shows on unrelated pages and is only cleared by the next open/apply of one of them.
fix: Keep the gate message in the chat look dialog's own state (a variant of its Apply stage), not in the session-wide background error.

title: Choosing a language rewrites the recent-languages file with packs the user just removed
trigger: Settings > Language: open the ... menu of a recent (non-official) pack and choose Delete (it dims, file written without it); then pick any other language row without leaving the page.
effect: install_language saves self.language.recent (which still holds the removed pack, filtered only in leave_language_settings), so the removed pack is written back and reappears in the list next visit.
fix: Apply a removal to LanguageUi::recent at once and keep only a 'dimmed for Restore' view in the box (Recent entry enum Kept/Removed), so every save writes one list.

title: apply_chat_mute clears the mute dialog's flags for whatever chat it shows and misses two of them
trigger: Open Notifications for chat A from a row menu (sound picker sub-view opens), press a mute preset; or swipe/menu-mute chat B while A's box is open in another window.
effect: apply_chat_mute (also called by swipe, profile rows, chat menus) sets mute_menu_open=false and mute_chat=None unconditionally, so it closes a box that was open for another chat; it leaves notif_sound_picker_open and mute_custom_open set (close_mute_menu clears them), so the next header Mute opens with the sound picker expanded.
fix: Make the mute box one Option<MuteBox{chat, view: Presets|Custom|Sounds, time_inputs}>; apply_chat_mute closes it only when it is for that chat, and close is one assignment.

title: A privacy rule whose save failed on the server is left Failed and every further edit in the open editor is silently ignored
trigger: Settings > Privacy > open a rule editor (e.g. Last seen); change a choice or add an exception while the server rejects the set (PRIVACY_TOO_LONG, flood, offline); then click another choice or Add user in the same editor.
effect: The row turns to 'Couldn't load', no radio is selected, no toast is shown (reducer comment says never toasts), and mutate_privacy_detail returns early for non-Ready so clicks do nothing and say nothing until the Privacy page is reopened (fetch_privacy).
fix: On a failed set, refetch the rule (like SetSenderBlockList does) or keep the last Ready detail in a PrivacyKeyState::Ready{detail, save: Fetch<()>} variant and show the error in the editor.

title: Undo of an agent's send marks the entry Undone although the delete was refused or failed
trigger: Agent sent a message that is no longer in the loaded history (agent_undo_for offers Undo for ids it cannot find, see its own comment). Click Undo, then Delete in the box. delete_selection filters or ConnectDriver::delete_selected refuses, shows an error note, and the on_ok handler still calls activity::mark_undone.
effect: The row shows the Undone tag and loses its Undo button while the message still exists in the chat.
fix: Have delete_selection return Result<Sent, Refused> and mark the entry only on Sent; better, mark it when the deleteMessages answer or the message-deleted update arrives.

title: Undo of an agent's message resets the user's forward draft and selection in an unrelated chat
trigger: In chat X tick messages to forward (ForwardStage::Selecting or the forward bar), open Settings > Agent access > Activity and Undo an agent send in chat Y. delete_selection ends with self.share.forward = ForwardStage::None.
effect: The user's forward in progress is silently dropped; only the agent's delete was asked for.
fix: Split delete_selection into the delete itself and the selection-mode exit, and clear the forward stage only when its draft is for the same chat and the same ids.

title: Activity filter outlives the account picked in the Chats section
trigger: Agent access page, Activity: filter by chat A of account 1. In the Chats section pick account 2 from the account menu (agent_ui.picked changes, filter does not). Account 2's log has no chat A.
effect: Activity shows 'nothing matches the filter' while the Chats button reads its default label (the chat is not in the new account's list), so no filter looks active; the user must find 'All' in the menu. The same stale filter also applies when picked changes back.
fix: Make the filter part of one value with the account it was made for (e.g. picked: Option<(AccountKey, ActivityFilter)>), or reset the filter wherever picked changes.

title: Log out box closes as if it worked when the logout request could not be sent
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out, press Log out while the send fails (request_logout returns Err) or there is no live client. The button handler clears settings.log_out_confirm and then calls close_kit_dialog_if_done unconditionally.
effect: submit_logout's own comment says a failed send must not silently close the dialog, but this box closes anyway; the user sees only a transient error note (or nothing with no live client) and believes the logout started.
fix: Make submit_logout return whether the request went out and clear log_out_confirm and close the box only on success; keep the box with an inline error otherwise.

title: Composer spelling and edit menu in a chat window is built from the main window's composer
trigger: Right click a misspelled word in a chat window's composer. composer_context_menu defers build_composer_menu with window.defer, outside in_window_scope, so app.composer, chat_ui and spell state are the main window's.
effect: Suggestions, Cut/Copy enablement, the code-block and emoji items come from the main composer text and selection; the replace is refused or applies to nothing.
fix: Capture the window scope at right-click time and run build_composer_menu inside in_window_scope(scope).

title: Wallpaper preview Apply closes the box and switches to the Telegram wallpaper before setDefaultBackground answers
trigger: Settings > Chat wallpaper > pick a gallery wallpaper (or From file...) > Apply while the request will fail (e.g. offline flood wait, upload of a local file refused).
effect: The box closes as if saved; appearance.telegram_wallpaper is set true and wallpaper_rgb is cleared even though the server never set the wallpaper, so the chosen preset color is lost and the old Telegram wallpaper shows; the error only lands in chats_state.background_error, which the closed preview no longer shows.
fix: Keep the preview open in an Applying { request } stage of the preview value and close it (and flip the appearance) only on the matching setDefaultBackground answer; show the error in the box on failure.

title: Wallpaper Share link is copied whenever any getBackgroundUrl answer lands, not matched to the preview that asked
trigger: Open wallpaper A's preview, press Share, press Cancel before the link arrives (or open wallpaper B's preview); the getBackgroundUrl answer for A lands.
effect: close/open clear background_url only before the answer; the late answer sets chats_state.background_url and drain_wallpaper_preview copies A's link to the clipboard (overwriting what the user copied) and, if B's preview is open, shows 'Link copied' under B.
fix: Record the getBackgroundUrl RequestId in the preview (a Sharing { request } stage) and apply the URL only when its request id matches the open preview's.

title: Shared wallpaper link lands in the clipboard after the preview was left
trigger: Press Share in the wallpaper preview, close it (or open another wallpaper) before getBackgroundUrl answers.
effect: background_url is an ownerless Option slot cleared only when a preview opens/closes; the answer sets it afterwards and the poll drain copies it to the clipboard without checking that a preview for that background is still open.
fix: Match the answer to the preview that asked (request id in the preview) and drop it otherwise.

title: fetch_new_chat_privacy replaces a Ready value with Loading and has no dedupe
trigger: Open Privacy twice, or reopen while a set_new_chat_settings is in flight.
effect: The Ready value (with the paid-message price) becomes Loading, so set_new_chat_privacy is refused during the fetch; a fetch answer arriving after an optimistic set overwrites the new value with the old server one.
fix: Keep Ready while refreshing (Ready{refreshing}) and ignore a fetch answer older than the last set.

title: Cancel is only seen between body chunks, so a stalled server keeps the row Downloading for up to 180 s after the switch is turned off
trigger: Start a download on a flaky connection that stalls mid-body, flip the switch off.
effect: Switch toggles off in the OS-less sense but the row keeps Downloading n% and toggling again does nothing (toggle_dictionary returns early while download.code matches) until the 180 s global timeout.
fix: Add a Cancelling stage that the row shows at once and drop the download future (cancel the ureq call) instead of polling a flag.

title: A timed-out ISpellChecker check answers correct, and SpellChecker caches that answer
trigger: Type a misspelled word on Windows while the COM thread is busy loading a cold dictionary (over 5 s) or backlogged with jobs.
effect: The word gets no underline and stays unflagged (cached as correct) until the cache is cleared by learn/unlearn/set_app_words or 20k other words.
fix: Backend returns Option<bool> (Unknown on timeout) and SpellChecker caches only Known answers.

title: Blocked-senders pages are not matched to the list they extend
trigger: Open Blocked Users, scroll so page offset N is requested, then unblock someone (SetSenderBlockList drops the data) or reopen so the offset-0 fetch restarts; the old page answers last.
effect: The late page is appended without dedupe to a fresh list, or take_data() finds nothing, leaves the Fetch Idle and the list is lost until reopened; blocked_total is written by any page.
fix: Put a list generation in GetBlockedSenders { offset, generation } and drop answers of an older generation; dedupe on append.

title: Late answer of the remembered-password check reopens the finish step after the user dismissed it
trigger: Type the password in 'Do you still remember your password?' and submit (password_check=Checking), close the box (dismiss_password_check sets Idle) before the getRecoveryEmailAddress answer comes.
effect: RecoveryEmailAddress sets Remembered (or the error arm sets Wrong or Failed) with no check that the box is still waiting for this request; the box shows the finish step or a wrong-password line the next time the page renders it.
fix: PasswordCheck::Checking { request: RequestId }; apply only when pending.id matches, and let dismiss drop the request.

title: Language page opened before an account switch never asks the new account for the pack list
trigger: With the Settings window on Language, switch account from the main window: language.open is still Some (LanguageUi is app-level, not OnScreen), so ensure_language_box returns early and request_language_packs is not sent to the new session.
effect: The page shows 'No languages found' (packs empty, packs_loading false) until the user leaves and re-enters the page.
fix: Make the request part of a Fetch<Vec<LanguagePackInfo>> in the session that the page asks for whenever it is Idle, instead of a once-per-visit Option in app state.

title: Failed language list request shows 'No languages found' with no retry
trigger: Settings > Language while TDLib getLocalizationTargetInfo errors or the request send fails.
effect: packs_loading is cleared on error and packs stays empty, so the page claims no languages exist instead of an error; no retry until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<LanguagePackInfoData>> with a Failed variant that the page renders with a Retry.

title: Corner preview windows end only on hover-out
trigger: Notification settings > Position: hover or click a corner slot, then close the settings page (Esc, tab or window close) without moving off the slot.
effect: notify_corner_preview(None) is called only from the slot's on_hover(false), which cannot fire once the element is gone; the sample popups (no timeout) stay on screen in that corner and the real notifications stay dimmed (windows.demo target 0).
fix: Own the preview as one value (Option<ScreenCorner>) cleared when the page closes, or give the samples a drop/close hook.

title: Tray 'disable notifications' flips only the account on screen
trigger: Two accounts signed in; use the tray/menu 'Disable notifications' while account A is on screen.
effect: set_desktop_notifications writes live.driver.session.settings of A only; account B's session still has desktop_notifications = true and keeps notifying (session_apply_messages.rs:457), and the tray checkbox flips back when B is brought on screen.
fix: Make the tray toggle an app-wide pref, or apply it to every account's session.

title: Mute time inputs are always built against the main window
trigger: Open Mute > Custom from a chat window whose box is hosted in that window, or with the main window closed to the tray.
effect: queue_mute_time_inputs defers into main_window.handle and builds InputState with that window; the fields are drawn in the chat window's dialog (focus/blur subscriptions belong to the other window), and with no main window handle they are never created, so the Custom row silently does not show.
fix: Create the fields with the window that asked (the Asker's window) and key them to it.

title: Scope/reaction notification settings are sent as a whole object copied from the session cache, without an optimistic update
trigger: Defaults dialog: flip two switches of one scope (or reaction sources) faster than TDLib's update arrives.
effect: Each apply_* clones scope_notification_settings, changes one field and sends the full object; the cache changes only on the later updateScopeNotificationSettings, so the second send carries the old value of the first field and silently reverts it. Same in apply_reaction_source/sound/preview.
fix: Keep a pending patch per scope (request id + the fields changed) and rebase on it, or send only the changed field when TDLib allows.

title: Undo of a reaction marks the entry Undone even when the toggle did nothing
trigger: Click Undo on a react entry when toggle_reaction returns early (react_premium_feature opens Premium instead) or there is no live client. mark_undone runs right after the call.
effect: The row reads Undone while the reaction is still on the message; Premium may open over Settings.
fix: Make toggle_reaction report whether it sent the change and mark the entry only then.

title: Contact chooser sends to whatever chat is open when a contact is clicked, not the chat it was opened for
trigger: Open Attach > Contact in chat A; before the click, chat B comes to the front in the same window (notification click, link, agent open, Saved Messages jump). Click a contact. submit_share_contact reads share_target() from session.open_chat, and nothing closes content_dialog on a chat change.
effect: The contact card goes to chat B, possibly one the user never meant to share a phone number with (privacy and wrong-target).
fix: Put the destination (AccountChat/ChatId) inside ShareContentDialog when it opens, send to that, and close the dialog in the chat-switch path.

title: If the wallpaper worker thread panics, every wallpaper area asks for an animation frame forever
trigger: Open a chat whose wallpaper render panics in Sources::render (e.g. a malformed pattern/photo that trips image/resvg); spawn_guarded catches the panic and the thread ends.
effect: Shared::threaded stays true, Board::running/wanted keep the dead job, nothing ever finishes, so lookup returns pending=true and request_animation_frame runs every frame in every window showing a non-solid wallpaper (CPU/battery drain) and the wallpaper never draws.
fix: Make the worker's liveness a value (Worker::Running/Dead) set when the guarded body returns, and fall back to inline rendering or a plain fill (no further frame requests) when it is dead.

title: One shared story page_op slot: a concurrent story-page request replaces the tracked op, so the earlier op's failure or success is never shown
trigger: On a chat's story page, delete or rename an album (page_op = Sending), then scroll the archive or posted list so a paging read starts (begin_story_page_check replaces page_op); the delete answer arrives with an error.
effect: story_page_op_for matches only the latest request id, so the error is dropped silently: no failed line, as if the delete worked. The archive/posted 'loading' indicator is also lost when an album op overwrites the Checking op.
fix: Track story-page ops per request (map keyed by RequestId, or one enum value per op kind), and keep the loading state of reads separate from the status line of mutations.

title: send_story_page overwrites page_op with Failed on a send error, replacing whichever other page op was in flight
trigger: A story page read is in flight; a second page request fails to send (AgentDriving or Native).
effect: The in-flight op's tracking is lost, so its answer no longer clears or settles the page status.
fix: Same per-request op map as the page_op entry.

title: viewMessages ack is not matched to the request: commit_viewed/abort_viewing act on every id in `viewing` of the chat
trigger: Scroll a busy chat so two viewMessages requests (different ids) are in flight at once. The first answers ok: commit_viewed moves ALL `viewing` ids, including the second request's, into `viewed`. The second then fails (flood, network): abort_viewing finds `viewing` empty, so those ids are never re-sent. Same when an answer from before a chat re-open lands after the new open generation began viewing.
effect: Messages whose view failed stay marked viewed: the chat keeps its unread count/mentions/reactions until the chat is re-opened (viewed is cleared per open generation).
fix: Key the in-flight set by RequestId (and view_generation): `viewing: HashMap<RequestId, BTreeSet<i64>>`; commit/abort only the entry of the answering request and ignore an answer whose view_generation is not current.

title: bar_focused survives a chat switch, so the new chat's unread bar reads as focused
trigger: With a screen reader on, move accessibility focus onto the 'Unread messages' bar (Up from the first unread), then open another chat that has an unread divider.
effect: MessageUi.a11y.bar_focused is per window, not per chat (ChatUi is replaced by sync_chat_ui, MessageUi.a11y is not): history_a11y_row_focus reports the new chat's bar as focused and Space/play-pause is refused (bar_focused true) before the user focused anything there.
fix: Make the a11y focus one value in ChatUi (enum A11yFocus { None, Bar, Row(MessageId) }) replacing bar_focused + selection_focus pairing, so a chat change replaces it whole.

title: pinned_list_open is window-wide and not reset when the open chat changes
trigger: Open the pinned-messages list from the pinned bar in chat A, then click chat B (which has pinned messages) in the chat list.
effect: Chat B shows its pinned list panel open without being asked; in a chat with no pins the flag stays set and the list pops open later in the next chat with pins.
fix: Move the open flag into ChatUi (per chat) or into an enum PinnedBar { Bar, List } keyed by AccountChat so a chat change replaces it.

title: Cover picker marks the clip unreadable at open when it is not local yet and never re-checks
trigger: own video story whose clip is still downloading (or evicted): open the story menu, Choose cover
effect: picker shows 'unreadable' permanently even after the clip finishes downloading; user must close and reopen the picker
fix: CoverStage::WaitingForClip that re-resolves story_video_path each tick and moves to Probing once local

title: Picker is closed before the create/add call is sent; a failed send loses the ticked stories
trigger: tick stories in the album picker, press Create/Save while the connection call fails (driver Err)
effect: picker is already gone (page.picker = None / close_album_picker) so the selection is lost; only an error note appears
fix: close the picker when the op settles Succeeded; keep it with the error on Failed

title: delete_story_album clears the confirm and leaves the album view even when the send failed
trigger: press Delete album twice in demo mode or when the driver rejects the call
effect: view returns to the album list as if deleted; the album is still there and no retry state is kept
fix: leave the album only when page_op for that request Succeeds

title: After a successful post the composer stays open with its media and Post enabled; a second press posts a duplicate story
trigger: post a story, see 'Posted', press Post again
effect: busy is false once outcome is Succeeded and post_sent is cleared, story_composer_post runs again and posts the same media a second time
fix: close the composer (or move to ComposerStage::Posted with Post disabled) on Succeeded

title: Opening one viewer panel leaves others open: stats closes only viewers/report, share closes only close-friends
trigger: open Share (or the privacy editor / cover picker), then press Statistics; or open Statistics then Share
effect: several panels (stats, share, privacy, cover) stack in story_action_row/story_more_row at once, pushing the story out of the 640px frame and each stealing the shared more_search field
fix: single ViewerPanel enum (see implicit-state entry) so opening one replaces the other

title: delete_confirm stays armed when the user opens the add-stories picker or another view, so the next click on Delete deletes at once
trigger: open an album, press Delete album (label turns to Confirm), press Add stories, Back from the picker
effect: the Delete button still reads Confirm delete; one click deletes the album without the intended second look
fix: enum AlbumView { List, Album{id, confirm_delete: bool}, Picker{..} } so changing the view resets the confirm

title: A comment waiting for Stars is dropped when the Stars box sends the viewer to top up
trigger: Type a comment that needs more Stars than chosen (send_live_comment opens the Stars box with then_send=true), pick an amount above the balance, press the button.
effect: submit_live_stars_box takes the box, stores stars_before_top_up and chosen_stars but not then_send; after the top-up the comment is not sent and the user must press Send again. If live_top_up is refused for an agent input, stars_before_top_up stays set with no box.
fix: Model the Stars flow as one enum (BoxOpen{mode,stars,then_send}, TopUp{mode,stars,then_send}, Idle) so the top-up stage carries then_send and has a cancel exit.

title: send_story_reply clears the typed reply and closes the row even when the driver refused the send
trigger: Type a story reply, press Send while the send fails (get Err from driver.send_story_reply: no chats path, story gone, slow mode; the text path has no slow_mode_blocked check unlike sticker/GIF/voice).
effect: The error note shows but reply_input.set_value("") and end_story_reply run unconditionally, so the user's text is lost and the row closes as if it had been sent.
fix: Clear the field and end the reply only on Ok (match the result once, as finish_story_reply_media does for media).

title: A story opened over an open viewer keeps the reply and live-comment draft of the story it replaced
trigger: In story A type text in the reply field (or the live comment field), then press the 'Reposted from' label (press_story_repost -> open_story -> start_story_viewer), or return from the live PiP into another story. Open the reply row on the new story.
effect: start_story_viewer calls leave_story_item (closes the row) but never clear_story_fields; only story_changed (step/jump) and release_story_viewer clear them. The old draft shows in the new story's reply field and Send delivers it to the other poster.
fix: Make 'the viewer shows another story' one place (a replace_item/switch that always runs leave_item plus clear_story_fields when the key differs) used by start_story_viewer and story_changed alike.

title: Re-requesting insights while statistics are in flight fetches the first forwards page again and appends it
trigger: Open insights for own story A; its forwards page answers first; reopen insights for A while getStoryStatistics is still pending.
effect: The pending-stats branch sees no forwards request in flight and calls fetch_story_public_forwards(offset empty); accept_public_forwards extends the list, so the first page of public forwards shows twice.
fix: Ask for the first page only when the forwards fetch is Idle; make forwards a Fetch with the offset it was asked for and replace on offset 0.

title: postStory answer and error are matched by purpose only, not to the composer that posted
trigger: Press Post in the story composer, close it before the answer, open the composer again (ui/story_composer.rs:185-187 resets eligibility, check_error and outcome to None); the first postStory then answers (outcome becomes Posting{id}) or errors (outcome becomes Failed).
effect: The new composer shows 'Posting failed' or Posted/busy for a post it did not make; post_sent clears because outcome left None.
fix: Key StoryPostOutcome by the postStory request id (Posting{request,story_id}) and apply Failed/Succeeded only when it is the current composer's request.

title: A 400 from getStory marks a story expired for the whole session
trigger: A story card or reply header asks getStory before its poster chat is loaded or while the story is not yet accessible; TDLib answers 400. Later the story becomes loadable (chat loads, user joins).
effect: missing holds the key forever (nothing removes it; reset_active_stories_paging clears only story_retry), the prefetch filter skips it and the card says 'This story has expired' until restart unless the story arrives through updateStory.
fix: Enum per story StoryFetch { Unasked, Asked, Waiting{until}, Gone } with a retry for 400 and a clear on new Ready/updateStory.

title: A story-page op left Sending/Checking by a lost request is never settled
trigger: Start an album mutation or load, then the request is dropped without an answer or error reaching story_page_op_for (for example after reconnect); settle_story_page_op keeps in-flight ops
effect: The status line shows 'Sending'/'Checking' indefinitely until another op replaces it
fix: Give the op an owner-going-away exit: clear in-flight ops when the driver takes back a request, and when the page is left.

title: Story interactions answer is matched to story only, not to the request or offset that asked
trigger: Open viewers, scroll to load more (offset page N in flight), close and reopen the panel: clear_story_viewers + begin_story_viewers makes a fresh state; fetch of page 1 returns Ok(None) because has_purpose_for_story is still true; the old page-N answer then lands
effect: Page N rows are appended as the first rows of the fresh panel, next_offset jumps ahead, page 1 is never fetched, loading never set so no spinner
fix: Store the asking RequestId in the viewers Fetch stage and apply an answer only when it equals that id; the skip check compares the same key.

title: Story report answers are matched to (chat, story) only; stage and request are not checked
trigger: Start report on a story, close the report box, reopen it on the same story (begin_story_report resets to Checking) before the first answer; or a late answer arrives after Failed/Reported
effect: The old answer moves the new flow to a wrong stage (picker or Reported) while the new request is still in flight, then the second answer flips it again; a late Ok can mark a failed report as Reported
fix: Put the in-flight RequestId in the Checking and Sending variants and apply an answer or error only when it equals that id.

title: The story editor's Save reads the shared StoryManageState slot, so another call's outcome closes or fails it
trigger: Edit a posted story in the composer and press Save; while editStory is in flight, another management call takes the slot (the viewer's cover or privacy editor, or an album action that calls fail_locally).
effect: frame_upkeep clears save_sent when stories.manage.pending is false, without checking that the slot still holds this edit's request. The other call's result decides: its success closes the composer as saved while the edit may still fail silently, its failure shows its error in the composer.
fix: Keep the edit's RequestId in the composer (a Saving{request} stage) and settle it only from the answer to that request, not from the shared slot's pending flag.

title: Strip wheel AxisLock never resets for a plain mouse wheel (no Started/Ended phases): the first event fixes the axis for the session of hovering
trigger: hover the strip with a mouse wheel and scroll vertically once, then Shift+wheel; or scroll horizontally first and then try to scroll the list vertically over the strip
effect: feed() keeps the decided axis until restart/Ended, which wheels never send: vertical wheel over the strip is either swallowed as sideways scroll or the strip never scrolls sideways
fix: for non-precise deltas decide per event (do not store the axis), reset on pointer leave

title: Cover Save and Privacy Save and composer Save-edit share the single StoryManageState slot; the first call's answer is dropped when another starts
trigger: save the cover, then (before the answer) save the privacy editor of the same story (both panels can be open at once)
effect: the cover call's answer no longer matches the slot, so cover_sent clears with the privacy call's result: the cover panel closes as saved (or shows the privacy error) though the cover edit may have failed
fix: key the in-flight management call by purpose (Cover|Privacy|Edit) per story, and let each panel hold its own RequestId instead of a sent bool matched to a global pending

title: Create album has no in-flight guard and does not clear the name; a second press creates a duplicate album
trigger: type an album name, press Create twice (or Create after choosing stories, then Create again)
effect: two albums with the same name; the name input still holds the old text
fix: disable story-page mutations while page_op is Sending for the page and clear new_album_name on success

title: Pin/unpin builds the full pinned list from the cached state and sends it without waiting for the previous answer
trigger: pin story A and quickly pin story B (before the first setChatPinnedStories answers)
effect: second call carries the old list plus B only, so A's pin is overwritten and lost on the server
fix: disable pin toggles while a pin op is Sending, or queue and rebuild from the settled list

title: Archive/posted loading is read from the single session-wide page_op slot by label, not by chat or request
trigger: open the story page of chat A while its three loads fire, or leave A's page and open B quickly
effect: only the last of the three loads owns page_op, so chat_page_loading() is false while posted stories load and a second page can be asked; B's page can show 'loading' that belongs to A; viewer ops (hide, profile toggle, close friends) also overwrite the line
fix: per-chat Fetch<Page> for archive and posted lists keyed by (chat, purpose), leaving page_op for mutations only

title: canPostStory answer is session-wide and not matched to the composer/target that asked
trigger: press Post, close the composer, reopen it, pick a different Post as channel and press Post; the first answer lands now
effect: the earlier eligibility clears check_sent and posts to the newly chosen target chat with eligibility computed for another chat
fix: carry the checked target and RequestId in ComposerStage::Checking and apply only the matching answer

title: save_story_media copies the story file to Downloads synchronously on the UI thread
trigger: press Save media on a large video story
effect: UI freezes for the length of the copy (no progress, no way to cancel)
fix: run the copy on the background executor and show a Saving/Saved/Failed notice

title: close_friends_saving has no way out when the list was never loaded, or when page_op was replaced, or when the server list differs from the sent ids
trigger: open the editor with the list unloaded and press Save while the call fails; or Hide the peer while saving
effect: tick_close_friends returns on loaded==None before checking failed; saving stays true, Save is disabled and shows Saving forever (Cancel closes it)
fix: CloseFriendsStage::Saving(RequestId) left by the matching answer (ok/error) rather than by comparing lists

title: Activate Stealth Mode failure from TDLib gives no feedback and leaves the box open
trigger: tap Enable Stealth Mode when the server rejects it (flood wait, premium lapsed)
effect: box stays open on the same button; no error is shown because ActivateStoryStealthMode has no arm in apply_stories_error
fix: StealthBox stage Activating(RequestId) with an error arm that shows the reason and returns to Idle

title: A user or chat named by Grams history is marked asked even when the request never left
trigger: Open My Grams while the connection is down or chats_path_active is false for a moment; a page lands naming a sender; grams_tick sets peers_dirty=false and tries getUser/getChat.
effect: asked_users/asked_chats get the id on both Ok and Err, and peers_dirty is already cleared, so the row keeps its placeholder for the whole session (missing_* is only filled on an error answer).
fix: Per-peer enum {Unknown, Asked(RequestId), Missing, Known}; set Asked only after a successful send and fall back to Unknown on the Err arm.

title: maybe_fetch_secret_chat_states drops the rest of the taken queue when one getSecretChat send fails
trigger: Two or more secret chats queued; the send for the first returns an error.
effect: The queue was mem::take n; only the failing id is pushed back, the others are lost, so their state (closed, pending) is never resolved and the composer state for those chats stays unknown.
fix: Re-queue the remaining ids on error (or pop one id at a time).

title: Media cache scope is a process-wide OnceLock set by the first account's connect; every later account (switch, background) shares it
trigger: Sign in account A, add account B, switch to B (plan_restore runs for B and calls set_media_cache_scope(B), which is ignored). Play a webm sticker, record a voice note or drop an archive in B.
effect: B's decrypted scratch (gif-frames/<file_id>, captures, video-note-thumbs, archives, file-thumbs) goes under quill-media-cache/<A>; file ids overlap across accounts so discard_frame_cache(file_id) in one account removes the other's extraction dir. The doc claim 'account-scoped' is false once a second account connects.
fix: Drop the global; take the scope from the account on screen (AccountKey in the caller or a per-OnScreen cache base) so the base is replaced with the account.

title: Profile edit failure is written to a field only the already-closed Edit Profile dialog shows
trigger: Open Edit Profile, change the name or bio, press Save while the request will fail (flood wait, offline). The save handler sends setName/setBio and calls close_edit_profile_dialog at once (ui/profile_edit_save.rs:107-125), then the error answer arrives.
effect: The box closed as if saved with a silent note 'update requested'; the failure lands in users_state.profile_edit_error, which nothing draws any more. The user believes the profile changed.
fix: Keep the dialog in a Saving stage (enum Editing/Saving{request}/Failed) and close it only on the matching ok, or post the error as a note when no dialog is open.

title: A failed follow-up page of groups in common ends the list for good
trigger: Open a user's profile with more than 40 common groups, scroll to load the next page while offline / on a FLOOD_WAIT: fail_profile_fetch sets exhausted=true and returns.
effect: The list silently stops after the first page; no Retry row, no later page until the profile is closed and reopened (reopening re-fetches).
fix: Failed follow-up returns to `More` (or a `PageFailed` variant with a retry affordance) instead of End; only a short page is End.

title: updateSupergroupFullInfo and the full-info answer rebuild SupergroupFullInfoData with admin, member_counts, profile and direct_messages_chat_id reset to defaults
trigger: Open a group's manage dialog or permissions box so admin flags (merge_full_admin), restricted/banned counts (session_permissions_box) and the direct-messages chat id (set_direct_messages_chat) are stored; then TDLib sends any updateSupergroupFullInfo (member count change, slow mode, boost) or the info is refetched.
effect: History-visible, hidden-members and sponsored toggles read false, the permissions box rows read 0 restricted/banned, the Gift/location row and the direct-messages link vanish until each side-channel fetch runs again.
fix: Update the existing entry in place (copy only the fields the payload carries) instead of inserting a fresh struct; keep the side-channel parts as separate Fetch<T> values.

title: Calendar generation restarts at 1 after every close, so a late getChatMessageCalendar answer from an earlier open lands in the new calendar
trigger: In a chat search with the Photos filter open Jump to date (generation 1, page request in flight), close the box (calendar set to None), switch the filter to Video and reopen Jump to date in the same chat (generation 1 again, a second request goes out). The first answer (photo days) matches generation and chat and is accepted.
effect: The calendar highlights days of the wrong media kind; with the same filter the duplicate page has the same cursor, so accept() sees no progress and marks the calendar exhausted, so older months never load.
