fix: Take the generation from a counter that lives beside the Option (never reset on close), or store the request id in the calendar and match the answer on it. Same fix in shared_media_months.rs open_shared_media_calendar.

title: Call privacy error flag is wiped by an in-flight answer after a failed send reset the counter
trigger: Open call privacy settings; fetch_call_privacy sends the first getUserPrivacySettingRules, the second send fails (connect/calls/history.rs:244 sets privacy_pending=0, privacy_error=true); the first answer arrives and calls privacy_roundtrip_done.
effect: pending saturates to 0 and privacy_error is set to false, so the failure line disappears and the page looks loaded with one rule unknown. Same for set_call_privacy failing while another roundtrip is in flight.
fix: Replace the counter plus bool by Fetch per rule (AllowCalls, PeerToPeer) keyed by request id; a failed send marks only that rule Failed.

title: A failed Saved Messages tag page marks the filter complete and ends paging with no retry
trigger: Filter Saved Messages by a tag; searchSavedMessages fails (flood wait, offline) on the first or a later page.
effect: fail_saved_tag_page sets loaded=true and history.loaded_complete=true, so fetch_saved_tag_page never asks again: the list is shown as complete (or 'no messages') although it was not loaded; only a new filter retries.
fix: SavedTagSearch.state: enum { Loading(RequestId), Ready{more: bool}, Failed(line) } with a Retry row; loaded_complete only when TDLib said so.

title: A late reportChatSponsoredMessage answer re-arms the report picker after the user cancelled it
trigger: Right-click a sponsored message, Report; before TDLib answers press Esc (dismiss_sponsored_report clears flight and target); the answer reportSponsoredResultOptionRequired arrives.
effect: accept_sponsored_report is applied on purpose alone (messages/apply.rs:536), finds no flight and no target, uses message_id 0 and stores a new SponsoredReportFlight, so the option picker reopens over a dismissed report; choosing an option reports message 0. A late Ok inserts id 0 into dismissed and the reported ad stays visible.
fix: Make the report flow one enum (Idle, Asking{request,chat,message}, PickingOption{flight}, Done{outcome}) and apply an answer only when its request id equals the Asking request; dismiss returns to Idle and the answer is dropped.

title: A deletion in another chat marks the in-chat search jump as missing
trigger: In a supergroup, search inside the chat and jump to a result (jump Loading or Ready on message id N). Meanwhile a message with the same id N is deleted for good in another supergroup or channel (server message ids repeat across channels).
effect: miss_search_jump compares only message ids, not ChatSearchState::chat_id, so the jump turns Missing and the status line says the message is unavailable for a message that still exists.
fix: Pass the chat id of the deletion and change the jump only when search.chat_search.chat_id matches; better, make the jump carry its ChatMessage key.

title: updateDefaultBackground with a null background fails to parse, so a removed default wallpaper is never applied
trigger: On another device (or another Quill session on the same account) remove the default chat wallpaper (deleteDefaultBackground / reset to no wallpaper). TDLib sends updateDefaultBackground with background:null.
effect: parse_chats_payload returns MissingField for the update, the envelope is dropped, and Session::chats_state.default_backgrounds keeps the old wallpaper: Quill keeps drawing the removed default wallpaper until restart. (Quill's own delete_default_background removes the entry optimistically and never restores it when TDLib refuses, the mirror-image leftover.)
fix: Make UpdateDefaultBackground carry Option<Background> and have the reducer remove the theme's entry on None; keep the optimistic delete as a pending value restored on the error arm.

title: ingest returns early with ? after the reducer took the pending request, dropping answers captured before apply
trigger: A link-preview, message-link, AI-compose, username-check or instant-view answer arrives in the same envelope while run_post_ingest_pumps, maybe_continue_boost, maybe_load_main_chats, maybe_load_archive_chats or sync_shown_views returns a send error (sender closed).
effect: The captured answer is never stashed: composer chip stays 'Getting link info', copy link / AI text / username verdict / instant view silently lost.
fix: Run the stash steps before any fallible step, or collect errors and return the first at the end as run_post_ingest_pumps does.

title: system_proxy_tick takes proxy.error as its own refusal, which can swallow the error of the user's own proxy action
trigger: Use system proxy mode on, and in the proxy box press Add on a bad proxy right after a system step was sent; the user's mutation fails.
effect: sent.settled is false, so the next tick does proxy.error.take(): the error the user should see is cleared and counted as the system step being refused; the box shows no failure.
fix: Tag the proxy error with the request that produced it (MutateProxy request id) and have the tick consume only its own.

title: Proxy auto-switch and system-proxy follow run only for the account on screen
trigger: Sign in two accounts, set Use system proxy (or a proxy list with rotation) on account B, switch to account A, then change the OS proxy or kill B's proxy.
effect: The Background tick scope returns before proxy_tick/system_proxy_tick, so B's TDLib client keeps the dead or old proxy, stops receiving messages and notifications until B is shown again.
fix: Run proxy_tick and system_proxy_tick for both scopes (they are per-driver), keep only UI-bound ticks on-screen.

title: net_watch::latest() re-probes the routing table on the UI thread on every poll while the route reads offline
trigger: Disconnect the network (or have no route to Telegram) and leave Quill open; the screen poll and each background account poll call poll_ticks(.., net_watch::latest()) every pump
effect: Each pump runs route_now(): two UDP bind/connect calls plus a netlink socket (Linux), SCDynamicStore lookups (macOS) or GetBestRoute2 (Windows), all under the tracker mutex that the watcher thread also needs; wasted work and possible UI stalls while offline, multiplied by the number of background accounts
fix: Let the watcher thread own the probe and publish a NetworkState (epoch, available) in an atomic; latest() only reads it, with a rate-limited re-probe owned by the watcher while offline.

title: begin_conference overwrites a join in flight, the first answer is then treated as a rejoin
trigger: Double activate Accept on a conference invitation or link before the first groupCallInfo answers
effect: The first answer no longer matches pending_conference (take_if by request id) so accept_conference_joined skips tracking but still queues a fetch and stores a join payload for an untracked call; the second joins normally
fix: Refuse begin_conference while pending_conference is Some (or cancel the old request id explicitly)

title: A transient getMapThumbnailFile error is remembered as 'asked' for the whole session
trigger: Open a chat with location messages while Telegram answers FLOOD_WAIT/timeout for getMapThumbnailFile: failed() removes `awaiting` but keeps the key in `asked`.
effect: Those places keep the coordinate card with no map tile until Quill restarts or 1024 other places are asked; opening the chat again does not retry. The request is also not sweepable, so a lost one never settles via the sweep either.
fix: Per-place `enum Tile { Asking(RequestId), Ready(FileId), Failed{retry_after} }` in one map; Failed retried after a delay or on reconnect.

title: A created or edited invite link turns an unfetched, Loading or Failed link list into Loaded with one entry
trigger: Create an invite link (CreateChatInviteLink) before the chat's link list was fetched, or while getChatInviteLinks is in flight / failed.
effect: The list is marked Loaded with total_count 1 and the new link only; fetch_chat_invite_links skips Loaded, so the other links never show until a manual refresh. If the list answer lands later it overwrites, if it already failed nothing refetches.
fix: Only merge into a Loaded list; for any other state keep the state and mark the list stale so the fetch runs again.

title: is_user_action classifies a request by the Debug-name prefix of its purpose (Get/Load/Search/Download/View/Open/Close/SetOnline)
trigger: (1) A user press whose purpose starts with Get/Open/Close (for example getPaymentForm, a close-secret-chat) hits a flood limit: no flood notice. (2) Log out or close: settle_account_requests drops every non-prefixed purpose (Set/Create/Toggle/Send/Edit...) without its failure handler.
effect: Flood notice missing for some user actions; in-flight UI state held by dropped Set*/Create*/Toggle* requests is never settled, and the Session survives a re-login (see session_updates entering Ready), so a spinner or busy marker can stay.
fix: Put a RequestPurpose::kind() (UserAction | Lookup | Auth) on each domain purpose enum, matched exhaustively; settle every non-auth request on logout.

title: A failed sublist page is retried on every scroll event
trigger: Open a Saved Messages sublist while the server answers errors for getSavedMessagesTopicHistory; scroll near the top.
effect: The error only sets chat_action_error (threads/error.rs:94); the view has no failed marker and loaded_complete stays false, so maybe_auto_load_older sends the request again at each history scroll event.
fix: Per-view page state enum with Failed that stops auto-paging until the user taps Retry.

title: A duplicate late first page marks a Saved Messages sublist complete
trigger: Open a sublist, press Back and open the same sublist again quickly; both getSavedMessagesTopicHistory requests answer (the first is not matched, only topic_id is compared).
effect: The second answer adds 0 new rows, so apply_saved_topic_history sets loaded_complete=true; older messages of the sublist never load. next_from_message_id is also overwritten by whichever page arrived last.
fix: Store the awaited RequestId in SavedSublistView (as SavedTagSearch.request does) and apply only that answer; complete only on an empty page.

title: The system proxy step's result is read from the shared ProxyState::error, not matched to its request
trigger: Use system proxy settings with an OS proxy set. Quill sends a system step (addProxy/editProxy); TDLib refuses it, which sets settings.proxy.error and marks the list stale, so system_proxy_tick returns early until the refetch lands. During that window open Settings > Proxy and save or enable a custom proxy (send_proxy_mutation clears error), and let that call fail.
effect: Before the refetch the proxy box shows an error for a change the user never made; then the user's own failure is taken by system_proxy_tick (error.take()) as the system step's refusal, so the box loses the user's error, the system step is marked refused (waits RETRY = 5 min), or, if the user's call succeeded, the refused system step is resent at once. system_proxy_tick also writes error = None before every send, wiping any error the box is showing.
fix: Give system steps their own RequestPurpose (or keep the RequestId in SentStep) and settle SentStep from that request's answer; never read or clear the user-facing ProxyState::error from the tick.

title: Replacing a stopped hub leaves every existing client unrouted on the dead hub's routing table
trigger: The receive thread gives up after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_PANICS; the user then adds an account or reconnects, which calls TdHub::shared and builds a new hub with an empty Routes table.
effect: The old clients' TDLib instances stay open (their envelopes are now dropped as unrouted-client), their bridges report stopped, and reconnecting the same account opens a second TDLib instance on the same database directory, which TDLib refuses while the first holds the lock; the account stays failed until restart.
fix: Keep one Routes (and MAY_BE_OPEN list) for the process and hand it to the replacement hub, so live clients keep their routes across a receive-thread restart.

title: submit_replies_block takes the box before checking the driver is active and before the send
trigger: Confirm Block in the Replies chat while locked or when the send fails.
effect: replies_block.take() closes the box; with chats_path_active false or a send Err the block is never sent and the user's choices (delete, report spam) are lost as if saved.
fix: Check active first, send, then clear the box; keep it open with an error on failure.

title: Keychain delete reports success on every error
trigger: Log out or delete an account on macOS when the keychain item is locked or the delete is refused
effect: KeychainSecretStore::delete maps Err(_) to Ok(()); the wipe path believes the database key is gone while it stays in the keychain
fix: Return Missing as Ok and map every other status to SecretStoreError::Locked/Platform, as get does.

title: Reply typed in a notification window is lost when the send fails
trigger: Type a reply in Quill's own notification window for the account on screen in a chat that refuses it (no rights, closed topic, channel) and press Enter.
effect: send_inline_reply returns false and sets a silent note that says to open the chat, but the window is unlinked and the Reply click is pushed only when another account is on screen. The text is gone and the chat is not opened.
fix: On a refused send keep the reply open with the text, or push the Reply click so the chat opens; make send_inline_reply return an enum (Sent / NotHere / Refused) instead of bool.

title: Touch Bar observes only the first screen's composer; after an account switch the formatting popover no longer follows the selection
trigger: Install runs once and observes `app.composer` through cx.defer_in. Switch account (replace_screen builds a new OnScreen with a new composer entity). Select text in the composer.
effect: The observation is on the old, dropped entity, so a selection change in the new composer schedules no sync. The bar keeps the picker (or nothing) instead of the Format accessory until some other app notify or window activation happens to sync. Same after switching back (the A->B->A composer is again a new entity).
fix: Re-subscribe per screen: observe the composer from the OnScreen constructor / a screen-scoped hook (spawn_screen / in_screen_scope), or have the composer's selection change notify the app so observe_self covers it.

title: A cancelled or failed Touch Bar drag still saves the new pinned-chat order
trigger: Drag a pinned chat sideways on the Touch Bar past the 10 pt start distance, then let the system cancel the press (the bar is swapped for the lock/recording/player bar, the window loses key, or the recognizer fails).
effect: touch_gesture routes Cancelled/Failed to touch_ended(x, false), but touch_ended runs finish_drag whenever drag.started, ignoring the `ended` flag. The entries are reordered locally and Command::ReorderPinned is sent, so setPinnedChats saves an order the user never dropped.
fix: Make the drag one enum (Idle / Pressed{index,start_x} / Dragging{index,start_x,x}) and give Cancelled its own transition that animates back and sends nothing; only Ended in Dragging commits.

title: deselect_chat returns early on a send error and leaves session.open_chat set after the main window cleared its chat
trigger: Move the open chat to its own window while cancel_outgoing_typing or closeChat fails to send
effect: `?` at lines 122-123 skips leave_open_chat, so the session still treats the chat as shown (chat_is_shown): new messages are auto-viewed/read while the main window shows nothing; draft_clock/pending_draft were not reset
fix: Do the local teardown first (leave_open_chat), then send the TDLib closes best-effort.

title: Story cover editor, privacy editor and composer edit all wait on one unkeyed manage slot, so one call's answer closes another's panel as saved
trigger: In the story viewer, Save the privacy editor of a story (privacy_sent), then before its answer start another management call (Edit story > Save from the composer, or the cover editor's Save) for the same or another story. StoryManageState is one slot: the second start() takes it, so the first call's answer is ignored.
effect: When the second call answers, story_frame_upkeep sees manage.pending false and clears cover_sent, privacy_sent and save_sent together, judging success by the slot-wide manage.error (not error_for(chat, story)): the privacy panel closes as saved though its own answer was never read (it may have failed), or the composer shows the other call's error. fail_locally on another story also releases the waiters with the wrong error.
fix: Each waiter keeps the RequestId it sent (an enum Saving { request } / Editing on the panel), and the upkeep settles it only from the answer to that request; or key StoryManageState by request id instead of one slot.

title: Header menu entries are built for one chat but run on whichever chat is open at click time
trigger: Open the chat header menu (entries built in chat_navigation_menu for chat A), then open chat B (notification click, Alt+Down, link) or switch account while the popup is still showing, and click Report / Auto-Delete / Close Secret Chat / Statistics.
effect: run_header_entry re-reads session.open_chat instead of using the chat_id the entries were computed for, so the action (report box, TTL picker, close-secret-chat confirm, wallet, boost) targets chat B, and with an account switch the old account's entry list runs against the new account.
fields: chat_navigation_menu closure captures `discussion` but not chat_id
fix: Capture ChatId (an AccountChat owner key) and ScreenEpoch in the menu closure and drop the click when session.open_chat != captured.

title: Host::Asked has no way out when the answer never sets the flag
trigger: Open a session-wide box from a chat window whose request fails or is cancelled before the flag is set; later the same kind is opened by a reducer answer nothing asked for.
effect: open_box_in inserts Asked(window); only Shown entries are removed by dialog_closed_in, so the stale Asked pins the box to that window (dialog_may_show_in) instead of the window of the last press; it can show in a window the user is not in.
fix: Expire Asked when its request settles (or on the next frame in which the flag is still clear), or key it by the request that asked.

title: A save while Restore::Opening overwrites the account's saved windows with only the windows open so far
trigger: Quit/relaunch with 3 saved chat windows and 'restore' answered yes; the first restored window renders (view.rs:196 schedules a save on its first render because bounds_seen is None), 600 ms later save_chat_windows_now writes only the open windows; quit (or switch account, close_chat_windows_for_switch) before the other chats have loaded.
effect: The still-waiting windows in Restore::Opening are erased from the file (set_windows_of replaces the account's list), so they never come back on the next launch or when switching back.
fix: Make the saved list the union of open windows and the `waiting` windows of Restore::Opening (or skip saving until restore is Done); give the saver the Restore value as input.

title: A notification waiting for its avatar decode is shown with the lock state it had when queued
trigger: A message arrives from a chat whose avatar is not yet cached; lock Quill (or auto-lock fires) before the background decode ends.
effect: Waiting.locked and the already built notification (sender name and text from for_display) are shown by show_notification_as unchanged after the decode, so the OS toast carries the message text although Quill is locked (privacy).
fix: Re-read the lock when the decode ends and rebuild with for_locked_display, as show_notification_as is the single gate.

title: A hover that never ends pauses the toast forever when its window stops drawing it
trigger: Hover the pointer on a toast, then the passcode lock engages (lock layer draws no toast), the host chat window is hidden/minimized, or the account switches.
effect: Only the rendered toast reports hover end; set_hovered(false) is never sent, so running_since stays None, deadline() is None and every later toast queues behind it (and starts paused via hovered=true) until a click.
fix: Clear hover in the lock/switch path (a Farewell for the toast) or time out hover state per frame.

title: Touch Bar commands are not gated by the passcode lock
trigger: Tap a pinned chat or a sticker (or have a touch already in INBOX) in the ~33 ms between the lock and the throttled sync that empties the bar.
effect: run_touch_bar_command never asks refused_while_locked/lock_waits, so OpenChat opens a chat (and SendSticker sends into the open chat) behind the lock screen; the guard script does not list this entry point either.
fix: Gate run_touch_bar_command on refused_while_locked (drop the command) and list it in scripts/lock-surfaces.txt; empty the bar synchronously in set_locked.

title: 'Code sent to' marker is cleared before the in-flight guard can refuse the request
trigger: A 2FA op is in flight (password_state_loading); user presses Forgot password / sets a login email / retries.
effect: request_twofa_recovery_code (463) and set_login_email (521) set twofa_flow.*_sent_to = None, then password_op_send returns InvalidRequest. The emailed code is still valid but the dialog drops back from the code step to the start step.
fix: Clear the marker in the answer/ack arm (or in a Sending stage) only after the request was accepted.

title: Password sign-in, recovery request and recovery code submit have no in-flight guard
trigger: On the 2FA sign-in screen press Enter/click twice on 'Forgot password?' (or submit on a slow link).
effect: submit_password, request_password_recovery and submit_recovery_code (unlike login_request/submit_phone) never check has_purpose/has_auth_submit; a double click sends two recovery e-mails (2nd answers 429 into last_auth_error), the UI sets recovery_mode before any answer.
fix: Route all three through login_request (one request per purpose) and set recovery_mode only on the answer.

title: review_pending sticks above zero when a send fails partway through several sessions
trigger: Banner shows 2+ unconfirmed sessions; user presses Yes; send_json fails on a session that is not the last (client closing)
effect: review_unconfirmed_sessions sets review_pending = ids.len(), then on a send failure calls finish_login_review once (decrement 1) and returns Err, so the ids never sent are never answered; review_pending stays >0, the banner buttons stay busy and review_unconfirmed_sessions refuses (InvalidRequest) until the session ends
fix: Set review_pending only to the number of requests actually sent (increment per send), or use the Reviewing { remaining } enum and drop unsent ids on failure.

title: Log out from the Account box leaves the typed 2FA password and reason in the box's text fields
trigger: Settings > Account: type the 2FA password (or a reason) in the delete-account section, then press Log out > Log out.
effect: submit_logout clears only confirm_logout and open; the shell then closes the kit dialog with window.close_dialog, which does not run on_close, so close_account_lifecycle (which empties reason and password) never runs. The password stays in the TextareaState until the screen is replaced, against the A2 rule the box documents.
fix: Have submit_logout go through close_account_lifecycle, or make the box's open state an enum whose leaving drops the inputs (Option<LifecycleBox { reason, password, confirm }>).

title: Device-link result that lands after leaving the Devices page shows as a stale notice on the next visit
trigger: Settings > Devices > Link device (scan or paste a tg://login link) > Link device; leave the Devices page before Telegram answers; open Devices again later.
effect: poll_device_qr clears the UI and returns while the page is not Devices without taking session.settings.device_login_result; the next visit shows 'Device linked' / 'couldn't be linked' for the old attempt.
fix: Drop or consume device_login_result when the flow is cleared (clear_device_qr), or key it by the ConfirmDeviceLogin request id held in the UI's link stage.

title: Typing on the lock screen erases the flood-wait message while the button stays disabled
trigger: Enter a wrong passcode until Too many tries appears, then type in the field.
effect: Change takes lock_error, so the message goes while flood_until still disables Unlock; the screen shows a dead button with no reason until the countdown ends.
fix: LockScreenError enum { None, Wrong(text), Flood{until} }; typing clears only Wrong.

title: Auto-lock and Touch ID switches show a new value even when saving it failed
trigger: Turn Touch ID on or pick an auto-lock time while passcode.json cannot be written.
effect: set_autolock_secs and set_system_unlock discard the write error; the UI shows the new setting, the next start uses the old one.
fix: Apply the setting to the UI state only after the write returns Ok, and show an error otherwise.

title: Pending share card file leaks when the screen is replaced before the chat opens
trigger: In the QR box press Share, pick a chat, then switch account (or lose the link's chat open) before the chat opens.
effect: qr_share_chosen closes the box and parks (ChatId, PNG path) in pending_attach. PeerQrUi's Farewell closes only an open box, so the OnScreen swap drops pending_attach and the temp PNG is never removed.
fix: Make Farewell call drop_shared_card too (or give the card file a guard type that deletes on drop).

title: The 2FA dialog's build closure changes twofa.view and confirm while rendering
trigger: A Recover/LoginEmail step finishes (twofa_step_finished) while the box is open.
effect: build_twofa_dialog writes this.twofa.view = Status and confirm = None during the draw without notifying or clearing the flow's input fields and notice; the state changes in the middle of a frame, other parts of the same frame (footer, notice) were already built from the old view.
fix: Move the step to the place the answer is applied (session apply hook) via goto_twofa_view, and keep render pure.

title: A password typed in the Privacy page check card is never cleared when the user leaves
trigger: Privacy page shows the 'Your password' card; type a password without pressing Check, leave the page or close Settings.
effect: close_twofa clears status_check_password but nothing clears check_password (only submit does), so the masked text stays in the field and is back in the card next time the page opens, until an account switch replaces the screen.
fix: Clear check_password in the Privacy page's leave hook (and on close of Settings), as close_twofa does for the box's fields.

title: Deferred web view delete outlives the account slot and can wipe the data of the next sign-in under the same key
trigger: Account-1 logs out while its mini app helper is open (delete waits on helper_gone); the user signs in again as account-1 and opens a mini app; the old helper then exits
effect: remove_dir_all(webview_dir) removes the new session's live web view folder and store-salt.key, so its mini app storage vanishes and the store id changes mid-session
fix: Key the deferred delete by an owner generation (the salt value read at forget time) and delete only if the folder still holds that salt.

title: Active crash report file is shared by every running instance of Quill
trigger: Start a second Quill process on the same logs folder (a second profile run or a second launch) while the first runs, then quit the second cleanly
effect: install() truncates native-crash-active.txt and the second instance's clean quit (discard_active) removes it, so a later crash of the first instance leaves a closed-fd report nobody finds; the first instance's start-up promote_previous can also file the second's report
fix: Name the active file by pid (native-crash-active-<pid>.txt) and promote only files whose pid is dead.

title: Old save answer overwrites served and clears failed of a newer pick
trigger: Save A (serial 1), pick B and close panel (serial 2 fails), answer for serial 1 arrives late
effect: save_answer applies Ok(saved) to served and failed = None even when the ticket serial is not the one in flight, so the failed pick can be sent again
fix: Apply Ok/Err to served/failed only when the ticket serial equals the saving serial; otherwise only update served from the session.

title: Registry read-modify-write is not serialized: two writers lose one update
trigger: add_account on one thread while another thread runs set_active_account/begin_remove_account/set_notify_from_all (each does load_registry, edit, save_registry with no lock held across the three steps)
effect: the second save overwrites the first: a new account or a pending delete silently disappears
fix: One `update_registry(app_root, |&mut AccountRegistry|)` that holds a mutex across load and save; the other functions call it.

title: The accept answer clears a newer updateTermsOfService that arrived while accepting
trigger: Accept terms A; before the ok answer, the server pushes updateTermsOfService for terms B
effect: session_apply_ok sets terms=None on any AcceptTermsOfService ok, so B is dropped and the user is never asked for it this session
fix: Accepting { id } and clear terms only when the current terms id equals the one accepted.

title: One 2FA op's answer or error clears the shared in-flight flag while another op is still in flight
trigger: Start getPasswordState then quickly a setPassword/resend; first one answers
effect: password_state_loading becomes false while the second request is pending; the overlay re-enables submits and a late error overwrites password_op_error
fix: Track in-flight request ids (Vec<RequestId>) and clear loading only when empty; or one Fetch per op

title: recovery_mode is set when the recovery request is sent, before the server accepts it
trigger: On the 2FA password step press Forgot password? and the server refuses (too many requests).
effect: The screen switches to recovery-code entry and says the code was sent. The error arrives later as last_auth_error; the user waits for an email that never comes (Resend and Back are the only ways out).
fix: Make the password step an enum PasswordStep { Password, RecoveryRequested { request }, RecoveryCode } and move to RecoveryCode on the answer.

title: Terms prompt state outlives the terms it was about
trigger: Tick the age box and Agree (or leave the prompt at DeclineSorry or DeleteWarning by closing it some other way). A later terms update arrives in the same session.
effect: terms_age_ok stays true and terms_step stays where it was, so the new terms open with the age already confirmed (or on the sorry/delete step) and Agree skips the age check.
fix: Own the prompt state in an Option created when notices.terms becomes Some and dropped when it becomes None.

title: 'Waiting for Telegram to link the device' notice has no exit if the answer is consumed off the Devices page
trigger: Confirm a scanned device, then leave Settings > Devices before the answer lands, return later
effect: poll_device_qr returns early (clear_device_qr) while the page is not Devices, leaving device_login_result in the session; on return the stale Linked/Failed result shows as a fresh notice, and if the answer never lands the Waiting notice sticks until the page is left
fix: Make the Waiting stage of the DeviceLink enum leave on the answer regardless of page, and clear a stale result on leave_devices.

title: Terms box step and age checkbox are never reset, so a later terms prompt opens pre-ticked or on the Decline step
trigger: Tick 'I confirm that I am N or older' and Agree (or go to Decline > Back is not pressed, e.g. Decline then the terms are cleared); later in the same run TDLib sends a new updateTermsOfService.
effect: AuthUi::terms_age_ok stays true and terms_step keeps its old value (only AuthUi::new sets them): the new terms show the age box already ticked, or open on the 'sorry'/delete warning step.
fix: Keep the box's step and age answer in one `TermsBox { terms_id, step, age_ok }` value created when a terms id first shows, so a new id starts a fresh value.

title: Lock leaves the media panel on its GIFs tab, so the GIF gate stays open under the lock
trigger: Open the GIFs tab of the composer panel, lock Quill with the passcode.
effect: close_for_lock never closes the media panel; the panel is only hidden, so wanted stays true and gifs.open stays set; the GIF search/download work continues while locked.
fix: Derive the GIF gate from what is drawn (not locked and panel on Gifs), or close the gate in close_for_lock.

title: Lock-screen Log out while a system unlock prompt is pending is later undone by the prompt's answer
trigger: Press Touch ID / system unlock, and while the OS prompt is open confirm Log out.
effect: The wipe starts and the lock lifts, then the prompt answers ok: global_unlock().set(master) and unlock_done run again for wiped accounts (second resume_after_unlock, intents, connection start).
fix: Log out sets PasscodeJob::Cancelled (or drops the receiver wait) so system_unlock_wait ignores a late answer.

title: QR card draws another link's code when the new code is not ready or failed
trigger: In your own box reset the free code or let a temporary link expire so the link changes.
effect: qr_code_image falls back to the newest ready code of any link when the wanted key is Loading or Failed, so a Failed slot keeps the previous link's code on the card while Copy/Share use the new link.
fix: Return None for a Failed slot (draw no code) and fall back only while the wanted key is Loading.

title: Copy does nothing, with no toast, when the box changed during the render
trigger: On macOS or Windows press Copy, then pick another color before the image finishes.
effect: The continuation computes current = same_box && qr_image_current(..); when the appearance differs it returns false without a toast and done ignores the PNG, so the click is lost.
fix: Re-run the export for the new appearance, or toast 'try again'.

title: Any share chooser's pick or cancel closes or strips an open QR box
trigger: Open a QR box in the main window, then in a chat window use a group link row's Share and pick a chat (or cancel).
effect: choose_share_chat and cancel_share_link call qr_share_chosen/qr_share_cancelled unconditionally; qr_share_chosen closes whichever QR box is open and qr_share_cancelled deletes its share_image, although the chooser was not opened by it.
fix: Remember in the box which chooser it opened (enum Share { None, Chooser{window} }) and act only for that one.

title: sessions_layer_open reads session_details while the dialog is open only when details_session() resolves
trigger: Open a session's box, terminate that session from another device so it leaves the list
effect: The box closes (is_open false) but session_details and renaming_device stay set, so the first Esc on the Devices page is swallowed closing an invisible layer
fix: Drop session_details when its session leaves the list, or derive sessions_layer_open from details_session().

title: The PIN asked for one key is tried on every plugged-in key in turn
trigger: Plug in two FIDO2 keys with different PINs, sign in with a passkey that lives on the second key, enter its PIN.
effect: run_login asks for the PIN when key B says PIN_REQUIRED, then the next round starts again at key A with B's PIN; A answers PIN_INVALID, the user is told 'Incorrect PIN' and A's retry counter drops (eventually blocking A). The PIN is not matched to the key that asked.
fix: Carry the key that asked for the PIN (device path/index) with the PIN and try it only on that key in the next attempt.

title: A security key Quill may not open (no udev rule) reads as 'no key' after the whole timeout
trigger: On Linux without the u2f udev rule, plug in a security key and choose 'Use a security key' / start a passkey ceremony.
effect: open_all logs 'cannot open /dev/hidrawN' every 500 ms poll and returns nothing; Link::devices waits until the request deadline (60 s) and the dialog then says no security key was found, never that access was denied.
fix: Return the open error from open_all (an enum Found { Keys(..), Denied(path) }) and end the ceremony with a permission error the dialog can show.

title: copy_new leaves an empty or partial file at the destination when the copy fails
trigger: download_file with a 'to' folder; the cached source file was evicted or the disk fills after create_new succeeded.
effect: The create_new file stays behind (empty or cut short) and the next try writes 'name (2)'; the agent is told the copy failed but a broken file sits in the user's folder.
fix: Copy to a temp name in the destination folder and rename it into place, removing it on any error.

title: td_call asks the user to Allow a send that is then refused for a reason known beforehand
trigger: An agent td_calls a money-class send (sendMessage with paid content) into a bot the user never talked to, or with no chat_id.
effect: The user is shown a prompt and clicks Allow; only afterwards grants.writable() refuses (stranger bot / no chat_id), so the click had no effect.
fix: Run grants.writable(first_chat) before ask_user for methods in SENDS.

title: The composer-clear command after an agent UI send is fire and forget
trigger: Two agents keep the bridge queue full (8 waiting) while one send finishes; bridge::post returns Busy and the result is discarded with let _
effect: The message was sent but the composer still holds the text, so the user's next Enter sends it again
fix: Hand the send and its clear over as one UiSend stage (Sent) that the UI acknowledges, or retry the post and report failure in the tool answer.

title: A screenshot is reserved against the rate limits before the command runs and not given back when the command fails
trigger: Agent calls click_element with screenshot true while the driver is Busy, times out, or the UI refuses (hidden window, blocked surface)
effect: The reservation is spent, so the retry or the next take_screenshot is refused as rate limited for a second, and 20 failed tries lock screenshots for a minute
fix: Reserve only when the UI reports it will take the picture, or release the reservation on Err/Refused.

title: Every error from getMessage is reported as 'There is no message'; and a failed re-read after a successful edit reports the edit as failed
trigger: Network or TDLib error on getMessage (flood, timeout) during react/pin/delete, or the re-read at the end of edit_message fails after editMessageText succeeded
effect: The agent is told the message does not exist (or the edit failed) and may retry or give up wrongly
fix: Separate NotFound from other TdError; after a successful edit fall back to the request data.

title: Screenshot rate-limit slot is spent before the screenshot is taken
trigger: An agent calls take_screenshot (or an input tool with screenshot:true) while the window is hidden, the surface is blocked, or the user is dragging; the command is refused.
effect: reserve() already counted it, so the agent's immediate retry gets 'try again in N s' and 20 refused attempts exhaust the minute budget with no screenshot taken.
fix: Reserve when the capture is about to run (or release the slot on refusal) instead of at the tool entry.

title: Request written to a link whose relay already drained pending is never answered
trigger: Quill closes the socket (access turned off) at the moment an agent sends tools/call: forward() saw alive=true, relay() then sets alive=false and drains pending, forward() inserts the id afterwards and the write to the dying socket still succeeds
effect: The agent's request hangs with no answer or error until the agent times out
fix: Insert into pending and check the Dead transition under one lock (pending: Mutex<Pending::{Open(map),Dead}>), and answer at once when Dead.

title: Agent requests of a closed client wait the full timeout instead of ending
trigger: An agent runs download_file or a slow read; meanwhile the user logs out or removes that account (client route closes).
effect: The waiter stays in PENDING with nothing to wake it: the agent thread blocks for 30 s (300 s for downloads) and then reports 'no answer from Telegram, check the connection' instead of 'signed out'.
fix: When a client's route closes, drain its PENDING entries (key them by client id) and answer TdError::Send.

title: AGENT thread-local keeps the last agent's name after the call ends
trigger: Agent A's call finishes on a pooled thread; code that runs later on that thread outside a call (a prompt, an activity row) calls current_agent().
effect: It names agent A instead of 'An agent'. Today every caller is inside a call, so only a future caller is hit.
fix: Clear AGENT in CallScope::drop, or pass the agent name in Ctx.

title: wait_for_message remembers a failed grant lookup as 'not granted' for the whole wait
trigger: wait_for_message with no chat; a first message from chat X arrives while getUser/getSupergroup times out, so granted() errs. More messages from X arrive in the next minutes.
effect: The error is cached as false in `checked` (and in `known` for the unread watcher), so every later message of X is dropped for the rest of the wait and the agent sees 'No new message'.
fix: Cache only Ok answers; on Err leave the chat unknown and ask again for the next message.

title: Offset tokens are global: not bound to the account, agent or method that got them
trigger: Agent A gets next_offset token 5 from searchMessages on account X. Agent B (or a td_call on account Y) passes quill-offset:5 as offset.
effect: The real offset (date,chat_id,message_id) of A's answer is substituted into B's request. Answers still pass the grant redaction, so only odd paging results, not a leak.
fix: Store (account, method, offset) with the token and refuse it for another account or method.

title: mute_chat writes back the full notification settings read earlier
trigger: User changes the chat's sound or preview settings between the agent's getChat and setChatNotificationSettings
effect: The user's change is overwritten with the old values
fix: Read and write in one turn; only change mute_for.

title: Folder add/remove edits the lists without checking pinned and excluded rules
trigger: remove: true on a chat that is only in included_chat_ids adds it to excluded_chat_ids (burning the folder's limit); add on a chat that is in pinned_chat_ids pushes it into included_chat_ids too
effect: TDLib refuses with CHATLIST_INCLUDE_INVALID, which the tool reports as 'Folder is full'
fix: Model membership as an enum (Pinned/Included/Excluded/None) and compute the lists from it; map the error truthfully.

title: UiSend names the chat by a bare id, not the account's chat
trigger: The user switches account in the window between the UI answering the click on Send and the tool thread running finish_ui_send (Ctx::active is read afterwards)
effect: granted() runs against the new account with the old account's chat id; if that id exists there (same user id for a private chat) the text goes to that chat from the wrong account
fix: Put an AccountChat owner key in UiSend and refuse in finish_ui_send when Ctx::active is another account.

title: Failed screen-pause toggle is never retried and shows a generic voice chat error
trigger: Share a window in a group call, hide it (pause edge), toggleGroupCallScreenSharingIsPaused fails
effect: set_screen_paused already stored active.paused/call.screen_share_paused; the request uses the ToggleGroupCallVideo purpose so the error arm only sets group_call_error 'Voice chat request failed'; later pumps see no edge, so the server keeps showing the share unpaused
fix: Own purpose for the pause toggle whose error arm reverts the flag, or resend while server and local state differ.

title: send_call_log has no in-flight guard and does blocking file IO on the UI thread; stale log file left
trigger: Click 'upload call log' twice quickly
effect: Two sendCallLog requests are sent (log_sent only becomes true on ok) and call-<id>.log is written synchronously under exports each time
fix: CallLog stage enum (Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed) checked before the write.

title: Deleting live story comments removes them locally at once with no restore when deleteGroupCallMessages errors
trigger: Delete a comment (or all from a sender) and the request fails
effect: Comments vanish until the call is rejoined although they still exist
fix: Mark messages Deleting(request) and drop them on ok, restore on error.

title: join_as_requested is set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never reset on error
trigger: Open an unjoined video chat while the join-as request fails
effect: maybe_fetch_join_as sets join_as_requested=true first (connect/group_calls/join.rs:223); on a send or server error it stays true, so the Join as picker is never offered for this tracked call
fix: join_as: Fetch<Vec<MessageSender>> reset to Idle on error (or Failed) per group_call_id.

title: A failed later page hides every loaded call and Retry restarts from page one
trigger: Open Calls, scroll so page 2 fails.
effect: calls_list shows only Couldn't load plus Retry although entries are loaded; Retry calls fetch_call_history, which clears the list and scroll position.
fix: Model the list as Fetch<Page> with a failed-next-page variant that keeps entries and retries the next offset.

title: Stream window is closed and marked user-closed before the PiP exists
trigger: Press PiP in the stream window when the PiP window fails to open (Q_MEDIA_PIP_FAILED path).
effect: open_stream_pip sets window_closed_by_user=Some(call_id), drops stream_join and overlay and removes the stream window synchronously; the deferred open then fails, so the call has no window until the user finds the call bar.
fix: Close the stream window from the open success arm (or restore window_closed_by_user on failure).

title: submit_call_rating discards the rating draft before the send succeeds
trigger: Fill stars, problems and a comment in the rating editor and press Submit while send_call_rating returns Err.
effect: rating_detail is take()n first; on Err only a note is set, the editor reverts to the bare star buttons and the typed comment and problems are gone.
fix: Take the draft only after the send is accepted, or put it back on Err.

title: dialing ticket is separate from the permission wait and stays Some on refusal
trigger: On macOS deny the microphone prompt when pressing Call.
effect: dial_user sets call_boxes.dialing before with_capture_access; only dial_allowed takes it. A refusal or a dropped continuation leaves it Some until the next dial or a switch. Two Call presses during one prompt share the single ticket, so the second silently does nothing.
fix: Put the ticket in the permission-ask enum (see with_device_access) so the refusal and the drop clear it.

title: Schedule box keeps its 'out of range' error after a valid time is picked
trigger: Open 'Schedule video chat', pick a time less than the minimum ahead, press Schedule (error shows), then pick a valid time.
effect: ScheduleStep::error is cleared only by the next Schedule press; the red error stays under a valid pick.
fix: Derive the error from the picked value at render (check_schedule) instead of storing it, or clear it on picker change.

title: Share Invite Link asks for the links and opens the box under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock Quill with a joined video chat (call windows stay usable), press Share in the call window menu or the invite row.
effect: group_call_needs_unlock only raises the main window and its result is ignored: the links request is sent and share_open is set while locked; the box appears at the unlock without being asked again. Other call-window openers refuse with refused_while_locked.
fix: Check refused_while_locked (or queue an unlock intent) in open_group_call_share_links before the request, and return when group_call_needs_unlock is true.

title: In-call chat visibility and per-participant level animations outlive the call
trigger: Open the in-call chat (Show chat) in a video chat, leave, join another video chat. For levels: a participant sounds then leaves.
effect: chat_shown is never reset (only toggled and initialised), so the next call's window opens with the chat section already shown. row_levels entries are removed only when that row is built again, so a leaver's entry stays for the process and an audio_source_id reused by a later call starts from a stale animation.
fix: Move per-call UI into one CallView value created when a call is tracked and dropped when it ends (sync_group_call_boxes already knows the call id).

title: Stream Key stays revealed after the Settings box is left by Share or Leave, so the next Settings shows it without the warning
trigger: Manager opens the live stream window, Settings, Show key and accepts the warning (key_shown = true), then taps Share (line 294 sets overlay = None directly) or confirms Leave (line 491). Later reopens Settings in the same call.
effect: The RTMP stream key is drawn in clear without going through the KeyWarning box again; only close_stream_overlay and StreamWindow::clear reset key_shown.
fix: Make the key reveal part of the overlay enum (StreamOverlay::Settings { key_shown }) so every path that drops the overlay drops the reveal, instead of two fields reset by hand in two of the exits.

title: Portal fd is converted to a raw fd before pw_context_connect_fd can fail
trigger: Start a Wayland screen share where pw_context_connect_fd returns null.
effect: fd.into_raw_fd() hands ownership away before the call, so on failure the descriptor is neither closed by PipeWire nor by Rust and leaks for the process lifetime.
fix: Keep the OwnedFd until the call succeeds (pass as_raw_fd/dup, forget it only on success).

title: The window monitor reports Ended without marking the stream stopped, unlike Windows
trigger: Share a window on macOS, then close that window
effect: Monitor pushes Ended and exits but StreamShared.stopped stays false, so frames keep flowing until the consumer stops and the SCStream delegate may push a second Ended
fix: Have the monitor end through a shared end() that swaps stopped once, as screen_win does.

title: An empty stream list overwrites the terminal Ended and Failed feeder states with NoStream
trigger: RTMP watch: a part reply returns GROUPCALL_INVALID (state Ended, Left outcome) while a getGroupCallStreams request is still in flight; that request then answers an empty list.
effect: on_streams_reply sets state=NoStream unconditionally, so stream_state() flips from Ended to NoStream and the watcher sees 'nobody is broadcasting' instead of the ended stream (live_feeds maps Ended to LiveEnd::Over). Same overwrite of Failed before the rejoin replaces the feeder.
fix: Make Ended and Failed terminal in one transition function (state.on_streams_empty() returns the same state for terminal variants), and drop streams_request when entering them.

title: If the reaper thread failed to spawn or died, hand_off runs the destroy inline on the caller (UI) thread
trigger: Thread creation fails at start (spawn_guarded error is ignored with let _) or the receiver is gone; then hang up or switch calls while tgcalls teardown is slow
effect: qc_p2p_destroy / qc_group_destroy wait on tgcalls with no time limit, so the UI thread freezes (the reaper exists to prevent exactly this)
fix: Make Reaper::start return Result and fail engine load, or leak/park the job instead of running it inline.

title: Late hook thread of a timed-out start overwrites the live hook's global CONTEXT
trigger: Start of hook A takes over 2 s (start returns Failed, failed_for set); the user presses 'Check again' and hook B starts and installs CONTEXT; thread A then runs run_hook and replaces CONTEXT with its own (active already false), unhooks and clear_context removes it.
effect: Hook B is Active but its on_key finds CONTEXT empty: push-to-talk never fires while Settings says it works.
fix: Key the context per hook (hook thread owns its context via a thread-local or a map by hook id) instead of one global slot.

title: X11 keycodes for the key are captured once at start
trigger: Start push-to-talk with key 't' on layout A, then switch keyboard layout/remap so 't' is on another keycode.
effect: The hook keeps listening to the old keycode, so the configured key no longer triggers push-to-talk until the call is rejoined or the key setting changes.
fix: Re-resolve keycodes on MappingNotify or when the layout changes, or restart the hook.

title: One generating bool covers two independent link requests
trigger: Admin clicks Share Invite Link; the listener request fails while the speaker request is in flight (or the speaker send fails in request_video_chat_share_links, which then forces generating=false); click again.
effect: generating is false though a request is still in flight, so plan() sends the speaker request again (wanted.speaker = speaker.is_none()); duplicate requests, and a late answer from the first. After a revoke reset (session_apply_ok.rs:385) in-flight old answers are also stored as the new links.
fix: Per-link Fetch<String> for listener and speaker; ready/generating derived; reset drops in-flight answers by generation.

title: SpeakerLevels keeps an ssrc forever when told_speaking is true and the driver stops accepting it
trigger: A participant is speaking (TDLib told speaking=true), then leaves the call so tell(ssrc) returns false.
effect: expire() retains the entry because told_speaking is true and speaking_changes never reports the stop; the entry lives until the levels are reset with the call (levels.rs:134). Small leak, no visible effect.
fix: Drop entries on participant removal, or make expire ignore told_speaking when tell() refuses the ssrc.

title: AddPending error rolls pending stars back but not committed_stars after a commit already took the reaction
trigger: Tap Stars, window elapses and commit goes out, then the earlier addPending answers with an error
effect: pending is None so nothing is subtracted; committed_stars and the flying-stars effect stay as if sent
fix: Pending reaction as an enum of Adding/Held/Committing with each answer matched to its stage.

title: Undo drops the local pending Stars before removePendingLiveStoryReactions is sent
trigger: Tap Undo while the send fails
effect: Local pending reaction is gone but TDLib still holds the pending Stars and the toast says they were dropped
fix: Keep pending_reaction as Undoing(request) until ok.

title: Failed group camera/mute engine calls are re-issued on every poll for the life of the call
trigger: Engine set_group_camera or set_group_muted keeps failing (device unplugged)
effect: pump_connected_group_calls retries each poll; only transport_error is rate-limited, so the engine is hit and the UI woken repeatedly
fix: Record a Failed(wanted) value in the per-call state and retry only on a change of wanted or a device list change.

title: An unwanted Rejoin offer is dropped without attempt_unsent, leaving rejoin InFlight on a request that is no longer pending
trigger: Rejoin offer is waiting for the payload while left_group_call is set for it or chats_path_active turns false
effect: GroupCallRejoin stays InFlight; maybe_auto_rejoin never restarts it (rejoin_tracked returns the dead request id unless manual), only the manual Rejoin button recovers
fix: finish_offer's unwanted branch must call undo_offer for every OfferSend, or Rejoin::InFlight must be validated against requests.

title: An unwanted Screen offer leaves screen_share_pending true with no offer or request behind it
trigger: Screen share offer lands after the call stopped being joined or chats_path_active turned false
effect: UI shows share starting until the user presses the toggle again (the toggle's pending branch recovers)
fix: Same fix as the rejoin offer: undo_offer on every unwanted branch.

title: no_chat holds one call id; a second call opened before its chat loads overwrites the first
trigger: Open two calls from links before their chats are known (call + live story)
effect: The first call is never moved to its chat key and its stream feeder never starts
fix: HashSet/Vec of call ids waiting for a chat.

title: Call log and diagnostics answers are applied to whichever summary is current, not the call that asked
trigger: Finish call A with need_log, start upload, end call B quickly before the answer
effect: SendCallLog ok sets log_sent=true (session_apply_ok.rs:523) and SendCallDebugInformation error sets the error on the new summary of call B; B's own upload prompt disappears or shows A's error. RequestPurpose has no call id
fix: Carry call_id in the purposes and apply only when summary.call_id matches.

title: failed_creates grows when no UI drains it (background account)
trigger: createVideoChat is refused on an account that is not on screen
effect: The request id stays in CallsState::failed_creates until the UI shows it; a switch back shows an old failure
fix: Drop on a timer or hold the failure in the create_join_as/start stage value

title: A terminal update of an untracked call replaces the pending end-screen summary
trigger: End a call and leave the rating/end card open; a missed call from someone else ends (terminal update, no active call).
effect: calls.summary is overwritten with Missed call, so the card of the call being rated and its log upload state are lost.
fix: Keep summaries as a queue or keyed by call id, and replace only for the same id.

title: The own-mute guard treats any participant's mute toggle in flight as the user's own
trigger: In a video chat as admin, mute another participant (ToggleGroupCallParticipantMute for the call is in flight), then unmute yourself elsewhere; an own-row update arrives.
effect: The own-row update is ignored while the other participant's request is in flight, so the mute button can show a stale state until the next update.
fix: Key the in-flight check by (call, participant) and compare against the own sender.

title: A one-shot cue cuts a ringing loop which the next tick restarts
trigger: While a second call rings in during a call (loop Incoming), toggle mute.
effect: play(Mute) clears looping/hold and stops the ring; the next sync (up to 1 s) restarts the ring from the start, so the cue is cut and the ring restarts out of phase.
fix: Let a cue play on top of the loop or resume the loop without resetting its phase.

title: card_window (where a failed start or the rating shows) is never reset except by answer_call
trigger: Press Call in chat window X, finish the call. Later answer an incoming call through the call window swap card, the lock card or a background ring (none reset card_window), then end it while X is still open.
effect: The failed-start card or the rating card of the incoming call appears over chat window X, not the main window.
fix: Make the card window part of the call (ActiveCall/CallSummary owner) or reset it when a call is tracked from any source.

title: A failed PiP open clears whatever link is current
trigger: Open a live PiP for source X, then (same frame) another for Y; X's deferred open fails.
effect: The (_, None) arm sets group_call.live_pip=None without checking that the link still is X's pending one: Y's link is dropped and its window closes when it opens, with an error note for X.
fix: Handle the failure only when the pending link matches source (as the success arm does); otherwise ignore.

title: live_pip_source_alive ignores the link's account
trigger: Play a stream PiP on account A, switch to account B which is in a group call with the same call id (same voice chat joined by both accounts).
effect: check_live_pip only compares call_id with B's active_group_call, so the PiP of A's stream stays open for B; only Enlarge compares link.account.
fix: Compare link.account with the account on screen in check_live_pip or key the source by (AccountKey, call_id).

title: VolumePill is four held bools plus closes_at; leave/Release events can be lost
trigger: Start dragging the live story volume slider, then the stream ends (slider slot set to None) or the viewer closes while the pointer is over the pill; reopen a live story.
effect: dragging/toggle/pill/keyboard are set by events on elements that can vanish before the matching leave or Release arrives (stream_volume_slider clears the slot, LiveStoryUi outlives the viewer). The pill then reads held() and stays open for the next live story.
fix: Reset volume_pill when the slider slot is cleared and when the story viewer is released, or derive 'held' from a single PillState enum.

title: The invisible Waiting step drains only in the window that asked; a minimized asking chat window strands it
trigger: In a chat window's header press 'Start video chat' and minimize that window before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants answers.
effect: CreateStep::Waiting is not drawn (is_open false) and its answer is applied only by the asking window's frame upkeep; with that window not drawing, nothing shows and no feedback until the window comes back. Pressing Start again replaces the flow, so it recovers.
fix: Apply the join-as answer in the session-wide poll (matched by the RequestId already in Waiting) and only open the box in the asking window.

title: Starting a video chat leaves the current call before the create request is sent
trigger: In a video chat, start another one in a different chat and confirm the leave box while createVideoChat cannot be sent (driver Err, e.g. connection closed).
effect: send_group_call_create calls end_current_call_for_create first, then start_video_chat().ok(); on Err the user only gets a server-error toast and is out of their original call with no new one. Same order in start_rtmp_stream_now (rtmp_stream.rs:363-373).
fix: Send first and end the old call from the accepted-request path (or when the new call is tracked), a CreateStep::Sending(RequestId) carrying the intent.

title: Sharing a call link to a chat overwrites a pending deep-link open
trigger: A deep link is waiting in links.pending_deep_link_open (for example queued while an earlier open is in progress), then the user picks a chat under Share to.
effect: The single Option slot is replaced; the earlier link action is lost without a note.
fix: Queue opens (Vec/VecDeque of PendingOpen) or refuse the share while one is pending.

title: A stream join wish for a call that never gets tracked lingers and can join much later
trigger: Tap a stream link or the chat's video chat button (note_stream_join_intent records Call(id) with tracked_then = None); the call is never tracked (request fails or the user waits). Later, with no other call tracked, the same call is tracked from another entry (e.g. a link to the same call).
effect: consume_stream_join_intent finds the matching intent and joins immediately although the user only meant to look; the wish has no timeout or cancel except close_group_call_window and a different call being tracked.
fix: Give the Wanted stage a deadline (manual clock) or clear it when the request that fetches the call fails.

title: Blurred stream photo is kept after the chat loses its photo
trigger: During a live stream the channel photo is removed (chat_photo_path returns None).
effect: group_call_stream_photo returns at the first ? without clearing StreamWindow::photo, so the picture view keeps the old chat's blurred photo behind the label until the call ends.
fix: When the chat has no photo path, drop the cached photo (and its task) in the same place.

title: In-call composer text survives a change of call within the account
trigger: Type a message in call A's chat, leave A, join call B in the same account; the unsent text is still in the box and Send posts it to B
effect: A draft written for one call is sent to another; sync_group_call_boxes resets the rename box, invite, share and pin but not the composer
fix: Clear the composer in the same branch of sync_group_call_boxes that resets other per-call state (before != id).

title: A join intent noted before fetch_group_call is not cleared when the fetch fails
trigger: Press the voice chat button, fetch_group_call returns Err (note says could not reach); later join that same call another way
effect: stream_join stays set until a call is tracked, then the window auto-joins the stream the user gave up on
fix: Note the intent only after the send succeeded, or clear it in the Err arm.

title: Rename box is closed before the rename is sent, so a failed send loses the typed title
trigger: Open Rename voice chat, type a title, Save while set_video_chat_title returns Err or there is no live client
effect: Box closes with an error note; the typed title is gone and must be retyped
fix: Take the dialog out only on Ok; put it back on Err (as restrict/permissions boxes do).

title: Folder share error is not matched to the folder or request that failed
trigger: Share Folder dialog open for folder A while a link request for folder B (or a recommended-folders fetch) fails
effect: The error text shows in A's dialog; the dialog for the failed request sees nothing
fix: Carry the folder id (or request id) in the error and show it only to the dialog for that folder.

title: chat_action_error is one slot overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two chat-list actions (pin, mark unread) fail before the UI drains the note
effect: Only the last error is shown; the first is lost
fix: Queue of notes instead of Option<String>.

title: RowFxMap (online-dot and badge animation state) is app-wide, keyed by bare chat id, never reset on an account switch and never pruned
trigger: Account A shows a private chat (id = peer's user id) online with a badge; switch to account B whose chat with the same peer has a different online/badge state
effect: The row animates the dot/badge from A's state (a spurious grow-in/shrink and animation ticks) instead of snapping on first sight; the map also grows with every chat ever drawn
fix: Move row_fx into ChatListUi (OnScreen, replaced on a switch) or key it by AccountChat.

title: Contacts Retry that fails to send leaves 'Loading contacts...' with nothing in flight
trigger: Contacts tab shows 'Couldn't load contacts'; the connection bridge is dead or the send fails; press Retry
effect: fetch_contacts clears contacts_error before send_json; on a send error it returns Err without setting it again, retry_contacts only toasts, so the list (contacts None, error false) reads as loading and nothing is in flight until a later contact change calls refetch_open_contacts (set_contact_sync has the same path)
fix: Make the contacts list a Fetch<Vec<..>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) set to failed by the send error in one place.

title: Sync contacts switch stays flipped when saving contacts_prefs.json fails
trigger: Settings > Contacts > toggle Sync contacts while the data folder is not writable.
effect: An error toast shows, but the in-memory pref (and the switch) stays at the new value. After a restart it is back to the old value.
fix: Save first and apply the new value only on success, or roll the in-memory value back on error.

title: Import-contacts read token `pick` restarts at 0 with every new box, so a read from a closed box can land in the next one
trigger: Open Import contacts, choose a large .vcf (read starts, pick=1), close the box, reopen it and choose another file (pick=1 again) before the first read ends
effect: The first file's contacts replace the 'Reading...' state of the second choice and Import is enabled for the wrong file until the second read lands; the picker answer in choose_vcard_file is also applied to whichever box is open when it returns
fix: Make the token process-wide (a counter on the app, or a ScreenEpoch-style id kept outside the dialog) or key the read by a box id that is never reused.

title: Copied check mark on a folder invite link never reverts
trigger: Share Folder, copy a link. The copy button keeps the copied icon until the dialog closes or another link is copied.
effect: Stale 'copied' state; no clock reverts it.
fix: Store copied as Option<(link, Instant)> reverted by a spawn_screen timer, or an enum Copy { Idle, Copied(link) } cleared by a manual clock.

title: Shared-folder join dialog keeps stale selected ids and can join chats no longer offered
trigger: Open the 'N new chats' dialog, then the list changes (chat joined elsewhere, bar dismissed by poll) while it is open
effect: Dialog shows an empty list yet 'Join N' stays enabled from the stale set and sends removed ids to processChatFolderNewChats
fix: Intersect selected with folder_new_chats at confirm and render (or close the dialog when the offer is gone).

title: A folder limit hit is not matched to the request that hit it: it clears busy/adding on whichever box is open and guesses the window
trigger: With a Share Folder link save in flight, create a folder from Settings that hits the folder limit (or vice versa).
effect: drain_folder_limit takes the session-wide folder_limit_hit and clears FolderShareDialog::busy and FolderInviteDialog::adding unconditionally, re-enabling Save/Add while their own requests are still in flight; the limit box goes to the window of whichever of invite/share/editor is open, not the one whose request failed.
fix: Carry the asking request id (or FolderOp + dialog) in folder_limit_hit and leave only that dialog's in-flight stage.

title: Add-folder box: seeded + adding bools plus session info/error/done one-shots kept in step by hand
trigger: Click Add in the add-folder box; the add's answer is lost (request dropped on a reconnect) or an error lands and the user retries.
effect: adding is cleared only when folder_invite_error is Some (or a limit hit); a dropped answer leaves the button spinning and disabled until the box is closed. Stages live across FolderInviteDialog::{seeded,adding} and ChatListState::{folder_invite_info,folder_invite_error,folder_invite_done}.
fix: One FolderInviteStage enum on the dialog (see the checking finding); every stage, Adding included, is left by the matching answer, error or close.

title: Delete-folder box has no loading stage for the chats-to-leave list
trigger: Delete a shared folder and click Delete before getChatFolderChatsToLeave answers.
effect: The box shows the plain 'Delete' text as if there were nothing to leave; confirm_folder_delete reads whatever is in the session at click time, so an early click deletes the folder without offering to leave its chats.
fix: Give FolderDeleteConfirm a Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the suggestions (shared folders only) and disable the confirm while Loading.

title: Deleting a folder that fails still moves the chat list off that folder tab
trigger: Delete the folder you are viewing while deleteChatFolder cannot be sent.
effect: confirm_folder_delete takes delete_confirm, and resets folders.tab to All even in the Err arm; the folder still exists, an error note is shown.
fix: Reset the tab only when the delete is confirmed by updateChatFolders.

title: Chat media counts: entry is inserted before six requests; a failed filter leaves a zero count forever
trigger: Open the info panel; one getChatMessageCount fails
effect: chat_media_counts[chat] is inserted as default and never re-asked ('once per chat per session'); the failing filter shows 0
fix: Per-filter Fetch<i32> that retries on reopen.

title: set_search_filters with an empty query changes the tab but keeps the generation and results, so an in-flight answer of the old tab still applies
trigger: Open search on Chats (recents request in flight), switch to Channels or Posts with an empty field.
effect: The Recent chats list lands under the new tab and the panel reads Ready.
fix: Bump the generation and clear results whenever filters change.

title: select_search_chat_open closes search without clearing the typing debounce, so a pending commit fires into a closed search
trigger: Type a query and pick a recent chat or hit inside the debounce window.
effect: commit_debounced_search later sends searchChats/searchMessages/searchPublicChats for a closed search; wasted requests and results into hidden state.
fix: Make Session::close_search (or a ConnectDriver wrapper) always clear the debounce.

title: Public-post search limits are applied without tying them to the query or search generation
trigger: Type query A, then B in Public posts; limits for A answer last
effect: tabs.limits (including current_query_free and star_count) comes from any GetPublicPostSearchLimits answer (lines 100-108) while every message answer is matched by generation; the paid-search gate search_public_posts_paid (connect/search/tabs.rs:140) reads the price from it and the UI shows free/paid for the wrong query
fix: Carry the generation in the limits request and drop answers of an older generation.

title: An unparsable last message in updateChatLastMessage becomes 'no last message'
trigger: Receive a new message whose JSON parse_message rejects in any chat.
effect: parse_message(..).ok() turns the failure into last_message: None, which the reducer applies as the chat having no last message: the row's preview and date go blank until another message arrives.
fix: Distinguish 'null' from 'failed to parse' (Result or a separate variant) and keep the old preview on a parse failure.

title: 'Hide new chats?' box reopens after Cancel/Esc when hideSuggestedAction cannot be sent
trigger: The suggestion box is up while the client is not on the chats path (auth not Ready or shutdown started, e.g. during a log-out/close); press Cancel or Esc
effect: hide_suggested_action returns Err before removing the action locally, so archive_mute_suggested() stays true: the shell reopens the box and every close adds another 'could not hide' error toast
fix: Remove the action locally (or record a per-account 'dismissed' value) regardless of the send result, so the box's open state does not depend on the request succeeding.

title: Cached drag classification is reused for the next drag with the same paths
trigger: Drag a file over the list, cancel, change what the path holds (empty the folder, delete the file), drag the same path again.
effect: same_paths() sees equal paths so fresh is None and the old DragState is kept; the row lights up (or refuses) by the old probe and drop_on_row attaches by the old kind (Folder vs Files).
fix: Clear paths/drag when the drag ends or leaves (drag_left/over=false/drop) so each drag probes again.

title: A file drag's one-second 'open the chat' timer can fire for a later forward drag
trigger: Drag files over row A (timer armed), cancel the drag without an exit event reaching the list (Esc), and start a forward drag from a history that rests on row A within one second.
effect: choose_row_by_drag checks only hover == chat and cx.has_active_drag() (true for the forward drag), so the chat opens although forward drags never open by resting (_dragForward); forward_over_row does not cancel `rest`.
fix: Fold into the ListDrag enum so entering the Forward variant drops the Files variant and its timer.

title: chat_list.items is a render-time cache read by key stepping while another pane is drawn
trigger: Open the Contacts or Calls tab or the search results (sidebar_chats not run), then press Alt+Down / Ctrl+Tab, or drag files over a row.
effect: step_open_chat, rows_selecting and freeze_list read chat_list.items from the last chats render, so stepping uses a list that is not on screen.
fix: Derive the stepping list from the same listing function the render uses (or clear items when the chats pane is not drawn).

title: Folder invite dialog seeds its ticks from session invite info that is not matched to its link
trigger: Open an addlist link, then open a second addlist link while check_folder_invite_link of the second fails to send (the first link's folder_invite_info is still in the session).
effect: drive_folder_invite (folder_share/mod.rs:841-858) takes folder_invite_info without comparing it to dialog.link, so the new dialog seeds and lists the first link's chats and Add would join them.
fix: Key folder_invite_info by link (or hold it in the dialog as Checking(link) / Checked(info) / Adding / Failed) so an answer is applied only to its own link.

title: Share Folder busy/error are applied from session one-shots not matched to the folder or request
trigger: Share Folder for folder A > Create link > Save (busy); close the box; open Share Folder for folder B and start editing a link; A's answer lands.
effect: drain_folder_share applies folder_link_saved / folder_share_error to whatever share box is open: B is switched to the List view (losing its form) or shows A's error, and B's busy is cleared while B's own request is still out.
fix: `enum ShareStage { List, Editing{link}, Saving{request, link}, Failed }` in the dialog, and the session answer carries (folder_id, RequestId) compared before applying.

title: Join box for a shared folder's new chats keeps ticks for chats no longer offered
trigger: Open the 'N new chats' join box; while it is open the poll refreshes folder_new_chats and the owner removed a chat; click Join.
effect: selected was seeded at open and is never pruned against the current list; confirm sends ids that are no longer offered, so the request can fail with an error toast after the box closed.
fix: Send selected ∩ the current folder_new_chats list (or rebuild the selection when the list changes).

title: Opening a search result for the page already shown leaves the page but skips its arrival work
trigger: On Settings > Devices (or Data and storage, Notifications) search for a setting of the same page and open it. open_search_target calls leave_settings_page, then show_settings_page returns early in switch_settings_page because the page is unchanged.
effect: The page's drafts are dropped (open session details, storage editor, confirm banner) but the arrival step (fetch_sessions, arrive_data_storage, fetch_notification_settings) does not run, so error lines and the guarded fetch of the visit are skipped.
fix: Treat leave plus arrive as one reset step run for a same-page result as well, or skip the leave when the page is unchanged.

title: NewChatState::creations entries are never removed
trigger: Create groups/channels repeatedly in one session
effect: grep finds no remove/retain/clear on creations: every create request stays with its outcome (and any unused photo path) until the account session ends
fix: Remove the entry when the dialog leaves the Creating stage (Farewell) or when the outcome is consumed

title: add_chat_welcome_message dedupes by purpose across all chats, with no feedback
trigger: Start adding a welcome message in chat A, add one in chat B before A answers
effect: The second add returns Ok(None) silently; the user's text is not sent and no error shows (edit/delete dedupe per chat)
fix: Use has_purpose_for_chat like edit/delete, and surface the refusal

title: A permissions save is not atomic: permissions may be sent, then slow mode or boosts fail
trigger: Save permissions plus slow mode where the second send fails.
effect: Err is returned after setChatPermissions was already sent (and applied optimistically); the box shows a failure but part of the save is live.
fix: Return a per-part outcome and tell the user which parts applied.

title: set_profile_accent_color sends background emoji id 0 when the own user is not loaded
trigger: Pick a profile color before the own user record is in the cache.
effect: unwrap_or(0) clears the user's profile icon instead of keeping it.
