fix: Refuse the call (InvalidRequest) when the own user is unknown.

title: maybe_download_profile_thumbs drops the rest of the queue on the first download error
trigger: One thumbnail download_file returns Err.
effect: take_profile_thumbs already emptied the queue; the ? returns early so remaining thumbnails are not asked until the tab is reopened.
fix: Ignore the per-file error (continue) or requeue the rest.

title: NewChatState::creations entries are never removed
trigger: Create several groups/channels in one session.
effect: Every create request id keeps its NewChatCreation (photo, outcome, flags) for the life of the session; no remover exists outside tests.
fix: Remove the creation when the dialog's stage leaves Creating (or when the outcome is consumed).

title: Bot lookup results shown for a stale query while the new text is debounced
trigger: Chat Automation, type a username, wait for results, then keep typing.
effect: business_found_bots checks only that lookup.query is non-empty, not that it equals the typed text; for up to 400 ms (and the request round trip) the old query's bots are listed as hits for the new text, with live Add buttons, and the leave-confirm ('No bot added') is decided on them.
fix: Compare parse_username_query(text) with lookup.query; treat a mismatch as Found::Loading.

title: Upgrade to supergroup confirm closes the box before the request is answered
trigger: Group Settings > Upgrade > confirm while the driver refuses the request (Err) or returns None.
effect: group_settings_action runs, then close_group_settings_dialog runs regardless; a failure only produces a toast and the user must reopen the box to try again.
fix: Make the upgrade a request stage (Confirm, Sending, Failed(reason)) that closes on the answer or on the pump_chat_upgrades event.

title: Add Members clears the picked contacts even when the add could not be sent
trigger: Member dialog, tick contacts, press Add while add_chat_members returns Err.
effect: std::mem::take(add_selected) runs before the send; on Err an error note shows and the user's picks are lost (the box is not closed).
fix: Take the selection only after Ok, or restore it on Err.

title: Choosing Public at the links limit leaves draft.public set while the box shows Private
trigger: Open Type box at the public links limit, click Public (limit box opens), dismiss it.
effect: draft.public is true but public_blocked hides it; if a link is freed later the box flips to Public with a link check the user did not choose. Save handles blocked correctly.
fix: Do not store the blocked choice; keep draft.public false until the limit clears.

title: Selecting a topic flushes the draft and forgets scroll before the select can fail
trigger: Click a topic row while select_topic returns Err.
effect: The leaving draft is flushed and the target topic's scroll memory forgotten, then an error note shows and the old view stays; draft restore runs for a view that did not change.
fix: Do the flush/forget after select_topic returns Ok.

title: Retry in the welcome dialog rebuilds the dialog and drops typed text
trigger: Type a new welcome message, load fails, press Retry.
effect: open_welcome_dialog replaces the whole WelcomeDialog (new inputs), so the typed text and an open edit are lost.
fix: Retry should only re-request load_chat_welcome_messages for the open dialog.

title: A finished plain group leaves admin.create_chat_dialog Some; 'closed' is only derived from the session's outcome
trigger: File > New Group, name it, pick members, Create. The session reports Created, so NewChatStep::Done hides the box.
effect: The kit box closes but NewChatDialog (three input entities, stage Creating) stays in admin.create_chat_dialog until the next open, and the NewChatCreation row stays in session.groups.new_chats.creations for the life of the session; nothing clears either.
fix: Make the dialog an Option that the Done arm takes (close_new_chat on Done, as drain_new_community_chat does) and remove the creation row when its outcome is consumed.

title: Subscribers step finishes as if Add worked when addChatMembers failed or there is no client
trigger: New Channel, pick subscribers, press Add while the driver refuses (no rights, no client).
effect: A note says the add failed, but finish_new_chat clears create_chat_dialog and opens the chat in the same call: the selection is lost and the box is gone, so the user cannot retry from it.
fix: Move to a Subscribers { adding: Fetch } stage and finish only on the answer; keep the box on error.

title: Business hours expanded and time-zone choice are one global flag pair, not per profile
trigger: Open a business profile, expand its hours and switch to the business time zone, then open another business profile (or the same panel for another user).
effect: The second profile's hours row opens already expanded and in the first person's chosen zone; nothing resets the pair when the profile changes (only written in profile_business.rs, never reset).
fix: Key the state by user id (Option<(UserId, HoursView)>) or hold it in the profile panel owner that is replaced when the target changes.

title: Failed poll votes graph shows nothing and is never retried
trigger: Open message statistics of a poll when getStatisticalGraph for poll votes fails (PollStatsFetch::Failed).
effect: Poll section silently absent ('_ => {}').
fix: Draw the error and a retry like the other pages.

title: lookup_business_bot records the query before the sends; a failed second/third send leaves it unresolved for the same text
trigger: Type a bot username while mine/global send fails
effect: lookup.query is set, Exact sent, `?` returns on Mine; typing the same text again returns early at line 179, so mine/global stay None (loading) until the text changes
fix: Set lookup.query only after all three parts are sent, or mark failed parts.

title: admin_followups are removed only when a real envelope answers; swept or settled requests keep them
trigger: A basic group upgrade or history toggle request is swept (stale TTL) or settled by logout while a followup is queued.
effect: The followup stays in groups.admin_followups forever and the chained step (link, topics, history) never runs and no error note appears.
fix: Drop and fail followups in settle_lost_request.

title: Revoked-link fetches use my_user_id.unwrap_or(0) as creator
trigger: Open revoked links before getMe has answered
effect: Request is sent for creator 0 and the cached Loaded list is for the wrong creator or errors
fix: Refuse (Ok(None)) until my_user_id is known

title: FilterDraft::open drops stored administrators that are no longer in the admin list and can open with none ticked
trigger: Filter Recent actions by one admin, remove that admin's rights, reopen the filter box.
effect: The stored filter has stored_admins=[X] but all_admins excludes X, so draft.admins is empty: 'All admins' and every admin box show unticked and Save is disabled until the user ticks something, while the log still filters by X.
fix: Keep stored ids in the draft even when they are not in the current list, or treat an empty intersection as 'all admins'.

title: A late add-chat-requests page is applied by purpose, not matched to the list generation
trigger: Open the requests list (page 1), scroll to load page 2, refresh (page 1 again) while page 2 is in flight
effect: Page 2's answer appends to the new list and overwrites next_offset with an older offset, so paging repeats or skips
fix: Keep the asking RequestId (or a list generation) in AddChatRequestList and drop other pages, as invite_pages does.

title: Processing one add-chat request while a page is in flight brings the handled request back
trigger: Approve a request while getCommunityAddChatRequests is in flight
effect: The page answer re-inserts the request that was just handled; it stays visible until the next reload
fix: Drop in-flight page requests in drop_add_chat_request as reset_add_chat_requests does, or remember handled chat ids.

title: Outcomes queue is only drained by the screen; a background account's outcomes pile up and are reported late
trigger: Add a chat to a community in account A, switch to B before the answer; return to A
effect: forget_outcomes clears them on return, so the success/fail toast is lost
fix: Report the outcome as a note on the account on screen at the time, or keep it keyed and drop only stale ones.

title: Chat-wide join-request pages: a late older answer applies once join_request_latest was removed
trigger: Search join requests (R1 'a'), then 'ab' (R2); R2 answers (latest removed), then R1 answers
effect: is_none_or accepts R1, replacing the list with the older query's results
fix: Keep the latest id until a new query replaces it, or reject ids lower than the last applied one.

title: Admin list answer applied after a membership update dropped the cache
trigger: Open the admin list; getChatAdministrators in flight; updateChatMember arrives (removes admin_lists entry); answer lands
effect: The pre-change list is stored as Loaded and shown until the next membership change
fix: Drop in-flight admin list requests in UpdateChatMember, or tag the fetch with a revision.

title: New join request bumps total_count while a search filter hides it
trigger: Search join requests for 'x' (join_request_queries non-empty); a request from someone else arrives
effect: The request is not inserted but total_count is incremented, so the list count exceeds the shown rows
fix: Bump the total only when the request is inserted or matches the query.

title: Invite-link, revoked-link and link-count list errors are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Open Invite Links, then create/revoke a link so the list is refetched twice quickly; the older request errors after the newer answered.
effect: The older error inserts Failed over the newer Loaded list (no request id compare), so the panel shows an error with good data hidden.
fix: Store the latest request id with each Fetch (as join_request_latest and InviteLinkMembersState::request do) and apply an error only when it matches.

title: GetMoreChatJoinRequests error clears join_request_latest without comparing the request id
trigger: Load more join requests (request A in flight), type a search (request B becomes latest), then A errors.
effect: join_request_latest is removed although B is the newest; B is then accepted only by the is_none_or fallback, and any other older answer would also land. The GetChatJoinRequests arm compares ids; this arm does not.
fix: Remove the entry only when it equals pending.id, as the GetChatJoinRequests arm does.

title: Groups-in-common pages are matched by a loading_more bool, not by request id
trigger: Open a user's profile, scroll to load the second page of groups in common, close and reopen the profile (fetch_profile_chats resets paging) before the second page answers.
effect: The old page-2 answer sees loading_more=false and replaces the whole list with page 2 only; or the old failure turns the list to Failed. The list is wrong until the profile is reopened.
fix: ProfileChatsFetch::Loaded { ids, more: MorePage::{Idle, Loading(RequestId), Exhausted} } and compare the pending id.

title: A failed refresh of a profile chat list replaces an already loaded list with Failed
trigger: Open a channel profile (similar channels loaded), reopen it so fetch_profile_chats sets Loading, and make the request fail.
effect: fail_profile_fetch inserts ProfileChatsFetch::Failed for the key regardless of what the list held; the earlier list is lost. (fetch_profile_chats itself writes Loading over Loaded first, so the earlier list is already hidden.)
fix: Keep the stale Loaded value inside Refreshing/Failed variants.

title: Saving hours silently replaces the saved time zone with the closest one when the saved id is missing from TDLib's list
trigger: Hours were saved with a zone id absent from getTimeZones; open Business Hours, change only a weekday, leave.
effect: business_zone() falls back to closest_time_zone and save_business_hours prefers it over draft.time_zone_id, so wanted != base on zone alone and a different zone is sent.
fix: Prefer the draft's saved id; use the closest zone only for a draft that had no zone.

title: Cancel on the Create visibility box is live while createCommunity is in flight
trigger: Press Create (button busy), then Cancel: box returns to the identity box; the Created outcome arrives
effect: Created closes the box only when it is still CreateVisibility, so the identity box stays over the finished community and a second Next/Create sends another createCommunity for a chat already in a community (an error toast)
fix: Disable Cancel while the CreateCommunity request is in flight, or let the outcome close any Create* box for that chat.

title: Topic menu builds the Ban/Unban item from a banned flag read before the member fetch answers
trigger: As a monoforum admin, open the header menu of a person who is already banned and whose ban status was not yet loaded.
effect: The menu closure captures banned (false while direct_member_banned is unknown) at render time; the fetch started by the same click answers after the menu was built, so it offers Ban for a banned person. Ban then asks to confirm and re-bans.
fix: Render the ban item as Fetch-state: disabled 'checking' until the member status is Ready, then Ban or Unban.

title: A chat window showing a group that was upgraded stays on the dead group when the main window handle is gone
trigger: Open a basic group in a chat window, close or hide the main window so main_window.handle is None, then upgrade the group (from another device or the chat window's box).
effect: move_upgraded_chat_window returns early; the chat window keeps the deactivated basic group, the upgrade event has already been taken by take_chat_upgrades.
fix: Open the replacement window from any live window handle, or retarget the chat window's chat in place.

title: A box derived as Saved is never removed and can reopen as Failed
trigger: Save succeeds (box closes); later another Manage action (upgrade, sign/translate toggle) records a Settings error for the same chat in info_edit_errors
effect: admin.group_edit_box still holds the old box with saving=Some(done ids); state() flips Saved -> Failed, group_edit_box() returns it again and the host reopens the Edit box with a stale reason
fix: Drop admin.group_edit_box (via close_group_edit_box) when the state becomes Saved, not just hide it.

title: Unban/kick refetch the member page right after sending, before the change applies
trigger: Unban a member in the Banned tab (or remove one from Add exception)
effect: refresh_supergroup_members clears the cache and asks again immediately; the page can come back with the member still there and nothing refetches after the status change lands
fix: Refetch on the answer to the set-status request (match by request id).

title: Permissions Save sends the permissions then fails on slow mode and restores the box
trigger: Change permissions and slow mode, Save when set_chat_slow_mode_delay returns Err
effect: Permissions were already sent but the box is restored and an error toast says it failed; Save again compares against the new state
fix: Report which parts were sent and close/restore per part.

title: Share link sets a session-wide share target from a chat window profile
trigger: Right-click the group link in a profile modal and choose Share.
effect: self.share.link_text is session-wide (main window state); the chooser opens in the window of the last press, not necessarily the window that asked.
fix: Use the Asker seam to name the window for the share box.

title: Opening an info panel with a failed fetch still leaves the target set
trigger: Open a user or group panel while the fetch request returns Err.
effect: Target is already set in the driver and the error note is shown; the panel draws empty with no retry path other than closing and reopening.
fix: Model the panel as Fetch<T> so the failure is drawn with a Retry.

title: Apply-to-invite-links alert answer is not matched to the type box that asked
trigger: Press Save in the Type box with join-approval changed, leave the alert open, close the Edit box (chat removed or window closed), open another group's Type box, then answer the alert.
effect: finish_group_type_box(Some(..)) applies to whatever type box is open now, not the chat that asked.
fix: Carry (chat_id, box token) in the alert and compare before finishing.

title: Show/hide username alert answer is not matched to the box that asked
trigger: Click a username, leave the alert open, close the Edit box and reopen it, answer the alert.
effect: toggle_group_type_username sends for the captured chat/name even if the box is no longer for that chat or the username list changed.
fix: Check that the Type box for chat_id is still open before sending.

title: New community box closes and says 'created' when the request is only sent
trigger: Create community with a chat TDLib then refuses (createCommunity error).
effect: submit_create_community_dialog takes the dialog on Ok(Some(_)) and shows the silent 'Community created' note; the refusal arrives later through Session::community_error and the typed name and picked chat are gone.
fix: Keep the dialog as Creating(RequestId) until updateCommunity or the error answer for that request.

title: toggle_link_requests ignores the Err of open_link_join_requests
trigger: Tap Requests on a link while the driver refuses
effect: Nothing opens and no note
fix: Set an error note on Err

title: revoked_open toggled before fetch; fetch Err ignored
trigger: Toggle Revoked links while the driver refuses the fetch
effect: Shows loading row forever (fetch map has no entry)
fix: Open state and Fetch<T> as one enum

title: focus_custom is taken during dialog build, not when the field is drawn
trigger: Open Custom limit; build runs but content closure never runs before a rebuild
effect: Number field is not focused
fix: Focus on first paint of the field entity

title: Editing the link clears Type.saving while the save request is still out
trigger: Type step: Save with a link, then type another character before TDLib answers.
effect: new_chat_link_edited sets saving = None, so the view is no longer busy and Save is enabled again with the first request still pending; a second Save sends another, and the late failure of the first cannot be told from the second.
fix: Keep the in-flight request id in the stage and separate 'refusal shown' from 'request in flight' (Type { chat, save: Idle | Saving(req) | Refused }).

title: Rating box stays open with an empty body when the person's full info or rating goes away
trigger: Open the rating box, then the account's user_full_info for that person is dropped or has no rating (account switch back, info refresh without ratings).
effect: rating_box_target() returns None ('None closes it') but build_rating_box only draws an empty div with the Understood button; the is_open check (rating_box.is_some()) stays true, so an empty box remains until dismissed.
fix: Close the box (clear rating_box) when its target no longer resolves, or make is_open use rating_box_target().is_some().

title: Disable Sharing explainer counts as shown when it opens, even if dismissed without acting
trigger: Open a private chat profile More > Disable Sharing three times and press Esc each time.
effect: chat_prefs.disable_sharing_box_shown reaches 3 on opens, so the fourth use skips the explanation the user never read and acts at once (or sends them to the Premium preview).
fix: Increment the count when the box's button is pressed, not when it opens.

title: Retry on a failed profile chat list removes the Failed entry and ignores a synchronous send error
trigger: Open a profile whose groups-in-common or similar-channels fetch Failed, go offline so chats_path_active is false (or the sender is closed), press Retry.
effect: retry_profile_chats removes the (kind,key) entry first and drops the Err from fetch_*; the Retry row vanishes and nothing is loading, so the list never offers Retry again until the panel is reopened.
fix: Only remove the Failed entry after the fetch returned Ok(Some), or set it back to Failed on Err.

title: Personal photo picker overwrites whichever profile dialog is open when the answer arrives and leaves a box host set when cancelled
trigger: Edit contact > Set Photo (file picker opens, open_box(ProfilePanel) runs before profile_dialog is set); cancel the picker, or open Birthday meanwhile and then pick a file.
effect: On cancel hosts[ProfilePanel] stays Host::Asked with no dialog open; on a late pick the answer replaces profile_dialog unconditionally, dropping the dialog the user is typing in.
fix: Model the pick as ProfileDialog::PickingPhoto{user_id, mode} set before the prompt (and cancelled by the answer), and apply the answer only when that exact stage is still current.

title: Parsed-chart cache is keyed by buffer address and length with a 3x128 byte sample, so a reused address can return a stale chart
trigger: A statistics refresh frees the old JSON string and the new one of the same length is allocated at the same address with equal first/middle/last 128 bytes but different values elsewhere.
effect: The old chart is drawn for the new data until the cache is cleared at 64 entries.
fix: Key by a hash of the full JSON, or hold Rc<StatChart> in the state next to the graph.

title: Statistics keep the colors of the theme they were fetched in
trigger: Open statistics in light theme, switch to dark; the cached Loaded result is kept and getChatStatistics(is_dark) is not resent.
effect: Chart colors do not follow the theme until the user presses Refresh.
fix: Store the is_dark the result was fetched for in the Loaded variant and refetch when it differs.

title: Ninth queued external link is dropped silently and reported as accepted
trigger: While the UI is busy or locked, open nine different tg:// links from the OS.
effect: push_external_link returns true and raises the window, but links past MAX_QUEUED are not queued; the user gets no word that the link was ignored.
fix: Return a result enum {Queued, Duplicate, Full} and tell the user when the inbox is full.

title: Style notices are not matched to the preview that asked: Added closes any open preview, Removed/Deleted closes any preview in Removing, and Removing has no exit on failure
trigger: Open an addstyle link of your own installed style, press Delete Style and confirm while the request cannot be sent (or deleteTextCompositionStyle fails). Or: press Add Style in one preview and, before the answer, a second preview replaces it.
effect: A failed or unsent delete does nothing visible (send result ignored with `let _`, DeleteStyle error is silent) and the preview stays in PreviewStage::Removing; the next Removed/Deleted notice from any request closes it. An Added notice for style X takes (closes) a preview showing style Y.
fix: Make PreviewStage::Removing/Adding carry the RequestId (or style name) and put the request id in StyleNotice; leave Removing on that request's error or a send failure.

title: Add Style has no in-flight stage and ignores a send failure
trigger: Open an addstyle link and click Add Style twice quickly, or click it while the request cannot be sent.
effect: Two addTextCompositionStyle requests go out (the second can fail with an error toast); a send failure shows nothing and the button stays as if nothing was pressed.
fix: A PreviewStage::Adding { request } variant that disables the button and is left on the answer, the error or a send failure (with the error toast).

title: An invite Join that fails to send shows its error box in the main window, not in the chat window of the invite box
trigger: Click a t.me/+hash invite link in a chat window, lose the connection, and press Join in the invite box.
effect: confirm_deep_link_invite's error arm sets DeepLinkState::ShowText('Couldn't reach Telegram.'), but Links::flow_window is set only on Ok(Some(_)). The next pump opens the DeepLinkInfo box with from_window None, so it appears in the main window, possibly hidden or behind. When the chats path is inactive (Err(InvalidRequest)), the session keeps InvitePreview while the UI copy was taken, so the invite box reopens with no message. Links::deep_link_invite is a hand-kept copy of ChatsState::deep_link.
fix: Set flow_window from the asking window before calling confirm, whatever it returns, and drop the UI copy: draw the invite box from ChatsState::deep_link, matched by generation.

title: Link tooltip token restarts at 1 so an old timer shows a new tooltip early
trigger: Hover link A (timer starts), move off it (tooltip set to None), hover link B within the delay
effect: token = previous tooltip's token + 1 with None counting as 0, so both tooltips get token 1; A's timer fires first, matches B's token and shows B's tooltip before its own delay
fix: Hold the timer Task in the tooltip stage enum {Waiting{task}, Shown} so dropping it cancels the timer, or use a monotonic counter outside the Option.

title: Publish on an already-busy suggestion closes the box silently
trigger: Press Publish twice (second box opened from a repeat click) or Publish a post whose approve is already in flight.
effect: confirm_suggest_accept sees busy, clears the accept box and returns with no toast or note, as if the second Publish succeeded; also no check that the suggestion is still pending (declined/expired by the other side) before sending approve.
fix: Keep the box open with a 'publishing' state, and check SuggestedPostState::Pending at confirm.

title: Only the last suggested-post note and balance prompt of a drain survives
trigger: Two suggested-post requests fail between two frames (decline and add offer), or two BALANCE_TOO_LOW errors.
effect: drain_suggested_post_notes keeps notes.into_iter().last() and one take_suggested_post_balance_low(); earlier errors are lost, so a failed Decline/Approve can go unreported.
fix: Queue every note into the toast queue (it already keeps a failure list) and take a Vec of balance purposes.

title: A late Ack from the pre-reload document terminates the carrier
trigger: A delivery is in flight, the relay page reloads inside the scope; the old document's Ack IPC message arrives after LoadStarted had already moved the delivery back to pending
effect: heard() finds no matching in_flight and returns Err, so the carrier fails with Terminated and the proxy is dropped although nothing is wrong
fix: Tag acks with a document epoch (part of the Document enum) and ignore acks from an older epoch instead of failing.

title: refresh_styles drops a vanished translate_style but neither re-asks nor invalidates the card
trigger: On the Translate tab pick a custom style and get a result (or leave it loading); the server then removes that style (updateTextCompositionStyles from another device).
effect: translate_style becomes None so the title reads 'To <language>' while the shown/arriving result was made with the removed style, and Apply applies it.
fix: Route the Translate branch through request_in(Translate) like the Style branch so the stale card is replaced.

title: Suggest bar is removed as soon as the send goes out, before the answer
trigger: Edit a suggested post with new price/time, send the change, and let TDLib refuse it (balance, permissions).
effect: The bar (terms the user set) is dropped on send success; the error arm only adds a note, so the terms must be entered again.
fix: Keep the bar until the request answers; remove it in the ok arm and keep it on error.

title: Venue icon state is sticky: Failed is never retried and Requested never leaves if the answer is dropped
trigger: A venue icon request errors once (FLOOD_WAIT, offline) or its answer is dropped.
effect: That category shows no icon for the rest of the session (icons is cleared only at 256 entries).
fix: Forget Failed/Requested entries when a picker opens.

title: A slow address lookup can show the previous place's address under the new pin
trigger: Rest the pin at A (address shown), drag to B and rest 3 s so the lookup starts, drag slightly again before it answers and release within the same place
effect: hidden_while_moving still holds A's address (it is only cleared when restored) and move_ended shows it for B until the lookup answers
fix: Key the hidden text by the point it was resolved for (Shown{point,text}) so it is restored only for that point.

title: attachment_menu_toggled and data_sent are not matched to the flow that asked
trigger: Start adding bot B to the attachment menu from a link (awaiting_toggle set, toggle in flight) while a Remove from menu for bot A (from its profile) is also in flight, and A's answer lands first; or send data from mini app A, close it and open keyboard mini app B before A's answer lands.
effect: poll_mini_app_session ignores the bot id in Ok((_, added)) and takes awaiting_toggle on any toggle answer, so B launches before its own toggle answered and the wrong Added/Removed toast shows; data_sent carries no app at all, so B's flow reports A's result.
fix: Make each one-shot answer carry the request id (or bot id) it answers and take awaiting_toggle only when it matches, as attachment_menu_bot and found already do with the bot id.

title: An offer update clears the busy mark while its approve/decline is still in flight, re-arming the buttons
trigger: As a channel admin press Accept on a suggested post; before the approveSuggestedPost ok arrives, an updateMessageSuggestedPostInfo for that message lands (e.g. the member edits the price), then press Accept again.
effect: apply_suggested_post removes (chat, message) from busy on InfoUpdated, so send_suggested lets a second approve/decline go out while the first is pending; the second gets an error toast or acts on changed terms.
fix: Clear busy only from the request's own answer (ok/error), or derive it from the pending request table.

title: A custom emoji id is marked asked on a send error and on send, and the UI never asks again if the lookup fails
trigger: Open the AI compose box while the getCustomEmojiStickers lookup for a style pill's emoji fails (network error) or resolve_custom_emoji returns Err.
effect: The style pill / editor / preview icon stays the Sparkles fallback for the rest of the account's screen; only an account switch clears emoji_asked. (Unconfirmed whether the driver's own lookup retries the id.)
fix: Do not insert on Err, and key the asked set to the outcome (Fetch per id, cleared on failure) so a failed lookup is asked again.

title: A link whose lookup cannot be sent does nothing and shows no error
trigger: Click a t.me link while the chats path is not active or the sender is closed (reconnecting).
effect: request_deep_link_info_from, continue_deep_link and request_deep_link_text results are dropped with let _ =; the queued link was already taken, the flow state is None, nothing is shown.
fix: On Err put the link back in the queue or set a StatusNote::error (Couldn't open the link).

title: A right-click link note outlives the right-click when no menu opens
trigger: Right-press a link where no message menu opens, scroll, then right-click another message at the exact same pixel
effect: right_clicked_link is only dropped by take_right_clicked_link or the next note, so the stale link's copy entry can be added to a different message menu at the same position
fix: Clear it on the next frame, scroll or chat change, or hand it to the menu opener within the same event.

title: A link tooltip stays on screen after the chat changes under the pointer
trigger: Rest the pointer on a text link until its tooltip shows, then switch chat with the keyboard (e.g. Ctrl+Tab / Alt+Down) without moving the mouse.
effect: The old link's address tooltip stays over the new chat until the pointer moves onto and off another link; nothing on the chat change clears message_ui.link_tooltip (only queue_link, note_right_clicked_link and the message menu do). Also LinkTooltip.shown is a Waiting/Shown stage as a bool.
fix: Keep the tooltip in ChatUi (replaced on chat change) with an enum TooltipStage { Waiting{token}, Shown }.

title: closed_by_user is never reset, so activation logic trusts hidden() alone after the first close
trigger: Close the main window once (hide), reopen from the tray, later minimize it and Cmd-Tab (on a Mac where is_hidden_on_mac also reports a minimized window).
effect: main_window_on_activation sees closed_by_user true and raises the window the user only minimized, or does so when a chat window is the last active.
fix: Clear the flag in raise_main_window by making it part of the MainWindowState enum.

title: Live location 'expires in' line is refreshed only for the main window's open chat
trigger: Open a chat with a running live location in its own chat window while another chat is open in the main window.
effect: ensure_live_location_tick is keyed on session.open_chat and only notifies when the main window is active, so the chat window's countdown does not tick.
fix: Run the tick per window slot (WindowSlot) keyed by the chat shown there.

title: CLLocationManager keeps running after the picker closes
trigger: Open Send Location with permission pending or a slow fix, then close the picker.
effect: The task and receiver are dropped but RUNNING keeps the manager and delegate alive and updating until the next lookup or an answer; nothing stops it on close.
fix: Give locate() a cancel handle that stops and drops the manager when the receiver is dropped.

title: A mouse-up lost outside the window leaves drag set and the map stuck moving
trigger: Press on the map, drag out of the window, release with the app deactivated.
effect: location_ui.drag stays Some, location_map_settled returns early on drag.is_some(), so the pin stays lifted, move_ended never runs, no venues or address refresh until the next click.
fix: Clear drag on window deactivation or on any mouse-move without the button pressed.

title: Opening the marketplace from another chat while a purchase is loading keeps the first chat
trigger: Start loading a gift from chat A's Send Gift box, close the box, open Buy by name from chat B before it finishes.
effect: busy skips the reset, so marketplace_chat stays A and the gift buys for A; B's request is silently dropped (recipient name shown is A's).
fix: Key the gift by ChatId and compare it with the asking chat before reusing it.

title: Decline reason input handler skips in_window_of
trigger: Open Decline from a chat window and press Enter in the reason field.
effect: open_suggest_decline subscribes with a plain subscribe_in; the price box's subscription wraps the same work in in_window_of(window). Without it, confirm_suggest_decline / close_kit_dialog_if_done run under the main window's slot state instead of the window the field lives in, so the dialog may not close or the wrong window's note is set.
fix: Wrap the handler in in_window_of like open_suggest_price.

title: Emoji status access stuck in Granting when the toggle answer never comes
trigger: In a mini app, request emoji status access, press Allow (Premium); the toggleBotCanManageEmojiStatus request is dropped unanswered (stale-request sweep / reconnect).
effect: AccessStage::Granting has no timeout or other exit; every later web_app_request_emoji_status_access is answered 'false' as busy until the mini app window is closed.
fix: Give Granting the request id and a deadline (as PhoneFlow and SetRequest have) and leave it on a dropped request.

title: Mini app render_action is one slot; a second action before the next render drops the first
trigger: In one poll tick the mini app sends web_app_open_invoice and the user picks 'Open bot' from the menu (or two events arrive together).
effect: The OpenInvoice action is overwritten, the checkout never opens and the app never hears invoice_closed.
fix: A queue (Vec<RenderAction>) drained at render, or answer 'failed' to an invoice action that is replaced.

title: Mini app from_window is one per screen and overwritten by every later flow
trigger: Start a ?startattach link in a chat window (waits for getAttachmentMenuBot), then open any mini app from the main window.
effect: from_window becomes None, so the first flow's Add-to-menu box and notes open in the main window instead of the chat window that asked.
fix: Keep the asking window inside each pending flow value (PendingOpen/LaunchFlow) instead of one shared field.

title: Mini app open answers are applied in arrival order, not to the launch the user asked for last
trigger: Click a bot's menu button app, then quickly another bot's app before the first opens.
effect: Both launches stay pending; the first answer opens app A, the second replaces it with B (A flashes); if B fails A stays open though the user asked for B. Two answers in one 30 ms tick overwrite open_result, so A's launch is never closed with closeWebApp.
fix: Keep only the latest asked launch as current (drop older pending launches and close their answers), and make open_result a queue or keyed by request.

title: awaiting_toggle continues on any attachment-menu toggle answer, not the one it waits for
trigger: Accept 'Add to attachment menu' for bot A, and before it answers use 'Remove from menu' in another open app's menu.
effect: The remove answer (Ok) is taken as A's add answer and launches A's app; A's later answer is then a stray note.
fix: Carry the bot id (or request id) in awaiting_toggle and match the toggled answer to it.

title: Bridge req_ids are cut to 64 chars, so the reply carries a req_id the page never sent
trigger: Open a mini app whose SDK uses request ids longer than 64 characters, and have it call readTextFromClipboard or invokeCustomMethod.
effect: clipboard_text_received / custom_method_invoked come back with the truncated req_id; the page matches replies by req_id, so its promise never settles and the action looks hung.
fix: Refuse an over-long req_id outright (BadArguments with a failure reply) instead of truncating it, so the answer always carries the id that asked.

title: A refused popup or custom-method request gets no reply event, so the page waits forever
trigger: A mini app calls showPopup with a 300-char message or 4 buttons, or invokeCustomMethod with params over 16 KB.
effect: parse_event returns Err(BadArguments) and spawn_mini_app_window drops it silently (`if let Ok(parsed)`); the page never gets popup_closed / custom_method_invoked with an error and its callback never fires.
fix: Make bad arguments of request-style events produce the bridge's failure reply (popup_closed with no button, custom_method_invoked with an error and the req_id) like `refusal` does for unsupported ones.

title: jump_shared_media_to_day takes history_calendar and then returns Ok without doing anything if the chat changed or the day has no media
trigger: Pick a day in the shared-media calendar after switching the gallery's chat, or a day with no nearby media.
effect: The calendar box is consumed and closes as if the jump happened; nothing loads.
fix: Return an outcome (Jumped/NoMedia/Stale) so the caller can show a note, and take the calendar only after the checks.

title: Swipe indicator shows 'reached' after backing off slightly, but releasing does not step
trigger: Trackpad swipe past the threshold so the arrow is fully in, then pull back 1 to 2 px (ratio 0.96..0.99) and let go.
effect: pull_to keeps `reached` true until ratio drops under 0.95 (indicator() draws the armed arrow), but end() steps only when ratio() >= 1.0, so the arrow says 'let go to move' and nothing moves.
fix: Decide the step from the same armed value the indicator shows (end() uses pull.reached), or drop the stored bool and derive both from one function.

title: A video userpic's full-info ask is recorded before it is sent and never undone on failure
trigger: Premium user with a video photo is drawn while offline or a send fails: connect/contacts.rs:120 calls take_userpic_full_info_ask (inserts (user,photo)) and then send_json fails, or getUserFullInfo answers with an error (no handler unmarks).
effect: That user's userpic stays a still image for the whole session (state Unknown never asked again) until their photo id changes.
fix: Make the ask a per-photo enum (Asked{request}/Known) and remove the entry on send error or error answer.

title: Test position_follows_the_frames_the_device_consumed sleeps 300 ms on the wall clock
trigger: cargo test
effect: Violates the deterministic-tests rule (no sleeps); slows the suite
fix: Drop the sleep; the frame-count assertion already shows no time-based advance, or use the engine's manual clock.

title: Demo setup uses assert! (panics) in the downloads and voice demos
trigger: Run --screenshot-demo ready-downloads or ready-voice when the playback intent logic regresses
effect: Process panics at demo start; only reachable in the screenshot demo build (lines 205, 208, 331, 336)
fix: Return an error/log note instead of assert!, or move the checks into tests.

title: Album pin label clones the whole loaded history on every viewer chrome render
trigger: Open a photo that is part of an album in a chat with a long loaded history and where you can pin; play a video in an album or leave the zoom animating.
effect: viewer_chrome runs on every chrome redraw (up to every 100 ms while a clip plays) and each time collects h.ordered().cloned() for the whole history just to compute a label, so UI-thread work grows with history length.
fix: Compute album membership and pin state from the album's ids (a lookup by media_album_id) instead of cloning the history, or cache the label per item and session revision.

title: Picture-in-Picture of another account never sees its message deleted
trigger: Open PiP for a clip in account A, switch to account B, the clip's message is deleted in A.
effect: pip_message_deleted requires the on-screen session to be the link's account, so the window keeps playing a deleted message (header says it goes when the message is deleted). Only logout or lock closes it.
fix: Look the tombstone up in the link's own account (background client session) or let the account's deletion update close its links.

title: Taken photo preview is a newer frame than the saved JPEG
trigger: Click Take photo; while the JPEG saves the stream keeps drawing newer frames into camera.live; on completion camera.live is frozen as the shot
effect: Preview shows a different picture than the file that is cropped and uploaded
fix: Stop the stream (or freeze live) when Take photo is pressed, not when the save answers.

title: Clicking a story tile does nothing when the story is not in the loaded stories
trigger: Gallery > Stories tab, click a tile whose story is not in session.stories (not yet fetched or expired). items.iter().position(..) is None and the function returns.
effect: A click that gives no feedback and no request for the story.
fix: Ask for the story (getStory) and show a loading state on the tile, or a note when it is gone.

title: Closing the Playlist page closes the whole gallery instead of going back to it
trigger: Open the gallery, open a profile's music Playlist page, press the playlist close button. It calls close_shared_media_ui, which closes shared_media entirely.
effect: The user lands on the bare chat with no gallery and the Media tab they were on is gone.
fix: Make the panel one enum Gallery(chat) / Playlist{user, back: Option<Gallery>} and let Playlist close pop to its back value.

title: A delete that never lands keeps a 60 fps redraw running for 10 seconds
trigger: Delete a message the server refuses to delete (for example an old message in a group without the right), or delete the only message left in a chat.
effect: begin_vanish pushes a Waiting ghost. merge_vanishing starts it only when a non-empty message list for its chat lacks the id: a refused delete keeps the message, and an emptied chat has messages.first() == None. Until VANISH_WAIT (10 s) prunes it, vanish_overlay sees a non-empty list and calls request_animation_tick(60) every frame, so the window redraws at 60 fps for 10 s with nothing animating. A deleted last message also gets no dust.
fix: Tick only for started ghosts. A Waiting ghost needs no frames, so wake it with the deletion update or a timer at VANISH_WAIT. Start the ghost from the deletion update (keyed by chat and message) rather than from the rows' absence.

title: The frame strip stays partly blank after an encode that started before the strip finished loading fails
trigger: Open Edit Video on a long video (or a video avatar) and press Done at once, while the strip frames are still being cut one by one. The encode fails.
effect: The strip loader checks editor.serial on each frame and stops when Done bumps it. When the encode fails, the editor stays open, but video_editor_reload_frames sees frames.len() == times.len() and the same width, so it treats the half-empty strip as kept and never reloads. The missing cells stay grey until the editor is reopened.
fix: Give the strip load its own stage (Loading { cancel, token } / Loaded / Stopped) keyed by its own token, not the editor serial, and reload when the stage is Stopped with frames missing.

title: download_user_file scans every message of every loaded history to find a file's origin
trigger: Retry/download a file with no known origin (picker sticker) with big histories loaded
effect: Linear scan over all histories on the UI thread per call
fix: Index file_id -> (chat,message) at insert time

title: Shuffle Previous/Next can return a message id that is no longer in the playlist
trigger: Shuffle music, skip a few tracks, delete one of the played messages, press Previous
effect: shuffled() returns played[cursor] without checking it is still in ids; the player is asked to start a missing message
fix: Filter played against ids before using the cursor (or drop vanished ids and re-seat the cursor).

title: cancel_untracked leaves a Cancelled intent that only an idle update clears
trigger: Cancel a row for a transfer TDLib reports as paused or already idle (another device).
effect: Phase::Cancelled stays until confirm_cancel, which runs only on an active-to-idle update that never comes; is_cancelling stays true and the entry keeps its place in the indexes.
fix: Have cancel_untracked settle at once when the file is not active in FileMap.

title: Stacked optimistic reactions on one message restore the wrong snapshot when the first is refused
trigger: React with A then quickly B on the same message; set_own_reaction_for records `before` for each. A is refused: settle_own_reaction restores A's pre-image, which also removes B's optimistic reaction.
effect: B's chip disappears until TDLib's updateMessageInteractionInfo for B arrives (self-corrects); if B's request also failed, its snapshot is restored later over newer state.
fix: Undo by reverting only this request's own change (remove the reaction it added) instead of restoring a whole interaction_info snapshot.

title: A late isProfileAudio answer overwrites a local save or remove made in the meantime
trigger: Open a song's Save to menu (isProfileAudio sent), tap Save to Profile before the answer; local_save_profile_audio sets the id true, then the check answers 404 and apply_profile_music_error sets it false.
effect: The menu offers Profile again for a track that is saved (or shows Remove for a track just removed) until the next check.
fix: Make the per-song state `Unknown | Asking(RequestId) | Known(bool)` and drop an answer when a local change replaced Asking.

title: Profile tabs (Stories, Gifts) accept pages from a closed and reopened gallery
trigger: Open the Gifts tab of a chat, scroll so a second page (append) is in flight, close the gallery and reopen it for the same chat before the page lands.
effect: Profile tabs are matched by open + chat_id only, never by the tab generation that open_for_tab restamps, so the old append page is added to the fresh tab: page-2 gifts show alone before the first page, or are duplicated after it, and next_offset comes from the stale page.
fix: Stamp GetProfileGifts / GetChatPostedToChatPageStories with the tab's generation (begin_profile_fetch restamps, begin_profile_more keeps it) and accept only matching answers, as the message tabs do.

title: A frame ThorVG fails to draw is asked for again on every tick
trigger: A TGS sticker whose frames ThorVG cannot render (render returns an error for some frame) is on screen.
effect: frame() delivers nothing and leaves the clip Ready; the view keeps wanting that frame, so the worker retries the failing render on every UI tick while the view waits on a frame that never comes.
fix: Turn a failed draw into ClipState::Failed (or a per-frame failed mark) so views rest and the frame is not asked again.

title: Idle watch thread spawned with std::thread::Builder, not spawn_guarded (panic-safety rule 11); a panic in look leaves watched=true forever
trigger: Any panic inside look() on the quill-audio-idle thread
effect: No new watch is ever started, so the output device is never closed after silence (keeps the Mac from idle sleep) and a stale device is only noticed by the next open
fix: Spawn through quill::thread_guard::spawn_guarded and clear `watched` in a drop guard, as Reopened does for `opening`.

title: Seek slider events are not matched to the track whose slider sent them
trigger: Start dragging the row's seek slider, then switch tracks (media key Next, or another row) before releasing.
effect: The subscription made in begin_track_playback is detached and never checks which slider fired. The old slider entity is held by the element during the drag, so its Release calls seek_active_to with the old value on the new track and moves it to a wrong position.
fix: Compare the event's entity to self.playback.seek_slider (or keep the subscription in the ActiveTrack so it drops with it) before applying.

title: Quit-while-exporting exit callback is lost if the screen is replaced while the Stop and quit alert is open
trigger: Quit with an export running (alert opens, exit stored in dialogs.export_stop), an account switch/removal replaces OnScreen, press Stop
effect: Exports are cancelled but the app does not quit; the alert closes and the Quit press is swallowed
fix: Keep the pending exit on the app (QuillApp), not in the per-account OnScreen; the alert is window-level and app-wide.

title: edr_on is lost with the replaced OnScreen, leaving the main window's layer in extended range
trigger: Open an HDR picture in the main window's viewer, then switch accounts (OnScreen is replaced whole, including a fresh HdrViewer with edr_on = false).
effect: want (false) equals the new edr_on (false) so set_window_edr(window, false) is never called; the CAMetalLayer stays a float extended-range drawable until another HDR picture is opened and closed (extra GPU memory and a different colour pipeline for the whole window).
fix: Keep the window's EDR mode in the WindowSlot / main window state (not in the per-account viewer), or have the Farewell of the viewer force set_window_edr(false).

title: A failed decode is cached as Loaded(Err) and never retried while the entry stays under budget
trigger: A picture whose file is partial or replaced in place at the same path fails to decode once (or a file is rewritten with new content).
effect: The tile stays blank (or shows the old decode) until the entry is evicted, which can be never when the cache is under budget.
fix: Key the entry by (path, mtime/len) and drop Err entries after a short life or on file-ready updates.

title: A sweep that finds a window mid-draw returns without rearming
trigger: A chat window is being drawn when the sweeper task runs after a retirement.
effect: Retired images wait in the atlas until some later wake (next retirement or chat frame); with nothing else drawing, they stay.
fix: On the early return, leave a pending-sweep marker that the next frame start or a short deferred wake handles.

title: A sleeping slot whose reopen fails is retried on every history pass
trigger: A sleeping clip is painted in view but VideoPlayer::open fails (file deleted/moved).
effect: revive returns without a stage change, so each sweep opens the file again every frame the tile is visible.
fix: On open failure move the slot to a Failed stage so it shows the still.

title: A display-scale change drops every player but keeps on_demand and the sound mode of the dropped ones
trigger: Move the main window to a screen with another scale while a round video plays with sound.
effect: Players are dropped and restart muted looping; on_demand entries for them are only cleared via forget; a chat window on its own screen uses the main window's scale.
fix: Per-window scale in State.

title: Reaction and status selectors force tab = Emoji without syncing the GIF gate
trigger: Open the composer panel on the GIFs tab, then open the reaction selector from a message or the status selector from the main menu without closing the panel first.
effect: tab is set to Emoji directly, so shows_gifs() becomes false but sync_gif_downloads is not called; the session GIF gate (gifs.open) stays open and GIF downloads continue until some later close.
fix: Make selector modes carry their tab (PanelMode::Compose(PanelTab) vs selectors without one) and have set_media_panel_mode be the one place that syncs the GIF gate.

title: Shared Media viewer merges the session's current shared-media tab without checking its chat
trigger: Open the viewer from the Shared Media panel of chat A, then (notification click or deep link) another chat B becomes open and its shared media loads while the viewer is still up.
effect: sync_shared_media_viewer reads session.media.shared_media.tabs[tab] and merge_older takes items older than the first by message id; nothing compares shared_media.chat_id with the viewer's chat, so B's older items can be prepended to A's viewer.
fix: Store the chat in ViewerSource::SharedMedia{chat_id} and merge only when the session's shared_media.chat_id equals it.

title: Viewer delete availability uses the session's single message_menu_actions slot shared with the message menu and other windows' viewers
trigger: Open viewers in the main window and a chat window (or open a message context menu) so that fetch_message_menu_actions is asked for different messages.
effect: Each step asks fetch_message_menu_actions and the answer overwrites one Option<(chat, message, actions)>; the matching in viewer_delete_confirm keeps it correct but the other viewer's Delete button disappears until it steps again.
fix: Key the actions answer by (chat, message) in a small map, or per window view like WindowViews.

title: Speed and volume changes reach only the current window's viewer player
trigger: Two windows each show a playing viewer clip (main window and a chat window); change speed or volume in one.
effect: set_playback_speed and set_playback_volume write players.speed/volume app-wide but update only `self.viewer.player` of the window in scope, so the other window's clip keeps the old rate/volume while its slider/label reads the new value.
fix: Apply the app-wide value in one pass over every window's viewer (`in_every_window`).

title: "Share at" position stash is set even when the forward picker did not open or was toggled shut
trigger: Play a video, Share at 1:23 while the forward draft is on a different chat/topic or the message cannot be forwarded (begin_forward_one shows a note or toggles/closes the picker), then forward the same message by another route and use Copy link.
effect: share_at is set after begin_forward_one returns, so a refused or closed picker leaves it behind; the next Copy link for that message carries the old second until the viewer item is reset.
fix: Carry the position inside the forward stage (`ForwardStage::Selecting { draft, at: Option<Secs> }`) so it lives and dies with the picker.

title: Transcribe can be requested again before TDLib reports Pending
trigger: Press the transcribe button on a voice note twice in quick succession.
effect: request_transcription sets no in-flight marker; the button stays offered until updateMessageContent brings SpeechRecognition::Pending, so a second recognizeSpeech goes out (may spend the free speech trial).
fix: Track a Requested stage in SpeechRecognition (None, Requested, Pending, Text, Error) set when the request is sent.

title: Keep original aspect ratio uses the unrotated ratio after Rotate
trigger: Set-sticker editor with a wide image: press Rotate once (crop, base item and orientation turn), then toggle Keep original aspect ratio off and on again.
effect: toggle_keep_ratio rebuilds the crop from original_ratio as if the image were unturned, so the crop is the wrong shape (cuts picture or leaves padding) for a quarter-turned base.
fix: Model the crop as an enum CropMode::{Full, KeepRatio} and derive the rect from the current orientation at use, instead of storing keep_ratio beside a crop that rotate/flip rewrite by hand.

title: Camera/save answers matched by a per-PhotoSources serial that is resolved through a moving photo_target()
trigger: Start the camera in the edit-profile dialog (serial 1), then an Edit-group box or New Group box with its own PhotoSources at serial 1 becomes the photo_target before the worker answers
effect: The late stream is attached to the other dialog's sources, or the answer is dropped and starting never clears
fix: Key the answer by (target owner, serial), or hold the answer task inside the PhotoSources that asked.

title: Slider quantisation can feed back into the colour while syncing controls
trigger: Type a hex colour; editor_sync_controls sets the three sliders to to_hsl(color); if a slider set_value emits Change with a stepped value, editor_slider_moved sees hsl differ and rewrites colour and hex
effect: Colour drifts by a rounding step and the hex field is rewritten under the caret
fix: Ignore slider events raised by programmatic set_value (a guard enum on the editor) or derive sliders from colour only.

title: Playlist rows decide 'playing' from a bare message id
trigger: Play a track in the Playlist page of user U in one chat, then open the same track's Playlist (same file id, so same playlist_message_id) while another chat is open. active compares playback.playing_audio with the synthetic id only, and toggle_audio_playback gets chat = open_chat or ChatId(0).
effect: A row can show playing/paused for playback that belongs to another chat key, and a press toggles the other chat's playback.
fix: Compare the full (ChatId, MessageId) owner key, as ChatMessage does, instead of the bare message id.

title: Playlist page shows 'Loading' forever when the playlist is not in the cache
trigger: open_playlist_ui sets playlist_user for a user whose playlist entry is missing (evicted, never fetched, fetch failed). empty is playlist.is_none(); the text picks PROFILE_LOADING and no fetch is asked here.
effect: A spinner-like text with nothing coming; only Close is a way out.
fix: Fetch<Playlist> per user (idle, loading, ready, failed) and ask for the playlist when the page opens.

title: Spoiler reveal fades are keyed by bare chat id and message id, not account
trigger: Reveal a spoiler in a chat open in two accounts, switch account within 200 ms.
effect: Cover fade state read by the other account's same chat/message key.
fix: RevealKey uses AccountChat/ChatMessage owner keys.

title: Dust starts from where a row was last painted, which can be stale or off screen
trigger: Select several messages, scroll so some are out of view (or select some, scroll away and back elsewhere), then Delete.
effect: PAINTED keeps each row's last painted bounds until 4096 entries pile up, and begin_vanish uses them as they are. A selected row painted at another scroll offset makes its dust appear over other rows at the old position.
fix: Record the frame or scroll generation with each painted bound and use it only when it is from the current frame of that window, else crumble without dust.

title: A set sticker's New Sticker box can open with an older cover frame than the one chosen
trigger: Open the video editor for an owned sticker set, drag the cover head to a new frame and press Done before that frame's still cut lands.
effect: finish_set_video_editor takes editor.preview, which is the last landed still, not the still for edits.cover_ms. The cut in flight is then dropped because the editor is gone. The New Sticker box shows the previous cover frame, while the job encodes the chosen one.
fix: Keep the preview's frame time with it (preview: Option<(i64, PathBuf)>). When it does not match edits.cover_ms, the box asks for the cut itself instead of taking a stale picture.

title: clear_clip leaves speed_preview set, so a viewer whose speed drag was cut off keeps its controls up and shows a stale speed
trigger: In the media viewer, open the speed popover and drag its slider, then close the viewer (Esc, or the clip ends and the next opens) before the drag's Release reaches the slider. Open another video.
effect: speed_preview is cleared only by set_playback_speed (on Release or a preset). clear_clip resets seek_preview and volume_dragging but not speed_preview, so VideoControlsState::dragging() stays true: the controls never hide, and the speed label shows the preview instead of the real speed.
fix: One gesture value: enum ControlsDrag { None, Seek(f64), Volume, Speed(f64) }, reset whole by clear_clip.

title: A file player stuck in Opening asks for a display frame every vsync with no limit
trigger: Open a clip whose backend never reports ready nor failed (AVPlayer item stuck unknown, a decoder that hangs opening).
effect: awaiting counts as animating while state is Opening regardless of AWAIT_PICTURE, so the element requests the next frame every vsync for as long as the view is shown (CPU/battery).
fix: Bound the Opening wait too (an open deadline that fails the player), or let the 50 ms open poll drive redraws instead of per-vsync frame requests.

title: Player::seek clears `eof` but not `error`, so a clip that hit a decode error keeps reporting it after a seek that works
trigger: Play a video with a corrupt stretch so decoding fails mid-way (State::error set), then seek back to a good part (or let a looping inline clip loop).
effect: seek() resets eof, the queue and the clock, and the decode thread resumes decoding, but State::error stays Some; Player::error() and FfmpegBackend::status().failed keep saying the clip failed, so the transport stays Failed although pictures decode again.
fix: Hold the decode stage as one value: `enum Decoding { Running, Ended, Failed(String), Stopped }` that a seek replaces whole (Failed -> Running when the seek is accepted).

title: A group bot user whose getUser send failed is never asked again
trigger: Open a group whose bot_commands name unknown bots while the sender is failing.
effect: asked_bot_users.insert(user_id) happens before the send; on send error the id stays in the set, so later ticks skip it and the bot's commands never show in the / menu for the session.
fix: Insert into asked only after a successful send, or keep a Fetch<()> per user.

title: One shared emoji.failed bool is cleared by any emoji_set_request, hiding an earlier failure
trigger: A status change send fails (failed=true, status_note set), then another unrelated emoji pack request is sent.
effect: failed is reset to false by the unrelated request; the stage of the failed action is lost (status_note remains).
fix: Per-action Fetch<()> instead of a shared failed flag.

title: view_shown_trending_stickers clears the unread dots (is_viewed = true) before the request and does not undo them if the send fails; ensure_manager_covers marks covers_requested before ensure_media_files
trigger: Open Trending while the view request cannot be sent / covers fail to request.
effect: Unread dots are gone but TDLib never learns they were viewed; covers never retried while the box stays open.
fix: Mark viewed/requested only after the send succeeds.

title: Composer suggestions waiting for the installed sets stay in suggest_waiting_for_sets when the sets request fails
trigger: Sticker suggest mode 'installed only' with installed sets not loaded; getInstalledStickerSets fails.
effect: The GetInstalledStickerSets error path sets failed but not the waiting flag; composer_suggestions_idle stays false, so every typed emoji re-sends the sets request.
fix: enum Suggest { Idle, WaitingForSets{emoji}, Asking{emoji, request}, Showing{emoji} } cleared on error.

title: Messages marked watched while the pack loads never play if the pack load fails
trigger: An incoming lone emoji is read before the EmojiAnimations pack arrives and searchStickerSet fails
effect: autoplay_emoji_effects calls mark_watched(key) before wait(); failed() clears the waiting queue, so those messages are already watched and never play their effect this session, even after the two hour retry loads the pack
fix: Mark watched only when the effect is queued, or keep waiting messages across a failed attempt

title: Chat-row animation map is keyed by bare chat id in app-wide FrameUi, never reset on account switch and never pruned
trigger: Open the chat list of account A, switch to account B that has a chat with the same id (same private user), or scroll a row away while its online state changes and back
effect: The online dot or badge animates from the other account's or the stale last-seen state instead of snapping on first sight; the map grows with every chat id ever drawn
fix: Move RowFxMap into OnScreen (replaced whole on a switch) keyed by ChatId, and drop entries for rows not drawn this frame.

title: A deleted direct-messages conversation keeps its message count, revenue and banned flags
trigger: Delete a conversation in a channel's direct messages, then a new conversation with the same topic id is not reused but the maps grow; if TDLib reuses the id its old count shows until a page answers.
effect: forget_direct_topic removes only topics[chat][topic] and the open marker; message_counts and revenue (keyed by chat and topic) stay, so a stale N messages can show for a returning topic id.
fix: Key all per-conversation values inside the topic entry so removing the entry removes them.

title: One shared StickerPanel.failed flag is cleared by any successful sticker fetch
trigger: The installed-sets fetch fails (failed=true); the user switches to Archived, which loads (accept_archived_sticker_sets sets failed=false).
effect: The installed tab's error banner disappears with nothing retried; back on the installed tab the empty list has no failure shown.
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> values.

title: A messageEffect answer that parse_message_effect rejects becomes Unknown, so the effect id stays 'requested' forever
trigger: Open a chat with a message whose effect TDLib describes with a messageEffectType* constructor Quill does not know (or with id 0). load_message_effects sends getMessageEffect and calls mark_requested(effect_id). The answer reaches 'messageEffect' => None => return Ok(None), so it falls through to EnvelopePayload::Unknown.
effect: The Unknown arm only logs. MessageEffects::requested keeps the id, it never goes to by_id or failed, and wanted() skips it from then on. The effect never plays and is never asked for again. is_gone() stays false, so anything waiting on it keeps waiting until restart.
fix: Return Err(ParseError::MissingField) for a messageEffect the parser rejects. recover_failed_response then sends the request a synthetic error and StickersPurpose::GetMessageEffect fails the id. Better still, keep the effect's lookup as one enum per id (Requested/Ready/Gone) in place of three sets.

title: Stale local error and sticky 'Saved' in the bot edit box
trigger: Save with a too-long name (local_error set), fix the text; or save once, then edit again
effect: local_error is cleared only by the next Save press, so the red error stays while the user fixes the field; edit.saved is a counter never reset by further edits, so 'Saved' keeps showing over unsaved changes
fix: Derive the status from the current field values and a SaveStage enum that goes back to Editing on change

title: 'Could not stop the reply' stays on screen while a retry is Stopping
trigger: Press Stop, request fails (stop_failed=true), press Stop again
effect: stop_failed is cleared only in finish_pending_bot_stop; a new StopPendingMessage request does not clear it, so the row shows 'Stopping...' and 'Could not stop the reply' together until the stop succeeds
fix: Fold into a StopStage enum so entering Stopping leaves Failed (connect/bots.rs:688 stop_pending_bot_message sets Stopping)

title: 'Show more' join requests drops its error and a refused send
trigger: Click 'Show more' while another page is in flight (load_more returns Ok(None)) or the send fails (Err).
effect: Nothing happens and no note shows; the button looks dead.
fix: Report Err as a StatusNote and disable the button while join_request_latest is set (derive it from the Fetch stage).

title: Sent-hashtag memory and scroll reset happen before the send is refused
trigger: Type '#tag hello' and press Send where slow mode, rights, size limit or the paid confirm refuses the send.
effect: forget_scroll_on_return_to_latest and remember_sent_hashtags already ran, so the hashtag is remembered and the reader's saved scroll is dropped for a message that was not sent.
fix: Run them in deliver_live_send after the snapshots are accepted.

title: Tapping the same custom emoji again while its card shows does not restart the 6 s timer
trigger: Tap emoji X, wait 5 s, tap X again.
effect: custom_emoji_card_seen already equals the preview, so no new timer is spawned; the first timer clears the card 1 s later. Likewise the timer of one window clears the session-wide preview for another window showing it.
fix: Give each tap a token in the card state and compare it in the timer.

title: EmojiBarUi::sets_asked is set before the installed emoji set list request is sent and stays set when it is not sent
trigger: Premium user: the ':' suggestion builds while self.live is None or ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets fails to send (send_json error). The flag is set by mem::replace before the send; later queries pass list=false.
effect: The installed emoji sets are never listed for this composer, so custom emoji never appear in the suggestion bar until the composer UI is rebuilt (account switch / new window).
fix: Drop the UI flag and let the driver key the ask on its own request state (has_purpose / installed_loaded), or set it only on a successful send.

title: 'Watching animation' action sends the emoji of the first effect in the chat, not the one that started
trigger: Two effects in one chat (a Premium sticker effect or an older emoji effect still playing), then the partner's emoji effect starts
effect: find(|a| a.effect.chat_id == chat_id) returns the first Active of that chat, so message_emoji reads another message and the partner is told you watch the wrong emoji
fix: Carry the started effect (or its head id) in watched instead of (ChatId, String) and look it up by head.

title: Debounced emoji pack search still fires after the box is closed
trigger: Type in the emoji packs search, close the box within 300 ms
effect: close_emoji_sets does not bump emoji_set_keystroke, so the timer still matches: search_emoji_packs runs, switches the session tab to Search and sends searchEmojiSets for a closed box (wasted request, stale found_sets)
fix: Hold the debounce as a Task in the box state and drop it on close, or bump the keystroke in close_emoji_sets.

title: Emoji packs box: closing does not cancel the debounced search or clear the search field
trigger: Open Settings > Emoji sets, type 'cat', close the box within 300 ms (search goes out with the box closed and switches emoji.tab to Search); or type 'cat', wait, close and reopen.
effect: A search request runs for a closed box; on reopen the field still reads 'cat' while the list and tab show Installed until the field is edited.
fix: Hold the box as one value (open, tab, query, keystroke token) that close_emoji_sets drops; bump the token and clear the field on close/open.

title: Emoji set download notifies the whole app every 120 ms even while its box is closed
trigger: Start an emoji set download, close the Choose emoji set box (the download keeps going by design).
effect: Wasted work: QuillApp is notified and redrawn about 8 times a second for the whole download, with no progress drawn anywhere.
fix: Notify only while the box is open (or give the progress its own entity that the box observes).

title: Word emoji bar stays expanded after it is closed by typing
trigger: Hover a lit word, click the chevron to open the grid, keep typing so the word is no longer highlighted (sync_emoji_words unhovers), then hover another lit word
effect: Only settle_word_bar(Close), Esc and pick call bar.reset(); the sync, block and turn-off paths unhover without it, so the next word bar opens already expanded and scrolled
fix: Make closing the word bar one function (unhover) that also resets the shared EmojiBarUi, or give each bar its own EmojiBarUi.

title: A Failed inline query for the current (chat, bot, query) is never re-asked
trigger: A first-page inline query fails (network).
effect: maybe_dispatch_inline_query returns early because the slot matches (fresh), so retyping the same query does nothing; the user must change the query text.
fix: Treat Failed as not fresh, or offer retry from the status line.

title: autoplayed_gifs is marked before the GIF starts
trigger: A GIF autoplays but its file is outside the sandbox or waits for download (play_when_ready).
effect: The row is marked autoplayed even though nothing played, so it is never autoplayed again this visit; tapping still works.
fix: Mark in gif_started.

title: Copy Option Link and Delete Item ignore a send error
trigger: Poll option menu, Copy Option Link or Delete Item while the request cannot be sent (not connected, chats path inactive).
effect: The menu closes and nothing happens; no status note (the comment relies on message_action_note, which only hears TDLib answers).
fix: Turn the Err arm into StatusNote::error like the other menu rows.

title: Save to Saved Messages says it needs a live account when only the user id or draft is missing
trigger: Message menu, Save to, Saved Messages while connected but my_user_id is not yet known (or the draft cannot be built).
effect: The else arm shows the demo note 'Saved Messages needs a live account' instead of an error, and the menu closes.
fix: Match live, me and draft separately and give each missing piece its own outcome.

title: Report details text survives Cancel and shows in the next report
trigger: Open a report, reach the details step, type a comment, press Close; later report anything (any chat) up to the details step.
effect: The text area still holds the old comment, which is sent with the new report if the user does not notice. close_message_report never clears report_text (only a send does).
fix: Reset the text field in the single place that ends the flow (the ReportBox going back to Closed).

title: Report and Save-as-HTML end the selection with clear_forward, which toasts 'Forward cancelled'
trigger: Select a message, click Report N (or Save as HTML)
effect: A 'Forward cancelled' note appears although nothing was forwarded
fix: Split ending a selection (no toast) from cancelling a forward; ForwardStage transition without the note.

title: After the effect card fades out the strip's hover animation stays paused until the menu closes
trigger: Right-click Send, pick an effect (card shows), click the card to hide it, hover another strip cell.
effect: preview stays Some with hiding set after it faded (it is never cleared), so paused = open.preview.is_some() is true and hovered cells only show their first frame.
fix: Clear open.preview when it has faded (or compute paused from hiding.is_none()), i.e. make the card stage an enum with a Gone variant.

title: MessageName status head is keyed by the bare message id
trigger: Two chats show a premium sender status on messages with the same numeric id
effect: status_head hashes (surface, message_id, status_id) with no chat, so both views share one play head: a loop count spent in one chat is spent in the other
fix: Key the head by ChatMessage

title: Account switch leaves the set box's encode running and its editor files behind
trigger: Press Done on a video sticker, switch account
effect: OnScreen is replaced whole; the empty Farewell does not set the encode cancel flag nor call CreateSticker::discard, so ffmpeg keeps running to completion and the editor PNG/preview stay in temp
fix: Farewell calls reset()

title: In the masks box one pending change disables Add on every row
trigger: Press Add on one archived mask set
effect: mask_change_pending() is not keyed by set, so all rows show loading and disabled until the answer
fix: Key the pending test by set id as for stickers

title: Retry on a failed thread open ignores a send error
trigger: Thread open fails, press Retry while the connection is down.
effect: retry_thread() sets threads.thread = None then open_thread; on Err the result is dropped with let _, so the failed pane disappears with no toast and the view is left on the chat with no explanation.
fix: Surface the Err as a StatusNote error (as open_thread_view does) and keep the Failed status.

title: pump_translation reports 'changed' on every tick in a demo session when the bar is no longer offered
trigger: Screenshot demo (live is None): chat is translated and translate_bar_model becomes None (bar hidden, setting off).
effect: The None arm clears chat_to only through self.live, then returns true unconditionally; with no live client chat_to is never cleared, so every poll pass returns true and the poll loop redraws every tick.
fix: Return true only when chat_to actually changed (clear it on demo_session too).

title: Widgets start at the main window's scale even in a chat window on another display
trigger: Put the main window on a 1x display and a chat window on a 2x (Retina) display; open a widget message in the chat window.
effect: WidgetsUi::scale is written only by the main window's render (app_render/mod.rs), so start_widget picks the main window's device-pixel ratio for every widget: a widget in the chat window on the 2x display is rendered at 1x and drawn blurry (or at 2x and wasted memory the other way round). If the main window never drew (started hidden to the tray), every widget starts at the 2x default.
fix: Keep the scale per window (in Passes, written by each window's frame start) and start a widget at the scale of the window it is shown in.

title: A released swipe re-resolves its action when it fires, so a chat state change in the 150 ms spring-back flips the action
trigger: Swipe a row past the threshold with Mute configured while the chat is unmuted, release; another device (or a sync) mutes the chat within 150 ms.
effect: poll() returns only the chat id; chat_swipe_ui.rs:290 perform_swipe_action recomputes the label from current facts, so the action run is Unmute while the panel showed Mute. Tiny window.
fix: Store the resolved SwipeLabel in Release and fire exactly that action.

title: A deferred caption for a pending media message is never dropped if the pending message is deleted or cancelled
trigger: Send a photo, press Up to edit the caption while it is uploading, then delete/cancel the pending message so no updateMessageSendSucceeded or Failed arrives for it.
