effect: The DeferredCaption stays in session.messages.deferred_captions for the life of the account (only run_deferred_caption on a send outcome removes it). Small leak; no wrong send since temp ids are not reused.
fix: Drop deferred captions in the message-delete reducer, or keep the caption on the pending message row as a PendingSend::CaptionEdited variant so it dies with the row.

title: Two separate adjacent quotes become one quote after markup round trip
trigger: Quote line 1 and quote line 2 as two separate block quotes on adjacent lines, then send or reopen the draft.
effect: The markup writes '> a\n> b' and push_quote_line (markup_parser.rs:167) merges consecutive quote lines, so the distinct quote spans are merged; to_final_markup sees from_markup(markup) != self and falls back to the same text.
fix: Separate adjacent quotes need an explicit marker in markup, or normalize them to one in the doc.

title: close_open_chat / send_open_chat / close_chat_window register a pending request and do not take it when the send fails
trigger: closeChat or openChat send returns Err
effect: session.request(..) entry stays in requests.pending for the life of the session (every other site calls requests.take(extra)); chat_window.rs:107, composer.rs:349 and :360
fix: Use the send-or-take helper (send_json_request) in these three sites.

title: One session-wide mention_search is searched against session.open_chat, shared by main and chat-window composers
trigger: Type '@x' in a chat window composer while the main window shows another group or no chat
effect: search_mentions uses session.open_chat (the main window's chat unless the caller entered the window view) and stores a single Option, so a window can show or clear the other window's suggestions
fix: Key the search by (window, chat) or store it in the window's ChatUi.

title: ensure_emoji_pack_covers marks covers requested before ensure_media_files succeeds
trigger: Open the pack browser when the media request send fails.
effect: Those set covers are never requested again.
fix: Insert into covers_requested only after the download request went out.

title: GIF search asks the inline bot with the main window's open chat, not the chat of the panel's window
trigger: Open the GIF panel in a chat window while the main window shows another chat (or none).
effect: getInlineQueryResults carries the wrong chat id (0 when none).
fix: Pass the asking window's chat into search_gifs.

title: delete_selected ignores can_be_deleted_for_all_users that delete_confirmed honors
trigger: Select several own old messages in a basic group and Delete for everyone
effect: revoke is sent as true when all are outgoing; TDLib refuses the ones past the window and the whole batch fails
fix: Pass per-message can_revoke into the selection delete

title: LiveSender notes the retry stash after td_send, so a fast 429 answer can be handled before the request is stashed
trigger: A retryable read is rate limited and answered on the receive thread before send_json returns.
effect: take_retained finds nothing, the retry is skipped, and the later note leaves a stash entry nobody removes (cleared only when 256 fill up).
fix: Insert into the stash before td_send and remove it when the send fails.

title: fetch_attached_sticker_sets replaces sticker_set_view with a loading placeholder, overwriting any open set box
trigger: Open a sticker set box, then choose Attached Stickers in the media viewer menu.
effect: The open set view is replaced by an empty set-0 view; the set the user was viewing is gone.
fix: Keep attached lookup as its own stage that opens the set view only on its answer.

title: Swept searchEmojis requests free their slot without counting a failure
trigger: A searchEmojis request is dropped by the stale sweep (offline, TDLib never answers)
effect: retain_in_flight removes the entry but failures[query] is not incremented, so wants(query) stays true and the same query is asked again after every sweep instead of stopping after ATTEMPTS; failures also grows by one entry per failing query for the session
fix: Make retain_in_flight call failed() for each removed request

title: Two quick set switches can leave the saved choice different from the drawn set
trigger: Click Noto then Twemoji (both downloaded) within one frame
effect: switch_emoji_set stores each switch in the single switch_task slot; the older task is dropped but its background load_state + save_current(Noto) can still run after save_current(Twemoji), so 'current' on disk is Noto while Twemoji is drawn; next launch shows the other set
fix: Serialize the switch: one SwitchStage enum with the target set; apply only the latest and save on the UI side after applying

title: Two installs of the same emoji set share one temp folder and one .old folder, so overlapping installs corrupt each other
trigger: Start downloading set X, press Download X again (the first download is cancelled but its worker is already inside unpack), or run 'Install from file' for X while a download of X is finishing.
effect: Both unpack calls use '.<name>.<pid>.part' and '.<name>.old': one remove_dir_all wipes the other's half-extracted files, so the install fails with 'damaged'/'Couldn't save' or the .old rollback restores the wrong pack.
fix: Name the temp folder with a per-call serial (as copy::part_path does) or serialise installs per EmojiSetId.

title: BoundedKeys clears the whole set at 16384 keys, which replays played effects and drops unplayed ones
trigger: A long session with many effect messages (or a busy chat history paged repeatedly) fills `watched`; the next insert clears it, and a history page that re-notes an incoming unread effect message makes it unwatched again, so it plays a second time. Filling `unwatched` first drops effects that never played.
effect: An effect replays on its own after scrolling back, or a sent or unread effect never plays.
fix: Evict the oldest keys (an LRU or a per-chat map dropped with the chat) instead of clearing everything.

title: Result bars of 0% show for a poll that is yet unsent or scheduled
trigger: View a scheduled or unsent poll in a chat
effect: poll_shows_results is true for any vote_restriction_reason, including YetUnsent and Scheduled, so zero-percent bars replace the option choices
fix: Show results only for reasons where the user can never vote and results exist (Closed, Country, Membership), not for YetUnsent/Scheduled.

title: Previews are matched by URL only and evicted while Asked; more than KEPT composers re-ask
trigger: More than eight composers/windows with distinct links typed at once
effect: An Asked entry is evicted before its answer, the answer is dropped and the chip asks again
fix: Never evict Asked entries, or key the answer by request id

title: Cache eviction of reply-bar fetches drops entries by smallest key, not by age, and a Loaded copy is never refreshed
trigger: Reply to an old message that was fetched with getMessage, then the original is edited (or others evict it)
effect: The bar keeps the stale text of a fetched copy (edits arrive only for rows in a history); eviction can remove another window's target and refetch
fix: Keep fetch order (insertion index) for eviction, and apply updateMessageContent to Loaded copies

title: last_callback_answer and last_login_url_info are single slots drained on poll, a second answer overwrites the first
trigger: Press two inline buttons (or two login buttons) before the poll drains the first answer
effect: The first button's toast, alert or URL is lost; login answer is not matched to the press that asked (login_url_request is also one slot)
fix: Queue answers keyed by request id, or key each by (chat, message, button)

title: Inline query pages are matched by (chat, bot) only, an older response lands on a newer query
trigger: Type an inline query, change the text quickly; the older answer returns last
effect: The picker shows results of the previous query text (acknowledged in the ponytail comment; the UI debounces)
fix: Put a query generation in BotsPurpose::GetInlineQueryResults and compare it with the slot

title: Set-edit counter and toast are shared by every edit of the set
trigger: Open an owned set, rename it, close the box, reopen it and start a second edit before the first one answers.
effect: The first answer decrements the new view's pending counter, so busy() is false while the second edit is still in flight; two answers also overwrite the single creator_note so one toast is lost.
fix: Hold the edits in flight as a set of RequestIds on the view (answers matched by id) and queue notes.

title: Emoji-set list failure is recorded only for the tab on screen at error time
trigger: Open Emoji Sets (Installed tab), switch to Trending before the installed list answers, let the installed request fail, switch back.
effect: emoji.failed is not set (tab differs) and no request is in flight, so Installed shows an empty loading state with no Retry until the tab is toggled again; emoji_set_request also clears the shared failed flag for unrelated requests.
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> (installed, trending, search) so each list owns its stage.

title: A mask list answer sent before a mutation can land after it and re-mark the list loaded
trigger: Manage Masks: open (list requested), remove a set; finish_mask_mutation clears installed_loaded, then the earlier getInstalledMaskSets answer arrives.
effect: accept_installed_mask_sets sets installed_loaded = true with the pre-mutation list, so the removed set shows as installed and nothing refetches.
fix: Tag list requests with a mutation generation, or hold installed/archived as Fetch<Vec<_>> invalidated by the mutation.

title: Message effect badge lookups only cover the main window's open chat
trigger: Open a chat with messages sent with effects in a chat window (not the main window's chat).
effect: message_effect_ids_in_view reads session.open_chat only, so the badge's effect description is not asked for in a chat window; the badge icon stays empty until the main window shows that chat.
fix: Collect effect ids over chats_shown() (all windows' views) instead of open_chat.

title: chat_preview_fetch is one slot not keyed by request: a late answer for an older preview overwrites the newer one
trigger: Peek chat A in the chat list, then peek chat B quickly (fetch_chat_preview_history sets the slot to None and sends B), then A's slower answer lands, then B's answer lands first in a reordered case.
effect: If B's answer arrives before A's, A's answer replaces it; the preview of B filters by chat_id and shows no rows and no retry.
fix: Store the slot as a Fetch<PreviewHistory> carrying the request id (or a map by chat) and apply only the answer whose id is current.

title: draft_dirty is set before the save and cleared only when a send succeeds
trigger: Type in a chat so mark_draft_dirty runs, then have send_draft fail (sender closed, rich input missing) and stay away from that composer.
effect: The dirty key stays in messages.draft_dirty, so set_remote_draft, updateNewChat and thread info skip every remote draft for that slot (a draft written on another device never shows) until a later save succeeds.
fix: Make the draft slot an enum (Clean, Dirty, Saving(RequestId)) and settle it on the error arm and when the composer leaves the slot.

title: GIF search results are kept under the current query, not the query the page answered
trigger: Search GIFs for 'cat', then 'dog'; the 'cat' page already sent but not cancelled (cancel_gif_search_requests drops only requests still pending in the registry).
effect: accept_gif_search_results calls searches_kept.keep(&gifs.search_query, ...) with the current query; if an old answer slips through it is stored and shown under 'dog'. Today cancellation makes this unlikely.
fix: Carry the query in StickersPurpose::GetGifSearchResults and compare it in the acceptor.

title: updateChatReplyMarkup is dropped whole when its message fails to parse, leaving the old keyboard
trigger: A bot sends a new reply keyboard attached to a message whose content Quill's parse_message rejects (an unsupported or malformed field).
effect: parse_message(m)? fails the whole update (no @extra, so it is not recovered); the chat keeps showing the previous bot keyboard (or none) until the chat is reloaded.
fix: Parse only reply_markup and id from reply_markup_message, or degrade to message_id with no markup instead of failing the update.

title: ui_send is an app-wide slot not keyed to the command or account that produced it
trigger: A composer send under the driver whose agent_route_send runs in a deferred effect after the step's take (a with_injecting deferred half), then an account switch or another command.
effect: AgentBridge::ui_send is a QuillApp (app-wide) Option taken after each step by whichever command runs next; it carries chat_id but no account or command id, so a late send would be delivered with another command's reply, possibly after a switch to another account.
fix: Carry the request id (and screen epoch) in UiSend and only take a send whose id matches the running command; drop it on screen change.

title: A poll task of a closed create dialog can finish a reopened dialog with the old name and username
trigger: Press Create, Cancel, reopen Create bot (another link/button) within 150 ms and press Create again
effect: The old poll task keeps its captured name/full and only checks bot_create_dialog.is_none(); with a new dialog present it keeps running and whichever poller sees created first closes the dialog, toasts and resolves the deep link with the old username
fix: Key the poller by a dialog token (like version) and stop when it differs, or drop polling for an answer-driven stage

title: Fill loop quits when no window can be updated, leaving the box 'Loading' with Save off
trigger: Open Edit bot, the opening window closes and the main window handle is unavailable (hidden/closed) before the texts arrive
effect: find_map returns None when neither window handle updates; 'filled != Some(false)' is true for None so the loop breaks and filled stays false forever; Save is disabled until the box is reopened
fix: Retry on None, or fill from the answer in the window that renders the box

title: Verify box returns to the list as if done before TDLib answers
trigger: Pick a chat, press Verify/Remove while TDLib will reject it (not allowed, flood)
effect: submit_bot_verify returns true once the request is sent, so the box goes back to Pick and shows a 'Verifying...' toast; the failure only sets chat_action_error elsewhere and the row stays unverified with no per-box error
fix: Add a Step::Sending(chat) that leaves on the answer and shows the error in the box

title: Opening Add-bot / Share-game by deep link replaces whatever ProfileDialog is open
trigger: Edit Contact box open with typed changes, click a t.me/<bot>?startgroup= or ?game= link.
effect: open_add_bot_dialog/open_share_game_dialog overwrite the single profile_dialog slot (EditContact, Birthday, ...) without closing or asking; the typed edits are lost and returning shows nothing.
fix: Queue the new box behind the open one or refuse while a ProfileDialog with edits is open.

title: Restart after Unblock is sent even when the unblock failed or was deduped
trigger: Bot chat blocked, press Restart while offline or while an unblock is already in flight.
effect: unblock_peer ignores its own result and always calls start_bot_from_bar when restart is set, so /start is sent to a still-blocked bot and the unblock error note is replaced by 'Starting bot'.
fix: Run the restart only on the Ok(Some) arm, or chain it on the unblock answer.

title: Wallpaper file picker answer is applied to whichever chat look dialog is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Click From file in chat A's look dialog, leave the native picker open, close the dialog (Esc) and open chat B's look dialog, then pick a file
effect: The file becomes chat B's pending wallpaper and Apply uploads it to B
fix: Capture the dialog's target (LookTarget) when the picker starts and apply the path only if the open dialog still has that target.

title: A due swipe action runs after the passcode lock
trigger: Swipe a chat row past the threshold, lift the finger, lock Quill (shortcut or idle timer) within the 20 ms poll.
effect: poll_swipe calls perform_swipe_action without refused_while_locked: a mute/pin/archive is applied under the lock and Delete opens its confirm box (hidden until unlock).
fix: Drop the gesture in the lock's close_for_lock and check refused_while_locked in poll_swipe.

title: ChatUi of a chat the reducer closed survives and is kept on reopen
trigger: Have a reply bar / rich editor / pending delete box in chat A, A is removed or left from elsewhere so session.open_chat becomes None, then open A again.
effect: sync_chat_ui returns when open_chat is None and nothing calls leave_chat_ui; enter_chat_ui then sees chat_ui.chat==Some(A) and keeps the stale value, so old bars and open flags come back.
fix: Have sync_chat_ui replace the value with ChatUi::for_chat(None) when open_chat is None.

title: Attach picker answer is applied while the passcode lock is on
trigger: Open the attach picker (portal, non-modal), lock Quill, choose files.
effect: spawn_screen continuation runs attach_picked_in under the lock: files are added to the tray and check_tray_videos starts ffprobe reads while locked.
fix: Wait for the unlock with wait_for_unlock like os_open, or drop the answer on locked_since(count).

title: confirm_delete starts the vanish effect before the delete is issued
trigger: Confirm Delete when delete_confirmed fails (client closing, flood).
effect: begin_vanish records dust for the rows first; the Err arm only notes, so the message plays its disintegration though it still exists.
fix: Start the vanish on the Ok arm only.

title: clear_draft_on_success is set before the ack and never cleared on failure
trigger: Send a rich message or voice note that fails; the Option<DraftClear> (whole_composer matches any stored text) stays set. A later successful send in that chat pushes draft_clears.
effect: finish_successful_sends (spawn_call_notification.rs:376) then matches the stale flag and clears the chat's draft if the composer is idle, though the draft was not the sent one.
fix: Key the flag by request id / send token and drop it on the error arm and on chat or account change.

title: Composer link/date/code-language boxes are not closed or re-keyed on a chat change
trigger: Open Formatting > Date (or Add Link / Code Language) on a selection in chat A, then change the open chat by a notification click, link or agent while the box is open, and Save.
effect: The boxes live in ComposerUi (not ChatUi) holding a byte range plus selected text; the only guard is that the text at the range still equals the remembered string. If chat B's draft has the same text there, the date/link is applied to the wrong chat's draft.
fix: Move the three boxes into ChatUi so enter_chat_ui replaces them.

title: 'Send as a document' for an edit replacement is window state, the edit is chat state
trigger: Tick 'Send as a document' while editing media in chat A, switch to chat B that has its own edit in progress, pick a replacement file.
effect: edit_replace_as_file lives in ComposerUi (per window) and is reset only in begin_edit and clear_edit_replacement; chat B's edit inherits chat A's choice.
fix: Store as_file in EditMediaReplacement / MediaEdit in the ChatUi.

title: Link, date and Code Language dialogs belong to the composer, not to the chat shown
trigger: Select text in chat A, press Ctrl+K (link_dialog stores a byte range plus the selected string), then change chat by keyboard/link while the box is open and press Save in a chat whose composer holds the same text at that range.
effect: The link or language is applied to chat B's composer text. The only guard is text equality of the range, not the chat.
fix: Put the three composer boxes into ChatUi (replaced when the chat or topic changes) or store the SendSlot in each and refuse when it differs.

title: Any pending outgoing message newer than the view counts as 'the reader just sent it' and scrolls the history to the end
trigger: Scroll up in a chat in the main window. Forward a message into that chat from a chat window, or have the agent send one into it.
effect: sent_since takes any is_outgoing && pending() message after the newest one as the reader's own send in this view. The main window jumps to the bottom and loses the reader's place, although the send came from another window or the agent.
fix: Mark sends made from this view (the composer's send records its local id in the window's ChatUi) and test that mark, not just pending outgoing state.

title: A dismissed one-time bot keyboard is remembered per window, not per chat
trigger: Open a bot chat with a one-time reply keyboard in a chat window, press a button (the keyboard hides there), and look at the same chat in another window while offline or before TDLib's updateChatReplyMarkup lands.
effect: MessageUi lives in the WindowSlot, so dismissed_keyboards and collapsed_keyboards keyed (chat, message) apply only in the window that pressed. The other window keeps showing the one-time keyboard until TDLib clears the markup, and an offline dismissal never reaches it.
fix: Keep the dismissed set per chat with its owner, keyed AccountChat, in the session's per-chat reply-markup state, which every window reads. Keep collapsed (a per-view choice) per window if that is intended.

title: Archive build error note is shown in whatever chat is open, and the 'Preparing the archive' note is never settled when the person moved on
trigger: Drop a large folder on the 'Send as archive' zone in chat A, switch to chat B (same account) before zipping ends and let the build fail (too large, unreadable file), or let it succeed.
effect: archive_ready checks send_slot() only in the Ok arm; the Err arm sets an error StatusNote for the current chat B, and the Ok-but-moved-on early return leaves the earlier 'Preparing the archive' note unreplaced until it times out. No in-flight marker exists, so a second drop starts a second zip.
fix: Make the archive job a stage value keyed by SendSlot (Building(slot) -> Ready/Failed) owned by the slot's composer state, and apply both arms only when the key still matches.

title: A finished archive for another chat is dropped silently and leaves the 'Preparing the archive' note
trigger: Drop a folder on the 'one archive' zone, then open another chat before zipping ends.
effect: archive_ready returns when send_slot() differs and sets no note, so the 'Preparing the archive...' note stays until something else replaces it and the user never learns the archive was discarded.
fix: Carry the preparing note as a stage tied to the slot and clear or replace it in every arm of archive_ready.

title: sets_asked is set before the installed-sets request and never cleared on failure
trigger: Premium user with an empty installed list; the first suggestion bar build sends while the client is not ready, or the list request errors
effect: sets_asked flips to true before ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets and its Result is dropped, so the installed list is not asked for again on this account: custom emoji never appear in the suggestion bar until the emoji box or panel loads the list
fix: Use the session's Fetch state for the installed emoji sets (idle/loading/ready/failed) and ask only from idle or failed.

title: Emoji effects and anchors are thread-locals keyed by chat id only, not by account
trigger: Tap a big emoji in a chat with user U on account A, switch within 2 s to account B where chat id U is also shown
effect: ACTIVE keeps A's effect (retain keeps it when its chat id is shown) and B's window can play it over B's message with the same ids; ANCHORS entries of other chats also survive the switch
fix: Key by OfAccount<ChatMessage> and clear both on the OnScreen swap (Farewell), or move them into OnScreen.

title: A pending emoji effect gets its START_WAIT clock when a window takes it, not when it arrived, so taps queued while locked play late
trigger: Open a 1:1 chat, lock Quill; the partner taps the big emoji several times; unlock. The locked window never runs emoji_effect_overlay, so the session's pending queue (up to MAX_PENDING) waits.
effect: At the unlock the old effects start (queued = now) if the emoji's anchor is still noted, and 'watching' is sent for taps long past (tdesktop drops after kMaxDelay).
fix: Stamp EmojiEffect with its arrival time in the session and drop it in take_pending/advance_effects when older than START_WAIT.

title: Quick set switches can save a different choice than the one shown
trigger: Click set A then set B within a frame or two
effect: switch_task is replaced but A's background closure may already be running and calls save_current(A) after B's save, so the saved choice is A while the UI shows B until restart
fix: Save the choice on the UI thread in the apply step (only the latest task applies), not in the background closure.

title: Closing the results panel (Esc) does not cancel an armed 100 ms query
trigger: Type '@bot q' then press Esc within 100 ms.
effect: close_inline_results clears inline_query_armed but the timer's token still matches, so the query is sent anyway (panel stays closed, wasted request).
fix: Bump the token on close.

title: flush_inline_return scans the bot chat history every frame while a return waits
trigger: A return is waiting after the start was sent and the bot never answers with a switch-inline button.
effect: Each frame walks all loaded messages; never ends (no way out).
fix: Give the Started stage an expiry and stop scanning.

title: One shared message_menu_actions slot is cleared by any window's menu, viewer or profile photo ask
trigger: With a message menu open in a chat window, step the main window's viewer or open a profile photo (each calls fetch_message_menu_actions, which sets the slot to None).
effect: The open menu's rows fall back to the local guesses (delete for all, edit, pin rows can appear or vanish) until the other answer lands and overwrites the slot with another message's actions that the menu then ignores.
fix: Key the answers by (chat, message) in a small map, or per window view, instead of one slot that every asker resets.

title: Most menu items close the menu without close_message_menu, so reaction options and the paid-reaction offer are not reset
trigger: Open the message menu on a message (reaction options are asked), pick Reply or any row, then open another menu quickly.
effect: close_message_menu is the only place that calls reset_message_reactions (Idle, paid.offered=None); the ~40 direct `menu = None` sites skip it, leaving the old message's options/offer in the session until the next fetch overwrites them.
fix: Make closing the menu one function (or the Drop of the menu stage) that also resets the session's reaction state.

title: Effect badge registries are process-global thread-locals keyed by bare (chat, message) ids
trigger: Click a message effect badge, switch account in the same frame; or leave a badge unseen/seen entry while switching to an account that has a chat with the same id.
effect: BADGES, REPLAYS and the overlay's WAITING survive an account switch and carry no account, so a queued replay or seen-badge note can apply to the other account's message with the same ids (private chat ids and small message ids collide).
fix: Key them by AccountChat/ChatMessage owner keys and clear them in the OnScreen replacement (or own them in OnScreen).

title: WAITING is a process-wide thread-local keyed by bare (chat, message) with no account or window
trigger: Ask for a message effect in a private chat with contact X on account A (WAITING gets an entry for up to 30 s), switch to account B within that time and open the chat with the same contact (private chat ids equal user ids), where a message has the same numeric id and a drawn badge.
effect: retain() keeps the entry because the chat id is in B's shown set and badge::seen(key) is true, so A's effect id plays over B's message (or its lookup is asked on B's session).
fix: Hold the waiting list in OnScreen (per account, per window slot) and key it by ChatMessage; it then goes with the screen.

title: A lost getMessageEffect answer is never asked again
trigger: The request for an effect description is dropped (connection reset, logout race) without an error answer.
effect: effects.requested keeps the id, wanted() filters it out for ever, the Waiting entry times out after 30 s, and the effect never plays for the rest of the session.
fix: Make each effect id a Fetch<MessageEffect> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the loading arm left by the answer, the error and the owner going away.

title: wanted_reactor_tab intent can outlive its menu
trigger: Right-click a reaction chip on a message whose properties request fails or returns can_get_added_reactions false; later open the normal menu on the same message.
effect: The intent is only taken inside fetch_message_audience; if that never runs for this menu it stays and a later open of that message fetches a reactor tab nobody asked for.
fix: Carry the wanted tab in the menu's own state (message_ui.menu_ui) so it dies when the menu closes.

title: A failed reactor tab or viewer list shows 'no views' instead of an error
trigger: Open Seen/Reacted page when getMessageAddedReactions fails (Audience::Failed).
effect: The page has no rows and nothing loading, so it shows the empty text; there is no error and no retry (a tab already Failed is only re-asked by reselecting it).
fix: Draw an Audience::Failed arm with a Retry row.

title: 'Blocked' toast is shown when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Block a Replies sender while TDLib rejects blockMessageSenderFromReplies.
effect: submit_replies_block sets the success note NEW_CONTACT_BLOCK_DONE as soon as send_json returned Ok; the error answer then sets chat_action_error (users/error.rs:110), so the user sees 'blocked' followed by 'could not block'. The session's replies_block was also take()n before the send (connect/replies_block.rs:10), so a failed send cannot be retried from the box.
fix: Keep the box in a Submitting stage until the answer; show the note on the answer.

title: Vote tap is matched to an option by position, not option id
trigger: Poll updates (an option added/reordered via addPollOption or updatePoll) between the frame that drew the row and the click.
effect: The click closure captures `index` and vote_on_poll(chat, message, index) resolves it against the poll as it is at click time, so the vote can go to a different option than the one the user clicked.
fix: Pass option.id (PollOption::id) from the row and have the driver look it up.

title: Most message-menu closes skip reset_message_reactions
trigger: Open the menu on a message, pick a row that does `this.message_ui.menu = None` (e.g. menu_media_rows, menu_gift_row, menu_block_sender_row, open_message_report) instead of close_message_menu.
effect: The session keeps message_reaction_options (Loading/Ready for the old message) and payments.paid.offered until the next open; a late answer lands for a closed menu. Next open refetches, so only a stale strip for one frame at worst.
fix: One close_message_menu used at all 52 sites, or tie the reaction request state to the OpenMessageMenu value.

title: Debug-build arithmetic overflow on negative (pending) message ids
trigger: Send a message so its local id is negative (message.id.0 < 0 exists, session_forward.rs:166); the row passes `message.id.0 as u64`.
effect: text_at computes `msg_key.1 * 2 + ..`, fast_button_cell `message_id * 10 + n`, poll_option_row `message_id.0 as u64 * 64 + index`: u64 overflow panics in debug/test builds (release wraps; Cargo.toml has no overflow-checks).
fix: Use wrapping_mul / a hashed id (or a MessageKey newtype with a checked element id) for element ids.

title: 'Load full message' has no in-flight state
trigger: Tap Load full message on a partial rich message twice, or when the request fails silently.
effect: The button stays live after the request is sent, so every tap sends another getFullRichMessage and a toast; nothing shows that the first is loading or ties the answer to the message that asked.
fix: A per-message Fetch<()> in the session (idle/loading/failed) that the button reads.

title: 'Mark as read' on a notification posted before the lock still runs while locked
trigger: Notification shown; lock Quill; press Mark as read in the OS toast.
effect: drain_background_clicks runs MarkRead without refused_while_locked, so read receipts are sent for a chat under the lock (tdesktop only shows the window).
fix: Gate MarkRead (and Reply) on the lock; keep the click queued until the unlock.

title: File picked for a poll option lands on a row index that may have changed
trigger: Click the paperclip on row 3 -> Photo or video; while the native file panel is open (non-modal on some platforms) remove row 1 from the poll box; pick a file.
effect: take_poll_option_file(AttachTarget::Row(3)) attaches the media to whatever option is now at index 3 (or nothing), not the row that asked.
fix: Give each option row a stable id (OptionId) and target AttachTarget::Row(OptionId) so an answer is matched to the row that asked.

title: Quick-reply edit/add closes the edit state when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Edit a message, Save, server rejects it
effect: Field is cleared and editing ends though the text was not saved; the server error is a generic line
fix: Hold the text in a Saving stage until the shortcut update arrives or fails.

title: Reaction fly-up animation starts before the request and stays when the request fails
trigger: Add a reaction while offline or when toggle_reaction_choice returns Err
effect: The emoji flies up from the message though no reaction was added
fix: Set reaction_fly only on Ok from the driver call.

title: Reply in Another Chat drops the reply when the destination chat is not opened
trigger: With an agent driving the window that may not open the destination, pick a chat in Reply in Another Chat.
effect: The reply is cleared from this composer before select_chat_request, which returns false on refusal (agent_may_open) without restoring it; the note still says replying from another chat.
fix: Take the reply only after the open succeeded, or restore it on a false return.

title: The 15 ms drag poll never checks that a button is still down
trigger: Press on a row, release the button where no mouse-up reaches the window (another window grabbed it), move the pointer back
effect: selection_drag stays Some, the loop keeps polling and extends the range/autoscrolls with no button held, until the next click
fix: Stop the loop when window.pressed_button is None.

title: Rich-HTML export outcomes are polled only for the account on screen
trigger: Start Save as HTML in account A, switch to B before it ends
effect: The finished outcome stays in A's background driver; no toast until switching back, then a stale 'saved' toast
fix: Poll or drain outcomes per background account.

title: begin_vanish starts the delete effect before delete_selected is known to succeed
trigger: Delete messages when delete_selected returns Err (or the server refuses)
effect: The messages play the vanish animation and hide although they were not deleted
fix: Start the vanish effect when the deletion update arrives, not at the click.

title: The send-button morph lives in composer_ui, not ChatUi, so switching chats fades from the previous chat's button state
trigger: chat A shows Send (text typed), click chat B whose composer is empty (Record)
effect: a 120 ms cross-fade from A's glyph to B's runs on first draw (and requests animation ticks) although B's button never changed
fix: Key the SendMorph by chat (put it in ChatUi, replaced on chat change) so a new chat starts settled.

title: The send menu stays open (hidden) when the chat changes without a click, and reappears on return
trigger: Right-click Send in chat A, then switch to chat B with a keyboard shortcut or the quick switcher while the pointer still rests over the strip. send_menu_dismissed keeps the menu when the mouse is over a picker part; send_menu_overlay then draws nothing because viewed_chat != open.chat, but composer_ui.send_menu.open stays Some(chat A). Return to chat A.
effect: The old menu (and effect card) pops back up in chat A with a stale state; meanwhile its kit PopupMenu entity and subscriptions are held. Nothing closes the menu on a chat change.
fix: Close the send menu in the chat-change reset (sync_chat_ui / a Farewell of the composer), or make the stage a ChatUi field so it is replaced with the chat.

title: A sticker flight armed in a chat window that closes before it lands is never ended and the sent sticker stays hidden
trigger: Send a sticker from a chat window's panel and close that window within about 2 seconds, then open the same chat in the main window.
effect: FLY (a thread-local, not owned by the window) keeps window=Some(chat). send_fly_overlay returns None in every other window and only the owning window's overlay clears FLY, so wrap() keeps replacing the matching outgoing sticker with an empty placeholder in the main window until another sticker is sent or the app restarts.
fix: Own the flight in the WindowSlot (or end it from the window's Farewell); at least clear FLY when the window it names closes.

title: Validation messages sent as Silent notes are dropped while a toast is showing
trigger: Press Done with no emoji (EMOJI_REQUIRED_NOTE), or add to a full set, within 3-6 s of another toast
effect: ConnectionUi::set_note_in discards Silent notes while the current note is a toast; the user gets no reason why Done did nothing
fix: Use StatusNote::info for refusals the screen does not show by itself

title: The manager box shares the composer sticker panel's tab and open flag
trigger: Open the composer sticker panel on Favorites, then Settings > Manage sticker sets, close it
effect: open_archived_stickers sets the shared panel tab to Installed and close_sticker_panel closes the composer panel's state
fix: Give the manager its own tab state

title: Thread info card stays open when another thread opens in the same chat
trigger: Open a reply thread in a group, open the info card with the root bar's info button, press Back, open a different message's thread in the same group.
effect: thread_info_open is per ChatUi (chat), reset only by sync_chat_ui when the chat changes; the new thread of the same chat starts with the card already open.
fix: Key the card by thread id (Option<thread id>) or clear it in leave_thread_view / on thread change.

title: Account switch leaves the open selection translation job in the old session
trigger: Open Translate Selected Text, switch account while the box is open or the answer is pending.
effect: TranslateScreen is dropped with the screen but its Farewell is empty, so drop_text_translation is never sent to the old client: the job stays in that session's translate.jobs (counts toward MAX_IN_FLIGHT for its pump) and texts keeps the result until the process ends.
fix: Implement Farewell for TranslateScreen: drop the dialog's job through the old client.

title: Hiding the translate bar claims success when the request was not sent, and falls back to an app-wide hidden flag by bare chat id
trigger: Bar menu -> Hide while toggle_chat_is_translatable returns Err (no usable client), or the server rejects it.
effect: set_translate_bar_hidden ignores the answer: on Err it stores prefs.bar_hidden(chat_id.0) in the app-wide translate_prefs.json (shared by all accounts, keyed by bare ChatId, so the same user's chat in another account is hidden too), and hide_translate_bar always shows the 'hidden' toast with Undo. On a rejected request the bar stays and the toast lied.
fix: Key local hidden flags by AccountChat and show the toast from the server answer (update chat.is_translatable) rather than from the send.

title: Translation pump stops for the whole account if in-flight jobs are never answered
trigger: Twenty translateMessageText requests whose answers are lost (connection drop, dropped continuation).
effect: room = MAX_IN_FLIGHT - session.messages.translate.jobs.len(); jobs leave only when an answer or abandon_translation arrives. Stuck Pending jobs keep room at 0, so translated chats in every window stop translating new messages until restart.
fix: Give a job an expiry/owner (drop jobs of a closed connection) or count only jobs younger than a deadline on a manual clock.

title: A widget press or hover sticks when its bubble stops painting mid-gesture
trigger: Press on a widget message and scroll the history (wheel) so the bubble leaves the view before releasing, or switch chats while hovering it.
effect: The mouse-up/move handlers are only registered while the canvas paints, so entry.pressed stays Some and later moves reach the widget as a drag; entry.hovered stays true with no hover-leave.
fix: Release the press/hover when the widget is not drawn in a pass (the per-window seen pass already exists) or on window blur.

title: Canvases::read multiplies widget-supplied w*h*4 unchecked
trigger: A widget calls getImageData with huge width and height.
effect: Overflow panics in debug; in release it wraps, passes the length check and loops w*h times on the widget runtime thread (hang).
fix: checked_mul for w*h*4 and cap w*h at MAX_PIXELS; cap put_image's w*h the same way.

title: WidgetEntry::pressed sticks when the release never reaches the widget, turning later hovers into drags
trigger: Press and hold the mouse on a widget, scroll the history with the wheel (or let the widget restart) so its input layer is no longer under the pointer, release, then move the mouse over the widget again.
effect: The mouse-up listener is only registered while the widget's input layer is painted, and nothing clears `pressed` on hide, stop or restart. The next moves over the widget are sent as Pointer action 1 (a drag with the old button) instead of Hover, and the new runtime gets a release for a press it never saw, until the next full click.
fix: Hold the press in the live runtime state (`Live::press: Option<Press>`) so a stop or restart drops it, clear it in hide_widgets, and end it on a window-level mouse-up rather than the layer's.

title: New widget content keeps the old content's frame and height, so a new runtime that fails shows the old picture as 'stopped'
trigger: A bot edits a widget message to new HTML that fails to start (or crashes before its first frame) while the message is on screen.
effect: The identity change resets runtime, lifecycle, crashes and polled by hand but keeps frame and height. The Failed event then finds entry.frame set and records Lifecycle::Stopped, so the bubble keeps drawing the previous content's last frame with the stopped state instead of the failure; poll also carries over.
fix: On an identity change replace the entry's content-bound part whole (frame, height from the stored value, poll, live runtime), e.g. `entry.content = ContentState::new(identity)`.

title: Widget query tokens restart with every OnScreen while their answers queue in the account's Session, so an old answer can match a new query
trigger: Tap a widget control that sends a query to its bot (slow bot); before the answer, switch to another account; switch back and tap the same widget again before the old query is answered.
effect: WidgetsUi::last_query is reset to 0 by the account switch (OnScreen), but the pending getWidgetQueryAnswer belongs to the account's Session, which survives in the background and appends its answer to bots.widget_answers. After switching back the new runtime asks again with token 1; a late answer to the old token 1 for the same WidgetKey is delivered to the new query.
fix: Make query tokens process-wide (a static counter) or tag them with the ScreenEpoch, so a token is never issued twice for one account session.

title: A public data poll that is never answered leaves the widget in Poll::Asking for good
trigger: Watch a widget with public data; lose the connection or have TDLib drop the pending getWidgetPublicData without an answer (client restart).
effect: Poll::Asking is left only by a WidgetAnswer::PublicData. The error answer exists (bots/widgets.rs), but a request that is dropped with no answer leaves the entry asking, and schedule_widget_polls never polls it again until the entry is pruned or the screen is replaced; the widget's live data stops updating.
fix: Give Asking a deadline (`Asking { since: Instant }`) after which it returns to Due, or tie it to the request id the driver returns so a dropped request ends it.

title: Tray notifications and sounds toggles still work under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock Quill with a passcode, click Disable notifications or Disable notification sounds in the tray menu
effect: The setting is saved and notifications stop while locked; tdesktop hides the toggle under the lock (lock-is-a-render-state.md)
fix: Test refused_while_locked in the tray action loop (or hide the items while locked) and list the step in scripts/lock-surfaces.txt.

title: quote_for resolves a selection by first occurrence of its text, not by where the user selected it
trigger: Select the second occurrence of a repeated phrase (e.g. the second 'ok.' or a repeated word) in a message and reply with a quote
effect: The quote's position points at the first occurrence, so the reply preview highlights and Telegram scrolls to the wrong part of the message
fix: Take the selection's byte start from the selection source and pass it to quote_for instead of searching for the string.

title: Fast buttons mode invalidates only the main window's history rows
trigger: Turn on fast buttons (the numberbuttons code) or toggle it in Experimental settings while a chat window is open with bot buttons.
effect: set_experimental_option clears self.history.rows_key, the main window's slot only; a chat window keeps its cached rows without (or with) the digits until its next history refresh.
fix: Invalidate the rows of every WindowSlot (or key the row cache by the fast-buttons mode).

title: Demo apply_demo_sticker/gif/edit/delete/pin_toggle/forward/archive/pin/marked_as_unread/notification_settings/message_sender number envelopes from demo_ui.seq without catching it up to session.last_seq
trigger: In a screenshot demo, before any album/outgoing send (the only two paths that fetch_max the counter), delete a message, pin one, send a sticker or GIF, archive a chat or mark it unread; or after QUILL_DEMO_UPDATE_STREAM has run (apply_json advances session.last_seq without touching demo_ui.seq)
effect: Session::apply drops the envelope as out-of-order-ignored (seq <= last_seq), so the action silently does nothing until the counter has caught up by repeated attempts
fix: One helper that stores last_seq into demo_ui.seq before every demo apply (as demo_apply_jsons/demo_delete_message do), or give the demo a single sequencer type that owns both counters, instead of syncing in some callers by hand.

title: Fact check text is dropped when the save request cannot be sent
trigger: Edit a fact check, press Save while the driver refuses the request
effect: Dialog closes with an error note; the typed text is gone and cannot be retried
fix: Take the dialog only on Ok; on Err keep it open with the error.

title: Create does nothing, with no message, while an earlier box's import is still pending
trigger: Window > Add Contact, Create, close the box before the answer, reopen it and press Create again.
effect: add_contact_by_phone returns Ok(None) because UsersState::new_contact_request is session-wide and still set; submit_new_contact then changes nothing (sent_request stays None), so the button looks dead, and the first import's answer is dropped for the new box.
fix: Show a pending state for the in-flight import (or cancel/supersede it) instead of Ok(None).

title: A story viewer open in the main window blocks the history shortcuts of every chat window
trigger: Open a story in the main window, then press PageUp, Cmd+Up, Delete on a selection or Ctrl+Space in a chat window. shortcut_blocked reads self.stories.viewer.is_open(), which is the main window's, while self.viewer.state is the window's own.
effect: The shortcuts do nothing in the chat window until the story closes.
fix: Block on this window's own viewer only; the story viewer blocks only when the scope is the main window.

title: Per-window toast Presence entries are never removed
trigger: Open and close many chat windows over a session.
effect: Surfaces::toasts is a HashMap<Option<i64>, Presence<StatusNote>> filled by status_toast_in (entry per host) and never pruned when a chat window closes; each retains its last StatusNote text.
fix: Remove the entry in the window-close path (ToastQueue::window_closed caller).

title: Secret codes are fed from every keystroke on the sign-in screen, including the phone, login-code and 2FA password fields
trigger: Sign in with a cloud password that contains 'testmode', 'viewlogs', 'debugmode' or 'numberbuttons' (or paste such text); AdvancedUi observes all keystrokes of the main window and code_screen() is SignIn whenever the account is not Ready.
effect: Mid-password, testmode adds a new test account and switches away (the typed text is lost), debugmode opens the confirm box. The buffer also holds the tail of typed secrets that is a code prefix.
fix: Feed only when no text input has focus (a CodeSource enum on the screen), and clear the buffer when the screen or focus changes.

title: Linux launcher badge push is marked sent although the worker may drop it
trigger: Start Quill with no dock/session bus ready, or let the bus connection fail once while unread stays the same.
effect: push_badge returns true after LAUNCHER_SLOT.put, so LAST_SENT records the count; the worker drops it when Connection::session() fails or emit_signal errors and the badge stays wrong until the count changes or the app is re-activated.
fix: Have the worker report success back (AtomicBool) so LAST_SENT is set only after a successful emit.

title: OPENED/FORGOTTEN are process-wide once-cells for the first account's key, while open() reloads layouts on every connect
trigger: Launch on account A, switch to B (connect_ui calls open for B; OPENED stays A), log out A before the first chat list draw, or just run on B.
effect: B's line layouts are never saved to its own file (A's key/file is used) and a logged-out account's FORGOTTEN flag covers only the first file; cold starts of B stay un-prewarmed.
fix: Key the file by the account on screen at save time (replace the OnceLock with the live LinesFile).

title: Notification bursts coalesce by chat only, so forum topics merge
trigger: A forum supergroup gets a message in topic A then one in topic B before the queue drains
effect: One toast reading 'N new messages'; the inline reply target message_id is the newest message, in topic B, and the first topic's title/body is lost
fix: Key the queue by (chat, topic) using the ChatMessage/topic owner key.

title: PsaLabels marks a type requested before the request and never clears it on a failed send or error answer
trigger: Open the app while offline or with a failed languagePackStrings request while a promoted announcement is on the list (pump_psa_labels ignores the send result)
effect: The row badge and the one-time about box keep the generic text for that type until the language changes or Quill restarts
fix: Per-type Fetch<String> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) so an error or failed send returns the type to Idle and the next pump retries.

title: Linux screen-reader watcher runs once and never retries or restarts
trigger: Start Quill before the AT-SPI/session bus is up or let the bus restart, then turn the screen reader on
effect: running() stays false (or stale) for the rest of the process, so screen-reader-only behaviour is not enabled
fix: Make the watcher a supervised task that reconnects (state enum Connecting/Watching/Failed) instead of a Once.

title: A launch whose sender thread cannot be spawned reports the live owner as not responding
trigger: Start Quill under thread exhaustion while another Quill runs.
effect: spawn_guarded fails, tx drops, recv_timeout gives Disconnected which maps to Forward::Unresponsive; launch shows Quill isn't responding and refuses to start though the owner is fine.
fix: Map Disconnected to Forward::NoOwner-with-error (Unchecked) instead of Unresponsive.

title: A macOS text-replacement answer is matched to the composer by text prefix only, not by chat
trigger: macOS, text replacements on: type a shortcut and a space in chat A, and switch to chat B in the same window before NSSpellChecker answers, where B's draft starts with the same text.
effect: apply_system_text_replace (ui/composer_system_replace.rs) checks only that the composer's prefix equals Check::prefix, so the replacement is applied to chat B's draft.
fix: Carry the chat/topic key (AccountChat) in Check and apply the answer only while that chat's composer is the one shown.

title: The Experimental settings page reads the system clipboard on every render
trigger: Settings > Advanced > Experimental settings, leave it open while chats update.
effect: experimental_settings_page calls cx.read_from_clipboard() each time the page renders to decide whether Import shows. On X11/Wayland a clipboard read is a round trip to the selection owner, done on the UI thread on every QuillApp notify while the page is open; the Import button also does not appear when the clipboard changes until something else redraws.
fix: Read the clipboard once when the page opens (and on window focus), keeping the result in the page's state.

title: Two UI-driver input commands run at once and interleave their steps
trigger: An agent issues ui_type and ui_click (or two agents drive) in parallel tool calls.
effect: bridge::take() hands every waiting command to agent_driver_start, which spawns one task each; the tasks await frames and glides between steps, so a click of one lands between the characters of the other. check_step compares only the surface, so the typed text continues into whatever the other command focused, and guard::take_refusals / agent_bridge.ui_send (process- and app-wide slots) can be credited to the wrong command's reply.
fix: Run input commands one at a time: a driver stage on the app (Idle | Running { id }) that queues further input commands until the running one answers.

title: The agent tree is the last drawn frame's, but it is checked against the surface of the state now
trigger: With chat G granted and chat X not: while an agent's read_ui_tree waits for a frame, the user opens X and then G again within one 16 ms poll, before the frame for G is drawn.
effect: agent_tree computes driver_surface from current state (granted chat G) but reads window.a11y_tree_snapshot() of the last frame, which shows X. The conversation slot is tagged REGION_CHAT only (no chat=<id> tag), so redact allows its content and X's messages reach the agent.
fix: Tag the conversation region with chat_tag(open chat) so redaction follows the frame's own chat, or record the surface each frame is drawn for and compare it with the frame read.

title: Takeover pill bounds are the main window's but are compared with the pointer of whichever window's input probe fired
trigger: While an agent drives, click near the top centre of a chat window (where the main window's pill sits in main-window coordinates).
effect: The click counts as on the pill, so it does not pause the agent; the user's input in that chat window is ignored by the takeover.
fix: Record the pill's window id with its bounds (or keep it per window) and treat input as on_controls only when the event's window is the one that painted the pill.

title: Autoscroll loop is not owned by the mode, so a stop then a quick new press runs two loops
trigger: Middle-click to start autoscroll, click to stop, and middle-click again within one 15 ms tick.
effect: The first spawn_scoped_in loop is still awaiting its timer. active is Some again (new anchor), so the old loop's autoscroll_plan returns a step and it keeps scrolling next to the new loop: double speed until the mode stops. The task is detached and not stored with Active.
fix: Hold the Task inside Active (dropped when active becomes None), or give Active a press token that the loop compares on each plan.

title: Downloads panel open flag lives in the Session and nothing closes it on an account switch
trigger: Open the Downloads panel in account A, switch to account B, switch back to A.
effect: A's Downloads panel is open again on switch back (and is drawn from the retired Session's flag), unlike OnScreen panels that start closed.
fix: Hold the panel flag in an OnScreen feature struct (or add a Farewell closer) instead of the Session.

title: A replayed intro clip keeps playing with sound under the passcode lock
trigger: Settings > Advanced > replay onboarding, then lock Quill (passcode hotkey) while the clip plays.
effect: The lock draws only the lock screen, so first_run_view/first_run_curtain (which run settle, the volume fade and the pause) stop running, and close_for_lock does not touch app.first_run: the clip's audio plays on to its end behind the lock.
fix: close_for_lock pauses or finishes FirstRun (skip_intro + pause the player), or the player is paused by the lock gate.

title: fire_resize takes the resize callback out while it runs so a nested set_zoom skips relayout
trigger: Change the interface scale twice while GPUI is inside the resize callback (e.g. from a deferred settings update)
effect: The inner relayout is silently skipped; window keeps the old scale until next real resize
fix: Queue a pending zoom re-fire (enum Idle/Running/RunAgain) instead of skipping

title: Selection check animations are keyed by bare message id
trigger: In one window select messages in chat A (selection mode on), switch to chat B, whose first message has the same id (TDLib private and basic-group ids start at the same value in every chat) while the fade-out is still running.
effect: SelectionFx::checks (HashMap<i64, CheckAnim>) is kept until the mode glide settles, so for ~150 ms B's row with the same id draws A's check state.
fix: Key by (ChatId, MessageId) or clear on chat change (sync_chat_ui).

title: Closing side column keeps the previous account's panel target after an account switch
trigger: Open a user's info panel, switch accounts from the account list.
effect: FrameState::panels is app-wide, so last still holds InfoPanelTarget of the old account; for the slide-out frames the column draws that target against the new account's session (wrong or empty user card for about 200 ms).
fix: Reset the reveal in the OnScreen swap (put PanelReveal in OnScreen, or settle to default on account change).

title: A failed source listing leaves for_call set with no chooser
trigger: In a call press share screen when listing sources fails (e.g. the backend errors).
effect: for_call stays Some(..) while window is None and sources empty (the empty-list arm clears it, the error arm does not); stop_screen_source/accept_screen_source then act on a chooser that is not open until the call ends.
fix: Move the reset into one Chooser::Closed transition used by the error and empty arms.

title: Self-destruct tick task is guarded by an Option<ChatId> started flag; A -> B -> A within a second runs two tasks
trigger: Open a secret chat with a live self-destruct timer, switch to another chat with a timer and back within one second.
effect: tick_chat is A again so ensure_self_destruct_tick spawns a second task for A while the first (still sleeping) sees still_open and keeps going: two tasks notify every second until the timers end.
fix: Hold the task itself in the owner (Option<(ChatId, Task)>) so replacing it drops the old one.

title: Reply-in-another-chat box and forward share box can be open together over one search field and one selection
trigger: With a reply set and reply_elsewhere_open true, start a forward from a selection (open_forward_picker never clears reply_elsewhere_open, while open_reply_elsewhere does close the forward picker). sync_share_search accepts either flag.
effect: Two boxes share one search_input, selection and focus_search flag; a tick in one shows in the other and the second box can take focus away.
fix: One enum ShareChooser { None, Forward(..), ReplyElsewhere } so only one chooser exists and opening one replaces the other.

title: Kit dialog can be closed twice in a transition, closing an unrelated top dialog
trigger: An action clears a dialog flag and calls close_kit_dialog_if_done (window.close_dialog), while the shell still has open_dialog = Some(old). The next sync sees open_dialog != first_open and calls window.close_dialog again before opening the next box.
effect: If another kit dialog (an alert opened with open_alert_dialog) is on top by then, it is closed instead of nothing.
fix: close_kit_dialog_if_done should also clear shell.open_dialog, or the sync should check the kit layer has a dialog before closing.

title: Report option picker stays after a pick, so a second click sends the report twice
trigger: In the sponsored report picker click an option, then click again before the reportSponsoredResult answer arrives.
effect: Two reportChatSponsoredMessage requests; second may fail with an error note after the first 'Report sent'.
fix: SponsoredReportFlight becomes Picking{options} | Sending{option} | Done and the panel disables on Sending.

title: Tab reveal key has no chat id, so another chat's strip is not scrolled to its selected tab
trigger: Open a forum chat with the strip scrolled to topic index k, switch to another chat whose selected tab has the same index, tab count and strip width (or the same chat after the key matches an old one).
effect: needs_reveal compares only (selected, tab_count, strip_width) against the last key held in HistoryUi, which is not reset on a chat change; the strip keeps the previous chat's scroll offset and the selected tab can sit out of view.
fix: Add the chat id (AccountChat owner key) to RevealKey, or reset SubsectionTabsScroll in sync_chat_ui.

title: Start Streaming closes the RTMP box as soon as createVideoChat is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Press Start Streaming; TDLib rejects createVideoChat (no rights, flood)
effect: The box is gone with only an error toast; the URL/key just fetched are lost and the user starts over
fix: RtmpStart::Starting(request) closed on the ok answer, reopened with the error on failure.

title: A second unrestrict-boost-count change while one is in flight is dropped with Ok(None)
trigger: Change the unrestrict boost count twice quickly
effect: The second value is lost without a message; the field shows the later value while the server has the first
fix: Queue the latest value and send it when the first answers, or disable the control while pending.

title: Wallet one-shot request flags are set before the send and some are never cleared on failure
trigger: Open the Money page while the send fails (state_requested/rates_requested stay true), or while getApplicationConfig is refused by TDLib.
effect: state_requested and rates_requested stay true after a failed send, and explorer_url_requested has no error arm at all, so the Gram USD rate and explorer address are never asked again this session and the fiat value shows a dash.
fix: Fetch<T> per resource (rates, explorer config, own state) with Failed re-askable on the next Money page open.

title: Files handed to Quill are silently dropped past 256 queued or when duplicated
trigger: Send a folder of 300 files to Quill (Send to menu) while Quill is locked or signed out
effect: push_files keeps the first 256 and discards the rest with no note
fix: Return the dropped count and surface a toast when the UI takes the queue.

title: photos_asked records a bot before download_user_photo is sent, so a refused request is never repeated
trigger: Open the affiliate programs page when download_user_photo returns Err (driver closing); the bot id is already in photos_asked.
effect: That program row keeps initials instead of the bot photo until the account is switched away and back.
fix: Insert only when the send returns Ok, or track Fetch<()> per bot.

title: drain_earn shows only the last of several notes and drops the rest
trigger: Open a channel Monetization page when both the TON statistics and the Stars statistics fail in the same poll tick; both push their reason to earn.notes.
effect: One error toast is shown; the other is lost.
fix: Show the notes one after another through the toast queue, or join them.

title: Join Program / Revoke answers are not matched to the box that sent them (JoinBox::joining, RevokeBox::sending are bools, answers carry no request id)
trigger: Click 'Join Program' for bot A, press Esc to close the box, open bot B's join box before A's connectAffiliateProgram answers. A's success (state/domains/payments/earn.rs:178-190) closes B's box and opens A's link box; A's error (:511-515) clears B's joining flag and toasts 'Failed'.
effect: The box the user is looking at closes or changes to another program's link box; a closed box's error toasts over an unrelated one.
fix: Give JoinBox and RevokeBox a stage enum Idle | Sending(RequestId) and apply Connect/Disconnect answers only when the open box waits_for that request, as Withdraw and SetupPage already do.

title: The withdraw amount field is refilled only when (peer, value) changes, so a reopened page keeps the old typed text
trigger: On a Stars Balance page type 1500 into the amount field, close the layer, reopen the same page; the balance is unchanged so prefilled == (peer, value) and the field is not refilled.
effect: The field shows the previous typed amount instead of the withdrawable maximum.
fix: Reset prefilled in open_earn (or key it by page open), or hold the amount as page state.

title: drain_gift_market_notes shows only the last of several notes
trigger: Two market answers fail in one frame (for example a failed purchase and a failed craft).
effect: notes are taken as a Vec and only notes.into_iter().last() is shown; earlier ones are lost.
fix: Queue notes through the toast queue one by one.

title: Message typed in the send-gift list is carried into the resale buy 'Send' step
trigger: Send-gift box list view: type in the Premium gift message textarea > tap a sold-out gift's resale tile > pick a listing > Buy.
effect: pick_resale_listing resets gift_hide_name but not payments.gift_message_input, and the buy step shows and sends the same input, so the unrelated text is prefilled for the recipient.
fix: Reset the three send inputs in one place (a SendGiftInputs value created per box/step) instead of per call site.

title: gift_premium_by_stars is not reset when the send-gift box opens
trigger: Send-gift box for a friend > tick 'Pay with Stars instead' > close > open the box for another person.
effect: reset_send_gift_inputs clears the message, hide_name and pay_upgrade but not gift_premium_by_stars, so the Stars payment choice persists across recipients and opens.
fix: Put message, hide_name, pay_upgrade and by_stars in one SendGiftInputs struct replaced whole when the box opens.

title: Direct Messages box shows an old failure and one save slot serves all targets
trigger: A Direct messages save fails for channel C; reopen the box for C. Or Remove Fee for a user is saving while the box is open.
effect: Opening the box does not reset PaidSave, so the earlier failure line shows at once; saving is is_saving() of any target, so an unrelated save disables Save. A success answer for one target also sets Idle for another.
fix: Make the save a per-target map of Idle/Saving/Failed, cleared when the box opens.

title: 'Buy more Stars' stays expanded after the Stars box is closed and reopened
trigger: Stars > Buy more Stars (expands list) > close Stars > open Stars again.
effect: The pack list is open at once because StarPacksState::open lives in the session and close_stars (mod.rs:129) does not reset it.
fix: Own the expanded flag in the Stars box UI state or reset it in close_stars.

title: Account switch closes the chooser and drops the waiting files
trigger: Files sent via 'Send to' while the chooser is open; user switches account (StartFiles uses .close).
effect: Files vanish silently; the chooser is gone.
fix: Keep the files app-wide until chosen or cancelled (they are app state), re-listing chats for the new account.

title: end_starref_program closes the confirmation (confirm = None) before the send can fail
trigger: Confirm 'End program' while the send fails.
effect: Confirmation box disappears as if ended; nothing was sent.
fix: Clear confirm only after the send succeeded.

title: ConnectedPrograms answer is not keyed to the join page's peer
trigger: Open the join page for peer A, then for peer B before A's connected list answers.
effect: A's list is written into B's join.mine (replaced when B's own answer lands).
fix: Add peer/generation to the purpose and compare in the reducer.

title: notes toast queue of a background account is shown only after switching back
trigger: A SetProgram / Connect / Disconnect / stats request fails or finishes while another account is on screen
effect: Session.payments.earn.notes is drained by drain_earn only for the on-screen live client, so the 'Failed: ...' or 'Affiliate program ended' toast appears later, unrelated to what the user is doing
fix: Toasts go through the owning account's status path at the time of the answer, or are dropped when the account goes to the background

title: One PaidSave slot is shared by every Remove Fee and Direct Messages save; answers do not check the target
trigger: Start 'Remove fee' for user A (PaidSave::Saving(User A)), open Remove Fee for user B (open_remove_fee_for sets Idle) or save a channel's Direct Messages meanwhile; then A's answer arrives.
effect: `finish_unpaid_exception` and the SetDirectMessagesGroup success arm set `save = Idle` whatever the target, wiping another save's Saving/Failed state; a failure for A overwrites B's state and `user_error()` returns the failure line of any user, so B's box can show A's error line. The Saving state of B (button disabled) is dropped while its request is still in flight.
fix: Keep saves as a map keyed by PaidTarget (or only reset when the answer's target equals the stored one).

title: StarAmount::label calls stars.abs() on an i64 read from JSON
trigger: A malformed or hostile star_count of i64::MIN in a starAmount.
effect: Overflow panic in debug builds (wrap in release) while drawing the balance or a history row.
fix: Use unsigned_abs() as group_digits does.

title: A getPremiumLimit that was lost or timed out is never asked again this session
trigger: Open a limit box right after connecting on a flaky link; the request is swept (408) or fails transiently.
effect: LimitStore::note_asked is set before the send and only forget_asked on a send Err; no error handler for GetPremiumLimit clears it, so the box uses the hardcoded fallback pair for the rest of the session.
fix: Per-kind state {Unasked, Asked(RequestId), Answered(pair), Refused}; clear Asked on a transient error and keep Refused only for the server's refusal.

title: Subscription page answers are not matched to a request; a refresh can run beside a next-page fetch
trigger: Scroll to load more subscriptions, then cancel a subscription (stale=true, refresh_star_subscriptions_if_stale sends a second page(false) without checking loading)
effect: Two getStarSubscriptions in flight; the first answer clears star_subscriptions_loading while the second is still out and the spinner/guard drop, a stale append can extend the list the refresh then replaces
fix: Track the in-flight RequestId in the Fetch state and ignore other answers.

title: Program lists and history pages are applied by peer/filter, with no request id or sort in the key
trigger: Change Sort by in the programs list (join.found reset, new page-0 fetch) while the old sort's page is in flight, or reload ton history while a next page is out
effect: SearchPrograms/ConnectedPrograms/TonTransactions/StarTransactions answers (lines 93-157, 41) are applied to the current list whenever it exists: the old sort's first page is shown as Ready (PageLoad::Ready) while the new one is out, and a stale append duplicates rows; fixed only by the newer answer arriving last
fix: PageLoad::Loading{request} and compare the answer's request id.

title: Connect/ConnectedProgram answers act on whatever box is open now, not the one that asked
trigger: Click Join Program, close the box or open another program, then the first answer arrives; or click two programs quickly
effect: Connect clears join_box and opens a link box for the old program over the new join box; the ConnectedProgram answer for program A can replace the join box or link box opened for B
fix: Store the RequestId in the box stage and ignore answers whose id is not the box's

title: Late Connected answers open boxes the user already left
trigger: Tap a program (getConnectedAffiliateProgram, resolving), go back or tap another program, then the answer arrives
effect: ConnectedProgram answer (166-176) and its error (505-512) call open_join_box_after_resolve / set link_box for the program in the answer, replacing the box of the program the user is on now; Connect ok (178-191) sets join_box=None and link_box unconditionally
fix: Keep the resolving request id in a Join stage and drop answers that do not match.

title: Transfer/upgrade/price/delete ok handlers act on whatever flow is open now, not the flow that asked
trigger: Start transferring gift A, close the picker is blocked while exporting but a different flow (collection edit) can be open when the ok for an earlier mutation lands
effect: apply_gift_manage_ok sets manage.flow = None and reads manage.transfer() for the Gift transferred toast without matching a request id (lines 46-52, 113-141): it closes an unrelated open flow and can name the wrong recipient/gift
fix: Store the RequestId in the flow stage and apply the ok only when it matches.

title: Gift export url, temp-password and error answers are matched by stage only, not by request
trigger: Send via Blockchain: submit password, cancel/close the flow, reopen for another gift and submit again while the first answer is late
effect: apply_gift_export_url/temp_password/apply_gift_export_error check only TransferPicker::exporting(): the first export's Fragment URL is opened and the second picker is closed (flow=None), or its error is shown under the second password field. Gram withdrawal (grams.rs:78) matches by id; this path does not
fix: Put the RequestId in TransferStage::Password{sending: Option<RequestId>} and match it.

title: Wallet transaction detail is matched by tx_loading only, not by which transaction was asked
trigger: Tap transaction A, then B before A answers
effect: Single tx_loading bool; A's answer is shown as selected_tx and clears the flag, B's answer is then dropped (apply_ton_wallet line 73), leaving A's details for a tap on B
fix: Loading{request,tx_id} stage and match the request.

title: Auction state fetch is three fields kept in step by hand (auction_request, auction_loading, auction_ready), plus UI pending_auction; the error arm clears loading without matching the request id
trigger: Open an auction from one gift link, then quickly another before the first getGiftAuctionState answers; the first request fails.
effect: The error arm (state/domains/payments/gift_market.rs:284-286) sets auction_loading = false for any AuctionState failure, not only when it matches market.auction_request. gift_market_frame_upkeep (ui/gift_market_ui.rs:231-243) then sees !loading with no ready id and drops pending_auction, so the second auction's box never opens even when its answer arrives.
fix: One AuctionFetch enum (Idle | Loading { request } | Ready { gift_id } | Failed) where the answer and the error both apply only when the request id matches.

title: Fragment highlight range assumes the English template layout
trigger: A translated qll_money_fragment_on_for (or any template whose Fragment word is not right after {prefix}, or a translated link word of different length) makes prefix.len()..prefix.len()+link.len() exceed the sentence or split a char
effect: StyledText::with_highlights gets an out-of-range or non-boundary range and can panic while painting the box
fix: Find the Fragment word's range in the formatted sentence with str::find, drop the highlight when absent, and translate the prefix.

title: A program row click's resolve answer opens the join or link box even after the list that asked was closed
trigger: Setup page > 'View existing programs', click a program row (open_affiliate_program), then close the programs box or the earn layer before getChatAffiliateProgram answers.
effect: The join box (or the link box) opens over whatever is on screen now, for a list the user already left.
fix: Carry the asking surface in EarnPurpose::ConnectedProgram and drop the answer unless that list (programs box or the Join page for that peer) is still open.

title: A bot photo asked for by a program list is never asked again when its download fails
trigger: Open an affiliate programs page while the photo download of a listed bot fails (network drop).
effect: photos_asked keeps the bot, so its row shows initials until the account switches (OnScreen is rebuilt).
fix: Leave the retry to the file layer (ask while user_photo_path is None and no download is active) instead of an asked-once set.

title: Setup sliders are two Options built once from the setup page and never re-keyed to the bot or rebuilt when the page's params are replaced
trigger: Open a bot's affiliate setup, then have earn.setup replaced without open_earn (a reload of the same panel through load_earn_panel after setup was cleared, or the demo path where open_earn keeps the old setup).
effect: The slider knobs keep the old stops/positions while the labels (format_commission of setup.params) show the new values.
fix: One Option<SetupSliders { bot_user_id, commission, duration }> rebuilt when bot_user_id or the program differs from earn.setup.

title: Bid button re-enables while a bid is still in flight once another auction's bid answers
trigger: Place a bid on auction A; before it answers, open auction B's bid box from the bar/Active Auctions and bid there (bidding becomes Some(B) only if A's had cleared). Or: A's answer clears `bidding` unconditionally while B's request is pending.
effect: apply_gift_market_ok/error set `market.bidding = None` without checking the gift id or request, so the button of the box whose bid is still in flight stops spinning and accepts a second press (a second Stars bid).
fix: `bidding: Option<(gift_id, RequestId)>`, cleared only by the answer whose request id matches.

title: Delete Gift confirmation is a kit alert not tied to the account or the gift list it was asked for
trigger: Gifts dialog > Delete Gift (alert opens) > switch account from the Dock/tray with the alert up, then press Delete.
effect: The on_ok closure calls confirm_delete_gift(id) on whatever live client is current and driver.delete_received_gift does not check the id is in the open list, so a stale id is sent for the other account (the server rejects it, the user sees an error for an action they never asked).
fix: Carry an OwnedBy<account,gift> in the closure and ignore the OK when the owner is not current.

title: market_replace skips after_market_pop so bid slider/custom field and hide_name outlive the replaced box
