trigger: Auction bid box > 'Send a gift' (market_replace to AuctionSend) > back out and open another auction's bid box.
effect: The popped AuctionBid never reaches the arm that clears slider/custom, and hide_name is only cleared when the stack empties, so the old chosen amount / custom field / Hide My Name can show in the next box.
fix: Carry slider/custom/hide_name inside the MarketBox variants that own them so popping or replacing drops them.

title: requested_files is stored even when the downloads were not sent
trigger: Open a resale or auction box while the client is not connected or download_file returns Err.
effect: download_file/follow_gift_auction results are dropped with let _ and requested_files is updated whenever the set changes, so the failed set is never retried until the set changes; follow_gift_auction sets followed before a failed send.
fix: Record a file as requested only when its download request was sent; make following an enum with the request outcome.

title: SendGift box never names its window with open_box
trigger: Open the send-gift box from a chat window's header menu while the last press was in another window.
effect: SendGift is a session-wide dialog whose flag is set by the driver (send.open) and no site calls open_box(DialogKind::SendGift), so the box shows in the window of the last press, not the window that asked.
fix: Call open_box(DialogKind::SendGift) in open_send_gift_in / open_send_gift_to_user next to the driver call.

title: Giveaway options of the previous chat are shown for a new chat while loading
trigger: Open the giveaway form for channel A (options load) > close > open it for channel B.
effect: request_giveaway_options sets *_loading but keeps options.premium/stars from A, and the body only shows 'Loading prices' when both lists are empty, so A's prices are shown and selectable until B's answer.
fix: Key the options by boosted chat (Fetch<Options> inside the form) and clear on open.

title: A clip that fails to open is retried on every render
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview whose downloaded clip cannot be opened by VideoPlayer::open.
effect: Only a player that opens and later reports Failed is kept in the slot; an Err from open is not remembered, so each re-render (hover, scroll, tick) re-opens the file.
fix: Make the slot an enum Idle / Playing(VideoPlayer) / Failed(file_id).

title: The revoke follow-up poll stops after 10 s without rechecking the Type box link
trigger: Revoke a public link while TDLib answers slower than 50 x 200 ms (flood wait).
effect: The spawn_screen loop exits without calling recheck_group_type_link, so the Type box keeps the 'link taken' status after the revoke finished.
fix: Run recheck_group_type_link from the reducer when the revoke settles, not from a bounded timer poll.

title: Show My Last Seen toasts success when the privacy request is only queued
trigger: Press Show My Last Seen while TDLib then rejects setUserPrivacySettingRules.
effect: show_mine counts is_ok() of the send as success, shows 'last seen shown' and closes the box.
fix: Toast on the answer, or keep the box in a Saving stage.

title: QUIT_ASKED is never cleared if a platform quit request is declined
trigger: A macOS terminate or session-end callback goes through noting_quit and then does not quit.
effect: Later main-window renderer loss: main_lost is false, so the main window is not reopened and the app keeps running with only chat windows or none.
fix: Set it only when the quit proceeds, or reset it when the quit is cancelled.

title: set_privacy_rules mirrors the new value into calls.privacy_allow_calls/privacy_p2p at send time; the error handler never reverts the mirror
trigger: Privacy > Calls or Peer-to-peer: change the rule, TDLib rejects setUserPrivacySettingRules.
effect: PrivacyKeyState becomes Failed (previous rule lost) but the calls mirror keeps the rejected value, so the Calls tab and call code show a rule the server does not have.
fix: Keep the confirmed rule in PrivacyKeyState::Saving{confirmed, wanted}; mirror only on ok and restore confirmed on error.

title: refresh_notification_sounds_if_stale: an answer already in flight clears saved_sounds_stale, so the later change is never refetched
trigger: A getSavedNotificationSounds request is in flight; updateSavedNotificationSounds arrives (stale=true); the in-flight answer (older data) lands.
effect: apply sets saved_sounds_loaded=true and saved_sounds_stale=false on the old answer; the sound list stays old until the next update.
fix: Stamp the list with a generation; the stale mark outlives answers sent before it.

title: A failed create_dir_all drops the user's recent hashtags instead of keeping them
trigger: an earlier build left recent_hashtags.json in the app folder, the primary account is registered but its folder cannot be created (read-only, full disk); start Quill
effect: `registered && create_dir_all.is_ok() && let Err = move_item` is false when create_dir_all fails, so control falls to remove_any(&stray) and deletes the only copy of the list
fix: Return early (keep the stray) when the owner folder cannot be created; only remove the stray when the account is gone or already has its own list.

title: A failed window_state.json write drops the staged geometry
trigger: Disk full or read-only data folder; move the window; free the space; do not move it again
effect: write_staged takes() the staged state before writing and ignores the error (`let _ =`), so nothing remains staged to retry and no failure note is raised; the next launch opens the window at the old place
fix: Put the state back (or keep it staged until the write is Ok) and report through take_deferred_write_failure.

title: A cancel pressed after the last chunk is ignored: install still runs and the language is switched on
trigger: Click the switch off right as the second file finishes.
effect: Dictionary is installed and enabled although the user cancelled; Err("Cancelled.") only returned if the flag was set before the install call.
fix: Make Cancelling a stage that the completion arm checks before set_spell_languages.

title: One shared privacy_data.error is cleared by unrelated successes and overwritten by unrelated failures
trigger: Change the inactive-session timeout and let it fail (error line set), then open Network usage which loads fine (apply_privacy_data_payload clears error at line 103).
effect: The timeout failure line vanishes without the user fixing anything; a later failure of another setting replaces it.
fix: Keep one error per control (Fetch/Save enum per setting) rather than a shared Option<String>.

title: Deleting a custom theme that fails on disk still switches the app away from it
trigger: Settings > Appearance, select a custom theme, press Delete when the file cannot be removed (read-only themes folder, permission error).
effect: delete_custom_theme shows the error toast but still resets the day/night slot to the built-in default, so the theme is unapplied while its tile (re-read from the folder) is still there.
fix: Reset the slots only when store::delete returned Ok.

title: Renaming a custom theme in the editor deletes the old file but leaves the other day/night slot naming it
trigger: Have custom theme 'Mine' (light) as the day theme; Edit it, change it to dark colours and rename it 'Mine2'; Save.
effect: save_theme_editor deletes 'Mine' and choose_app_theme puts 'Mine2' in the night slot only; the day slot still names the deleted 'Mine', so in day mode Quill silently falls back to the default theme (delete_custom_theme clears such slots, the rename path does not).
fix: On a rename, repoint every slot that named the old theme to the new name (or reset it), the same way delete_custom_theme does.

title: Turning spell check on re-checks only the main window's composer
trigger: Open a chat in a separate chat window and type a misspelled word with spell check off; in the main window go to Settings > Chats and turn 'Check spelling' on.
effect: The switch handler runs sync_spellcheck on self.composer, the main window's slot only; the chat window's composer shows no underlines until its text changes (composer_ui.spelling is per window).
fix: Run the re-check in every window (in_every_window), as set_chat_prefs already does for the submit-on-Enter mode.

title: Each refresh_system_accent while a Linux read is pending starts another 100 ms poll loop
trigger: With 'use system accent' on, on Linux, switch to Quill repeatedly (window activation) while the gdbus/gsettings read is still running (up to the desktop query time limit)
effect: Several identical 100 ms poll tasks run at once, each re-applying the appearance when the read lands; wasted wakes, no wrong state
fix: Keep the poll as one stored Task (e.g. `accent_poll: Option<Task<()>>`) and skip starting a second while it is set.

title: Badge pref is applied to the session before it is saved
trigger: Toggle a badge switch while the account dir cannot be written.
effect: The session value changes and a silent note says the save failed; the switch shows the new value until restart, when the old one returns.
fix: Apply after a successful save, or show the failure as an error and revert.

title: Mute panel reopens with a sound picker still expanded
trigger: Header Mute > Change (story sound) > pick a mute preset or press X; open Mute again, on this or another chat.
effect: close_mute_menu clears notif_sound_picker_open but never story_sound_picker_open, open_mute_menu clears neither, and apply_chat_mute clears none of the picker flags, so the pickers open from the last visit show for the new chat.
fix: Reset the whole panel value on open (see the MutePanel enum).

title: Mute box closes as if saved when setChatNotificationSettings failed
trigger: Press a mute preset while the driver refuses the request.
effect: apply_chat_mute sets mute_menu_open = false and mute_chat = None before sending, so on Err the box is already gone and only a status note says it failed; the choice must be redone from scratch.
fix: Close in the Ok arm only.

title: Custom mute fields keep the last duration when the panel opens straight on Custom
trigger: Mute a chat for 3 days via Custom, then open a chat row's menu > Mute custom for another chat.
effect: open_mute_menu_for(custom = true) calls queue_mute_time_inputs, which returns at once when mute_time already exists; only the Custom toggle button resets the fields, so the new box shows 3 days instead of the 8 hour default.
fix: Reset the fields whenever the panel opens (part of the open value), not only on the toggle.

title: Sound picker closes before the setting is applied or even attempted
trigger: Defaults dialog: choose a sound while the scope/reaction settings are still loading, or the send fails.
effect: apply_scope_sound, apply_reaction_sound (and apply_chat_sound, apply_chat_story_sound) clear the picker flag first; the 'still loading' return and the Err note leave the picker closed with the old sound.
fix: Close the picker in the Ok arm only.

title: Upload target is lost on an account switch while the upload goes on
trigger: Upload a sound from the picker, switch accounts before it lands, switch back.
effect: tone_upload_target lives in NotifyUi (replaced by the switch) but the upload outcome stays in the old account's session; on return settle_tone_upload sees Added with target None and only toasts, the new sound is not selected.
fix: Put the target inside ToneUpload::Uploading in the session so the two cannot separate.

title: Delete saved sound ignores the result and has no confirmation
trigger: Right-click a saved sound > Delete while the request fails.
effect: remove_notification_tone's Err is dropped with let _ =; no note, the row stays and the user cannot tell whether it worked.
fix: Show the error as a status note (and confirm like tdesktop).

title: The 'No' note of the phone-number prompt is never reset
trigger: In Settings > Account answer 'No' to 'Is +X still your number?', later answer Yes (or let TDLib drop the suggestion), then get the suggestion again in the same session.
effect: settings.phone_change_note stays true for the life of the account's OnScreen, so the explanation is already open the next time the prompt appears. Nothing clears it when the suggestion goes away.
fix: Make the prompt a small enum (Asking, NotMine) owned by the suggestion, reset when the suggestion leaves chat_list.suggestions.actions.

title: How many activity rows show is app-wide and never resets
trigger: Press Show more several times, change a filter or pick another account, or leave the page and return.
effect: Another account or filter opens with an enlarged page of rows (up to hundreds drawn at once); only Clear resets it.
fix: Move the paging count into AgentPageUi next to the filter, reset in leave_agent_page and when the filter or picked account changes.

title: Dictionary rows list the dictionary folder from disk on every render
trigger: Open Manage dictionaries; during a download render runs every 120 ms. dictionary_rows calls installed_codes(&dir) each time.
effect: Disk reads on the UI thread every frame while the list is open.
fix: Cache the installed codes and refresh them on download or remove.

title: Switching on a second dictionary while one downloads does nothing and says nothing
trigger: Switch on a language, and while it downloads switch on another. start_dictionary_download returns when download.is_some(); the switch draws from row state so it snaps back.
effect: The click is lost without a note.
fix: Queue the second request or show a note.

title: Cancel is recognised by comparing the error text to "Cancelled."
trigger: Any future change to the string in spell_download turns a cancel into a red failure row.
effect: A user cancel shows as a failed download with an error line.
fix: Return an enum DownloadError::{Cancelled, Message(String)} from download_dictionary.

title: remove_dictionary updates the chosen list even when removing the files failed
trigger: Remove a downloaded dictionary whose file is locked or read-only.
effect: Toast says it could not remove, but the language is dropped from the picked list; if that empties the list the engine silently goes to automatic locale languages.
fix: Return early after the error note; only change the chosen list when remove succeeded.

title: Turning spell check on does not check drafts already in the composers
trigger: Turn Check spelling off, type a draft, turn it on again. sync_spellcheck clears misspellings while disabled and nothing re-checks when the setting changes (new_accent_picker.rs:512 only sets the pref).
effect: No underlines until the next edit in each window.
fix: Call recheck_spelling from the setter.

title: Which theme a default-wallpaper answer belongs to is a session field, not part of the request
trigger: Set a wallpaper for the light theme and, before its answer, one for the dark theme (or the reverse).
effect: set_default_background(_local) writes chats_state.background_set_for_dark; the Background answer reads it at arrival, so the first answer is stored under the second request's theme.
fix: Carry for_dark_theme in RequestPurpose::SetDefaultBackground{for_dark}.

title: resolve_notification_sound registers pending_sound_downloads/sound_file_ids before download_file, whose result is ignored
trigger: Play a custom notification sound whose file is not local while download_file fails to send (path inactive).
effect: The sound id stays in pending_sound_downloads; a later unrelated completion of the file plays the sound unexpectedly.
fix: Insert the pending marker only when download_file returns Ok, and remove it on Err.

title: confirm_device_login sets sessions_mutating before the answer and relies on the answer to clear it; a dropped continuation leaves device login and session terminates blocked
trigger: Scan a login QR, confirm; TDLib never answers (connection drop with the request lost).
effect: sessions_mutating stays true, terminate/toggle/confirm all return InvalidRequest until restart.
fix: Hold Mutating{request} and clear it when that request is dropped (reconnect/account reset).

title: ToneUpload::Uploading has no exit when the answer is lost, and blocks every later upload
trigger: Upload a notification sound; the connection drops and the request is dropped without an answer.
effect: tone_upload stays Uploading; upload_notification_tone refuses all further files until restart.
fix: Clear Uploading when its request is dropped (reconnect or account reset).

title: If the writer thread cannot start, a submit that raced in is left unwritten until the next submit or quit
trigger: Thread spawn fails (resource limit) while a second pref change is submitted between the flag set and the reset
effect: submit A sets writer_running=true and fails to spawn; submit B (before A resets) sees running=true and returns without spawning; A then sets running=false. B's bytes sit queued with no writer; a crash before quit loses both
fix: Make spawn failure and the flag one step under the same lock, or let the next lock holder notice has_work() && !writer_running and spawn.

title: A panic inside the sink leaves writer_running true for the rest of the process
trigger: A sink panic on the quill-settings-writer thread (e.g. a panicking filesystem shim or OOM unwind) while a write is queued
effect: drain() never resets writer_running on unwind, so later submit() calls see running=true, never spawn a writer, and nothing is written; flush() at quit waits the full 10 s stall budget then gives up, losing every setting changed after the panic
fix: Reset writer_running in a drop guard inside drain(), or hold the thread as an enum Writer::Running(JoinHandle) and check is_finished on submit.

title: A failed settings write is reported once and then not retried until some unrelated submit or quit
trigger: Disk full: change a pref, see the one note, free space, change nothing else
effect: Queued::failed stays true; nothing retries it on a timer, so the pref exists only in memory and the queue until another submit/flush; a crash in between loses it
fix: Make Failed a retry stage with a backoff owned by the writer (manual clock in tests) instead of waiting for an outside submit.

title: If recording 'started' fails, the next launch treats the new install as an upgrade and skips onboarding
trigger: Read-only or full app data folder on first launch; TDLib then creates its database; relaunch
effect: save(app_root,false) error is ignored, the file is missing, database_exists() is true, so first_run_pending marks done and returns false
fix: Surface the write error, or decide 'upgrade' from a version marker rather than from the database existing.

title: A failed first dictionary load is cached forever in OnceLock<Option<..>>
trigger: Dictionary file is briefly unreadable (antivirus lock, being replaced) when the engine first checks a word.
effect: That language's words are never flagged (is_correct returns true when nothing loaded) until the engine is rebuilt by changing languages or restarting.
fix: Entry stage enum Unloaded / Loaded(dict) / Failed(retry after) instead of a permanent None.

title: Each hunspell_engine build starts a warm thread that keeps parsing after the engine was replaced
trigger: Switch spelling languages several times quickly with large dictionaries.
effect: Several threads parse dictionaries nobody uses (the Arc keeps the backend alive) until done; wasted CPU and memory.
fix: Give warm a cancel token owned by the SpellEngine, set on drop.

title: is_correct inserts a backend answer after a concurrent clear_cache, so a stale verdict outlives a learn/unlearn
trigger: Background re-check is in is_correct (backend call) while the user picks Add to Dictionary on a macOS-system-learned word; the check then inserts its old false.
effect: Word added to the system dictionary stays underlined until another cache clear.
fix: Tag the cache with a generation counter bumped by clear_cache and drop inserts from an older generation.

title: updateLanguagePackStrings for the pack being switched to is dropped
trigger: Switch language; while the new pack's strings are fetched the server pushes a change to that pack.
effect: UpdateStrings compares with state.current (the old pack) and returns, so the fetched snapshot misses that change until the next full reload.
fix: Also match switching.info.id and queue the patch on the switch, applying it when the switch becomes ready.

title: HISTORY_AREA thread-local is shared by all windows and never cleared
trigger: Main window and a chat window both show outgoing gradient bubbles with different sizes, or a history without wallpaper layer paints after another window.
effect: note_history_area stores the last painted history's bounds; a bubble in another window (or a frame where the wallpaper layer did not report) slices its gradient from that stale area, so colours differ from what the window's own area gives.
fix: Key the area by window/history (pass it through the paint context) or clear it at the start of each frame.

title: A file dialog answered after the passcode lock still starts the upload
trigger: Pick Upload Sound, leave the file dialog open, let auto-lock engage, choose the file.
effect: The spawn_screen continuation calls begin_tone_upload with no refused_while_locked or wait_for_unlock check, so the upload goes out and the picked sound is applied under the lock.
fix: Queue the pick as an unlock intent (wait_for_unlock) like the other OS opens.

title: Block and exception pickers say 'No more contacts' while the contacts are still being fetched
trigger: Privacy > Block... (or Add user in an exception list) before contacts are loaded.
effect: contact_rows() is empty until fetch_contacts answers, so the picker shows the empty-state text instead of a loading state.
fix: Show Fetch::Loading for the contacts list in the picker.

title: Add-a-chat picker is rebuilt only when the chat count or granted ids change
trigger: A chat is renamed, or one chat leaves and another joins between renders so the count stays the same, while Agent access is open.
effect: The picker lists stale titles or misses the new chat until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Key the picker on a session revision counter for the chat list, or derive the item list on each open of the menu instead of caching it.

title: Narrow-window back from a page keeps the search Arrival alive, with its animation tick
trigger: Narrow window: open a search result so Arrival is set and its row has been painted, then press the back arrow before the next render has centered it. settings_back sets page = None without clearing arrival; landed stays None so the timeout never starts.
effect: settle_arrival requests an animation tick at 60 fps for the rest of the Settings visit and the wash never ends. Needs a very fast click, so unlikely.
fix: Clear arrival in leave_settings_page (the one place a page is left); make Arrival one enum Seeking / Landed(Instant) / Done.

title: Slot::Preview is one slot for every preview area in every window, so two previews replace each other's render forever
trigger: Open the chat wallpaper box (ChatLook) in a chat window and the wallpaper preview in the main window (or any two chat_look_preview areas of different size at once).
effect: Each frame one area's request replaces the other's queued/running job (replaces=true) with a 150 ms settle delay, so neither renders and both keep requesting animation frames.
fix: Hash the window id (and the owning dialog) into the preview slot as History does, or give each preview area its own slot key.

title: A pattern or photo that failed to read is remembered as None, and its fill-only result is cached under the same key
trigger: A pattern file read fails once (e.g. replaced while TDLib rewrites it) while its chat is open.
effect: remember() keeps the None, and the Cache entry for that (wallpaper,size) key holds the fill-only/empty picture, so the pattern/photo never appears until another wallpaper evicts it or the size changes.
fix: Do not remember failures (or remember them with a retry time), and do not cache a degraded render under the final key.

title: set_less_data_for_calls and set_storage_limits send several requests and return on the first send error, leaving networks or options half applied
trigger: Toggle 'Use less data for calls' when the second send fails.
effect: Network 1 is sent (applied on ok), networks 2 and 3 are not; the toggle shows a mix with no retry.
fix: Queue the set as one step list in an enum (like ManagerCommit) with a single outcome.

title: A failed send of the next search page throws away all search results
trigger: Scroll a public story search to its end and trigger Load more when the sender refuses the request.
effect: send_story_search_page calls clear_story_search on any send error, so the open results panel and its pages vanish instead of showing a retryable error.
fix: On a send error settle the page as Failed (search.error, loading cleared) and keep the pages.

title: One failed calendar page ends paging for the box for good
trigger: Open Jump to date on a media tab, scroll to an older month while the getChatMessageCalendar page fails (timeout, flood wait, offline) or the send fails (connect/search/chat_search.rs:437).
effect: fail() sets exhausted = true, so older months show no highlighted days and never page again until the box is reopened.
fix: Model paging as an enum Idle/Loading/Failed{retry}/Exhausted; only a 404-like empty page is Exhausted, a failure stays retryable.

title: A failed searchChatMembers for the @ menu leaves the search stuck on its query
trigger: Type @ab in a group while searchChatMembers fails (flood wait, no rights). Retype or keep the same query.
effect: There is no error arm for SearchMentionMembers: MentionSearch.request stays Some forever and search_mentions returns early for the same chat and query, so no retry is made until the text changes.
fix: Add a SearchMentionMembers error arm that clears request (and the query so it is asked again), or make the stage Fetch<Vec<UserId>> keyed by the query.

title: scroll_view_probe is not reset when the history key changes, while scroll_top_probe is
trigger: Scroll chat A down so its rows 40..55 are on screen, open chat B (or switch topic); before B's first paint press PageUp/PageDown, click the open chat in the list, or let the render choose chrome rows
effect: The page keys, reselect_open_chat (first_unread_below_view), history_a11y and chrome_due_rows read A's row range for B's rows: wrong page jump or chrome refreshed for the wrong rows for a frame
fix: Reset every per-history probe together in one `HistoryUi::for_new_key()` (or keep the probes in a struct keyed by history_key).

title: 'Clear selected' forgets the ticked types even when the clear was refused
trigger: Tick types, confirm Clear while storage_clearing is true or the send fails.
effect: storage_selected is cleared before clear_storage runs; its Err (let _) leaves an error line but the ticks are lost.
fix: Clear the selection only on the confirmed answer (or when the send returned Ok).

title: Fact-check expansion is per window, not per chat
trigger: Open a chat in the main window and in its own chat window, expand a fact check in one.
effect: fact_check_expanded lives in each window's MessageUi, so the other window shows the same fact check collapsed; the set also only grows and is not cleared on chat change.
fix: Move the set into ChatUi (per chat, replaced whole on chat change), or key it by account chat in OnScreen.

title: stealth_toast lives in StoryUi, not StoryViewerUi, so a toast survives the viewer closing
trigger: enable stealth in the viewer, close the viewer within 4 s and open another story
effect: the previous 'Stealth mode on' toast shows again over the new viewer until its 4 s deadline
fix: move the toast into StoryViewerUi so release_story_viewer drops it

title: Viewers panel shows a loading spinner whenever next_offset is set, even after an error, and the error has no retry
trigger: fail a viewers page, keep the panel open
effect: error text and 'Loading viewers' spinner are shown together; no Retry button despite the comment above fail_story_viewers
fix: same Fetch-like enum; spinner only for Loading, Retry for Failed

title: Ban User still runs after the comment delete failed
trigger: In the live comment delete box tick Ban User and confirm while delete_live_story_comment returns Err.
effect: `banned` is computed regardless of `deleted`, so the sender is banned/blocked although the comment was not deleted; the box has already closed (delete taken) and only a generic note shows.
fix: Run the ban only after the delete was accepted, and keep the box open (or report which step failed) on Err.

title: Staged close-friends list is one Option not matched to the request
trigger: Save the close-friends list twice quickly (A then B) and let the first request fail.
effect: close_friends_pending holds only the latest list; A's error clears B's staged ids, so B's ok applies nothing and the list on screen stays stale although the server has B.
fix: Stage the list on the PendingRequest (or a map by RequestId) and apply it on that request's ok.

title: A deleted string in updateLanguagePackStrings clears the key to English, dropping the base pack and community overlay layers
trigger: Using a pack with a base pack or a Quill community overlay; Telegram deletes one of its strings (patched with Deleted).
effect: That string shows in English (or empty fall-through) instead of the base pack's/overlay's text until the pack is reloaded.
fix: Keep layers separate (overlay, base, pack) and recompute the key from the lower layers on delete.

title: show_from_pinned shows the list but does not mark comments read or clear has=WithUnread
trigger: Comments toggle shows the dot (WithNew); click a pinned comment (list opens); close the list again with the toggle.
effect: last_read_id and has stay stale, so on_messages (hidden) computes 'unread' from old ids and the dot can come back for comments already seen when has changes.
fix: Make show_from_pinned go through the same transition as toggle to Shown.

title: getChatsToPostStories error is written into the eligibility check_error
trigger: Open the story composer while the Post-as chats request fails and press Post at the same time (check_sent = true).
effect: frame_upkeep reads check_error.is_some() as the eligibility answer, so the composer reports a check failure with the post-as message and stops waiting for the real canPostStory answer, which then clears the line.
fix: Give the post-as list its own Fetch<Vec<i64>> error.

title: set_donors zeroes committed_stars for any donors snapshot, including one older than the commit
trigger: Tap Stars, commit, and a getLiveStoryTopDonors answer or updateLiveStoryTopDonors that predates the commit lands.
effect: The Stars button total and 'your Stars' drop by the committed amount for a moment until the next donors update counts them.
fix: Keep committed batches with the request that sent them and retire a batch only when a donors snapshot after its answer arrives.

title: AddPendingReaction error after the pending Stars were already committed leaves committed_stars inflated; CommitPendingReactions error zeroes all batches
trigger: Tap Stars on a live story, the addPendingLiveStoryReaction error arrives after the 5.5 s commit tick (slow network), or two commits are in flight and one fails.
effect: The Stars button total keeps showing Stars that were not added (until a donors update), or drops other committed batches from the total.
fix: Track each batch with its request id (AddPending/Commit carry stars) and undo exactly that batch's stars from whichever bucket holds it.

title: Custom emoji cache cap clears entries stored earlier in the same batch
trigger: Answer with stickers while the cache holds 512 entries and several new ids
effect: Each new id past the cap clears the cache, including stickers just inserted from this answer, so emoji just fetched vanish and are refetched
fix: Evict once before the loop (or evict only entries not requested now) instead of clearing per sticker.

title: fail_story_viewers matches by story, so a stale error from an earlier request of the same story fails the current fetch
trigger: Close and reopen viewers panel for the same story while the old request is lost/errors
effect: Panel shows an error while a newer request is still loading, or the newer answer later overwrites it
fix: Compare the request id carried by the Loading stage.

title: Story insights forwards accept any page for the same story, including a stale append
trigger: Open story statistics, load more public forwards, switch to another story's statistics and back while the page is in flight.
effect: accept_public_forwards matches by (chat, story) only and extends the fresh list, so a page from the earlier visit lands without page 1; a reopen while a page is in flight also never sets forwards_loading on the new state.
fix: Keep the forwards fetch as one value with the request id (Idle | Loading{request,offset} | Failed) and accept only its answer.

title: "Page is loading" is checked by op label only, not by chat, so paging for one chat is skipped while another chat's page loads
trigger: Open chat A's story page and scroll the archive to its end (getChatArchivedStories in flight, page_op Checking 'loading archived stories'); before it answers, open chat B's story page and scroll its archive to the end. Or start an album mutation while a page loads.
effect: ui/story_albums/paging.rs story_page_loading() matches op.label == story_page_op_label(purpose), so B's next page is not asked until A's answer clears the op (self-corrects on the next scroll); a mutation started mid-load makes the load look finished and the same page is asked twice.
fix: Key the load-in-flight check by (chat, purpose, request) instead of the label string.

title: Auto-download editor closes on Save before TDLib confirms; a refused save drops the draft
trigger: Edit a network's auto-download caps, press Save, TDLib answers with an error.
effect: The editor was taken at Save (only a failed send restores it); on a TDLib error the overview shows the error line and the user's draft is gone.
fix: enum Editor { Closed, Open{network,draft}, Saving{network,draft,request} } restored to Open on the matching error answer.

title: Accept / Reject on a sharing request has no in-flight stage
trigger: Click Accept (or Reject) twice quickly, or click Accept then Reject before TDLib's update removes the buttons.
effect: answer_sharing_request sends every click to the driver; the buttons stay until the message update arrives, so two answers (possibly contradictory) go out and a second error toast can appear.
fix: A per-message enum SharingAnswer { Open, Sending(approve) } in the chat's ChatUi that hides the buttons on the first click and returns to Open on error.

title: Frame-strip ffmpeg cuts keep running while Quill is locked or the viewer is paused/hidden
trigger: open cover picker, then lock with the passcode (or minimise) before the 8 strip frames are cut
effect: background ffmpeg work on the story clip continues under the lock until all frames are done (only a closed/replaced picker stops it)
fix: gate the loop on lock/active state or cut frames from a task owned by the picker that the lock cancels

title: picker_load_near_end skips the archive_asked guard, so an empty or short page re-asks on every scroll; in demo mode it sets a note every time
trigger: scroll the picker grid near its end when the server total exceeds what it returns (hidden stories)
effect: a request (or in demo a status note) per scroll event
fix: use the same Asked/load_due guard as story_archive_more

title: stats_asked and found_asked (and the page asked guards) are never reset; the automatic first look is skipped when the list length repeats
trigger: view statistics of story A (10 shares loaded), then story B whose first page also has 10 and does not fill the panel; or run two story searches with equal first-page sizes
effect: next page is not requested until the reader scrolls (Asked::reset exists but is unused here)
fix: reset Asked and scroll handles when the viewed story or search changes (hold them in the per-item value)

title: send_live_comment and live_story_admin read calls.story_stream without matching it to the watched live story's call id
trigger: Switch live stories or rejoin so story_stream holds a different call than stories.live.group_call_id for a moment, then press Send.
effect: price and admin are taken from the other call (the composer filters by call.id == live.group_call_id, send does not), so the free/paid path and moderation controls can differ from what the field showed.
fix: One accessor `live_call()` that returns the story_stream only when its id equals the live story's group_call_id, used by composer, send and admin checks.

title: A finished voice/video reply closes whatever reply row is open now, not the one it came from
trigger: Record a voice reply for story A, press Send (encoder finishes off-thread), step to story B and open its reply row before the encoder finishes.
effect: finish_story_reply_media calls end_story_reply, closing and cancelling B's row and recording; the reply is correctly addressed to A.
fix: Pass the (chat, story) the recording was for and end the row only if it is still the current reply target.

title: maybe_send_parameters leaves the SetParameters pending entry when send_json fails
trigger: setTdlibParameters send fails (sender closed) on kickoff or an ingest; every later ingest registers another SetParameters request.
effect: Pending registry accumulates dead SetParameters entries until swept; parameters_sent bool shadows the WaitTdlibParameters stage.
fix: take(extra) on send failure like the other senders; derive 'sent' from the auth stage instead of a bool.

title: grams_tick records asked_users/asked_chats even when the lookup send failed
trigger: Open My Grams while a peer lookup send fails.
effect: That peer is never asked again, its row keeps the bare id.
fix: Insert into the asked set only when the send succeeded.

title: edit_proxy and remove_proxy drop the ping result before the mutation is accepted
trigger: Press Remove or Edit on a proxy while another mutation is in flight.
effect: pings.remove(&proxy_id) runs, then send_proxy_mutation returns InvalidRequest because mutating is true; the ping result of the untouched proxy is lost.
fix: Clear the ping inside the accepted branch.

title: zoom_stat_graph records the zoom before load_stat_graph can refuse, and zoomed is keyed by token only
trigger: Zoom a graph while the chats path is inactive.
effect: zoomed[token]=x is set but nothing loads; the view shows a zoomed graph with no data.
fix: Record the zoom only when the load is issued and key it by (chat, token).

title: fetch_message_statistics sets statistics = Loading before the send and returns the send error with Loading left
trigger: Open a post's statistics while the send fails (AgentDriving or Native).
effect: The page spins forever; only Failed gets the Retry path, and a Loading page is not retried.
fix: Set Loading only after the send succeeds, or return to Idle on the send error.

title: Optimistic rollbacks restore the pre-request value unconditionally, except the topic mute and poll vote
trigger: Toggle a supergroup setting or pin a chat, an update (another admin or device) changes the same value, then the first request fails.
effect: The rollback overwrites the newer truth with the old value until the next update.
fix: Store the shown value in every rollback and restore only when the current value still equals it, as ForumTopicMute does.

title: request_close restores shutdown on send failure but not the logout_request that begin_close cleared
trigger: A logOut is in flight (logout_request Some), then request_close is called and its send fails.
effect: shutdown goes back but auth_state.logout_request stays None, so TDLib's logOut answer is no longer matched.
fix: Make begin_close return an undo token or save/restore both fields together (one ShutdownPhase carrying the logout request).

title: resume_disk_paused_found takes the whole due list, then returns on the first toggle error
trigger: Several found paused downloads are due and the first toggle_download_paused send fails.
effect: The remaining ids were already mem::taken and are never resumed; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped.
fix: Keep ids queued until each is sent, and always run the save step.

title: pump_call_audio errors are mapped to 'changed' every poll
trigger: A group call is active and send_speaking keeps failing (sender closed).
effect: request_tick returns true every poll, forcing a redraw loop.
fix: Treat a send error as unchanged and surface it once.

title: A flood-retry re-send that fails drops an export request via settle_lost_request, which never clears the export link's pending
trigger: During an export a getChatHistory gets a 429 (retained and retried), and the re-send's send_json fails (TDLib closing / connection teardown).
effect: settle_lost_request feeds a generic error to the reducer, not to WorkerLink::reply, so link.pending stays Some(id): idle_or_cancelled() is false and no further export request is forwarded; the worker waits out QUERY_TIMEOUT per call.
fix: Route ExportAccount/ExportChat/ExportRichHtml lost requests to link.fail_send (or reply with an error) in settle_lost_request.

title: Collect password box goes idle with no message when the request fails to send
trigger: Open Collect, type the password, submit while the send fails (not connected).
effect: withdraw is replaced by Password{request: None, error: None}; the Err is returned but the box shows no error, so Submit looks like it did nothing.
fix: Put the send error into GramWithdraw::idle(Some(error)) on the Err arm.

title: set_requested is inserted before mask_request, so a send error marks the set as requested for good
trigger: Open the photo editor Masks strip while sender fails once
effect: That set's stickers are never fetched again until the installed list changes (set_requested.clear in state masks.rs:118); strip shows blank set
fix: Insert into set_requested only after send_json succeeds, or remove it in mask_request's Err arm

title: send_sharing_request closes the request box (enable=None) before toggleChatHasProtectedContent is sent
trigger: Press Send Request while the sender refuses.
effect: The box is already gone and the request is not sent; only the returned Err tells the caller.
fix: Clear enable only after the send succeeds.

title: answer_sharing_request reads only histories, so a request shown in a topic or other view cannot be answered
trigger: Accept a sharing request shown in a view other than the chat's main history.
effect: answerable is false and the press does nothing.
fix: Use loaded_message.

title: ensure_private_dir remembers a directory as created once per process; nothing notices the directory being removed
trigger: Quill runs for days; the OS temp cleaner removes quill-media-cache/<account>/gif-frames; render paths call ensure_private_dir every frame.
effect: The dir is never recreated (ENSURED_DIRS says done), so every extraction/capture under it fails until the next sweep or restart.
fix: Check existence cheaply on failure (retry after forgetting the entry) or key the entry to a sweep generation.

title: sweep_media_caches wipes every account's scratch (and clears the verdict/ensured-dir memos) when one account logs out
trigger: Two accounts signed in, B playing a webm sticker or recording a voice note; account A is logged out remotely (restart_live_connection calls sweep_media_caches).
effect: B's in-flight frame extraction or capture directory is renamed away under it; the sticker/clip stays blank or the recording write fails until reopened.
fix: Sweep only the logged-out account's scoped base (needs the per-account scope of the previous finding).

title: ConferenceInviteResults keeps pending requests that can never settle if the call goes first
trigger: Add people to a new conference, then leave the conference before all invite answers arrive
effect: is_done never becomes true for a dropped request so invite_results lingers and its toast never shows
fix: Clear invite_results with the conference call, or settle pending as failed when the request is taken

title: Chat photo, theme and background caches are keyed by bare chat id and never pruned (chat_upgrades Vec grows)
trigger: Upgrade many basic groups over a long session
effect: chat_upgrades only grows; stale entries are re-scanned
fix: Drain the pairs once the UI consumed them, or store as map old->new.

title: setDefaultBackground answer is filed under the current background_set_for_dark, not the theme the request was for
trigger: Set a wallpaper while light, switch the app to dark before the answer lands
effect: default_backgrounds[dark] gets the light wallpaper
fix: Put for_dark in the pending purpose (SetDefaultBackground { for_dark }) and drop the shared field.

title: Deep-link stale check ignores states past ResolvingInfo/ResolvingChat
trigger: DeepLinkJoin or CheckInvite fails after the flow already moved to Info/InvitePreview (e.g. the user confirmed a second action)
effect: stale is true so the failure is ignored and the flow stays in its current state without any error while the join request is lost
fix: Match the generation on every DeepLinkState variant that carries one, not only the two resolving ones.

title: getLoginUrl answer stored in one slot without matching the request
trigger: Tap two login-url buttons quickly; the first answer arrives after the second request was sent
effect: The open-URL consent for the first button is shown with the second answer, or the second answer is replaced
fix: Key the answer by RequestId or message so each button consumes its own.

title: getBackgroundUrl answer lands in a global slot
trigger: Open the wallpaper preview Share for wallpaper A, close, open B before the answer for A
effect: background_url holds A's link while B's preview is open
fix: Return a Fetch keyed by the preview's request id.

title: A superseded username check's error sets the shared profile_edit_error
trigger: In Edit Profile type a username, then change it before the first checkChatUsername answers; the first one fails (timeout/flood). username_check_pending is matched by request id (line 15-24) so the newer check is kept, but the CheckUsername arm still writes profile_edit_error unconditionally.
effect: 'Profile update failed' is shown under a valid, still-being-checked username and is cleared only by the next check or save.
fix: Apply the CheckUsername error only when the failed request id equals username_check_pending; keep the check outcome as one enum (Idle/Checking{id,text}/Result/Failed).

title: AddContact failure has no handler in the users error arm
trigger: Add a contact from a profile while the addContact request fails (flood wait, offline).
effect: RemoveContact/ImportContacts/AddContactByPhone report errors but AddContact falls into the catch-all, so the Add button shows no failure unless a shared handler elsewhere reports it.
fix: Add AddContact to the contacts_notice arm.

title: loading_more is not tied to the request that set it, so a stale groups-in-common answer is taken as the first page
trigger: Load page 2 (loading_more=true), then trigger fetch_profile_chats for the same user again (retry/reopen) which removes the paging entry; page 2's late answer arrives with loading_more=false and replaces the list.
effect: After the fresh first page landed, the late page-2 answer replaces it: the panel lists only page 2's groups and `exhausted` is recomputed from it.
fix: Carry the RequestId in the Loading/Asking variants (as ProfilePhotosFetch does) and apply an answer only when its id matches.

title: refresh_chat_statistics drops the Loading entry while the old request is still pending and the new fetch is skipped
trigger: Open channel statistics, press Refresh while the first getChatStatistics is still in flight: the entry is removed, fetch_chat_statistics sees has_purpose_for_chat and returns Ok(None) without re-inserting Loading.
effect: The panel shows neither spinner nor data until the old answer lands (then it fills with the old result, ignoring the refresh); if that request is lost it stays empty. Same Loading-without-request-id shape in PollStatsFetch, InviteLinkFetch, JoinRequestFetch, AdminListFetch, ChatEventLogFetch.
fix: Give `Loading` the RequestId (like ProfilePhotosFetch) and have refresh replace it with a new Loading(id) so only that answer applies.

title: The 1024-place cap clears `files` and `asked` while the open chat still shows more places than that, so tiles are re-requested in a loop
trigger: Open a chat whose loaded window (up to 1500 messages) holds more than 1024 distinct locations/venues: each expect() at the cap clears the maps, the next pass finds the earlier places unasked and asks again.
effect: Tiles flicker to placeholders and getMapThumbnailFile is re-sent for places already answered, on every poll while the chat is open.
fix: Evict least-recently-shown entries (LRU) or only drop places not in the open window; never wholesale clear.

title: check_in_flight has no request id and CanTransferOwnership is not swept, so a lost answer blocks every later check
trigger: Open the transfer dialog; the canTransferOwnership answer never arrives (connection drop while the request stays registered). Close and reopen the dialog: check_can_transfer_ownership returns early on check_in_flight.
effect: The transfer dialog keeps its checking state; Transfer never becomes available until the account session restarts.
fix: Store `Option<RequestId>` and let a new dialog open replace it; or make the request sweepable.

title: Row-progress grading uses only the main window's rows, so auto-download progress in a chat window is always coalesced
trigger: Open a chat in its own window while the main window shows another chat; photos auto-download in the chat window. file_need compares against RowsOnScreen (reported by the main window only) and falls to RedrawNeed::Later.
effect: Download progress and the completing row update in batches instead of live in the chat window (cosmetic).
fix: Report rows per window view (WindowViews) and test the window that draws the chat, as interaction_need does for the chat-window case.

title: is_sweepable leaves the later-page and tab searches out, so a lost answer keeps their in-flight state
trigger: Open global search, Channels tab or Posts tab, or press Load more; the answer is lost.
effect: Leg stays Pending (panel says Searching), tabs.loading_more or recommended_loading stays true until a new query; Load more is refused.
fix: Give the in-flight state a deadline in one Fetch value or add these purposes to the sweep list.

title: An envelope dropped as out-of-order is dropped before its pending request is taken, so the request and its download count leak
trigger: An answer arrives with seq <= last_seq (reader reorder or seq reset) for a mutation or a DownloadFile request.
effect: The request stays in RequestRegistry.pending forever (only sweepable lookups are swept); for a download has_download() stays true so the file is never asked again, and its spinner never clears.
fix: Take the pending request first and settle it (as lost) when the envelope is ignored, or do not drop answers by seq at all.

title: A story album answer creates the chat's album list when albums were never fetched
trigger: Create a story album (CreateStoryAlbum) in a chat whose albums were not loaded.
effect: stories.albums gets an entry with one album, which the album UI reads as the whole list.
fix: Store albums as Fetch<Vec<_>> and merge only into a Ready list.

title: SellGift ok clears the selected gift and convert box whatever is selected now
trigger: Sell a gift, then before the ok lands select another gift in the hub.
effect: The newly selected gift's panel and convert confirm are closed by the old gift's answer.
fix: Clear gift_selected only when it equals the gift the request carried.

title: SetCloseFriends ok applies whatever ids are staged, not the ids of the request that was acknowledged
trigger: Edit close friends and save, then save again with other ids before the first ok lands (the story editor stays usable).
effect: The first ok takes the second save's staged ids as confirmed; if the second fails the list shows ids the server does not have.
fix: Carry the ids on the pending request (story_ids, as ReorderStoryAlbums does) and apply those.

title: createCall answer is ignored when another call is already tracked, leaving the created outgoing call with no owner
trigger: Press Call and, before the callId answer lands, an incoming call from another user arrives and becomes active_call.
effect: The outgoing call exists on the server but is never tracked: its updateCall is ignored as an untracked outgoing id, so it cannot be hung up and rings the callee to timeout.
fix: On a callId answer with a busy slot, discardCall the created id (or queue it in busy_decline_queue).

title: Switching to another chat takes open_topic without releasing the old topic history
trigger: Open a forum topic in chat A, click chat B in the list.
effect: select_chat does open_topic.take() but release_topic_history only when previous == chat_id, so the left topic's history is never queued for trimming and stays at full length until the closed-chat bound evicts it (memory only).
fix: Release the taken topic against the previous chat id in every case, as deselect_topic does.

title: is_offline is true for Initial while connection_indicator shows nothing
trigger: Start the app and send or place a call before the first updateConnectionState arrives.
effect: Sends and calls are refused as offline (is_offline matches only Ready and Updating) with no connection strip drawn, so the person sees an offline error and an apparently connected app.
fix: Define both functions from one match on ConnectionState so Initial is the same answer in each (not offline, or shown as Connecting).

title: Supergroup member counts and profile facts are dropped when the full info is not stored yet
trigger: A supergroupFullInfo answer where the full-info record is created after set_supergroup_member_counts runs, or an update arrives before the first full info (groups/apply.rs:131).
effect: set_supergroup_member_counts and set_supergroup_profile_facts use get_mut and silently do nothing, so the permissions box shows zero restricted/banned counts until the next full-info update.
fix: Store the counts in the same step that creates the full info, or make the setters create the entry.

title: getProxies answer matched by purpose, not by request id; explicit refresh does not dedupe an in-flight fetch
trigger: Open the proxy list (fetch_proxies sends getProxies without checking has_purpose) while a fetch or a mutation's refetch is already out, then add a proxy
effect: The first answer clears loading and stale although a second request is still out, or an answer sent before the mutation lands after stale=true and clears it, so the list shows the pre-change proxies until the next change
fix: Fetch<T> carrying the RequestId of the getProxies it waits for; apply an answer only when its id is the current one, and let a mutation answer re-arm the refetch after it.

title: mutating is a bool, so the first of two overlapping proxy mutations clears it
trigger: Press Enable on one proxy and, before TDLib answers, Remove another (both purpose MutateProxy).
effect: The first answer sets mutating=false while the second is in flight, so the list controls re-enable and the first success marks the list stale and refetches while the second mutation may still be pending.
fix: Count by request id (Saving(Vec<RequestId>)) or serialize mutations.

title: Similar-channels strip state outlives the membership
trigger: Join a channel (strip inserted with expanded=true), leave it and open it again within the same session.
effect: similar_strips keeps the old joined_at notice and expanded flag for the chat id; the 'You joined this channel' row shows although the user left and is not a member (joined_at is only replaced by a new join).
fix: Remove the strip when the member status becomes Left/Banned or the chat is forgotten (history_prune).

title: A topic created by updateForumTopicInfo is pushed without preserving or fetching its unread and last message state
trigger: A bot creates a topic while the topic list is loaded
effect: The topic shows no unread badge and an empty preview until the driver refetches; topic order is max+1 with unchecked add
fix: Request getForumTopic for a new topic id, and use saturating_add for order.

title: replace_forum_topic runs keep_dirty_topic_drafts before the loaded check and drops the answer when the list is not loaded
trigger: getForumTopic answer arrives before getForumTopics (opening a topic from a link)
effect: The answer is discarded, the topic has no data until the list loads; the draft merge ran on a topic that is then thrown away
fix: Check loaded first, or store the answer in a per-topic Fetch.

title: A stale public-forwards page is appended to a freshly reopened post's statistics
trigger: Open Message Statistics for post A, load more public forwards, and while page 2 is in flight open post B's statistics and then post A's again.
effect: begin_message gives A a fresh empty state, and the in-flight page-2 answer (matched by chat and message only) is appended to it: page 2's forwards show without page 1, next_offset continues past them, and message_forwards_loaded now reports loaded so page 1 is never asked.
fix: Record the forwards request id (or the offset it asked) in the list and accept only the answer to it; dropping the state for another post should also forget its request.

title: Process-wide LAUNCH_CHATS stage is moved by any client's Ready, not the on-screen client's
trigger: Launch with two accounts where the background account's TDLib reports authorizationStateReady before the on-screen account has opened its database.
effect: The stage goes to ASKED for a page nobody asked for, so the first frame (macOS) blocks the main thread up to the 50 ms cap waiting for the on-screen page that is still far off; the design says a client still opening its database is not waited for.
fix: Key the launch wait to the client id that registered the on_ready launch request (store it in LaunchChats when load_chats_when_ready runs) and ignore other clients' auth states.

title: Name accent palette is one process-wide table written by every account's session
trigger: Have a production account and a test-DC account signed in (or two accounts whose servers send different updateAccentColors); the background account's updateAccentColors arrives last.
effect: Names on the account on screen are painted with the other account's server palette (ids 7+), and the table only corrects when the on-screen account's next updateAccentColors arrives.
fix: Keep the palette in each Session (it is per-server config) and pass the on-screen session's palette to the renderer, or key PALETTE by AccountKey.

title: Outgoing typing is keyed by chat only; sendChatAction is built with topic_id null and routed by whatever thread is open at send time
trigger: In a forum or a channel's comments, type into the composer in thread/topic A, then open topic B of the same chat (or go back to the chat) within 4 s.
effect: OutgoingTyping { chat_id, last_sent_ms } (connect/typing.rs) has no topic, so a thread change inside the same chat neither cancels A nor starts B (prev.chat_id == chat_id, inside the interval). The later chatActionCancel goes through thread_routed with the new thread's topic, so A keeps showing 'typing' until the server times it out, and the cancel goes to the wrong topic. For an admin in a channel's direct messages with a topic open, direct_routed leaves sendChatAction at topic null, so the typing does not reach that conversation.
fix: Key OutgoingTyping by (ChatId, Option<TopicId>), pass the topic into send_chat_action_kind, and cancel when that key changes.

title: 'Warning confirmed for this run' resets on account switch
trigger: Confirm the IP-exposure warning, switch account, open another proxy link
effect: The one-time warning appears again; the field lives in the per-account SettingsUi although documented as per run
fix: Keep it in an app-wide struct (allowlisted) or document it as per account.

title: Proxy editor closes on 'request sent', not on TDLib's answer
trigger: Save an add/edit that TDLib rejects after the request was sent
effect: Box closes as if saved; the error only shows as Settings error text on the page behind
fix: Keep the editor in a Saving stage until the add/edit answer, close on ok, show error on err.

title: A failed key put leaves the raw key in the .key.tmp file
trigger: Disk full or rename fails while storing a new database key on Linux
effect: write_key_file_0600 writes the unsealed key to db-encryption.key.tmp; when rename_retrying fails the tmp file is never removed
fix: Remove tmp on every error path after it was created (guard with a drop-removing file).

title: Tray menu's notification and sound toggles work while Quill is locked
trigger: Lock Quill with the passcode. Open the tray menu and click 'Disable notifications' or 'Disable notification sounds'.
effect: main.rs:499-510 calls set_desktop_notifications / set_inapp_sounds_enabled with no refused_while_locked check. The on-screen account's setting flips and is saved from behind the lock. tdesktop hides the notifications toggle while locked (docs/decisions/lock-is-a-render-state.md, tray.cpp). Tray::new always builds both items, and sync_tray never learns the lock.
fix: Pass the lock into sync_tray so the menu model drops or disables the toggles while locked (the SNI menu too), and refuse ToggleNotifications/ToggleSounds in the tray action dispatch via refused_while_locked.

title: Turning the tray icon off while it is still registering leaves an orphan tray icon that nothing can remove
trigger: Linux with a slow session bus: start Quill (tray registering, Phase::Connecting), switch Settings > 'Show tray icon' off before registration finishes; later switch it on again.
effect: hide() drops the Receiver and goes Idle; the worker thread then finishes tray.spawn(), its send fails and the Handle is dropped without shutdown(). ksni's service loop only stops on HandleRequest::Shutdown (a closed handle channel just disables that select arm), so the icon stays in the tray with its menu live although the setting says off; switching it back on registers a second icon. Needs a restart.
fix: Make the registration worker own the outcome: Phase::Connecting carries a cancel flag (or the worker sends to a channel it checks) and the worker calls handle.shutdown() when the receiver is gone; or keep Connecting until it lands and then shut it down in the Ready arm when hidden.

title: Failed chat window open leaves the chat open nowhere
trigger: Open in new window for the chat active in the main window when creating the OS window fails.
effect: The main window already left the chat (leave_open_chat, draft moved) and the Err arm closes the window chat, so the chat shows in no window; only an error note appears.
fix: On Err re-select the chat in the main window, or leave the main window only after the window opened.

title: Reopen closed window loses the entry when the reopen is refused
trigger: Close a chat window, lock Quill or let the chat vanish/driver open_chat_window fail, then Reopen closed window.
effect: closed.pop() runs before open_chat_window_at, which returns early (chat unknown, locked, driver error) without putting the entry back; the window can no longer be reopened.
fix: Peek the last entry and pop it only when the window opened (or push back on the early returns).

title: Network usage reset confirmation stays armed after leaving the Data and Storage page
trigger: Data and Storage, press 'Reset statistics' (confirm shown), go to another settings page, return via the sidebar.
effect: The page shows 'Reset the statistics?' with a live Reset button again; network_reset_confirm is cleared only by open_data_storage, not by leave_data_storage/arrive_data_storage (data_storage.rs:218-231).
fix: Make the confirm part of the page's transient state dropped in leave_data_storage (an enum NetworkReset { Idle, Confirming } on the settings page state).

title: Failed reset of network statistics is silent
trigger: Press Reset in the confirmation while the driver cannot send (chats path inactive or send error).
effect: The confirm disappears as if the reset worked; reset_network_statistics (connect/privacy_data.rs:199-213) returns Err without setting any error and the UI discards it with let _.
fix: Surface the Err as data_storage_error (the pattern of clear_storage/set_storage_limits) and keep the confirm until the send succeeded.

title: Dropped pinned chat jumps back until TDLib echoes the new order
trigger: Drag a pinned chat to a new slot and release; any app notify syncs within ~33 ms, before TDLib answers setPinnedChats.
effect: finish_drag reorders the local entries, but the next set_pins gets the model's old order (same_order false), rebuilds the entries in the old order (the picture snaps back), then moves again when the server update arrives. If the request fails the picture stays in the old order with only a note.
fix: Keep an expected-order stage (Reordering{ids}) in the panel that set_pins honours until the model shows that order or the command fails.

title: The 4-hour recheck replaces 'Updated to Quill X' without acknowledging the changelog, so the banner comes back on the next launch
trigger: Install an update and start Quill on 'Updated to Quill X'. Leave the banner and the Settings changelog alone, keep Quill running for 4 hours, then restart.
effect: UpdateState::Installed maps to UpdateControl::Check { busy: false }, so the timer's check_for_updates runs and overwrites Installed with Checking and then UpToDate. The banner and the 'Dismiss changelog' button disappear, but acknowledge_changelog never ran, so the result file stays and the next launch shows the banner again. A dismissed banner (update_banner_dismissed) is also reset by the check.
fix: Keep the changelog in its own value (Installed { release, dismissed }), apart from the check state, so a recheck cannot drop it. Or skip the timer check while Installed is unacknowledged.

title: The frozen-account and age-check box flags stay set when their condition clears, so the box reappears unasked
trigger: Open the frozen-account details from the banner (or the age prompt by turning on 18+ content). The server lifts the freeze, or the age check is completed in the browser, while the box is open. Later the account is frozen again, or verification is required again.
effect: account_notice() shows Frozen only while freeze_info_open && sync.freeze.is_some(), so the box vanishes when the freeze clears, but freeze_info_open stays true. When freeze is set again in the same session, the box pops open without a click. age_verify_open has the same shape. The two flags and age_verify_started also describe one box with no single owner.
fix: One value for the open notice (enum OpenNotice { None, Frozen, AgeVerify { started } }), cleared when its condition goes away (in the dialog sync) as well as by Close and Esc.

title: The per-window applied-frame map keeps an entry for every window ever opened
trigger: Open and close chat windows, call windows and notification popups for a long session.
effect: APPLIED (thread-local HashMap<WindowId, bool>) gains an entry per window in sync() and nothing removes it when the window closes: state that outlives its window, a slow leak.
fix: Keep the applied frame in the window's own state (WindowSlot / the window view) or remove the entry from when_window_goes.

title: answer_on_exit leaves an unreaped child when no waiter thread can start
trigger: Thread spawn fails (resource limit) while opening a link
effect: The Err arm answers true and drops child without wait(); a zombie stays until Quill exits
fix: Hand the child to child_reap::wait_in_background as the Windows path does.

title: Answers stamped with a closed chat window land in a new window for the same chat
trigger: Open chat X in its own window, start a view request there (shared media, calendar, message-by-date, thread history, sponsored rows), close the window and reopen X in a window before the answer lands.
effect: PendingRequest::window is the chat id, which repeats: apply_payload_in_asking_view finds window_chats contains X again and applies the old window's answer to the new window's fresh view. Most view states have their own stamp, but any that match only by chat (sponsored rows, date jump, Instant View) take it.
fix: Key window views by a per-open window token (or bump a view epoch in open_window_chat) and stamp requests with it, so a reopened window never takes the closed one's answers.

title: activate reads the composer of a slot that is swapped in
trigger: In chat window X choose Open in new window for X's own chat (or a notification click routed while X is in place).
effect: slot.composer is the main window's composer while X's scope is in place (swap_slot), so focus goes to the wrong entity and X's compose field does not take the keyboard.
fix: Look the composer up through the in-place state when the slot's scope is in place, or focus via the window's own view.

title: route_chat_open drops the ChatOpen (forward draft, dropped files, compose text, inline return) silently on three paths
trigger: Drag selected messages or files onto a chat row (or Forward 'continue in chat') while (a) the target chat window's session view is gone (in_window_scope returns None), (b) main_window.handle is None (`let main = self.main_window.handle?`), or (c) the account switches before the deferred select_chat_request runs (in_screen_scope returns None / main.update fails).
effect: The carried forward draft/files/text vanish with no note and no chat opens; the source selection was already consumed so the user's picked messages are lost.
fix: Return a Result/enum from route_chat_open (`Routed::{Landed, Here(open), Dropped}`), and on Dropped restore the carry to its source (ForwardStage::Selecting) or post a note.

title: Account switch started from inside a chat window's update neither saves nor removes that window
trigger: Active window is a chat window; switch account from the OS menu/Dock/secret-code path (os_menus/mod.rs:192, secret_codes_ui.rs:147), so close_chat_windows_for_switch runs inside that window's update.
effect: save_chat_windows_now uses handle.update(...).ok()? so the leased window is skipped and its place is not saved under the outgoing account (not restored on switching back); handle.update(remove_window) also fails for it, so the OS window lingers until its next render notices window_chats lost it and removes it (mark_closed already set, deferred remove).
fix: Read each window's bounds from the data ChatWindows already keeps (WindowPlace in open.slot/note_place) instead of handle.update, and remove windows through cx.defer.

title: ChatWindows::save_pending is a bool armed before a screen-scoped timer and cleared only inside the timer's update
trigger: Move or close a chat window (arms save_pending and the 600 ms spawn_screen timer), then let the screen epoch move before the timer fires without the screen being replaced (screen_leaves_later with no main window: 'the old UI stays under the new epoch').
effect: The timer's update returns Gone, save_pending is never cleared, schedule_chat_windows_save returns early forever and window places are no longer saved; close_chat_windows_for_switch also treats it as 'a save is due'. Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt.
fix: Replace the bool with `save: SaveTimer { Idle, Due(Task<()>) }` stored in ChatWindows so dropping the owner drops the timer and the stage is the task itself; clear it when the task is cancelled.

title: Restore::Offered has no exit if the offer box goes away without calling on_ok/on_cancel
trigger: The 'Restore chat windows?' alert (open_alert_dialog, not a registered DialogSpec) is replaced or closed by something that runs no callback (kit close_all_dialogs runs no on_close, another kit dialog opening over the single modal slot, close_kit_dialog_if_done closing the top box).
effect: restore stays Offered for the session: the question is never asked again, the windows are never restored, and nothing re-opens the box until restart. Only the account switch (which replaces ChatWindows) leaves this stage.
fix: Register the offer as a DialogSpec whose flag is Restore::Offered, so the shell syncs the box from the stage and a lost box re-opens or falls to Done; or tie Offered to the alert's close.

title: A key in a chat window's message menu closes the main window's chat-row submenu
trigger: In the main window right-click a chat row and hover a row with a submenu, so it opens. Without closing it, right-click a message in a chat window and press an arrow key.
effect: open_submenu() reads the screen-wide chat_list.menu / community row_menu. parent_of finds no parent in the chat window's items, so the main window's submenu is closed as stale.
fix: Read open_submenu only when !windows.in_window(), the same gate as main_menu_open.

title: Debounced window-state save flag sticks when the window is gone before the 600 ms timer fires
trigger: Main window is replaced after a lost GPU (forget_native_window) or closed within 600 ms of a move/resize; the spawn_in task's update_in returns Err and never clears the flag
effect: schedule_window_state_save returns early forever after: geometry is staged but only written to disk on quit, so a crash loses the window position
fix: Replace the bool with a SaveTimer enum (Idle | Scheduled(Task)) holding the task, so dropping the task or window returns it to Idle

title: Storage limit sliders apply only on Release
trigger: Drag a storage slider and release outside the control or lose the pointer.
effect: If Release is not delivered the label shows the new value but the limit was never applied.
fix: Apply on blur or dialog close too.

title: A previewed saved sound plays whenever its download ends
trigger: Press the play button on a saved sound that is not downloaded, close the settings, wait.
effect: The completion lands in pending_sound_plays and hand_out_notifications plays it unconditionally, long after the picker is gone, even when sounds are off or the user is in a call.
fix: Tie the pending play to the picker session (token) and drop it when the picker closes.

title: The ringing-call toast is tracked in one slot that is the account on screen's
trigger: Account A rings and is notified; switch to account B (or another call rings there).
effect: calls.notified holds one (account, call_id); announce_ringing_call dismisses it as soon as the account on screen has no ringing call, so A's still-ringing toast (with Accept/Decline) is withdrawn, and a second notified call overwrites the slot so the first is never dismissed.
fix: Track notified calls per account (map keyed by AccountKey), dismissed by the account that owns the call.

title: A withdraw can run before the toast it should close is registered
trigger: A chat is read on another device right after its message arrives (Linux D-Bus path).
effect: show() runs on a worker thread and records the id only after the Notify round trip; close() finds no id in Shown and returns Ok, then the toast appears and stays for a chat that was already read.
fix: Record 'withdrawn' for the key in Shown so show() closes what it just made.

title: The signal listener thread ends for good when the bus iterator ends
trigger: The session bus connection drops (bus restart) while Quill runs.
effect: listen() returns when MessageIterator ends and is never restarted; NOTIFIER stays set, so toasts still show but their clicks, Reply and Closed signals never arrive until restart.
fix: Reconnect (clear NOTIFIER and let the retry gate re-make it) when the listener ends.

title: An unlinked window still counts as replying
trigger: Type in a notification's reply field, then the chat is read/opened elsewhere (clear_custom_notifications) or Hide all is pressed.
effect: The window is unlinked and fading but Shown::replying stays true until it is removed, so held() blocks the other windows' fade and notify_start_all_hiding returns early for that time.
fix: Make replying part of the window's stage enum so unlinking leaves it; any_replying counts live windows only.

title: A notification is dropped silently when its window cannot open
trigger: A notification leaves the queue and open_window fails (display gone, window limit).
effect: Pending was already taken from the queue; only an eprintln is left, so the message is never shown by Quill's windows and no fallback runs.
fix: Put the Pending back at the head of the queue (retry on the next display change) or fall back to the system notification.

title: Color box shows a shared profile-edit error and keeps its own stale one
trigger: Fail an Apply (or fail another profile edit such as username/photo while the box is open), then pick another swatch.
effect: The box reads the session-wide users_state.profile_edit_error, also written by profile, photo and username saves, so a foreign error shows in the color box; after its own failure the error stays through further edits (edit_peer_color clears only sent) until the next Apply.
fix: Keep the apply failure in the dialog's own stage enum, keyed by the request that asked, and clear it on edit.

title: Failed image decode is cached for the path for the rest of the session
trigger: A pinned chat photo or sticker path is drawn before the file is readable/complete, or the file is later replaced at the same path.
effect: FILES stores Some(None) for the path; file_image returns None from the cache every time, so the pinned chat keeps its initials / the sticker stays blank until 512 other pictures flush the cache.
fix: Cache only successful decodes (or key by path+mtime/size); a miss retries.

title: Touch Bar model is rebuilt on every app notify on Macs without a Touch Bar and while hidden
trigger: Run Quill on any Mac (enabled() only reads the experimental option, not the hardware); keep an animation or poll running.
effect: Every notify schedules a 33 ms timer task that rebuilds the pinned panel (clones titles, photo paths for all pinned chats) and applies it to AppKit, up to 30 times a second, also with the window hidden to the tray.
fix: Skip scheduling when the OS reports no Touch Bar / the window is not visible, and skip apply when the Bar equals the last one applied.

title: Touch Bar is bound to the first main window; a main window reopened after GPU loss is never attached
trigger: GPU is lost; startup_failure::device_loss reopens the main window (attach_main_window runs again, os_menus::install does not). Press a Touch Bar item.
effect: The command task's update_in on the dead window fails and its loop breaks, `handle` for sync is stale and HOST keeps the old NSWindow, so the new window has no Touch Bar and later touches pile up in INBOX unread.
fix: Install per main window from attach_main_window (a WindowSlot-like owner that drops HOST/INBOX with the window), not once per process.

title: Touch commands carry bare ids with no account or screen epoch
