trigger: Tap a pinned chat/sticker, or drop a reorder, while an account switch lands between the tap (bar still shows the old account for up to ~33 ms) and the command running.
effect: OpenChat(ChatId), SendSticker(file_id) and ReorderPinned(ids) are applied to the account now on screen: opens an unrelated/missing chat, sends a sticker file id of the other account, or sends a pin order of the other account's chats (TDLib error note).
fix: Stamp each Command with the ScreenEpoch of the Bar it came from (in_screen_scope) and drop it when stale.

title: A disk dip shorter than the download's reaction time leaves the update at 'Update Quill' instead of resuming
trigger: Let an update download start, then let the disk go Low and back to Healthy within a moment, before the download thread notices the hold.
effect: hold_update_download sets the hold. On Healthy, auto_download_update calls download_update, which returns at once because the state is still Downloading. The old download then fails as held and finish_update_download sets Available. Nothing starts it again until the next disk transition or the 4-hour check, so the title bar shows Update Quill instead of downloading.
fix: Make a held download a stage of its own (Downloading { held: true }) that resumes on Healthy when its answer lands, or have finish_update_download restart it when the disk is already healthy.

title: The X11 connection is cached for the process even after it breaks
trigger: On X11, have the X connection fail after first use (Xwayland or the X server restarted under a running session, or the connection hits an error); then use Close to tray / pin on top / Show taskbar icon.
effect: CONNECTION keeps the first RustConnection forever; once it errors every set_visible, set_always_on_top, set_skip_taskbar and is_minimised call fails silently (hide does nothing, minimised reads false) until Quill restarts.
fix: Drop the cached connection when a request on it fails (`Option` replaced by `Connected | Broken`), so the next call reconnects.

title: The update helper gives up after 30 s of waiting for the app to exit and starts the old Quill again while the first one is still quitting
trigger: Press Restart to update while Quill takes long to quit (several accounts closing TDLib, a slow disk), or on Unix after the pid is reused by another process.
effect: restart_to_update hands off and calls cx.quit(); wait_for_parent polls kill(pid, 0) for 30 s at most. If the quit is slower, install() fails, apply_plan writes a failed receipt and relaunches the old version, which then meets the still-running process (single-instance lock) and opens with 'Update installation failed'. A reused pid has the same effect.
fix: Wait on something only the parent holds (the claim's lock, already shared with the helper) instead of the pid, with no fixed deadline while that lock is held.

title: Login review is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Review of new-login alert.
effect: review_pending, review_confirmed, review_error and review_outcome together encode Idle/Reviewing/Failed/Done.
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing{confirmed, outstanding}, Failed(String), Done(LoginReview) }.

title: Terms accept is terms_in_flight + terms_error beside terms
trigger: Accept terms of service.
effect: In-flight flag and error line are cleared by hand on the ok and error arms.
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Offered(Terms), Accepting(Terms), Failed(Terms, String) }.

title: Change-number flow is loading/checking bools plus phone/timeout/error options
trigger: Settings > change phone number.
effect: change_number_loading, change_number_checking, change_number_phone, change_number_timeout, change_number_error are cleared in four different places (apply, error, session_apply_ok) and the check deliberately may overlap a resend.
fix: enum ChangeNumber { Idle, Sending, CodeSent{phone,timeout,resending}, Checking{phone}, Failed{..} }.

title: One password_state_loading bool serves every 2FA operation
trigger: Any two-step verification action (fetch, set, recover, reset, login email).
effect: password_state_loading + password_op_error + password_state are shared by ten ops; the ok, error, passwordState, emailCodeInfo and resetPasswordResult arms each have to clear the flag, and a request refused by the guard is silently dropped (InvalidRequest).
fix: Fetch<PasswordState> plus an Option<PasswordOp> in-flight marker keyed by RequestId.

title: Passkeys screen has removing Option, adding bool, stale bool, requested_at, registration, ceremony Options and error
trigger: List, remove and create a passkey.
effect: Registration is registration + ceremony + adding + Parameters in-flight purpose scan; login (passkeys_login.rs) adds pending, ceremony, checking, config_requested bools.
fix: A Register enum (Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(options), Adding) and a Login enum.

title: Signal handler stage is IN_HANDLER + REPORT_DONE + INSTALLED atomics
trigger: A fault in one thread while another faults
effect: Works today (first thread writes, others wait up to 2 s); stage is three separate bools
fix: One AtomicU8 with Idle, Reporting, Reported.

title: Background unread is a process-global atomic written by the UI at several call sites
trigger: Account switch, retire_live_to_background, take_background_live, poll, stop_background_clients each call publish_background_unread
effect: A path that changes background clients without calling publish_background_unread leaves the tray, dock badge and window title with the old other-accounts count (also read without an owner key by window_chrome.rs)
fix: Derive the badge from BackgroundAccounts::total_unread when drawing, or make the clients list the single writer through a setter that publishes.

title: Passkey sign-in stage is config_requested, pending, ceremony, checking and error
trigger: QR sign-in screen: link click, options fetch, ceremony, checkAuthenticationPasskey.
effect: `checking: bool` is set before the request and cleared only by ok/fail/send error; a dropped request or an auth state that moves on by itself leaves it true until the next fail(). `config_requested` is a once-only flag kept on a Session that survives logout.
fix: enum LoginStage { Idle, FetchingOptions(request), Ceremony(options), Checking(request), Failed(String) } reset whole when the authorization state leaves the QR screen.

title: PasskeysState spreads the list fetch, removal and registration over eight fields
trigger: known/stale/requested_at drive the fetch; removing/error drive removal; registration/ceremony/adding/added drive the add flow; error is shared by all three.
effect: A failed removal and a failed list share one `error` string; `added` is a one-shot flag the UI takes; `ceremony` and `registration` hold the same options twice.
fix: List: Fetch<Vec<Passkey>> with a stale generation; removal: Option<Removal{id, request}> in the list value; registration: one enum (see 04-p2-010) with its own error.

title: FreeState requesting + serial + menu_open are a request stage plus a menu stage
trigger: Click the pill, open the menu while a request is on its way, account price changes
effect: requesting, serial and menu_open are reset by hand in request, drop_pending, sync and pill_clicked
fix: enum FreeUi { Idle, MenuOpen, Requesting{request,serial} } so a request closes the menu by construction.

title: contact_link Fetch is paired with a separate contact_error Option
trigger: getUserLink for the contact link fails
effect: UserLinkFetch::Failed and contact_error are set together and cleared separately (retry_contact_link, drain_peer_qr take()); Failed with no error or error with no Failed can occur
fix: UserLinkFetch::Failed(Option<String>) with the box taking the reason once (Fetch<T> shape).

title: PeerQrBox save stage is chosen + saving + failed + save_serial + served kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick, close panel, save, fail, pick again, rights change
effect: chosen/saving/failed/served move together in apply(); a missed arm leaves a pick unsaved or resent
fix: One enum Theme { Following(served), Picked(choice), Saving{serial,choice}, SaveFailed(choice) } with the transitions in one place.

title: ThemeGifts stage is loaded + complete + loading + retry_at + requested_at
trigger: Open the gifts panel, scroll to the end, a next page fails, close and reopen
effect: five fields encode idle/first-loading/ready/more-loading/failed-retry; wants_more and fail() must keep them consistent by hand
fix: enum GiftsFetch { Idle, FirstLoading, Ready{more:bool}, LoadingMore, RetryAfter(i64) } carrying the serial.

title: Backdrops stage is loading bool + requested_at Option
trigger: Open the QR box with no network, then with network
effect: loading and requested_at must be set by start() and cleared by fail(); a dropped answer with neither accept nor fail leaves loading true and due() false for the session
fix: Fetch<Vec<ShareThemeBackdrop>> with a timestamp in the Ready/Failed variant.

title: Account lifecycle is three fields kept in step by hand: accounts, pending_deletes and active
trigger: remove an account / lock-screen log out: begin_remove_account moves the key from accounts to pending_deletes, mark_for_deletion leaves it in both, finish_pending_delete clears it
effect: an account can be listed and pending-delete at once (mark_for_deletion) or only pending (begin_remove); active must be re-pointed by hand in two places (begin_remove_account, tidy_registry)
fix: enum AccountEntry { Listed, Removing{folder pending}, WipeOnNextStart } in one Vec<(AccountKey, AccountEntry)>, active as an index/key into the Listed ones only.

title: New-login review is review_pending counter + review_confirmed + review_error + review_outcome
trigger: Press Yes it is me or No on the new-login banner with several unconfirmed sessions
effect: Stages (idle, reviewing N, failed, done) are spread over four fields; review_confirmed is written by connect/account_hygiene.rs:53 and never read (dead state); busy is review_pending > 0
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing { confirmed, remaining: Vec<RequestId>, error: Option<String> } } with the outcome taken once by the UI.

title: Terms accept is terms + terms_in_flight + terms_error
trigger: Accept the terms of service
effect: in-flight bool next to an error and the terms option; the ok answer (session_apply_ok.rs:232) is not matched to the terms id that was sent
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Pending(Terms), Accepting { id }, Failed { terms, error } }.

title: TwofaFlow is code_sent_to options + notice + refetch flag kept in step with PasswordStateOp answers
trigger: Two-step recovery, reset and login-email flows
effect: recovery_code_sent_to / login_email_code_sent_to / notice are cleared in several places (apply_reset_password_result, apply_password_state_op, apply_password_op_ok, ui clear_twofa_flow, connect/auth.rs); refetch is a take-once flag
fix: enum TwofaFlow { Idle, RecoveryCodeSent{to}, LoginEmailCodeSent{to}, Done(notice) } plus a refetch request token.

title: Change-number flow is loading/checking bools plus an error and pending phone/timeout options
trigger: Settings > change number: send code, resend, check
effect: Stage is spread over change_number_loading, change_number_checking, change_number_error, change_number_phone, change_number_timeout; the checks in connect/auth.rs use different guards for each and a lost answer relies on error arm clearing
fix: enum ChangeNumber{Idle,Sending,CodeSent{phone,timeout,resending},Checking{phone},Failed{..}} with the request id inside Sending/Checking

title: 2FA management uses password_state_loading beside password_op_error and password_state
trigger: Open Two-step verification, run get/set/recovery ops
effect: A bool in flight flag shared by every PasswordStateOp request, an error string and the cached state are kept in step by hand
fix: Fetch<PasswordState> plus an op enum holding the request ids in flight

title: Passkey registration: adding bool, registration, ceremony and added one-shot
trigger: n/a
effect: adding is set in finish_register and cleared by the Add error arm or accept_added; the Parameters error arm leaves registration/ceremony as they were.
fix: enum Registration { Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(opts), Adding, Added }.

title: The Export Telegram data box's mode is three fields kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: The box is Options(draft) when account_export_dialog is Some, Progress when the session has an export and account_export_progress_hidden is false, Hidden when the flag is true; account_export_seen caches the last progress. Every close path (on_close, .close, Cancel, Done, Hide, the poll) writes a different subset of them.
fix: enum AccountExportBox { Closed, Options(AccountExportDraft), Progress { seen: Option<AccountProgress> }, Hidden }, with the export's existence read from the session.

title: Account box: open, confirm_delete and confirm_logout are one stage held as three bools
trigger: n/a
effect: Both inline confirms can be armed at once (press Log out, then Permanently delete); each closer resets a different subset (submit_logout skips the inputs, submit_delete_account resets only confirm_delete).
fix: Option<AccountBox { confirm: Confirm::{None, Delete, LogOut}, reason, password }> with one close that drops it.

title: Account box reads TTL, auto-delete and password-state fetches as loading/busy bools next to error options
trigger: n/a
effect: account_ttl_loading + account_ttl_days + account_error, account_mutating, default_auto_delete_busy + default_auto_delete_error, password_state_loading + password_state are each a loading flag beside a value/error pair; open_account_lifecycle clears the error fields by hand because a cached value skips the fetch that would.
fix: Fetch<i32> for the TTL and the auto-delete time, Fetch<PasswordState> for the password state, and one Mutation { Idle, Running, Failed(String) } for the setters.

title: Age verification prompt: age_verify_open and age_verify_started are stages of one flow
trigger: n/a
effect: The gate is NotAsked / Prompting / Started held as two bools written in updates_sync_ui.rs and account_notices.rs.
fix: enum AgeGate { Idle, Prompting, Started } on AccountBoxes.

title: recovery_mode and accepted_registration_terms are reset by poll_live when auth changes, not by the auth stage
trigger: Auth moves away from WaitPassword or WaitRegistration (any path).
effect: Two UI values are valid only in one authorization state; notifications/mod.rs:467-480 clears them by hand each poll. A path that changes auth without that poll code (a restart of the connection, a screen replacement) relies on OnScreen being rebuilt.
fix: Keep step-specific UI in an enum keyed by the authorization state, rebuilt when the state changes.

title: Terms prompt is terms_step plus terms_age_ok plus terms_age_error
trigger: Terms of service box: tick the age box, press Agree without it, press Decline, Back.
effect: Three fields describe one prompt: the step enum, a bool for the ticked age and a bool for the shown error. They are written from three click handlers in dialogs/account_notices.rs and reset nowhere except the checkbox handler.
fix: enum TermsStep { Terms { age_ok: bool, age_error: bool }, DeclineSorry, DeleteWarning } on a Option<TermsPrompt> that exists only while notices.terms is Some.

title: BackgroundAccounts keeps the lifecycle of each account in several sets, counters and bools
trigger: Starting, closing, removing, wiping or restarting accounts.
effect: starting (set), preparing (counts), closing (ClosingSet), deleting (set), clients (Vec with live Option and status), plus polling, wiping, swept and screen_preparing are all read together in ensure_background_accounts, deletion_wait, open_wait and startup_sweep. An account's stage (Preparing, Starting, Running, Closing, Deleting, Failed) is the combination of its membership in these. The polling bool is also the 'a poll task runs' flag.
fix: HashMap<AccountKey, AccountStage> with an enum (Preparing, Starting, Running(LiveConnect), Closing{restart}, Deleting, NeedsSignIn/Failed) so every check is one match; polling as Option<Task>.

title: A background account that failed to start keeps a dead client entry that nothing retries
trigger: finish_background_start gets a non-DiskFull blocker (keychain read fails once) or the bridge stops unexpectedly.
effect: The entry stays with live None and status Failed; ensure_background_accounts skips any key that has a client entry, so the account gets no notifications or unread count until Quill restarts or the account is switched to.
fix: Make Failed a stage with a retry exit (on the next ensure pass or an explicit retry), instead of an entry that blocks the start.

title: Marketplace gift purchase is loading/sending/completed bools plus a note, seeded by hand in the demo
trigger: Gift marketplace box
effect: No bug found in this shard; the demo builds GiftPurchase with loading:false, sending:false, completed:false, so any combination of the three can exist
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Quoting, Quoted(GiftQuote), Sending, Completed, Failed(String) }.

title: Storage statistics are an Option plus storage_stats_loading bool, set together by hand
trigger: Settings > Data and storage
effect: No bug found here; the demo sets storage_stats = Some(..) and storage_stats_loading = false separately
fix: Use Fetch<StorageStats> (idle/loading/ready/failed).

title: Device linking stage is three Options: scanner, scanned link, notice
trigger: n/a (side effect: paste a link while the camera scan runs; the scanner's later result overwrites the pasted link)
effect: device_qr_scanner, device_login_qr and device_link_notice can all be set at once; scan_device_qr checks two, paste_device_login_link checks one.
fix: `enum DeviceLink { Idle(Option<notice>), Scanning(DeviceQrScanner), Confirm(Zeroizing<String>), Linking(RequestId) }`.

title: Device-link flow is three Options kept in step by hand (scanner, scanned link, notice)
trigger: Settings > Devices > Link device: scan or paste, confirm, wait for Telegram
effect: No bug today; stages Idle / Scanning / AwaitingConsent / WaitingForTelegram / Done(notice) are spread over device_qr_scanner, device_login_qr and device_link_notice, with scan_device_qr and paste_device_login_link each re-checking a different subset
fix: One enum DeviceLink { Idle, Scanning(Scanner), Consent(link), Waiting, Result(DeviceLoginResult|Error) }; Waiting leaves on the DeviceLoginResult answer.

title: Lock screen stage is spread over lock_error, flood_until, shake_started, logout_confirm and suggest_system_unlock
trigger: Lock, enter wrong passcodes, press Log out.
effect: These fields change together in lock_failed, unlock_answered, unlock_done, passcode_tick and the Log out buttons.
fix: enum LockScreen { Ready, Failed{text, shake_at}, Flooded{until}, ConfirmLogout, Verifying }.

title: PanelMotion keeps shown, opening and started in step with the reducer's panel
trigger: Open and close the colors panel.
effect: Three fields describe one animation (idle, opening, closing) beside QrPanel in the reducer; qr_act rebuilds them whenever panel changes, and started is never cleared after the motion ends.
fix: enum PanelMotion { Idle, Opening{panel,since}, Closing{panel,since} } derived from the reducer's panel change.

title: QR box export and clock stages are two bools on OpenQr
trigger: Open the QR box with a countdown, press Copy or Share.
effect: exporting (set in export.rs qr_export, cleared in the continuation only when the box id matches) and clock_running (set in sync_qr_clock, cleared by the loop) are hand-kept stage flags; a dropped continuation leaves exporting true and the Copy button spinning.
fix: enum Export { Idle, Rendering, ShareReady(PathBuf) } and enum Clock { Stopped, Running } (or a task handle) on OpenQr.

title: Two-step box: open bool, view, confirm and notice kept in step
trigger: Open 2FA, move between Enable/Change/Disable/Recover, close.
effect: twofa.open (bool mirror of the dialog), view, confirm, notice and the session's twofa_flow.notice are reset together in goto_twofa_view/close_twofa and again in build_twofa_dialog (state mutated during dialog build).
fix: enum Twofa { Closed, Open{view, confirm, notice} } with transitions only in methods.

title: Devices page: session_details, renaming_device, sessions_confirm and device QR/scan are separate flags/options
trigger: Open a session's details, start Rename, press Terminate, leave the page.
effect: renaming_device is only meaningful with session_details and is cleared by hand in fetch_sessions, leave_devices, close_sessions_top; device_login_qr and device_qr_scanner are exclusive Options; sessions_mutating/sessions_stale/storage_stats_loading sit beside Fetch in Session.
fix: enum DeviceLayer { None, Details{id, renaming}, Confirm(..)} and enum DeviceLink { Idle, Scanning, Consent(qr) }; fold mutating/stale into Fetch variants.

title: CeremonyUi keeps sheet, worker handle, qr and focus_pin in step by hand
trigger: Any ceremony event (Hybrid, PhoneConnecting, Failed, UseKey).
effect: sheet and ceremony: Option<Ceremony> and qr must change together (Failed sets sheet=Error, ceremony=None, qr=None; set_ceremony_sheet clears qr); focus_pin is a one-shot flag; the dialog open predicate also excludes Probing, so the ceremony can be running with no dialog and no way to cancel.
fix: Make each CeremonySheet variant own what it needs (Choose{qr}, Pin{invalid,focus}, Running{ceremony}) so the worker handle lives only in running sheets.

title: Passkey ticker is an Option<Task> used as a started flag
trigger: Create Passkey / Log in using passkey; lock; finish.
effect: ticker.is_some() means running; cleared by the task itself at its end and by the lock; busy is derived from ceremony + driver adding/ceremony/login state, a second copy of the stage.
fix: One PasskeyFlow enum in the owner with the ticker task inside the busy variants.

title: PasskeysUi holds list_open, about_open, confirm, ceremony and ticker for one passkey flow
trigger: Open Privacy > Passkeys, Create, delete
effect: Three dialogs and a ceremony are separate bools/options whose priority and cleanup (close_passkeys keeps pin_input and ticker by hand) is kept in step manually
fix: One enum PasskeysScreen { Closed, List, About, DeleteConfirm{id}, Ceremony{..} } with the ticker inside the Ceremony variant.

title: Session details box is session_details Option plus renaming_device bool
trigger: Devices > open the session box > Rename
effect: Edit mode is a bool beside the target id; both are reset by hand in four places (row click, close, terminate, leave_devices)
fix: enum SessionBox { Closed, Details(id), Renaming }.

title: Connected websites screen: websites_open + websites_confirm in the UI and connected_websites/loading/stale/error/mutating in settings
trigger: Open Connected websites, Refresh, Disconnect
effect: Fetch stage is Option + loading + stale + error flags; refresh_websites resets cache and stale by hand
fields: PrivacyUi::websites_open, websites_confirm; SettingsState::connected_websites, connected_websites_loading, websites_stale, websites_error, websites_mutating
fix: Fetch<Vec<ParsedWebsite>> plus a Mutating enum; websites_confirm inside one WebsitesScreen enum.

title: Two-step verification flow is spread over twofa.view, twofa.notice, twofa.confirm, twofa_flow.* and password_state_loading
trigger: Open Privacy > Two-step verification, use Forgot password / login email
effect: View, notice line, inline confirm, session flow notice and code_sent_to fields are cleared together by hand in goto_twofa_view and clear_twofa_flow
fields: TwofaUi::view, notice, confirm; TwofaFlow::notice, recovery_code_sent_to, login_email_code_sent_to; AuthState::password_state_loading
fix: One TwofaStage enum carrying the code-sent pattern and a Fetch<PasswordState>.

title: SignInUi keeps the sign-in stage as bools and strings in step by hand
trigger: picker_open, editing_phone, touched, banned_dismissed, tick_armed, hint, phone_text and submitted_phone are set from sync_signin, submit_phone, signin_error and button handlers; tick_armed is set before spawn_screen and cleared only by the continuation.
effect: No bug today; a dropped tick or a missed reset would stick the countdown or the phone form.
fix: One SignInStep enum (Phone, PhoneSending, Code, EditingPhone, ...) plus a Ticker handle as Option<Task> that is its own armed state.

title: Three Option<(state, Instant)> clocks mirror the auth state and are re-armed by hand
trigger: sync_signin resets code_clock and email_clock when the delivery or reset value differs and clears them off-step; signin_error resets error_clock and banned_dismissed on a changed or absent error; submit_phone clears code_clock, error_clock, banned_dismissed.
effect: No bug today; any new auth transition that skips one of the places leaves a stale countdown.
fix: Store the clock inside the auth step enum variant that owns it, so leaving the step drops it.

title: Two-step box stage is open + view + confirm + notice by hand
trigger: Open the 2FA box, go to Recover/Reset/Email forms, close.
effect: open: bool, view: TwofaView, confirm: Option<TwofaConfirm> and notice: Option<String> must change together; goto_twofa_view resets three of them, close_twofa the rest, and the render of the dialog also writes view/confirm (see 13-TMP-021).
fix: enum TwoFaBox { Closed, Open{view: TwofaView, confirm: Option<..>, notice: Option<..>} } with goto/close as the only transitions.

title: Ceremony::finished bool next to the event receiver
trigger: A ceremony ends with Registered/SignedIn/Failed or its worker panics.
effect: poll sets finished on a final event and uses it to synthesise one 'worker stopped' failure on disconnect; the stage (running / finished) is a bool beside the channel. No bug today.
fix: enum CeremonyState { Running(Receiver<CeremonyEvent>), Finished } so poll after the end cannot read the channel again.

title: CTAPHID Assembly uses a `started` bool with cmd/total/next_seq/data
trigger: A key sends an init packet followed by continuation packets.
effect: started gates whether continuation packets are accepted and is reset by hand when a message completes; cmd/total/next_seq are meaningless while !started. No bug today.
fix: enum Assembly { Idle, Reading { cmd, total, next_seq, data } }.

title: macOS scanner Shared keeps `stopped` beside an Option<Sender> that stop() also clears
trigger: The phone ceremony stops scanning (advert found, Use a security key, cancel).
effect: Two fields say the same thing (stopped, events None) and send checks both; told is a once-flag. No bug today.
fix: Let `events: Mutex<Option<Sender>>` alone mean running/stopped and drop the `stopped` atomic.

title: Windows Cancellation is a `cancelled` bool plus an Option<GUID> in-flight id
trigger: Press Cancel in Quill's passkey dialog before or during the Windows Security dialog.
effect: Idle / in flight / cancelled are encoded as (false,None) / (false,Some) / (true,_); begin, end and cancel each update the pair. No bug today.
fix: enum Cancellation { Idle, InFlight(Option<GUID>), Cancelled }.

title: Lock pause is an AtomicBool plus a lock counter plus a generation, ordered by comment
trigger: set_paused_by_lock stores the flag then bumps LOCKS; set_enabled(false)/reset_token bump GENERATION; calls compare flag and counters at start and end.
effect: Correct today thanks to the documented store order; a new writer that bumps one without the other would silently let a locked call return its result.
fix: One AgentGate state value (epoch: u64, locked: bool) in a single atomic/mutex so 'locked since' is one comparison.

title: An agent connection's stage lives in three parallel statics (CONNECTED, REVOKED, REFUSED) kept in step by hand
trigger: revoke() pushes the id into REVOKED and the name into REFUSED after reading CONNECTED separately; Presence::drop removes from two of the three; allow_all_again clears only REFUSED.
effect: No bug today beyond TMP-002 (a connection that drops between the find and the push leaves a dead id in REVOKED), but the stages Live/Revoked/Closed/Refused are not one value.
fix: One Vec<Connection{id, agent, tools, stage: Live|Revoked}> under one mutex plus a refused set keyed by the Quill-made identity.

title: MCP bridge link stage is an Option<Link> plus an AtomicBool alive plus a pending map kept in step by hand
trigger: Agent sends a request after Quill closed the socket
effect: forward() drops the link when alive is false and reopens; relay() flips alive and drains pending on its own thread
fix: One LinkState enum (Closed, Open{send,pending}, Dead) owned by the relay, with pending drained on the transition to Dead.

title: Subscription watcher stage is an AtomicU64 where 0 means none and a number is the current watcher token
trigger: resources/subscribe then unsubscribe then subscribe on one connection
effect: watching (0/token) plus StopOnDrop plus the watcher's own compare_exchange keep the stage; the token makes it safe today
fix: A small Subscription enum (None, Watching{token}) behind one type, so the 0 sentinel is not repeated at three call sites.

title: request_access keeps `ask`, `what` and `granted_chat` in step by hand per branch
trigger: Any edit to one of the three branches (contacts, all chats, one chat).
effect: No bug today. `granted_chat.is_some()` is the stage 'asking for a chat' and must match the Ask variant; a branch that sets one without the other gives a wrong 'allowed' message.
fix: One enum Request {Contacts, AllChats, Chat{id,title}} that yields both the Ask and the answer text.

title: 'Inside a call' is an Option in a thread-local that CallScope::drop resets to None
trigger: A tool run that calls call_on/CallScope::begin again on the same thread (nested), or code spawning work on another thread.
effect: No bug today (one caller, server.rs). A nested scope would clear the outer call's CallStart on drop, so still_allowed would answer 'locked' for the outer write; on another thread CALL is None and every write refuses.
fix: Make the scope restore the previous value (or carry CallStart in Ctx) instead of a thread-local Option.

title: Screenshots travel to the MCP answer through a thread-local side channel
trigger: Any tool call with a screenshot
effect: The answer's images exist only if the same thread drains ATTACHED in tools::call_on; a tool path that attaches and then errors, or runs on another thread, leaks or loses the picture (call_on currently clears it before and after)
fix: Return images in ToolOutput instead of a thread-local.

title: A queued UI command's lifecycle is queue membership plus a cancelled atomic plus a one-shot channel
trigger: Any driver command
effect: Stage (queued, taken by UI, answered, abandoned) is implied by where the Pending sits and a flag; withdraw, take and cancel must be kept in step by hand
fix: enum CommandStage {Queued, Running, Answered, Abandoned} behind one handle.

title: Drive and real-input clocks use 0 as a 'never' sentinel in process-wide atomics
trigger: Agent drives, user types, takeover pause
effect: Option<Instant> kept as u64 with 0 meaning none; shared across accounts and windows
fix: Option<Instant> in one DriverClock owned by the takeover record.

title: Injection state is INJECTING + OPEN counter + LAST_STEP + REFUSALS thread-locals kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a (with_injecting and OpenCommand::drop restore them on the normal paths).
effect: INJECTING is set/cleared by paired set_injecting calls (perform_step) with no guard object, so a panic or early return between them leaves every real write refused; LAST_STEP is never cleared and names a stale agent for later deferred refusals.
fix: One RAII Injection guard (stores previous state, restores on Drop) owning the agent/tool and refusal list.

title: Facts keeps paused/paused_ms/stopped/session.ended_ms in step by hand
trigger: n/a (no bug found: phase() derives the display, forget_hold/observe clear pause and Stop at the switch).
effect: paused_ms is meaningful only while paused is Some; stopped (bool) and paused (Option) are two stages of one hold; Session.ended_ms is an Option used as an 'ended' flag beside the HOLD timeout.
fix: One enum Hold { None, Paused{reason,since_ms}, Stopped } in Facts, and Session { Running{..} | Ended{at_ms} }.

title: Call link flow spread over three session Options
trigger: Open a call link while in a call.
effect: call_link (offered hash), call_link_confirm (question) and call_link_after_leave (queued offer) are stages of one flow kept in step by hand; only leave_group_call_local and cancel_call_link_leave clear parts, and call_link (hash) outlives a dismissed join screen.
fix: One enum CallLinkStage { Idle, Asking(CallLinkConfirm), Leaving(target), Offered(PendingCallLink) } owned by the call state, reset in one place.

title: MicProcessor.denoised_last remembers the previous frame's mode
trigger: Toggle noise suppression or mute while a call is running.
effect: A bool tracks whether the last frame was denoised so the RNNoise state is rebuilt; mute path, off path and on path each set it by hand, and it is the only record of the mode.
fix: enum Denoise { Off, On(Box<DenoiseState>) } so switching on constructs a fresh state and off drops it.

title: Feeder stage is stop + forwarding + sink.closed atomics
trigger: Pause/resume screen share, end the call.
effect: Running/paused/stopping live in three AtomicBools (stop, forwarding, closed) that Drop and set_forwarding keep in step by hand; the thread's exit has two different conditions (stop and closed).
fix: One AtomicU8-backed FeederMode { Forwarding, Paused, Stopped }.

title: CpalMic stage is stream Option plus a failure Mutex<Option<String>> plus a Failed event
trigger: Unplug the microphone during a call or level test.
effect: Running/stopped/failed are encoded by `stream: Option<Stream>` and `error` (get_or_insert keeps the first text, cleared only in start) and reported twice (error slot and CaptureEvent::Failed); LevelTap reads only the slot, the call path only the event, so the two can disagree.
fix: enum MicState { Stopped, Running(Stream), Failed(CaptureError) } shared through one slot that both readers use.

title: Frames tracks the PipeWire stream stage as streamed + paused bools
trigger: Share a Wayland screen, then the compositor pauses the cast
effect: Pause is only reported after a first Streaming; the two bools are kept in step by hand in state_changed
fix: One enum StreamPhase { Connecting, Streaming, Paused } with transitions in state_changed.

title: WinCapture.closed bool sits beside Shared.stopped AtomicBool for one stop stage
trigger: stop() or the item Closed event
effect: Two separate flags (closed for stop idempotence, stopped for callbacks) must agree; end() and stop() set only one each
fix: One CaptureStage { Running, Stopped } on Shared, used by both stop() and end().

title: Window pause state is a local paused bool in each capture's poll loop (X11 run, mac and Windows WindowMonitor)
trigger: Share a window, minimise it, restore it
effect: Paused/Resumed events are derived by comparing a local bool with the polled visibility; the consumer keeps its own ActiveScreen.paused copy
fix: A shared ShareVisibility enum { Visible, Hidden } with a transition fn returning the event to push.

title: StreamFeeder state is kept in step with streams_request, time_waiters and pending by hand
trigger: RTMP stream watch: time requests, stream list replies, cancels, drain.
effect: No bug found beyond TMP-004: Syncing is set only when state is Idle at the first time request and again from Idle/NoStream on a non-empty list; it does not mean a streams request is in flight (streams_request does). time_waiters are non-empty only while streams_request is Some, and drain/cancel must clear both.
fix: Fold streams_request and time_waiters into one variant (Syncing{request, waiters}) so waiters cannot outlive the request.

title: GroupCall and Presentation use a connected bool beside mode, camera_id and camera
trigger: Any group call join, stream join, presentation start.
effect: GroupCall::connected is a stage flag; mode is only meaningful once connected (defaults to Rtc before, and set_streams_volume/group_stream_health read it without checking connected); camera_id (wanted) and camera (running) and group_sends() must agree. Presentation::connected is the same flag for the screen instance. TMP-001 is a bug this shape already caused.
fix: enum GroupStage { Created, Connected{mode} } and enum PresentationStage { Offered, Connected }, with mode readable only from the Connected variant.

title: Conference lifecycle is handle (null) + closed bool + two request queues kept in step by hand
trigger: Null handle means both 'not attached yet' and 'closed'; attach, close, deliver and set_owners each re-check closed under the media lock
effect: No bug today (locks are consistent), but a new path that forgets the closed check would keep or send answers for a destroyed instance
fix: One enum behind the media mutex: Unattached{unsent} / Attached{handle} / Closed, with pending requests inside the live variants.

title: Presentation::connected bool beside the instance handle; offers for a call and its screen are separate maps keyed by group call id
trigger: Start a presentation, the call ends or rejoins while the screen offer is being made
effect: Handled today by dropping the OfferRun (Unclaimed discards) and group_mut failing; the connected flag is a stage flag set from network callbacks
fix: Presentation stage enum (Making / Joining / Connected) and one offers map keyed by GroupOfferKey.

title: P2pCall connect stage is handle Option + pending_signaling Vec + gate state
trigger: Signaling arrives before connect; connect/retry replaces the instance via retire_instance
effect: handle None means 'not connected yet' and 'instance retired'; pending_signaling must be empty exactly when handle is Some. No bug found today
fix: enum P2pStage { Waiting{pending_signaling}, Live{handle}, Ended } on P2pCall.

title: P2pCall keeps its stage and media choices as parallel Options and a bool
trigger: Any 1:1 call: connect, retry connect, camera on/off, screen share on/off.
effect: No bug found today, but handle (None = not connected yet) decides whether pending_signaling is queued or delivered; media.screen_share_on mirrors screen.is_some(); media.camera (wanted device) mirrors camera (running source). These pairs are kept in step by hand in set_camera, set_screen_share_enabled, connect and retire_instance.
fix: One enum for the stage (Pending{signaling}, Connected{handle}) and one for the outgoing video (None, Camera{device,source}, Screen{source}) so camera and screen share cannot both be set.

title: CallMediaConfig sends camera or screen via camera Option + screen_share_on bool (+ P2pCall::camera/screen handles)
trigger: Turn the camera on, then start screen share, then reconnect (retained_call_media keeps screen_share_on but takes camera from params)
effect: The 1:1 video source is a mode spread over config.camera, config.screen_share_on, P2pCall::camera and P2pCall::screen; they must agree by hand. No bug found today
fix: enum VideoSource { Off, Camera(device), Screen } in the config, with the native handle held in the matching variant.

title: Latest frame slot: unshown, wake_pending, waker and end are hand-kept together
trigger: Frames pushed with/without an armed waker; end then late pushes.
effect: Stages of the slot (Empty, FrameWaiting, Taken, Ended) and of the waker (Armed, WakePending) are bools/Options; documented and consistent today.
fix: enum FeedStage and enum Waker { Idle, Armed(w), Pending }.

title: MutedSpeechHint: showing, done, tester and was_live describe one hint stage
trigger: Speak while muted in a group call; unmute; dismiss; admin mute.
effect: Stages Listening, Showing, Done are encoded as showing/done bools plus tester Option, with update() clearing them by hand in several branches.
fix: enum HintStage { Idle, Listening{tester,due}, Showing, Done } owned per call_id.

title: PushToTalk held / mute_at / talking are one stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Key down/up/tick/reset.
effect: Stages Idle, Held, Releasing(deadline) spread over two bools and an Option.
fix: enum PttStage { Idle, Held, Releasing{ mute_at } } (talking = not Idle).

title: Controller keeps running, failed_for and state in step by hand
trigger: Any sync/retry sequence.
effect: Three fields describe one stage (Off, Active(key), Failed(key, reason)); state duplicates running/failed_for.
fix: One enum HookStage { Off, Active{key,handle}, Failed{key,err} } with HookState derived from it.

title: Playout primed bool is the Priming/Playing stage
trigger: Underrun then refill.
effect: primed toggles in fill() with the ring state; correct today.
fix: enum PlayoutStage { Priming, Playing }.

title: Calls 'Clear all' stage is recent_calls_clearing: bool beside recent_calls_request and recent_calls_error
trigger: Open the Calls tab, press Clear all, confirm; while in flight the button hides via can_clear(len, clearing).
effect: Stage is a bool set after send (connect/calls/history.rs:190) and cleared by hand in session_apply_ok.rs:63 and calls/error.rs:92, not matched to the request id; fetch_call_history can clear the list while clearing is true. No bug found today.
fix: One enum for the recent-calls list: Idle/Loading{request}/Ready/Failed/Clearing{request}; can_clear takes the enum.

title: CallAudio is a hand-kept machine: source/opening/injected/injected_open/failed_at/error/speaking/read_at
trigger: Any group call with the microphone level tap
effect: Fields must change together (open sets source+clears opening/failed_at/error; close clears opening/read_at but not speaking)
fix: enum Tap { Closed, Opening(Receiver), Open{source, read_at, speaking}, Failed{at, error} }.

title: CallCapture: active Option + failed_at + error kept in step by hand
trigger: Open, lose, and reopen the call microphone
effect: active is None/Opening/Running (DeviceRun) while failed_at and error are separate Options cleared in finish_open and when wanted==None
fix: enum Mic { Off, Active(ActiveCapture), Failed{at, error} }.

title: Screen share spread over chosen/with_audio/active/error here and screen_sharing/screen_share_pending/screen_share_paused in the session
trigger: Pick a source, share, pause by hiding the window, stop
effect: Driver and session each hold part of one share; resets are repeated at four sites (stale, Ended, finish_open Err, wanted none)
fix: enum Share { None, Chosen{source,audio}, Opening, Running{..}, Ended{error} } owned by the driver, session flags derived from it.

title: Recent calls list is a hand-made Fetch: recent_calls + offset + error bool + request Option + clearing bool
trigger: Open Recent calls, page, clear all, switch tabs
effect: fetch_call_history resets four fields by hand; recent_calls_clearing is a stage bool cleared only on ok/error
fix: Fetch<Paged<Call>> plus a Clearing(RequestId) variant.

title: Call privacy: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error + optimistic Options
trigger: Open call privacy settings and change a rule while the first fetch is in flight
effect: fetch/set error paths zero privacy_pending while other requests are still in flight (answers then decrement saturating); a failed set clears the optimistic value to None with nothing refetching it
fix: Per-setting Fetch<PrivacyWho> with optimistic Saving{previous,new} variant.

title: 1:1 call media is driven by CallTransport enum plus call_devices_warmed bool, call_devices_listing Option, call_sound_watch Option, camera_on/screen_sharing/muted intent flags
trigger: Place a call, toggle camera and screen share before the transport exists
effect: Intent flags (camera_on, screen_sharing, muted) are stored on the call and replayed at connect; camera/screen share clear each other by hand (set_call_camera:337, set_call_screen_share:379) without telling the engine of the other track
fix: enum LocalVideo { Off, Camera, Screen } on the call.

title: Share-link generation is generating: bool beside two Option links, hand-reset on a send failure
trigger: Press Share Invite Link; the second (speaker) send fails after the listener request went out
effect: generating is forced false while the listener request is still in flight; a second press can send the listener request twice (harmless)
fix: Each link as Fetch<String>; generating is derived.

title: A conference join is pending_conference + conference_crypto(PENDING key) + group_offers[PENDING] + a native instance kept in step by hand
trigger: Join/invite/upgrade a conference, fail or cancel at each step (conference.rs:188-203, :280-283, offers.rs:316-319)
effect: No bug proven; every exit must clear all four and tests only cover some
fix: One ConferenceJoin enum owned by the driver with a single teardown.

title: join_as_requested is a started flag set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never cleared by an error or send failure
trigger: Open a video chat while the send fails or the answer errors (error.rs treats it as optional)
effect: The join-as picker is never offered for that tracked call; join goes ahead as yourself
fix: Fetch<JoinAsList> on the call (Idle, Loading(request), Ready, Failed).

title: Call link flow spread over call_link, call_link_confirm and call_link_after_leave
trigger: Open a call link while in another call, confirm leave; or the fetch_group_call after offer_call_link fails
effect: call_link keeps the hash after a failed fetch; call_link_after_leave waits on active_call.is_some(), which stays Some through the 1:1 call's Discarded end screen, so the link is not offered until the user dismisses it; there is no cancel for the queued offer
fix: enum CallLinkFlow { Idle, Confirming(..), LeavingThenOffer(..), Offered(..) } cleared on every exit.

title: Join/transport/screen-share stage held as transport_ready + join_payload + transport_error + rejoin + screen_* fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Join, rejoin, drop and screen-share paths each reset a different subset (join.rs:467-471, stream.rs:559-562, controls.rs:64-68, mod.rs:172-182)
effect: No bug proven beyond the others listed; every new path must remember which fields to clear
fix: enum Transport { NoTransport, Offering, AnswerReady(payload), Connected, Failed(err) } plus a ScreenShare enum, reset together on rejoin.

title: ActiveCall: state, ready, ready_at and the media flags are separate fields
trigger: Any 1:1 call
effect: ready_at: Option<Instant> and ready: Option<ReadyParams> must change with state == Ready; remote_video/remote_screen/remote_audio_muted, muted, camera_on, screen_sharing are intents and reports kept as bools beside the phase
fix: Fold ready params and ready_at into CallState::Ready { params, since }; keep intents in their own struct.

title: CallSummary upload stages are rating_sent, debug_information_sent/error and log_sent/log_error
trigger: Call ends with need_rating / need_debug_information / need_log
effect: Each upload is a bool sent next to an error option (CI-flagged shape); error handlers reset sent=false by hand, rating has no error arm at all
fix: enum Upload { NotNeeded, Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed(String) } used three times, keyed by the request id.

title: ActiveGroupCall has both need_rejoin: bool and rejoin: GroupCallRejoin for the same stage
trigger: TDLib reports need_rejoin; Quill rejoins on its own
effect: need_rejoin is copied from updateGroupCall (session_calls.rs:579) while rejoin is the driver's enum; readers use either (live_story.rs:397, session_video_chat_caps.rs:60, session_calls.rs:291 read the bool; join_failed/reconnecting read the enum), so they can disagree
fix: Delete need_rejoin; have updateGroupCall call rejoin.want() and let readers use GroupCallRejoin only.

title: Group call transport is transport_ready + transport_error + join_payload (+ stream_mode/stream)
trigger: Join a video chat
effect: bool ready beside an error and a payload string; join failure is derived from transport_error.is_some() || rejoin == GaveUp
fix: enum GroupTransport { NotJoined, Joining { request }, Handshake(payload), Ready, Failed(String) }.

title: Group call screen sharing is screen_share_pending + screen_sharing + screen_share_paused + screen_share_error + screen_share_answer
trigger: Share screen in a video chat
effect: Stage (off, starting, offer built, live, paused, failed) is four bools/options and a String answer; clears are spread over controls.rs, join.rs:470, offers.rs:322, mod.rs:278-284 and calls/error.rs:201,216; readers always test pending || sharing
fix: enum ScreenShare { Off, Starting { request }, Answered(String), Live { paused }, Failed(String) }.

title: Screen share stage is screen_share_pending and screen_sharing bools cleared together
trigger: Start or stop screen sharing in a group call
effect: Two bools plus screen_share_answer are reset by hand in two error arms and elsewhere
fix: enum ScreenShare{Off,Starting,On{answer},Stopping}

title: 1:1 call stage kept in answered_call, hang_up, second_call and active_call.state together
trigger: Answer, hang up, swap calls
effect: answered_call (Option<i32>) is a 'Pending but answered' flag beside ActiveCall.state; hang_up owns HangingUp beside it; second_call is an enum but depends on hang_up
fix: Put Answered inside CallState / ActiveCall phase so a single enum value holds it

title: Call privacy and recent-calls use a counter, error bools and a clearing bool
trigger: Open Calls settings and the Recent calls tab, Clear all
effect: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error bool; recent_calls_request + recent_calls_error + recent_calls_clearing bool are separate fields with their own clearers
fix: Fetch<..> for privacy and recent calls and a ClearCalls{request} stage

title: Group-call join state is need_rejoin + rejoin + is_joined + left_group_call kept in step by apply_group_call_fields
trigger: Network drop makes TDLib send need_rejoin; a join answer, a joined update or a leave each change a different subset of these fields.
effect: No bug found; the comments describe order dependencies (a routine joined update is no evidence of a rejoin).
fix: One GroupCallLink enum { NotJoined, Joining, Joined, Rejoining{request}, Left } on the call.

title: ParsedCall carries ReadyParams beside CallState instead of inside CallState::Ready
trigger: Code reading: parse_call fills ready only for callStateReady; session_calls.rs copies it into the active call only when state is Ready and keeps it through HangingUp.
effect: state and ready must agree by hand; the active call keeps the old ReadyParams (emojis, is_group_call_supported) after it leaves Ready.
fix: CallState::Ready(ReadyParams); the active call keeps its connection params in its own stage enum.

title: ParsedGroupCallParticipant keeps video_enabled/screen_sharing_enabled bools beside the Option video infos they mirror
trigger: Code reading: both are derived from the same JSON field in parse_group_call_participant.
effect: Two representations of one fact that callers may read inconsistently after a partial merge.
fix: Drop the bools and use video_info.is_some() / screen_sharing_video_info.is_some().

title: GroupCallCrypto bound/unbound stage is an AtomicI32 0-sentinel plus a separate hiding_log AtomicBool kept in step by bind/unbind/Drop
trigger: n/a
effect: No bug found; bind hides the request log then stores the id, unbind clears the id then shows the log, and Drop repeats the show, so the two atomics carry one stage by hand.
fix: One Mutex<CryptoStage> enum { Unbound, Bound { group_call_id, log_hidden: HideGuard } } where the guard's Drop restores the log level; frames read the id under the lock or via an ArcSwap.

title: Call window linger: `ended_at` + `linger_wake` Option are an implicit 'ended, wake scheduled' machine
trigger: sync_call_window derives lingering from CallScreen::ended_at (id, Instant) and uses linger_wake: Option<i32> as a 'wake task already spawned for this call' flag, cleared by the task itself; plus calls.raised_for and calls.window_opening are further hand-kept stages of the same window.
effect: No wrong state found: the wake always clears itself and a switch replaces CallScreen; but a task dropped before it runs (app teardown) would leave the flag set.
fix: One CallWindowPhase enum: Hidden, Showing, Lingering{call_id, until}, ClosedByUser(call_id), with the wake owned by the Lingering variant (a stored Task dropped with it).

title: CallSounds loop stage is player, looping, hold and again_at kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: Idle, Playing, Gap(until) is inferred from player.is_none()/empty()/lost() plus again_at Option; play(), keep_looping() and set_enabled() each reset a different subset.
fix: enum Loop { Off, Playing{sound,player,hold}, Gap{sound,hold,until} }.

title: SoundMarks is bools plus an id standing for the call sound stage
trigger: n/a
effect: call_id, connected, ended and muted record which cues played for the current call, reset by hand when call.id changes; ended needs marks.call_id==summary.call_id, so a call that was never synced while active plays no end cue.
fix: A CallCues enum per call id (Ringing, Connected{muted}, Ended) transitioning on state changes.

title: Call summary uploads are need/sent/error flag triples
trigger: n/a
effect: debug information (need_debug_information, debug_information_sent, debug_information_error), call log (need_log, log_sent, log_error) and rating (need_rating, rating_sent) are each a stage kept in step by hand, with sent set optimistically and reverted on error only for two of three.
fix: One Upload enum per kind (Offer, Sending{request}, Sent, Failed) on CallSummary.

title: Recent calls fetch stage is four separate fields read together
trigger: n/a
effect: calls_list and calls_history_more combine recent_calls_loading() (Option<RequestId>), recent_calls_error, recent_calls_clearing and recent_calls_offset.is_empty() to decide loading, failed, has-more and clearing; error is cleared in several places by hand.
fix: One enum: Idle, Loading{request}, Failed, Ready{offset}, and a separate Clearing{request}.

title: LivePipLink.window Option is an Opening/Open flag
trigger: n/a
effect: window None means the PiP is still opening (deferred), Some means open; the deferred open, check_live_pip, detach and close each match it by hand with a source comparison.
fix: enum LivePip { Opening{source,account,return_to}, Open{source,account,window,return_to} }.

title: Call window is window Option + window_opening bool (+ raised_for, window_closed_by_user)
trigger: Press the call bar to open the call window; close it; second call rings.
effect: Closed / Opening / Open is spread over CallUi::window, CallUi::window_opening (set before cx.defer, cleared in the deferred body) and the screen's window_closed_by_user and raised_for. A deferred body that does not run leaves Opening forever; same shape for tick_active (call tick) and linger_wake.
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening, Open(handle) } and enum Tick { Idle, Running } owned by CallUi.

title: create_request is never cleared on success; a refused create is noticed only in the window that may host GroupCallStart
trigger: Start a video chat (or 'Start Streaming') successfully; later the server refuses another create.
effect: group_call_boxes.create_request keeps the last successful RequestId forever; session.calls.failed_creates is drained only by group_call_create_frame_upkeep, gated on dialog_may_show_in(GroupCallStart) (window_upkeep.rs:117), so a failure waits until that window (last press) draws a frame. Works today because ids do not repeat.
fix: A `CreateCall { Sent(RequestId), Joined }` value cleared by the answer and the error, owned by the session request, not a UI Option left behind.

title: Global push-to-talk hook is a controller plus a listener-stop flag plus a polling bool kept in step by sync_global_ptt
trigger: Join a group call with push-to-talk on, switch it off, lose Input Monitoring permission.
effect: No bug found: the stop flag is set whenever the hook is replaced or inactive, global_ptt_polling is cleared by its own task. The three must change together.
fix: enum GlobalPtt { Off, Running { hook, stop }, NeedsPermission { poll: Task<()> } } with the key-capture arming as its own variant of a shortcut-capture enum.

title: Group call window stage is window: Option plus window_opening: bool plus window_visible: bool
trigger: Open/close/replace the video chat window (open_group_call_window defers the open; sync_group_call_window removes and reopens when the layout changes).
effect: No bug found today: window_opening is cleared in the deferred open on both arms. The stages closed/opening/open(visible|hidden) are three fields.
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening { stream: bool }, Open { handle, visible, is_stream } }.

title: Push-to-talk hook as ptt_capture + global_ptt_polling + global_ptt_listener_stop + global_ptt
trigger: Join a call with push-to-talk, rebind the key, leave
effect: Two bools and an Option kept in step with the controller; bound by hand in sync_global_ptt
fix: enum PttHook { Off, Capturing, Listening{stop} }.

title: Stream join is three fields: stream_join intent, stream_joining id and stream_join_timeout task
trigger: Watch a stream or create a video chat; join_stream sets stream_joining and the timeout, settle_stream_join / stream_join_ended / stream_join_failed / sync_group_call_window clear the pair in five places.
effect: No stuck state found: every exit clears both fields, and the task is dropped with the Option. But stream_joining and stream_join_timeout must always be Some/None together.
fix: enum StreamJoin { Idle, Wanted { intent, tracked_then }, Joining { call: i32, timeout: Task<()> } } with one method that leaves Joining.

title: Share and invite boxes are bools plus a call id in step
trigger: Open Share Invite Link, then the call changes or the links fail.
effect: No bug found: sync_group_call_boxes closes them when boxes_call changes and when the links are neither generating nor ready. share_open, share_speaker and share_copied are one box's stage.
fix: enum VideoChatBox { None, Invite, Share { speaker, copied } } with the call id inside it.

title: Stream overlay and key reveal are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Any open/close of the stream window boxes.
effect: See P2-001; also the overlay is only cleared by StreamWindow::clear, not by sync_group_call_boxes, so it outlives a changed call while a live PiP keeps the stream.
fix: One enum for the stream window box (none, settings with key hidden/shown, speakers, leave, revoke, warning) owned by the screen, dropped with the call in sync_group_call_boxes.

title: StreamWindow holds several staged fields: hide_armed + hide_task, photo (None while blurring) + photo_task, title_pressed
trigger: Hover/move in full screen (arm_stream_hide_timer), first frame of a stream with a chat photo (group_call_stream_photo).
effect: No bug found: hide_armed is cleared when the loop ends; photo/photo_task are replaced together. A blur that fails leaves (path, None) for good, with no retry (cosmetic).
fix: hide timer as Option<Task> alone (armed iff Some, cleared by the task's last step); photo as Fetch<Arc<RenderImage>> keyed by path.

title: StageVolume keeps sender, level and a dragging bool beside the slider; dragging is cleared only by a Release event
trigger: Drag the stage volume slider and let the pointer-up land outside the slider/window so no Release event arrives.
effect: dragging stays true, so the slider is never remade when the server level changes, and the entry (app-wide GroupCallUi) also survives call end and account switch until another sender is pinned.
fix: enum StageVolume { Idle { level }, Dragging } owned by the screen's pin, dropped with the call.

title: Archive-and-mute setting stage is reload_pending + ChatListState::archive_settings_loading + archive_chat_list_settings Option
trigger: The suggestion arrival sets reload_pending, the request sets archive_settings_loading, the answer sets the Option and clears both by hand in different files.
effect: Two bools kept in step across files; TMP-002 is the resulting stick.
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> plus a single 'stale since suggestion' marker inside the Fetch's Reloading variant.

title: Remove-from-folder chain: folder_remove_queue + folder_specs + folder_specs_stale + in-flight EditChatFolder/GetChatFolder
trigger: Remove a chat from a folder twice in a row, or while an edit is in flight
effect: Queue intent, fetch spec, edit, mark stale is a four-step machine kept by purpose lookups; a chat missing from session.chats is skipped (continue) yet counted as removed
fix: Per-folder enum FolderEdit{Queued(chats), FetchingSpec, Editing(RequestId)}.

title: archive_settings_loading bool beside archive_chat_list_settings Option
trigger: Open archive settings; fetch fails
effect: Loading is a bool kept in step with the cached Option and cleared in apply and error arms
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings>.

title: Contacts list: contacts Option + contacts_error bool + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Contacts, add/delete a contact (list set to None) while offline
effect: refetch_invalidated_contacts re-derives loading from three places; a send failure sets contacts_error by hand
fix: Fetch<Vec<UserId>>.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog is folder_invite_link + info + error + done + request
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields and sets request.
effect: If the send fails, link is Some with info/error None and no request: dialog shows no result and no error (S3 plausible).
fix: enum FolderInvite{Idle, Checking{link,request}, Ready{..}, Failed{..}, Adding{..}, Done}.

title: In-chat search stage is split across pending_typed_chat_search, chat_search_debounce_token, search.chat_search.{status, generation, query, loading_more} and a session-wide single state
trigger: Type in Ctrl+F search, change sender, press next.
effect: The debounce token and pending Option live on the ConnectDriver while status, generation and loading_more live in Session; clear_chat_search_debounce, begin_query and restart_chat_search must be called in the right order; loading_more is a bool cleared by the answer.
fix: A ChatSearch enum in ChatUi (Idle, Debouncing{token,query}, Searching{gen}, Ready, Failed) owning the debounce.

title: Typed-search stage is pending_typed_search Option + search_debounce_token + search.query + generation, held by hand
trigger: Type in global search, change a filter, close search inside the debounce window.
effect: Four fields must agree; clear_typed_debounce is called from some exits (close_search, filters) but not from select_search_chat_open / select_search_message, which only call session.close_search.
fix: enum TypedSearch { Idle, Debouncing{token, query}, Sent{generation} } owned by SearchState and reset by close_search.

title: Paid public-post search depends on public_limits_exceeded bool + tabs.limits + query + scope
trigger: Search public posts until the free quota is gone, then confirm the Stars search.
effect: Stars spending is guarded by a bool that begin_query resets as a side effect; money safety rests on that hidden coupling (a repeated confirm is refused only because begin_query clears the flag).
fix: enum PublicPostsQuota { Free, Exceeded{query, price}, Paying{request} } so a paid request is bound to the query and price shown.

title: Recommended channels use recommended_loading + recommended_loaded bool pair
trigger: Open the Channels tab, fail, retry.
effect: Error clears loading only; loaded and loading must stay mutually exclusive by hand.
fix: enum Fetch { Idle, Loading, Loaded, Failed }.

title: Folder share one-shot flags and errors: folder_link_saved bool, folder_share_error, folder_limit_hit drained by UI
trigger: A link create/edit or a failure sets a one-shot the UI drains on a poll
effect: Outcome is a bool/Option latch that any dialog can drain, not matched to a folder or request
fix: Push typed outcomes (with folder id) onto a queue like CommunitiesState::outcomes.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog: link, info, error, done and request id are five fields moved together
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields by hand, sets the request id after the send; close_folder_invite resets four again but not folder_invite_request
effect: Stage (checking / checked / adding / done / failed) is implied by which of five fields is set; close leaves the request id set so a late answer still fills info after the dialog closed
fix: One enum FolderInvite { Idle, Checking{link,req}, Checked{link,info}, Adding{..}, Done, Failed{link,reason} } replaced whole on open/close.

title: Page retry: exhausted bool + retry Option per list (main, archive) with a separate folder set
trigger: LoadChats 404 sets chats_exhausted and clears retry; other errors set retry with doubling wait
effect: Paging stage (idle/loading/backoff/exhausted) is spread over chats_exhausted, chats_retry and PendingRequest presence
fix: enum PageStage { More, Backoff{until,wait}, Exhausted } per list; in-flight stays in the request table.

title: Archive settings panel: loading bool + open bool + Option settings kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Settings > Archive; fetch is sent and loading is set only when no cached copy exists; answer or error clears it
effect: Two bools plus an Option stand in for one fetch stage; a dropped answer leaves loading true
fix: Use Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> for the settings and keep the panel-open flag as a UI (OnScreen) field, not in Session.

title: Recommended chats: recommended_loading + recommended_loaded
trigger: n/a
effect: Error clears loading only, so the Channels tab is neither loaded nor failed and retries only on the next filter change.
fix: Fetch<Vec<ChatId>>.

title: Date jump stages spread over date_jump, date_jump_pending, date_jump_note and the calendar
trigger: n/a
effect: A jump is resolved in date_jump, then pending in date_jump_pending, then landed; the note is a one-shot; the calendar box is a fourth Option.
fix: enum DateJump { Idle, Calendar(..), Resolving{..}, Loading{..}, Failed(note) } owned by the window's view.

title: SearchTabsState holds recommended_loading + recommended_loaded and loading_more + more_failed as separate bools
fix: Fetch<Vec<ChatId>> for the recommendations and a PageState {Idle, Loading, Failed} for the paging.

title: SearchState open + recents + query + public_limits_exceeded select the surface by hand next to the derived status()
fix: Surface enum Closed | Recents | Query{..} | Browse.

title: TopicHistory paging stage is has_newer + newer_failed + loaded_complete + stale_pages
fix: A per-end PageEnd {More, Loading(id), Failed, Complete}.

title: ChatSearchState keeps open, chat_id, status, loading_more and jump in step by hand
trigger: begin_query sets open without chat_id; close/open_for/clear_query each reset a different subset.
fix: One enum Closed | Open{chat, query, stage} with the paging stage inside.

title: In-chat search stage is status + jump + loading_more + generation + open on one struct
trigger: Search in a chat, jump to a hit that is not loaded (Loading), page older hits (loading_more) and change the query meanwhile; each path resets a different subset.
effect: No bug found in this file; answers are matched by generation and chat.
fix: enum ChatSearch { Closed, Open{query, results: Fetch<Hits>, more: Fetch<()>, jump: ChatSearchJump} }.

title: DropOnRow holds a file-drag / forward-drag / preview mode as eight fields kept in step by hand

title: Sidebar tab is two bools, 'mutually exclusive' only by convention
trigger: open_chats_tab/open_contacts_tab/open_calls_tab, archive_row.rs:114, the demos and open_folder_tab each set a different subset of contacts_tab_open and calls_tab_open.

title: Pinned-row drag is pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived + pin_press + preview_press + preview
trigger: Mouse down on a pinned row sets pin_press (chat_row), the first drag move builds pin_reorder and clears preview/preview_press, release keeps pin_reorder for the slide, render drops it when settled.

title: Pinned drag stage is pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived + pin_press kept in step by hand
trigger: Press on a pinned row (pin_press), first drag move (pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived set), release (reorder.release), settle (pin_reorder cleared in sidebar render at sidebar.rs:330)
effect: pin_reorder_archived is read after pin_reorder is gone (finish_pin_drag, sidebar) and pin_press survives a click that never became a drag; today the id compare in pin_drag_move guards it

title: Peek preview stage is preview + preview_press (long-press token) cleared by hand in 9 places
trigger: Mouse down on a row starts preview_press + a timer; 500 ms later preview opens; mouse up, esc, reorder drag, top-people tiles each clear one or both

title: Multi-select mode is implied by a non-empty HashSet<i64> of bare chat ids (selecting_chats/rows_selecting derive the mode)

title: Sidebar tab held as two mutually exclusive bools (contacts_tab_open, calls_tab_open) kept in step by hand at ~10 sites
trigger: n/a (see the folder-step bug for the live consequence)
effect: Every writer must remember to clear the other flag; both true is representable

title: New Contact box stage kept in sent_name + sent_request + not_joined

title: FolderEditorDialog: fetch_pending bool + error + picker Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Edit flow: fetch_pending, error and picker each change in different handlers (prefill clears fetch_pending/error; Save sets error; picker is separate).

title: FolderShareDialog stage kept in busy + error + confirm_delete + copied beside view
trigger: n/a: a save in flight, a delete awaiting confirm, a copy mark and an error are four fields next to the view enum.
effect: n/a

title: FolderInviteDialog: seeded + adding next to session-side folder_invite_info/error/done/request
trigger: The add-by-link stages (checking, ready, adding, done, failed) are split between the dialog's seeded/adding bools and four Session::chat_list fields that drive_folder_invite polls and resets by hand.
effect: No bug today (the answer is matched via folder_invite_request) but the stage is not one value; adding is cleared by polling for an error.

title: FolderInviteDialog stage kept in seeded + adding + session invite fields
trigger: n/a: link check, seeded ticks, add in flight, error and done are spread over seeded, adding, and session folder_invite_info/error/done.
effect: n/a
fix: enum FolderInviteStage { Checking, Choosing{selected}, Adding{selected}, Failed(msg) } held by the dialog.

title: Folder invite box keeps seeded and adding bools
trigger: n/a
effect: adding is cleared by an error or a limit hit read elsewhere; seeded marks the first info arrival.
fix: `enum InviteStage { Checking, Ready{selected}, Adding(RequestId), Failed }`.

title: Top-people strip expansion lives in two owners (session top_view + SearchUi top_toggled_at/top_drag)
trigger: Toggle Show more / Collapse in the frequent contacts strip; drag the row.
effect: top_view (Session) and top_toggled_at/top_drag/top_scroll (SearchUi) are changed together by hand in toggle_top_people; top_drag is Option<TopDrag{moved}> set on mouse down and cleared in several handlers.
fix: enum TopStrip { Collapsed, Expanding{since}, Expanded, Dragging{..} } in SearchUi only.

title: SettingsSearch keeps query text, selected index and pending_clear flag beside the input entity's own value
trigger: Typing, Enter on a result, Esc, closing Settings.
effect: query mirrors the input value on each Change and is reset by hand in clear_settings_search and focus_settings_search; pending_clear is a one-shot 'clear on next render' stage flag.
fix: Read the query from the input entity (single source) and model the field as enum Search { Idle, Typing{selected}, ClearOnNextRender } or clear immediately where a window is at hand.

title: SidebarReveal holds hidden, two glides and a pointer enum that must agree
trigger: set_hidden, pointer_entered, pointer_left, dismiss and settle each move several of hidden, docked, peek and pointer; the glide target must equal hidden.
effect: No bug found; the tests cover the transitions.
fix: Derive the glide targets from one SidebarMode enum (Docked, Hidden{peek: Peek}).

title: Business page loads: chat_links_requested/connected_bot_requested bools, chat_links_saving counter, business.saving Vec, one shared business.error
trigger: Open Business pages, save several settings, one fails
effect: 'requested' bools are reset on error/ok by hand; every new save does `business.error = None`, wiping another save's error before it was seen
fix: Fetch<T> for links and bot; per-kind Saving/Failed(error) map instead of one error string.

title: Time zones: time_zones Option + time_zones_requested bool; own info: user_full_infos presence + own_info_error + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Business hours/location offline
effect: Stage derived from a bool plus an Option; reset on send error and TDLib error separately

title: Saved sublists: topics_requested/topics_exhausted bools, SavedTagSearch.request Option, history.loaded_complete
trigger: Open Saved Messages, scroll sublists, filter by tag.
effect: No bug found; topics_requested is reset on error and the tag request is matched by id.

title: Chat photo emoji icons are icons + chat_photo_emoji_icons_failed + an in-flight purpose
trigger: Open the photo builder, fail, reopen
effect: Reset by hand at load_chat_photo_emoji_icons; no bug today

title: Welcome messages: welcome_messages map plus welcome_message_fetches enum plus a pending-purpose check decide one 'is it loading' answer
trigger: load_chat_welcome_messages
effect: dedupe checks contains_key(welcome_messages) OR has_purpose; the Loading marker is a second source of truth

title: Join request search uses three maps (join_request_latest, join_request_queries, join_requests=Loading) as one stage
trigger: search_chat_join_requests / load_more_chat_join_requests; load_more treats join_request_latest.contains_key as 'loading'
effect: Stage spread over maps; removed in answer and error arms by hand (error.rs:234-252, apply.rs:479)

title: InviteLinkMembersState holds loading:bool, error and request:Option together
trigger: open_chat_invite_link_members / load_more / answer
effect: three fields set by hand in request_invite_link_members (append sets loading/error/request, fresh sets all)
fix: One enum stage carrying the request id

title: Event log state is spread over event_logs, event_log_waits{page,poll}, queries, filters, users maps
trigger: Open Recent actions, filter, scroll, poll every 5 s.
effect: A page request and a poll request are tracked as two Options per chat that are cleared by hand in refresh_chat_event_log; filters change in four maps that must be followed by a refresh.
fix: One EventLog per chat holding query, filter, fetch stage and in-flight page/poll ids.

title: Member list stage is supergroup_members Fetch + supergroup_member_queries (extra, query) + note_member_more + pending scan
trigger: Search members, scroll, change the query while a request is in flight.
effect: The query the list belongs to is kept in a second map, the next-page flag is derived by scanning all pending requests (members_more.rs:7), and the first page and next page share one key.
fix: A MemberList per (chat, filter) holding query, fetch stage and optional next-page request id.

title: Ownership transfer is check_in_flight bool + can_transfer Option + transfer_in_flight Option
trigger: Open the transfer ownership dialog.
effect: The check is gated by a bool; the error arm clears it (groups/error.rs:42), but check_in_flight is not tied to the chat, so opening the dialog for another chat while one is in flight reuses its result.
fix: Ownership stage enum keyed by chat (Idle, Checking(RequestId), Ok, Blocked(reason), Transferring(RequestId)).

title: Groups in common first page and next page share one purpose and are told apart by common_groups_paging.loading_more
trigger: Open a profile, scroll the groups in common list.
effect: RequestPurpose::GetProfileChats(GroupsInCommon) is used for both pages; the answer handler must read the loading_more bool to know which; paging{exhausted, loading_more} sits beside the Fetch list.
fix: Loaded{ids, next: PageState} like ProfilePhotosFetch, with the page request id in the purpose.

title: Playlist per user is loading bool + loaded bool + tracks + has_more
trigger: Open a profile with music, scroll, reorder.
effect: playlist.loading, loaded and error are changed in fetch_playlist and fail_profile_audios by hand; entry(user_id).or_default() creates a playlist entry for any user that is asked about.
fix: Fetch<Paged<Track>> per user.

title: NewChatStage::Type.saving: Option<Vec<RequestId>> is a 'save attempted' flag cleared by hand
trigger: Type step: Save sends requests (saving=Some), a refusal is read from groups.info_edit_errors[chat] (keyed by chat, field Username, not by request); typing in the link field sets saving=None via new_chat_link_edited
effect: A refusal from a save that is not the one in flight is shown for the current one, and a save whose requests all vanished without an answer moves on to Subscribers as if it succeeded
fix: Type{chat, save: TypeSave} with TypeSave::{Editing, Saving(requests), Refused(reason)}; match the refusal by request id.

title: StageFacts mirrors request liveness as bools next to the NewChatStage enum
trigger: New Group/Channel flow: create_pending, type_pending, type_failed and outcome are derived from Session.requests and info_edit_errors on each draw and combined with NewChatStage by view()
effect: Stage and facts can disagree (Creating with no outcome and no live request shows the back step unbusy; Type{saving:Some} with a request that vanished goes straight to Subscribers as if the save succeeded)
fix: Put the request state in the stage: Creating{request, state: Fetch<ChatId>} and Type{saving: Saving{requests, state: InFlight|Failed(reason)|Done}} updated by the answer, instead of re-deriving it from the session.

title: Community request tracking mixes in-flight table, notification_sends map and outcomes queue
trigger: setCommunityNotificationSettings: settings are parked in notification_sends under the request id; on ok moved into the full info; on error removed
effect: An entry is removed only on ok or error; a request settled another way (take_purpose, dropped continuation) leaves the entry and community_notification_settings keeps showing the unsent value
fix: Store the sent settings inside PendingRequest (or the purpose) so removing the request removes them.

title: Boost chain: boost_intent Option<i64> + boost_slots_by_chat + boost_box phase kept in step
trigger: Press Boost: intent set, slots fetched, boostChat sent; answers clear intent in two places (boost_flow.rs, error.rs)
effect: Stage lives in an Option as a started flag plus a per-chat stash, boost box phase, and note
fix: enum BoostFlow { Idle, FetchingSlots{chat}, Boosting{chat,slots}, Done } owned by the box.

title: Boost list page: loading bool + error + request id in BoostsListState
trigger: Open Boosts tab; page request sets loading and request; the reply clears loading, error and request together
effect: Three fields stand for one Fetch stage; the error arm in error.rs must clear them by hand
fix: Fetch<Page> with the request id in the Loading variant.

title: Invite member and join-request pages: loading bool + error + request id
trigger: Open an invite link's details; each page sets and clears the trio
