effect: Same trio as boosts; clears only when the answering id matches
fix: Fetch<Page> with request id.

title: OwnershipState::check_in_flight is a bool beside check_error and can_transfer
trigger: Owner leaves/transfers a chat; canTransferOwnership check.
effect: Set true on send, cleared in the error arm, the ok arm and the driver; check_error and can_transfer are cleared by hand.
fix: Use Fetch<CanTransferOwnershipResult>.

title: InviteLinkMembersState and BoostsListState hold loading bool, request id and error together
trigger: Open invite-link members or the boosts list.
effect: The error arm sets loading=false, request=None and error in three writes; loading is redundant with request.is_some().
fix: Replace with a Fetch-like enum carrying the request id (LinkRequestsState already derives loading from request).

title: PublicLinkRevoke keeps requests and a failed bool in step by hand
trigger: Revoke in the limit box.
effect: failed is OR-ed as the two answers come and read when requests is empty; revoke Some/None plus public_chats Fetch and limit_box change together in settle_public_link_revoke.
fix: Enum Revoke { Waiting{chat, left: Vec<RequestId>, failed: bool-free via Outcome} } with Ok/Failed per request.

title: Username check is spread over check_generation, check_pending, check and check_failed
trigger: Typing a link in the Type box.
effect: Four fields kept in step by hand; the box derives 'Checking...', verdict and failed from them by text compare.
fix: One enum UsernameCheck { Idle, Checking{generation, chat, text}, Verdict(..), Failed{chat, text} }.

title: Member list paging is tracked by four maps kept in step by hand
trigger: Scroll or search the members list.
effect: supergroup_members, supergroup_member_queries, member_more_bases and member_more_failed must change together; a member_more_bases entry for a request that is never answered stays forever.
fix: One MemberList { query, first: RequestId, state: Fetch, more: Idle|Loading(RequestId)|Failed } per key.

title: Business time zones / chat links / bot: *_requested bools, saving counters
trigger: n/a
effect: time_zones_requested, chat_links_requested, connected_bot_requested are set at send and reset in error arms; chat_links_saving is a u32 incremented by sends and decremented by answers.
fix: Fetch<Vec<TimeZone>>, Fetch<Vec<ChatLink>>, Fetch<Option<ConnectedBot>>; saves as request-id sets.

title: Which conversation is shown is open_topic, threads.thread, threads.direct.open and threads.saved.sublist kept mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: Open a forum topic, open a comment thread inside it, switch chats; or select a direct-messages conversation then a topic.
effect: open_topic_id and open_draft_topic resolve the clash by a fixed priority order (thread, direct, topic, saved) and select_topic/deselect_topic/select_chat/leave_open_chat each clear a different subset (close_topic_thread_unless, saved.close_views), so a missed clear shows the wrong conversation's drafts and sends.
fix: One OpenConversation enum on the view (Chat, Topic(i32), Thread(..), Direct(i64), Saved(..)) replaced whole when the chat or sub-view changes; open_topic_id becomes a match.

title: A topic window's paging stage is spread over flags, a stale set and a session-wide failure set
trigger: Forum topic paging.
effect: loaded_complete, has_newer, newer_failed, stale_pages, history_pruning.gone_topic_pages and threads.topic_load_failed together describe each end's fetch.
fix: Per end: enum EndState { Complete, More, Loading{request}, Failed }, with stale requests dropped by request id on the window.

title: ParsedChatMember spreads per-status data over status + five Options/bools
trigger: Code reading: admin_can_post_messages, admin_can_invite_users, admin_rights, can_be_edited only mean something for Administrator; restriction only for Restricted.
effect: Fields that belong to one status variant are carried for every status and must be kept consistent by the parser and every merge.
fix: enum MemberStatus { Creator { anonymous }, Administrator { rights, can_be_edited }, Member, Restricted(MemberRestriction), Left, Banned, Unknown }.

title: Own admin rights are eight Option<bool> fields beside ChannelMemberStatus, kept in step with it
trigger: n/a: UpdateSupergroup and Supergroup carry status plus can_restrict/invite/promote/manage_tags/manage_topics/change_info/send_welcome/manage_video_chats as Option<bool>, None meaning 'not an administrator'. UpdateBasicGroup flattens three of them to bool with unwrap_or(false).
effect: No bug in the parser. Each consumer must agree that None means 'not an administrator' and that the creator has every right. A status change applied without the rights, or the reverse, leaves the rights stale.
fix: Carry the rights inside the status: ChannelMemberStatus::Administrator { rights: AdminRights, .. }, with one rights() accessor that returns all rights for Creator.

title: Recent-actions poll is an Option<ChatId> 'running' flag beside a detached task, plus a hooked bool
trigger: n/a
effect: event_log_poll says a detached spawn_scoped loop is running for a chat; the task is not stored, so the flag and the task are kept in step by the task clearing it through the main window at its end. event_log_hooked is a set-once 'started' flag for the scroll handler.
fix: Store the poll as Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)> so dropping it stops the loop and its presence is the running state.

title: ChatbotDraft holds a stage as loaded bool + committed Option + confirm_leave bool + warning Option
trigger: Open Chat Automation.
effect: loaded/confirm_leave are hand-kept stage flags; loaded is filled from session.connected_bot and the screen polls every 200 ms (business_bot_watch) to copy it. Not a bug today beyond the entry below.
fix: enum ChatbotStage { Loading, Failed(String), Editing{..}, ConfirmLeave{..} }; drop the polling by applying the answer in the reducer.

title: ChatbotDraft: bot stage is `loaded` bool + `committed` Option + `warning` + `confirm_leave` bool
trigger: Chatbots screen: the draft is made before the server's bot is known (loaded=false), then loaded=true, then a bot is committed (committed Some), a risky right sets warning, leaving with found-but-unadded bots sets confirm_leave. The stage is spread over four fields (loaded is already a baseline entry in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt) and reset by hand at chatbots.rs:107,214,406,448.
effect: No wrong state found in the files read; the 'loaded' flag has no failed arm in the struct (failed is derived from the session at chatbots.rs:147).
fix: enum BotStage { Loading, Failed(String), NoBot{username}, Connected{bot, rights, warning: Option<..>}, ConfirmLeave{..} } inside the Chatbots screen variant.

title: BusinessDialog: the open screen is `view` plus a set of Option drafts kept in step by hand
trigger: Navigation inside the box (business_go / business_back / route_business_start_page_sticker, which sets d.view directly): d.view must agree with which of greeting, away, hours, day_rows, location, picker, start_page, link_edit, chatbot is Some (View::Picker needs picker; View::Greeting with greeting None means 'Loading'; Hub clears seven drafts by hand; link_edit/confirm_delete reset in business_go; local_error and note are two Option<String> that can both be set).
effect: No wrong state found beyond P-002, but every new screen must edit business_go's reset list, business_draft_missing, business_fill_draft and business_leave in step.
fix: One enum Screen { Hub, Greeting(Fetch<GreetingDraft>), Away(..), Hours{draft, sub: HoursSub}, Location(..), StartPage{draft, sticker_pick: bool-free sub enum}, ChatLinks{edit}, Chatbots(..) } so a draft exists exactly while its screen does, and a child view is a variant of its parent's.

title: Topic chooser load stage is DropTopic::load_failed plus two session sets
trigger: Drop files on a forum row: the stage is load_failed (bool, in the baseline) OR threads.forum_topics_failed.contains(chat) OR forum_topics.contains_key(chat) OR bot_topics.is_some(), combined in drop_topic_failed/drop_topic_loaded/drop_topic_choices.
effect: load_failed never clears when topics later arrive; a failure that is retried shows 'could not load' only while choices are empty. No stuck state found.
fix: Hold Fetch<()> for the topics in DropTopic (Loading/Ready/Failed) written from the same answer, instead of a bool beside session sets.

title: CommunitiesUi runs three flows as separate Options (open, ban_wait, new_chat_for) plus row_menu
trigger: Ban from a moderation menu while a box is open, or Create a New Chat from the chooser
effect: The stages of one community flow live in three fields: ban_wait waits for session state, new_chat_for waits for another subsystem's NewChat view; each is cleared by its own drain and by nothing when its owner goes away
fix: One enum CommunityFlow { None, Box(CommunityBox), BanAsking(PendingBan), NewChat{community_id} } with the drains matching on it.

title: UndoAction keeps the answer, a started Instant used as token and a timer Task as three parts
trigger: Add or Decline a pending request
effect: The wake is matched to the action by Instant equality; the action is sent by 3 paths (timer, next answer, box replace) each of which must take() it first
fix: A request-answer id in UndoAction (counter) instead of Instant, and one send_if_due path used by all three triggers.

title: Recent actions page upkeep is four hand-kept fields: event_log_hooked, event_log_poll, event_log_keystroke, event_log_autoload
trigger: Open/close the recent-actions page, switch chats and account
effect: hooked is a 'started' bool, poll an Option<ChatId> started flag cleared by the task tail via main(), autoload a length marker; none is tied to the open page
fix: One EventLogPage { chat, poll: Polling|Idle, hooked, autoload } value owned by the Group Settings view and dropped with it.

title: Recent actions page keeps event_log_hooked, event_log_poll and event_log_keystroke as separate stage fields
trigger: n/a
effect: event_log_poll: Option<ChatId> is a 'poll running' flag cleared by the loop's tail through the main window; event_log_hooked is a one-shot bool; the search debounce token is a counter. They are correct today but kept in step by hand.
fix: An EventLogPage { chat_id, poll: Task, search_debounce: Option<Task> } value owned by the RecentActions view, dropped when the view changes.

title: Sticker pack loading derived from request purposes plus stickers.failed flags
trigger: Press Load packs in the Edit box
effect: busy/loading come from has_purpose over two purposes and session.stickers.*.failed sits beside them; no stage enum
fix: Fetch<T> for each pack list.

title: Edit box stage is saving + title_empty + title_emoji + type_box + history_box + photo/photo_note
trigger: Edit, Save, open sub boxes, emoji panel
effect: Stage is derived partly from the session (requests, errors) and partly from five fields in the box and the shared media panel; Saved is a derived state that is never applied
fix: enum EditBoxStage owned by the box: Editing{sub: None|Type|History|Emoji}, Saving(ids), Failed{field,reason}.

title: Title emoji panel is edit.title_emoji AND pickers.media_panel open, kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the name field emoji panel, close the panel with Esc/outside click, or let the box turn Saved
effect: title_emoji stays true after the shared panel closes; close_group_title_emoji only closes the panel when group_edit_box() is Some, so a box that became Saved while the panel was open leaves the panel open
fix: The panel's open state carries its owner (MediaPanelOwner::GroupTitle) in one value.

title: reported, slider and release subscription are three keyed states kept in step by render
trigger: Render the slider; change the value from outside.
effect: reported mirrors the caller value, the slider holds the thumb, the subscription holds a clone of reported; correctness depends on the order of updates in render. Keyed by (kind, chat) only, so two windows of one chat share names but not state.
fix: One keyed state enum Synced(value) / Dragging(position).

title: save_refused flag and version counter drive the link status line
trigger: Press Save with an empty or bad link, then switch Public to Private and back.
effect: save_refused is a bool cleared only by a link edit; it stays set when the user flips Public/Private so the empty link shows 'too short' again without a new Save press. version is a keystroke token for the timer.
fix: Fold into one LinkCheck enum (Idle, Typed{version}, Refused{version}) cleared by choose_group_public too.

title: UsernameDialog carries a community id in a ChatId field
trigger: Open Rename community.
effect: UsernameDialog.chat_id is ChatId(community_id) with the real id also inside TextPromptKind::CommunityName; the kinds of id share one field and one dialog slot for two unrelated prompts.
fix: Put the owner inside TextPromptKind (CustomTitle{chat,user} / CommunityName{community}) and drop chat_id.

title: Group confirm is one session-wide slot with chat_id plus an action
trigger: Open any confirm (delete chat, block, delete topic) from the main window then another from a chat window.
effect: GroupConfirmDialog{chat_id, action} uses ChatId(0) for actions with no chat (DeleteContact, BlockContact, ClearPaymentInfo) and a second opener overwrites the first.
fix: Make the action carry its own target (no ChatId(0) placeholder) and own the dialog per window.

title: forum_chats_peek and forum_column_shown are two bools kept in step by the render path
trigger: Open a forum chat, press 'Chats' to peek, then resize the window or open a non-forum chat.
effect: forum_column_layout (called while rendering, takes &mut self) both resets forum_chats_peek and records forum_column_shown; derived state written every frame and the peek ends only when something renders.
fix: One enum ForumColumnState {Hidden, Column, Peek} in ChatUi, derived from the layout in one place, not written from render.

title: Topic info toggle is a bare bool on ChatUi
trigger: Click the topic info button in the topic strip.
effect: chat_ui.topic_info_open is flipped by hand and is not tied to the open topic; it stays set when the user selects another topic or leaves to the topic list.
fix: Make it part of an enum of the thread view (TopicList / Topic{id, info_open}) so leaving the topic drops it.

title: Welcome edit target is an Option<i32> not tied to the loaded list
trigger: Start editing a welcome message that is then deleted or replaced by an update.
effect: dialog.editing keeps pointing at an id that may be gone; Save sends editChatWelcomeMessage for a missing id and nothing on screen shows the edit.
fix: Drop editing when the id leaves welcome_messages, or hold the edited message's id and text in one enum variant.

title: Member paging stage is four fields: shown, failed_offset, retry_at_scroll, admins_asked
trigger: Scrolling the members list.
effect: Four values kept in step by hand across inline_members.rs (maybe_load_more_inline, inline_members_stale, reset).
fix: enum MemberPaging { Idle, Requested{offset}, Failed{offset,retry:bool} } plus a separate Admins{Asked} stage.

title: MembersView carries loading: bool beside failed: Option<String>
trigger: Render of the members list.
effect: Derived from SupergroupMembersFetch each frame, so both cannot be wrong at once today, but the shape is the loading+error pair the rule rejects; the snapshot RefCell is also written during render.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<MemberRow>> in the view.

title: InviteLinkMembersState keeps loading bool beside error and request
trigger: Open who joined through a link
effect: loading/error/request can disagree (state/info_types.rs:356)
fix: Fetch<T>-style enum Loading{request}/Loaded/Failed

title: InviteLinkBox holds `custom` Option and focus_custom bool that must move together
trigger: Open Custom limit/date
effect: focus_custom survives a set_invite_link_custom(None) and is consumed from a dialog build
fix: Put focus request inside CustomBox::Limit{input, focus_pending}

title: Title error is shown from two sources: NewChatDialog::title_error bool and view.failure NoTitle
trigger: Press Create with an empty name: dialog.title_error is set by hand; a server NoTitle failure sets the same message through the view.
effect: No bug today; title_error is cleared only by the title input's Change subscription, so any other path that edits the name (set_value from a demo, paste events that do not emit Change) keeps the error.
fix: Fold the name error into the stage (Info { name_error }) or derive it from the view only.

title: Username check is three loose session fields (username_check, username_check_pending, profile_edit_error) reset by hand at every entry point
trigger: open_edit_profile_dialog, check_profile_username, submit_profile_username, move/toggle username and remove photo each clear profile_edit_error (and open clears username_check and username_check_pending) by hand; the dialog derives 'checking' from pending text equal to the typed text.
effect: No bug today; a new entry point that forgets one reset shows a stale verdict or error. profile_edit_error is also shared with the peer colour dialog.
fix: One Fetch<(String, UsernameCheckResult)> keyed by the checked text, and one per-dialog error owned by the dialog that asked.

title: Rating box is an Option<i64> plus a rating_preview bool kept in step by hand
trigger: Click the rating pill (sets rating_box, then clears rating_preview), press Preview (toggles the bool), close (close_rating_box clears both).
effect: No bug today; any new closer that clears only rating_box leaves rating_preview true so the next person's box opens in Future Rating.
fix: Option<RatingBox { user_id, view: Current | Future }>.

title: ProfileModal fade stage is a closing bool beside the Glide, and the modal also mirrors session.open_info_panel
trigger: Click an avatar (opening), close it (closing = true plus a timer), open another avatar during the fade (the modal is taken and rebuilt keeping previous).
effect: No bug found: the timer matches on closing and target. The stage is closing + glide direction + whether the session's info panel still equals target (profile_modal_active) kept in step by hand.
fix: enum ModalStage { Opening, Open, Closing } with the glide inside the variants.

title: Groups-in-common search field is an Option made on profile open and closed by hand (close/reset), matched to the panel by user_id
trigger: Open profile A, then profile B without close_info_panel in between.
effect: No bug: reset_common_groups_search replaces it on each open and the render filters by user_id; the paging stage (loading_more/exhausted) lives separately in the session.
fix: Make the search part of the panel target value so it is replaced with it.

title: ZoomedDay is chart: Option + error: Option, both None meaning 'loading'
trigger: Zoom into a day; GraphFetch Loading/Loaded/Failed is mapped to two Options in stat_graph_section.
effect: Loading and failed-to-parse are told apart only by which Option is set.
fix: ZoomedDay { x, fetch: Fetch<Rc<StatChart>> }.

title: range/_range_changes and pie/_pie_changes are Option pairs kept in step by hand
trigger: sync(), reset_range(), enter_pie() and exit_pie() set and clear the Option and its Subscription separately.
effect: A subscription can outlive or miss its slider if one site forgets the pair.
fix: Put the Subscription inside RangeSelector/PieZoom so they drop together.

title: Public shares list is loading: bool + error: Option + next_offset + list passed as separate arguments
trigger: Message page: forwards.loading/forwards.error; story page: forwards_loading/forwards_error.
effect: Both loading and an error line can show; 'Show more' hides while loading.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list with next_offset inside the ready variant.

title: The boost chain is split across boost_intent, boost_slots_by_chat and boost_box.phase
trigger: Press Boost: getAvailableChatBoostSlots then boostChat.
effect: boost_intent (global Option<i64>), cached slots and the box phase are advanced by the driver and the error arm separately; only GetBoostSlotsForBoost clears boost_intent on error.
fix: BoostBox owns an enum phase Main|AskingSlots{chat}|Boosting{chat, slot} and the intent goes away.

title: Forum topic first page state is split between threads.topic_load_failed set and TopicHistory.loaded_complete
trigger: n/a
effect: Loading, failed, empty and loaded are inferred from a set membership and fields of a separate map entry, cleared in separate places (session_forum.rs, connect/groups/forum.rs).
fix: One `TopicLoad { Loading(RequestId), Failed, Loaded{complete} }` per (chat, topic) in TopicHistory.

title: Carrier helper phase is spread over armed AtomicBool, view Option, relay.closing_at Option and wait_for_browser bool
trigger: Open, lockdown, load, close and hangup each flip a different one of these
effect: None today; the phase (locking down, loading, running, closing, gone) is implied by which flags are set, and handlers re-derive it with `loading` and `closing_at` checks
fix: One `enum Phase { LockingDown, Loading, Closing{at,wait_for_browser}, Gone }` owned by the loop; the flag the web view callbacks read becomes a copy of it.

title: Relay document lifecycle kept as bridge_seen, receiving, started, load_finished and in_flight, reset by hand in load_started
trigger: Page loads, reloads in scope, says hello, takes onmessage, posts
effect: None today; `next` and `failure` re-derive the stage from four fields and a new field must be added to `load_started`'s reset list
fix: `enum Document { Loading, Loaded, BridgeUp, Listening, Started }` replaced whole in load_started; in_flight lives with Listening.

title: Mini-app shell readiness is a shell_ready bool plus a queued Vec kept in step by hand, with a silent 256 cap
trigger: Quill sends commands before the shell page script posts shell_ready
effect: None today; commands beyond 256 before ready are dropped without a trace, and if the shell page ever reloaded, shell_ready stays true while window.__quillShell is gone so commands are dropped by the script guard
fix: `enum Shell { Booting(Vec<HostCommand>), Ready }` reset to Booting on any top-level shell navigation; capture_at joins as a variant of the same phase.

title: Style example request stage is split over StyleExamples.loading, AiStylePreview.example_token and example_asked_at
trigger: Each starter (load_ai_style_example) and each exit (loaded, failed, send error) must set or clear three fields together by hand.
effect: No bug today beyond TMP-003, but a new exit path that misses one field sticks the spinner.
fix: enum ExampleFetch { Idle, Asked { token, at }, } inside StyleExamples (shown count beside it), with loaded(token) matching the token.

title: Deep-link flow keeps DeepLinkState plus a separate origin bool, original string and generation counter
trigger: request_deep_link_info / continue_deep_link / confirm_deep_link_invite each set several fields.
effect: No bug found; answers are matched by generation. deep_link_from_agent and deep_link_original live outside the enum and are overwritten on every start.
fix: Carry origin and original link inside the DeepLinkState variants.

title: GiftPurchase is loading + sending + completed + note + quote/price Options
trigger: fetch_marketplace_gift / buy_marketplace_gift / answers in payments/apply.rs:102-160 and error.rs:48
effect: Stages are bools set/cleared in three places; money (Stars/TON) is spent in this flow, answers matched by purpose only, not request id
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Loading{req}, Quoted, Sending{req}, Sent, Failed } and match answers by request id

title: Mini-app launch is a Vec of pending contexts plus single one-shot Option slots
trigger: n/a
effect: Launch stage is spread over WebApps::pending, open_result, dropped_launches and the one-shot found/write_access/emoji_access/phone_share/data_sent/attachment_menu_* slots, each cleared by hand at the start of the next call.
fix: One enum per flow (Launch{Pending(RequestId,ctx)|Opened|Failed|Dropped}) keyed by request id; grossing_loading becomes Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: Address lookup stage is resolving_for, job, postponed, hidden_while_moving, shown_once and moving
trigger: drag the pin, release, wait for the address, drag again
effect: none today; the address shown depends on which of five fields is set
fix: An enum Address { Hidden, Postponed(point), Resolving(point), Shown{point,text}, HiddenWhileMoving{point,text} } owned by the picker, with moving as part of the pin state.

title: VenueSearch stage is list (VenueList) plus needs_send, debounce and request kept in step by hand; Address is resolving_for/postponed/job/hidden_while_moving; moving and places_in_area are separate bools
trigger: n/a (every pan, zoom, search keystroke and answer edits several of them)
effect: No bug today; a request in flight is only 'needs_send == false && list == Loading'.
fix: One enum per concern: VenueQuery { Idle, Waiting(debounce), ToSend, InFlight(generation), Done } and AddressState { Hidden, Postponed(p), Resolving(p), Shown(text) }.

title: Venue search stage is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: open picker, type in the search field, pause, close search, move the map
effect: none today; stage is spread over needs_send, debounce, search_shown, generation, request and list
fix: One enum for the venue query: Idle, Debouncing{query}, Wanted{generation,point,query}, InFlight{generation,..}, Answered, Failed; list derived from it.

title: GiftPurchase stage is loading, sending, completed bools beside quote, price and note
trigger: Open a Marketplace gift, load a name, buy it
effect: none found today; Stars/TON money flow rests on loading/sending/completed staying exclusive and on the UI separately holding marketplace_open
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Loading, Quoted{quote,price}, Sending{price}, Sent, Failed(note) } held by the session; the note derived from the stage.

title: AI style editor/lookup stages: style_save + style_edit, outcome None meaning 'running', styles_received bool
trigger: Create/save a style, open an addstyle link, preview an example.
effect: style_save and style_edit change together by hand (wait_for_style_save/forget_style_save); StyleLookup/ExampleAnswer use outcome: Option as an in-flight marker; styles_received is a loaded flag next to styles.
fix: StyleSave { Idle, Saving(RequestId), Answered(..) }, Fetch<..> for lookup and example, Fetch<StyleList> for the list.

title: WebApps grossing_loading bool beside grossing_bots Option
trigger: Apps tab.
effect: A Fetch held as a bool plus an Option (failure is an empty Some); the one-shot answer slots beside it are a second pattern of unkeyed results.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the grossing bots.

title: SuggestedPostsState::busy is a hand-kept mirror of in-flight approve/decline requests
trigger: Code reading: connect/suggested_posts.rs inserts on send; the reducer removes on ok, on error and on any updateMessageSuggestedPostInfo for that message.
effect: The set duplicates Session::requests (which already knows the purpose and key) and can disagree with it.
fix: Derive 'busy' from Session::requests (has a pending SuggestedPost Approve/Decline with that key) and drop the set.

title: Style editor's save stage lives in two places kept in step by hand: StyleEditor::save (UI) and AiComposeState::style_save (session)
trigger: submit_ai_style_editor sets save=Sent; the session sets style_save in wait_for_style_save; open_ai_style_editor calls forget_style_save; dismissing the editor (ai_compose_dismissed) drops the editor but leaves style_save set.
effect: No bug found today (the answer is matched by RequestId and every editor open forgets the old save), but the Sent stage has no exit except the matched answer, so a lost answer leaves Create disabled until Esc.
fix: StyleSave::Sent { request: RequestId } in the editor, matched against the answer's request id, with the session only holding answers.

title: Style preview's example load is four fields kept in step: example, example_token, example_asked_at and StyleExamples::loading
trigger: Every path in style_preview.rs (load_ai_style_example, ai_style_example_upkeep, the send-failure arm) sets or clears the token, the start time and the loading bool by hand.
effect: No bug found today; a new exit (close, error) must remember all three or the spinner/60 fps tick and the token disagree.
fix: One `ExampleStage { Idle, Loading { token, asked_at }, Failed }` beside the shown example (or `Fetch<StyleExample>` keyed by token); StyleExamples keeps only the count.

title: Deep-link flow origin is kept by hand in three places beside the flow state
trigger: Any link click
effect: The flow stage lives in Session::chats_state.deep_link while its origin (agent flag, asking window, window the resolved link waits for) is in ChatsState::deep_link_from_agent, LinkUi::flow_window and LinkUi::pending_flow_window; pump_deep_link takes and puts them back in step on every poll.
fix: One enum DeepLinkFlow { Idle, Resolving{origin}, Invite{origin,..}, Resolved{origin,result} } with Origin { agent, window } inside each variant.

title: A resolved link waiting for its frame is three fields: pending_deep_link_open, pending_deep_link_ui and one shared pending_flow_window
trigger: A chat open from the share chooser (choose_share_chat -> hold_resolved_link) while a typed-link UI step from another window is still waiting for its frame.
effect: Today the two kinds rarely overlap. When they do, the second hold_resolved_link overwrites pending_flow_window, and the first link's box or chat runs in the second link's window. The 'which frame runs it' answer comes from three Options read together in resolved_link_frame.
fix: One Option<ResolvedLink { window: Option<ChatId>, step: ResolvedStep::{Open(PendingOpen), Ui(DeepLinkUi)} }>, so each waiting step carries its own window and a new one replaces the old whole.

title: LinkTooltip is waiting vs shown as a bool plus a token
trigger: Hover a link
effect: shown: bool and a hand-matched token are the stage of the tooltip (timer pending, then shown)
fix: enum LinkTooltip {Waiting{pos,text,timer:Task}, Shown{pos,text}}.

title: Main window close state is closed_by_user plus hide_after_full_screen plus a polling task
trigger: Close the main window in full screen on a Mac: hide_after_full_screen is set, a 3 s poll waits; raising the window or Cmd-Tab clears one flag but not the other; closed_by_user is never cleared.
effect: Two bools in a Global describe one of: Open, ClosedHidden, LeavingFullScreenThenHide; closed_by_user stays true forever after the first close.
fix: enum MainWindowState { Shown, LeavingFullScreen(task), Hidden } on the Global.

title: Live location tick uses Option<ChatId> as a 'task started' flag
trigger: history.live_location_tick_chat is set before the task is spawned and cleared by the task's last update; a task dropped by a screen change never clears it (it lives in HistoryUi, which is replaced with the screen, so fine today).
effect: A started-flag kept next to a detached task; no bug found today.
fix: Hold the Task in HistoryUi (Option<(ChatId, Task)>) so dropping the owner stops it and clears the flag.

title: Location picker UI keeps search, drag, settle, resolve, search_timer, locate and geocode as separate Options beside the session picker
trigger: The picker's search_shown, moving and address stages live in Session::location while location_ui.search/drag and five tasks mirror them and are reset together by reset().
effect: Task Options are stage flags (settle/resolve/search_timer set means 'waiting'); the search field Option must agree with picker.search_shown.
fix: One enum PickerPhase { Idle, Moving{drag}, Settling(task), ResolvingAddress(task) } plus Search { Closed, Open(input, debounce) } and Locate { Idle, Locating(task) }.

title: Marketplace box is marketplace_open/chat/error/private beside the session gift's loading/sending/completed
trigger: Open Buy collectible by name, load a gift, pick a price, buy: stage is spread over PaymentUi fields and MarketplaceGift loading, sending, completed, note, price.
effect: Error lives in two places (marketplace_error and gift.note); busy is re-derived as loading||sending in two places.
fix: enum MarketplaceStage { Entering, Loading, Quoted(q), Buying(q), Bought, Failed(e) } owned by the session, with the box open flag derived.

title: Suggested-post boxes are five Options that must follow the flow by hand
trigger: Price box -> time box -> accept box; Accept needs a time box first, balance shortfall opens grams_needed while price stays open.
effect: price, time, accept, decline, grams_needed are independent Options; ordering (time above price, grams_needed above price) and clears (confirm_suggest_accept clears accept before ask_for_balance; submit_suggest_time clears time then price.send_date) are done at each call site.
fix: One enum SuggestFlow { Price{..}, PriceTime{price,time}, PriceGrams{..}, Accept, AcceptTime, Decline } with explicit transitions.

title: SuggestBar mode and edit_of are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Edit Message from the Suggest Changes menu, then open the bar's price box and apply terms.
effect: begin_suggest_edit sets mode=Change and edit_of=Some together; apply_suggest_terms re-reads edit_of from the old bar and takes mode from the box; composer_post_options and set_suggest_bar both branch on edit_of.is_none() separately. No bug today, but nothing ties the two.
fix: enum SuggestBarKind { New, Counter, EditOf(MessageId) } carrying the message id only in the edit variant.

title: Apps tab reads grossing_loading bool beside grossing_bots Option (a hand-made Fetch)
trigger: Open global search > Apps while getGrossingWebAppBots fails.
effect: The failure turns into an empty list, so the tab says 'No apps to show right now' instead of an error with retry; loading and loaded are two fields.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the grossing list, with the failure arm shown in the tab.

title: SetStage::Resolving { sent: bool } tracks the lookup by purpose, not by request id
trigger: Mini app calls web_app_set_emoji_status while other custom emoji lookups run.
effect: Whether the lookup is answered is judged by 'any GetCustomEmojiStickers in flight', so unrelated lookups delay it; no wrong result found.
fix: Resolving { request: Option<RequestId> } and match the answer by id.

title: MiniAppWindow keeps ready, wedged, waiting_write_access, data_sent and closing_confirmation bools
trigger: Open a mini app that requests write access and sends data.
effect: waiting_write_access is a request-in-flight flag (cleared on answer, send failure or popup dismissal); ready/wedged are helper lifecycle stages.
fix: HelperState { Starting, Ready, Wedged } and WriteAccess { Idle, Checking(req), Asking, Allowing(req) } enums, as PhoneFlow already does.

title: One mini-app launch waits in one of three Options (awaiting_attach_bot, awaiting_search, awaiting_toggle) plus confirm
trigger: Click a t.me/bot/app link, then an ?startattach link before the first answers.
effect: Several Options can be Some at once for different launches; each answer is matched by bot id at best, and the poll's lifetime is computed from all of them.
fix: LaunchFlow enum { Searching(PendingOpen, req), FetchingAttachBot(..), Confirming(WebAppConfirm), Adding(PendingOpen, req) } in one field.

title: gif and sound_removed are two bools that must change together
trigger: Video editor 'remove sound' / GIF choice.
effect: sound_removed is only meaningful when gif is set; gif also depends on cover/edits/source set in step.
fix: enum VideoKind { Video, Gif{sound_removed: bool} } and group source+edits in one Option<VideoEdit>.

title: photo_render Option<u64> marks 'rendering' next to path/kind/file_name
trigger: Done in the photo editor on a tray photo.
effect: photo_render, path, photo_jpeg, file_only, kind, file_name are rewritten together by land_attachment_edit; a send is blocked while photo_render is Some.
fix: enum AttachmentFile { Ready(PathBuf), Rendering{render, from: PathBuf} }.

title: Account/chat export: Option<Export> as the 'running' flag, WorkerLink.pending Option as in-flight request
trigger: start_account_export / pump_export / answer
effect: Guard `account_export.is_some()` means 'running' until the UI clears it; fail_send/answer must clear link.pending
fix: enum ExportStage { Idle, Running(handle), Finished(result) } owned by the box

title: WorkerLink lifecycle is spread over pending: Option<RequestId>, an AtomicBool cancelled and an 'ended' channel whose disconnect means done
trigger: Any chat or account export: running() = !cancelled && !ended, idle_or_cancelled() = pending.is_none() || cancelled, and the UI separately reads Progress.stage (Finished/Failed/Cancelled) written by the worker thread.
effect: Four independent signals (link.pending, link.cancelled, link.ended, progress.stage) must agree; they disagree after a worker panic or a request timeout (see 03-P3-001 and 03-P3-003).
fix: One ExportRun enum owned by the session (Starting, Running{awaiting}, Cancelling, Ended(outcome)) written by the pump and by a worker-ended notice, with progress as data inside Running.

title: One trackpad gesture is tracked by two machines (SwipeNav::gesture and WheelNav accum plus spent_at) handed off by a returned bool
trigger: n/a: ui/media_viewer/navigation.rs viewer_scroll_wheel runs viewer_swipe first and skips WheelNav when it returns true, so WheelNav::spent_at and SwipeNav::gesture must agree on when a gesture started, ended or moved an item.
effect: No bug today; WheelNav::spent_at (an Option used as a 'gesture already moved' flag) is not refreshed for captured events, and the two must be reset together by new_item() on every item change and by nothing on viewer close.
fix: One TrackpadGesture enum (Idle, Undecided, Swiping, Scrolling, Spent, Released) owned by the viewer that both the swipe and the scroll step read.

title: ShuffleState played + cursor are two fields that move together and key tracks by a bare message id
trigger: Shuffle in chat A then play in chat B
effect: played ids carry no chat; note_current resets only when the current id is not at the cursor
fix: Key by (ChatId, MessageId) via OwnedBy and make the round one value with the cursor inside it.

title: Disk-low handling uses disk_holds_auto_downloads, disk_room, disk_paused, disk_resume_searched and avatar_rescan flags
trigger: Disk goes low then healthy.
effect: disk_holds_auto_downloads is derived from disk state elsewhere (connect/media.rs) and must match disk_room; disk_resume_searched and avatar_rescan are 'once' markers.
fix: One DiskPressure enum (Healthy, Low{room, paused}) and a ResumeSearch enum.

title: MediaLibrary tracks a set's load stage in three collections: set_stickers, loading, failed
trigger: ensure_library_sets inserts into `loading` after the send; accept/fail move it to set_stickers/failed; open_media_panel and reconnect clear `failed`; creator.rs removes from `failed`.
effect: No stuck state found (lost requests settle through settle_lost_request), but four writers keep three sets consistent by hand, and the MAX_LIBRARY_LOADS cap counts `loading`.
fix: `HashMap<i64, SetLoad>` with `SetLoad::{Loading(RequestId), Ready(Vec<StickerItem>), Failed}`.

title: The reaction picker's options (MessageReactionsState) and payments.paid.offered change together by hand
trigger: accept_message_reaction_options sets both; reset_message_reactions clears both; fetch_message_reactions replaces only the first (Loading) and fail_message_reaction_options only the first.
effect: paid.offered can name message A while the state is for B (harmless today because paid_reaction.rs compares the message ids).
fix: Put `paid_offered: bool` inside MessageReactionOptions and drop payments.paid.offered.

title: Joined-or-joining a video chat is read off four sources
trigger: Video chat join.
effect: call.is_joined, call.need_rejoin, reconnecting(), the UI's joining Option and a pending JoinVideoChat request together form the join stage; each caller passes the UI half in.
fix: One join stage on the tracked call: Idle | Joining{request} | Joined | Rejoining.

title: Playlist fetch is loaded/loading/error/stale bools
trigger: The profile's saved music.
effect: loaded, loading, error and stale are set by hand in fetch_playlist, apply_profile_audios, fail_profile_audios and take_stale_playlists; an append failure sets error beside loaded tracks.
fix: Use Fetch<…> for the first page plus a separate more-page state, with Stale as a variant that the driver turns into Loading.

title: Shared media tab: status enum plus loading_more bool and an error string
trigger: Any gallery tab paging older items.
effect: loading_more is a second stage beside status (only meaningful when Ready) and error is filled beside Failed by hand; begin_fetch, accept, fail, accept_more and the profile paths each reset a different subset.
fix: Fold into one enum: Idle | Loading | Ready{more: Idle|Loading|Failed} | Empty | Failed(String).

title: SharedMediaState: open bool and chat_id Option change together
trigger: Gallery open/close.
effect: open and chat_id (and playlist_user) are set and cleared together by hand in open_for_tab and close; accepts() checks both.
fix: Replace with gallery: Option<OpenGallery{chat_id, active_tab, tabs, playlist_user, selection}>.

title: A clip's stage is origin Option, busy, drawing, delivered and state together
trigger: Every sticker clip.
effect: origin Some means waiting to open, busy means a worker holds it (open or frame), drawing names the frame, and state is Opening/Ready/Failed; next_job, next_decode, worker::frame and opener::open each update a different subset.
fix: enum ClipStage { Waiting(Origin), Opening, Ready{drawing: Option<u32>}, Failed(String) } owned by the engine.

title: PlayHead started bool duplicates last Option
trigger: Every sticker view.
effect: started is true exactly when last is Some; start and restart keep both.
fix: enum PlayHead { Waiting, Playing{pos, last} }.

title: A file's download stage is three bools and a path (LocalFileState) plus an uploading flag
trigger: n/a: is_downloading_active, is_downloading_completed, path and can_be_downloaded together encode idle/downloading/complete, and usable_path() and is_idle_incomplete() rebuild the stage by hand.
effect: No bug in the parser. Every UI reader re-derives the stage, and active+completed or completed with an empty path are representable.
fix: Parse into enum LocalFile { Absent { can_download }, Downloading { downloaded_size }, Complete { path } } with an Uploading stage on ParsedFile.

title: AudioEngine stage is spread over track/building/sim_clock Options plus failed, start_failed, stale bools, parked_secs and error
trigger: n/a
effect: state() derives the stage from priority order of the fields (failed beats building, so a retry build after a failure reads Failed until it lands instead of Loading); combos like failed+building or stale+building are representable
fix: One `Stage { Idle, Building{..}, Loaded{track, stale_at: Option<f64>}, Failed{at, error}, Simulated(PlaybackClock) }` enum with the error inside the failing variant.

title: Output device lifecycle held as device Option, opening bool, failed_at Option and watched bool
trigger: n/a
effect: Closed/Opening/Open/Failed are kept in step by hand in open, install, Reopened::drop and look; e.g. device Some with opening true is representable
fix: `DeviceStage { Closed, Opening, Open{device, watched}, Failed{at} }`.

title: The active track is spread over playing_voice, playing_audio, player.chat, player.meta, seek_slider, track_length and the seek bools
trigger: Any play, stop, pause, finish or switch of a track.
effect: Two Options (voice and audio) that must never both be Some, plus chat/meta that must be Some exactly when one is, plus slider, track_length, seek_scrubbing, seek_preview_secs, seek_hover kept in step by begin_track_playback, stop_*_playback, clear_playback_state and release_player_chat. A caller that stops only one kind (demos/media.rs) clears the other's slider and length while its sound plays.
fix: One Option<ActiveTrack { kind, chat, message, meta, length, seek: SeekState }> where SeekState is an enum Idle | Hover | Scrubbing { preview }; stop drops it whole.

title: playback.tick and players.builds_watched are bools standing for 'a task runs'
trigger: Start a track (tick), or start the first non-simulated player (builds_watched).
effect: tick is set true before spawning and reset by the task's tail; the task's way out is 'no active track' only, a dropped continuation leaves it true (harmless today because the whole PlaybackUi is replaced with the screen). builds_watched is set once and never cleared. tick_shown is an Option that is also reset by hand with it.
fix: Store the tick as Option<Task> (or enum TickState { Off, Running { shown } }) in PlaybackUi so dropping it ends the loop and clears the flag.

title: Update stream keeps two sequence counters (DemoUi::seq and Session::last_seq + 1) in step by hand
trigger: QUILL_DEMO_UPDATE_STREAM combined with any later demo action using demo_ui.seq
effect: The stream advances session.last_seq without advancing demo_ui.seq, so later demo envelopes are dropped as stale (see 09-P03-001)
fix: Have the stream number its envelopes through demo_ui.seq (copy_and_parse) so there is one counter.

title: Saved-GIF panel is open + loading bools beside the list, set by hand before the answer
trigger: Open the GIF panel
effect: No bug found here; fixture sets gifs.open = true and gifs.loading = true then applies the answer, which must clear loading
fix: GifPanel { open, items: Fetch<Vec<Gif>> }.

title: RTMP box stage kept in key_shown + confirm beside the session process
trigger: n/a: hidden key / key warning / shown key / revoke confirm are key_shown and confirm kept in step (revoke resets both, warning accept sets both).
effect: n/a
fix: enum RtmpBoxView { KeyHidden, KeyWarning, KeyShown, RevokeConfirm }.

title: RTMP start process keeps `failed: bool` beside `info: Option` and a request list
trigger: Open 'Stream with...', let the URL request fail or revoke the key with the request failing.
effect: RtmpStart { info, failed, requests } is a Fetch with a sticky failed flag the UI clears per frame (rtmp_start_frame_upkeep); RtmpStartUi { key_shown, confirm } is reset by hand in four places. No bug found today.
fix: `RtmpStart::state: Fetch<RtmpInfo>` plus a one-shot error event; the box's reveal/confirm as one `RtmpBoxView { Rows { key_shown }, Confirm(RtmpConfirm) }`.

title: Export box mode is chat_export_dialog + chat_export_progress_hidden + chat_export_seen + the session's export
trigger: n/a
effect: Options / Calendar / Progress / Hidden / Closed are derived from an Option draft (with picking: Option<DateField>), a bool and the session's export; on_close, Cancel, Done and Hide each set a different subset.
fix: enum ChatExportBox { Closed, Options(ChatExportDraft), Progress, Hidden } with picking inside Options.

title: Chat export box stage is spread over chat_export_dialog, chat_export_progress_hidden, chat_export_seen and the session's chat_export
trigger: Open options, start, hide, finish, Done, close with X
effect: Options / Progress / Hidden / Ended are inferred from three UI fields plus a session Option; close handlers set progress_hidden = true even when no export exists; draft.picking and draft.month change together by hand
fix: enum ExportBox { Closed, Options(ChatExportDraft), Progress{hidden}, } and picking: Option<(DateField, YearMonth)>.

title: Probe cache Entry is a proper enum but Probing has no way out if its task is dropped
trigger: The QuillApp entity or the task is dropped between background_spawn and the result being stored (app shutdown only today).
effect: No bug today: Probing, Known and Unreadable are one enum with a retry timer. A dropped continuation would leave Probing for that path until the 1024-entry reset, so the HDR tag never appears.
fix: Store the probe task handle in the Probing variant, or store the result from the background job itself (not the foreground continuation).

title: HdrViewer keeps its decode and window stage in key + token + slot + in_flight + polling + edr_on + edr_lost + headroom
trigger: Open an HDR picture file in the viewer, step to the next item, move the window to another screen, close the viewer.
effect: Nothing wrong today, but in_flight duplicates Slot::Decoding (a bigger re-decode keeps Slot::Hdr while in_flight is true), polling is a 'task started' flag cleared by the task itself (stays true if its update_in fails), and edr_on/edr_lost mirror window state by hand; reset() clears some and not others.
fix: One enum Decode { Idle, Decoding{key,token,showing:Option<HdrPixels>}, Sdr, StandardRange, Hdr{key,pixels} } and a separate WindowMode { Sdr, Edr, EdrLost } owned by the window; the poll task handle lives in the Hdr variant so dropping the variant stops it.

title: Slot play stage is asleep + hidden_since + sound + paused + seeking + bytes
trigger: Scrolling a clip away, clicking a round video, dragging its seek ring.
effect: wants_play() combines five of them; asleep implies bytes==0 and hidden_since==None, sound implies Release is skipped; set by hand in sweep, revive, toggle_sound, seek_to, end_seek.
fix: enum SlotStage { Playing, Held{since}, Asleep, Sounding{paused}, Seeking{was_playing} }.

title: OnDemand pairs a Demand with a hand-kept `started` bool
trigger: Click a round video or GIF
effect: Stages asked -> started -> ended live in a bool plus map membership
fix: enum DemandStage { Asked, Started, Ended } held in the slot, dropped with it

title: Chosen sticker category is a bare index into the session's category list
trigger: Choose a category in the sticker tab; later the list is reloaded (sticker_categories_asked reset, premium state change) in another order.
effect: pickers.media_panel.category is an index, so after a reload it can name another category; wanted_sticker_search then searches that one.
fix: Store the EmojiCategorySource (the key) instead of the index.

title: Rotate/flip decode stage is reorient_pending + reorient_gen + orientation + rotated
trigger: Press Rotate or Flip several times quickly on a photo in the viewer.
effect: An Option target, a generation token and two result fields are set in different places (reorient_viewer_photo, finish_viewer_reorient, cancel_reorient, reset_viewer_item_state); correct today because every exit bumps the generation.
fix: enum Orientation { Settled{orientation, image}, Decoding{target, base, gen} } owned by the viewer item.

title: Viewer control visibility is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Idle in the viewer for about 1.1 s, move the pointer, rest on a control.
effect: hide_timer (task running), controls_hidden, controls_hidden_at, controls_gen, last_activity and over_controls together encode Shown / Waiting / Faded / Gone; hide_timer is a bool set before spawn_scoped and cleared only when the task body sees done.
fix: One ControlsVisibility enum { Shown{since, hold}, Fading{at}, Gone } holding the timer Task in the variant, so dropping the viewer or the variant cancels it.

title: inactive_paused bool records who paused a looping clip
trigger: Switch away from the window while a GIF/loop plays in the viewer, come back.
effect: A bool beside the player's own play state says the pause came from window inactivity; it is cleared in reset_viewer_item_state but not by close_media_viewer.
fix: Fold into a PauseReason enum on the viewer's playback state (UserPaused, WindowInactive, Playing).

title: Inactive-window pause of a looping clip is a bool beside the player's play state
trigger: A looping clip plays, the window loses focus (flag set, clip paused), the user steps or closes.
effect: The flag is cleared only in reset_viewer_item_state; the pause/resume decision depends on flag, viewer_loops(), player and window activity kept in step by hand.
fix: Fold into the player stage: `Playing | Paused(ByUser) | Paused(WindowInactive)`.

title: Viewer media-session tick is a started flag kept in step with a detached task
trigger: Open a viewer clip; the 250 ms tick task runs until the player goes away.
effect: None today: the task clears the flag on its own exit; if the final update fails (screen or window gone) the flag stays set but its owner is gone too.
fix: Hold the tick as `Option<Task<()>>` (or a `Ticker` enum Idle/Running(Task)) so dropping the owner stops it and no flag is needed.

title: Profile viewer's owner lives in a separate Option beside ViewerSource::Profile
trigger: Open a profile photo gallery, close, open a shared-media viewer.
effect: profile_owner is set in show_photo_gallery and never cleared; every reader must also test source()==Profile or it reads a stale owner.
fix: Make the source an enum `ViewerSource::Profile(PhotoOwner)` so the owner exists only while the source is Profile.

title: Pointer gesture is three Options on PhotoEditor
trigger: Draw, drag the crop, or drag a sticker in the photo editor.
effect: current (stroke), drag (crop) and item_drag (sticker) are mutually exclusive stages of one press; press chooses by mode, drag_to prefers current over item_drag over drag, and release clears all three by hand. A lost mouse-up leaves one set until the next press.
fix: enum Gesture { Idle, Stroke(Stroke), CropCorner(usize), CropMove{..}, Item(ItemDrag) }.

title: Sticker-set editor fields sit beside the purpose and must agree with it
trigger: Open the editor from the sticker-set creator.
effect: base_item, corners, keep_ratio and original_ratio are meaningful only when purpose is EditorPurpose::Set, and selected/placed[0] must stay the base item; nothing ties them to the purpose.
fix: Move them into EditorPurpose::Set { set_id, kind, corners, keep_ratio, original_ratio } and derive base_item from it.

title: builds_watched bool as a 'task started' flag
trigger: watch_audio_builds uses mem::replace(&mut builds_watched, true) and never clears it; the spawn_app task ends only when the app is gone.
effect: No bug today; if the task ever ended early the engine builds would never land again.
fix: Hold the watcher as Option<Task> / enum BuildWatch { Off, On(Task) }.

title: Playlist track menu page is a save_to bool inside PlaylistMenu; removal confirm is a separate Option
trigger: Right-click a track, Save to... flips save_to; Delete sets playback.playlist_remove and opens a box while playlist_menu is closed by hand.
effect: No bug today.
fix: enum PlaylistMenuPage { Main, SaveTo } and one enum PlaylistUi { None, Menu{..}, ConfirmRemove(FileId) }.

title: PendingGallery is an Option holding five snapshot keys compared by hand (window, chat, panel, viewer opens, lock count)
trigger: Click a profile photo, move on (other chat, close panel, lock) before the photos load.
effect: No bug today: pending_gallery_still_wanted compares them. The pending slot itself has no way out except the answer or a Failed entry, so a request that never answers keeps it set.
fix: Fetch<PhotoGallery> stage owned by the viewer open request, dropped when its owner key changes.

title: ProfileDialog sub-steps (ShareContact target, EditContact note Seeded, Birthday error) are mutated in place from render closures
trigger: Share contact: pick a chat, Back; Edit contact before full info lands; Birthday with a bad date.
effect: No bug found; steps are variants or Options inside ProfileDialog, but the box host (hosts[ProfilePanel]) and the dialog value are set in two separate calls everywhere, and the file picker path sets the host before the value.
fix: One open_profile_dialog(value) that sets both together.

title: CameraDraft stage is starting + stream + live + shot + drawn + rgb
trigger: Open the photo camera, take a photo, retake, camera unplugged.
effect: starting bool next to stream Option and shot Option; Starting/Live/Taken/Stopped are inferred from combinations (can_take = live && stream && !busy). A serial counter on PhotoSources is the only match for the worker answers.
fix: enum CameraStage { Starting(serial), Live{stream, frame}, Taken{path, image}, Stopped(note) }.

title: Recording stage is spread over capture, start, locked, discard_confirm, once, voice_tick and preview
trigger: Hold-to-record, lock it, open the discard row, toggle play once, pause and preview; cancel, send or close the window.
effect: No bug today: end_capture_flags resets locked/discard_confirm/once/round_preview by hand in the take paths, but preview is cleared separately by callers (stop_record_preview) and voice_tick by the tick task.
fix: One enum Recording { Idle, Opening{..}, Recording{capture, mode: Held|Locked, once, confirm_discard}, Paused{.., preview} } so flags die with the capture; voice_tick becomes Option<Task>.

title: Gallery tab stage is status plus loading_more bool plus error String plus Asked mark
trigger: Open a tab, scroll to load more pages, a page fails.
effect: status (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed/Empty) is an enum but the next-page stage is a separate loading_more bool read here (and in load_due) and a failed next page has no visible state; the retry rests on Asked and a scroll.
fix: Ready { more: More::{None, Idle, Loading, Failed(err)} } so a failed next page is a state the list can show with a retry row.

title: Gallery search field, its key and the keystroke token are kept in step from the layout pass
trigger: keep_shared_media_search_field (called from shell_columns during render) replaces input and sets key when shared_media_search_key changes and bumps keystroke; the query itself lives in SharedMediaTabState::query in the session.
effect: No bug found; two owners (UI field and session tab query) must agree on the text.
fix: One GallerySearch value holding the SearchKey, the field and the debounce task, built and dropped with the open tab.

title: Player and UiClip keep stage as Cell<bool>/Option/bool combinations
trigger: Any sticker shown
effect: pump and closer are 'task started' bools reset by hand; UiClip.timeline + failed + ready_at + shown mirror the engine's ClipState (Opening/Ready/Failed) and failed is sticky until the clip closes
fix: UiClip::state enum {Opening, Ready{timeline}, Failed}; closer/pump as Option<Task> handles

title: A userpic player's slot holds its stage as hidden_since plus asleep, kept in step by hand
trigger: Scroll userpic videos out of view and back: the slot goes playing, off screen, asleep and revived.
effect: No bug found. Every writer sets asleep and clears hidden_since together, and State keeps sweep_due, timer and history_listed as extra flags.
fix: enum SlotStage { OnScreen, OffScreen { since }, Asleep } on Slot, with the player inside the awake variants.

title: Vanishing uses started: Option<Instant> as its stage, with grains empty until started
trigger: Delete a message: the ghost waits for the deletion, then crumbles.
effect: Phase is derived from started, requested and row, and grains is filled in only when started is set. Covered by the 10-second tick bug above.
fix: enum GhostStage { Waiting { requested }, Crumbling { started, grains } }.

title: The cover player and its failed clip are two Options for one stage
trigger: Open a Premium user's info panel with a video photo that fails to decode.
effect: No bug found. clip and failed are set and cleared separately, and sync_video_avatar reads both.
fix: enum Cover { None, Playing(CoverClip), Failed(FileId) }.

title: VideoEditorDialog's stage is spread over info, timeline, note, busy, serial and player
trigger: Open Edit Video: the probe, the ready editor, an unreadable file and an encode are told apart by which Options are Some and by the busy flag.
effect: No bug beyond the two recorded for this struct (player and still_busy after a failed encode), but each new path has to keep info, timeline, busy, note and player in step by hand.
fix: enum EditorStage { Reading { serial }, Unreadable, Ready { info, timeline, player }, Encoding { info, timeline, serial } }, plus a separate StillCut value for the cutter.

title: EditorMotion keeps the strip drag, the seek throttle and the cover bubble/capture animation as loose Options and bools
trigger: Drag the cover head on the strip and let go: grab, head_dragged, seek_pending, seek_last, bubble, bubble_shown_at and capture change together across press, drag, release and tick.
effect: No bug found. The bubble's stages (hidden, growing, flying in, shown since, fading) are decided by which of capture, bubble_shown_at and bubble.target() are set, and the drag's by grab plus head_dragged.
fix: enum StripGesture { Idle, Held { grab, shift, head_moved, seek: Throttle } } and enum CoverBubble { Hidden, Showing(Fade), Capturing(Instant), Shown(Instant), Fading(Fade) }.

title: The live feed's off-screen policy is six fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Hide or cover a window that shows a video chat tile, then bring it back.
effect: No bug found. wake_view and note_live_paint both reset unseen, probed, unpainted_since and quiet, each in their own way.
fix: enum Sight { InView { seen, painted }, Unseen { count, unpainted_since }, Quiet { probed } }.

title: ControlsFade holds the full-screen timer as wanted plus hide_at beside full
trigger: Put the stream window in full screen and let the controls hide.
effect: No bug found. wanted and hide_at only mean something while full is set.
fix: enum Mode { Window, Full { shown_until: Option<Instant> } }.

title: VideoPip keeps the press, drag and slide, and the seek drag, as separate flags
trigger: Drag the PiP window to a screen edge, or drag its progress line.
effect: No bug found. press.dragging, dragged and slide decide together whether a button press counts and whether on_bounds_changed refits the window. seek_preview and paused_by_seek, and volume_dragging and volume_synced, are pairs set by hand. feed_left_told is a once-per-player flag.
fix: enum PipGesture { Idle, Pressed(Press), Dragging(Press), Sliding(Slide) } and enum LineDrag { None, Seek { preview, paused_by_seek }, Volume }.

title: VideoPlayer Inner keeps asleep, awaiting and error beside the transport machine's state
trigger: Hibernate an inline tile, then call play()/seek on the handle; or let a clip fail.
effect: asleep duplicates 'backend is None' and the machine's Paused; play() on a hibernated player sets the transport to Playing while no backend exists (frame_demand masks it with !asleep); error is a take-once Option beside PlayState::Failed.
fix: A player stage enum (Open { backend, awaiting }, Asleep { orphan }, Failed(PlayerError)) so a sleeping player has no transport to play and the error lives in the Failed variant.

title: TransportMachine::loop_sent is a 'loop seek in flight' flag beside PlayState::Playing
trigger: Play a looping GIF/round video to its end.
effect: loop_sent is cleared by hand in observe and sleep; no bug found.
fix: PlayState::Playing { looping_back: bool } or a Looping variant entered on Command::Loop and left when the position leaves the end.

title: Viewer clip mode is seven fields cleared by hand in stop_viewer_video
trigger: Open a video in the viewer, step, close, open PiP.
effect: video, video_path, player, gif, clip_error, video_layer and session_tick describe one clip; stop_viewer_video clears some, session_tick is a 'task running' bool cleared inside the task, and video is a bare MessageId.
fix: ViewerClip enum (None / Playing { item: ChatMessage, path, player, layer, tick: Task } / Gif(path) / Failed(String)) replaced whole on step/close.

title: Viewer rotate/flip decode held as rotated, reorient_pending and reorient_gen
trigger: Press Rotate twice quickly in the photo viewer.
effect: A pending decode is an Option beside a generation counter kept in step by cancel_reorient; no bug found.
fix: Reorient { Idle, Decoding { target, token }, Ready(path, code, image) }.

title: Viewer controls auto-hide held as controls_hidden, controls_hidden_at, controls_gen and hide_timer bools
trigger: Move the mouse over the media viewer, wait for the controls to fade.
effect: hide_timer is a 'task waiting' flag cleared only inside the task; if the task's update ever returns Gone while the slot survives it sticks and controls never auto-hide again.
fix: ControlsVisibility { Shown { idle_task: Option<Task<()>> }, Hidden { at } } with the stored Task replacing the bool.

title: Cancelable ffmpeg extraction is a shared `Option<Child>` slot plus an `AtomicBool cancelled` kept in step by two threads
trigger: wait_for_cancelable_child checks cancelled before and after publishing the child, and treats an emptied slot as cancellation; the UI side sets the flag and takes the slot.
effect: No bug found; the protocol is correct but lives in two values.
fix: One `Mutex<Extraction { Starting, Running(Child), Cancelled }>` value both sides lock.

title: VideoNoteCapture uses `child: Option<Child>` as its running flag and an emptied `path` as its handed-over flag
trigger: ended() sets child to None when ffmpeg exits by itself; finish() takes the path with mem::take so Drop knows not to delete it; Drop branches on both.
effect: No bug found today.
fix: `enum Capture { Recording(Child), Ended(Result<(), String>), Finished }` owned by the struct, path removed by Drop only outside Finished.

title: Clock stage is two bools (`playing`, `held`) plus an optional anchor
trigger: seek sets held, follow clears it, release clears it only if set, play/pause toggle playing; Player::update_ended and decode_loop::paint_floor test the combinations.
effect: No bug found today.
fix: `enum Run { Paused, HeldAfterSeek { playing: bool }, Running { anchor: Instant } }` with base and rate beside it.

title: The decode thread's stage is `eof`, `error`, `stop` and `seek` flags in State
trigger: ExitReport, the open failure, decode_loop::turn and Player::seek each set eof and error together by hand; stop is checked separately; error implies eof by convention only.
effect: Bug found: the seek clears one flag and not the other (separate entry).
fix: `enum Decoding { Running, Seeking(f64), Ended, Failed(String), Stopped }` in State.

title: Player keeps its playback stage in `first`, `ended` and `last_pts`, reset by hand in seek
trigger: Player::seek resets first, ended and last_pts one by one; update_ended and play read them in combination with Clock::held.
effect: No bug found today.
fix: `enum Shown { NothingSinceSeek, Showing { last_pts: f64 }, Ended }` replaced whole by a seek.

title: Player first/ended/last_pts and Clock::held are one presentation stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Seek, step forward/back while paused, or let a clip end.
effect: seek sets first=true, ended=false, last_pts=None and clock.held; take_frame_for and step_forward clear first and release the clock separately; update_ended reads first and held together ('running = !first || !held'). No bug found today.
fix: enum Presenting { AwaitingFirst, Showing { last_pts }, Ended } on Player, with the clock's hold derived from AwaitingFirst.

title: Encoder pause handshake is two atomics (paused, flushed) kept in step by hand
trigger: Pause, Resume, Pause on the voice record bar.
effect: Recording / pausing / paused-and-flushed is spread over Control::paused (UI writes) and Control::flushed (worker writes) plus the worker's local `paused`; preview_path reads the pair. No bug today beyond the one above (flushed never set when the worker died).
fix: One AtomicU8 stage (Recording, PauseAsked, Flushed, Failed) written by both sides with compare-exchange, so a dead worker is a stage too.

title: VoiceCapture fixture vs live mode is three fields (live None, fixed_seconds Some, keep_file true)
trigger: Screenshot demo builds VoiceCapture::preview; real recording uses VoiceCapture::start.
effect: elapsed_secs, sample_bar, preview_path and discard each branch on a different one of the three fields; a mix (live with fixed_seconds) is representable.
fix: enum Source { Live(Live), Fixture { seconds: i32 } } inside VoiceCapture; keep_file and the fixed duration follow from the variant.

title: The photo editor and its deferred open live beside the viewer state, not inside it
trigger: Open the photo editor from the viewer, then lock with the passcode (close_media_viewer).
effect: photo_editor and photo_editor_after are separate from MediaViewer state, so closing the viewer does not close the editor (doc 6.3 notes this); left for the photo editor files' owner to confirm.
fix: Make the editor a field of the viewer's open state so closing the viewer drops it.

title: SwipeMachine holds gesture: Option and releases: Vec plus per-gesture direction_set/reached bools
trigger: Trackpad swipe on a chat row.
effect: Explicit machine, tested; Gesture uses direction_set + orientation + reached bools stepped by hand, and the app keeps a poll: Option<Task> as a 'timer running' flag (ui/chat_swipe_ui.rs:36). No bug found: state lives in OnScreen.chat_list and its task is spawn_screen.
fix: Fold direction_set into Orientation::Undecided{no_direction}/..., and make the poll task part of the machine state.

title: Draft save clock is an Option used as an 'armed' flag
trigger: Typing in the composer.
effect: started_ms None/Some is the armed stage; the caller (connect/composer.rs) must reset it to idle at every Write, chat switch and send.
fix: enum DraftClock { Idle, Armed{first_edit_ms} } owned by the draft target.

title: schedule_repeat_period is only valid beside scheduling = SendAtDate
trigger: Schedule a message with a repeat period, then switch to send-when-online.
effect: Doc says 'ignored unless scheduling is a send date': two fields that must agree.
fix: ComposerScheduling::SendAtDate{date, repeat_period}.

title: Composer document keeps text, span ranges and emoji ranges in step by hand
trigger: Any edit in the composer field.
effect: spans/emoji hold byte ranges into text; writer.rs:104 and :252 defensively drop ranges that an edit left stale or off a char boundary.
fix: Edit the doc only through methods that map ranges (a rope with attached spans) so stale ranges cannot exist.

title: Inline query is a slot enum plus waiting/armed/token side state in the UI
trigger: Typing '@bot query' in the composer.
effect: inline_query slot (Loading/Loaded/Failed) is correct, but 'a newer query waits' lives in chat_ui.inline_query_waiting (bool), inline_query_armed (Option) and composer_ui.inline_query_token, kept in step with the slot by hand.
fix: Make the queued query a variant of the slot (InlineQueryFetch::Loading{queued: Option<String>}).

title: Draft save pipeline: pending_draft Option + draft_clock + draft_save_token + session dirty flag
trigger: Type in two slots (main and a chat window)
effect: One save waits at a time; settle/flush/cancel paths each reset clock and pending by hand (seven sites)
fix: enum DraftSave { Idle, Waiting{slot, started, token, content}, Sending(RequestId) }.

title: Emoji pack browser stage is open + tab + trending_offset + mutating_set + mutation_failed + search_query
trigger: Open the browser, switch tabs, install/remove a pack.
effect: No bug found; stale tab answers are dropped by take_purpose.
fix: enum EmojiBrowser{Closed, Open{tab, mutation: Idle|Changing|Failed}}.

title: GIF panel stage is open + search_mode + search_loading + search_failed + loading + loaded + failed + stale
trigger: Open GIF panel, search, switch back to saved, bot username changes (core/mod.rs gif_bot_changed).
effect: No bug found; errors reset search_loading. The ingest loop re-calls maybe_search_gifs every envelope while search_loading is true.
fix: enum GifPanel{Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch, next}}.

title: Forwarding: in_flight_forward:Option plus queued_forward_flights:Vec as a hand-run queue
trigger: forward_messages_with_options (share box to several chats)
effect: First takes the slot, the rest queue; promotion happens in session_forward.rs:168-176; session_updates clears both
fix: Single Vec<ForwardFlight> with a state per flight (Sending/Done), no special 'main' slot

title: Send pipeline: history paging and sends use open_chat/open_topic ambient state (send_topic only knows the topic for session.open_chat) with SendPlace as the fix for deferred voice/video notes only
trigger: send_animation, send_sticker, send_album_snapshot, send_paid_media_snapshot, send_snapshot compute send_topic/thread_routed at call time
effect: Safe only while callers wrap in in_view_of/with_window_chat; every new caller must remember to
fix: Pass SendPlace (fixed at Send) to every send function, as the voice/video-note _to variants do

title: Owned-bot edit and create dialogs track stages with Vec<RequestId>, pending_* Options and generation counters
trigger: Edit a bot name and about, create a managed bot.
effect: BotEditTexts has loads, saves, pending_name, pending_about, error; CreateBotState has generation, check_pending, check_username, creating, created, error. Several fields change together.
fix: A Save enum per field (Idle, Saving(RequestId), Failed) and a CreateBot enum (Idle, Checking, Creating, Created).

title: Next-channel preload readiness is preloaded_histories set + pinned_messages key + has_purpose scan
trigger: Pull toward the next unread channel.
effect: Ready flags are the presence of keys in two session maps; preload_next_channel removes the preloaded entry before re-asking, so a second pull flips readiness false then true; nothing clears the preloaded history when the pull is cancelled.
fix: A Preload stage in the pull machine (Idle, Loading, Ready) per target chat.

title: Quick replies load state is shortcuts_requested bool + messages_requested set + error
trigger: Open quick replies.
effect: requested flags are reset by hand on a failed send, and by the error arm on a TDLib error (must be checked in both places); no loaded/loading/failed stage.
fix: Fetch<Shortcuts> and a HashMap<ShortcutId, Fetch<Messages>>.

title: Panel set loading is selected_set_id + loaded_set_id + loading_set + set_request Option<(RequestId,i64)> + failed_set_id
trigger: Switch tabs and pick sets quickly.
effect: set_request is never cleared on success and is not reset when select_sticker_tab/search_sticker_picker drop the pending GetStickerSet (loading_set=false by hand).
fix: enum SetView { None, Selected(id), Loading{id, request}, Ready(id), Failed(id) }.

title: Batch install/archive progress is batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed and batch_pending kept in step by hand
trigger: Select several sets and archive them; one is busy or fails.
effect: Four fields mutate from the driver (reset, unsent items) and the reducer (finish_sticker_batch_item); no stage says finished or cancelled, and a new batch resets them while old answers still arrive.
fix: enum Batch { None, Running{pending: Vec<i64>, done, failed}, Finished{done, failed} }.

title: GIF panel stage is open + loading + loaded + failed + stale + search_mode + search_failed + search_loading
trigger: Open the GIF panel, search, fail, reopen.
effect: Eight bools and offsets are patched together in open_gif_panel, maybe_refresh_saved_animations and the reducer (failed also forces loaded=true).
fix: enum GifPanel { Closed, Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch} }.

title: Thread open stage is status plus needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed
trigger: n/a
effect: ThreadView::status, needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set in step by switch_to_thread_chat, begin_thread_reading, fetch_thread_history and the reducer; the UI polls thread_needs_start each frame to decide which step is due.
fix: ThreadStage enum {Resolving, SwitchingChat, Starting, Loading, Ready, Failed} with reload as a Ready sub-variant.

title: EmojiPanel holds many stage flags kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Emoji Sets, the status picker or the chat Appearance box
effect: open, failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, status_open, chat_status_open, status_note, pending_status_emoji, trending_stale, sticker_categories_asked and installed_loaded are written from connect/emoji_sets.rs, the stickers error arm and ui/emoji_sets.rs; failed is shared by the Installed, Trending and Search tabs
fields: EmojiPanel::open, EmojiPanel::failed, EmojiPanel::mutation_failed, EmojiPanel::mutating_set, EmojiPanel::status_open, EmojiPanel::chat_status_open, EmojiPanel::status_note, EmojiPanel::pending_status_emoji, EmojiPanel::sticker_categories_asked
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> and a single enum for the status/appearance consumers; mutating_set as Option<Mutation{request,set,install}>

title: EmojiAnimations load stage is split between load, ready and waiting
trigger: Open a private chat that receives a lone emoji
effect: ready (bool) is set by apply_set, load by loading()/apply_set()/failed(), and waiting is cleared only by failed(); a lost request (never answered and not swept as an error) keeps Loading for two hours (load_due) with ready false
fix: enum Pack { Never, Loading{since,waiting}, Ready{asked,map}, Failed{asked} } so waiting lives only in Loading

title: Emoji set row state is derived from five separate fields of EmojiStyleUi
trigger: Settings, Choose emoji set: click Noto while another set downloads or failed
effect: SetState::of(id, current, ready, loading, failed) is recomputed from current, ready, download, failed and file_error that download_emoji_set, switch_emoji_set and install_emoji_set_file update by hand (ui/emoji_style_ui.rs)
fix: Store SetState per EmojiSetId in the UI (HashMap<EmojiSetId, SetState>) and mutate it only by transitions

title: A message's effect stage (unwatched, watched, unknown) is two key sets kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a: note(), renamed() and mark_watched() consult `watched` and `unwatched` together; renamed() moves only unwatched, and a key's stage is the combination of two memberships.
effect: Both sets are cleared independently when full (BoundedKeys::insert), so a stage can silently revert to unknown and a message can replay or never play.
fix: HashMap<MessageKey, EffectStage> with Unwatched and Watched variants and one eviction policy.

title: Per-effect fetch stage is spread over by_id, requested and failed
trigger: n/a: accept(), fail() and mark_requested() each have to remove the id from the other sets by hand.
effect: An id can be in requested and failed, or in by_id and failed, if a writer is added that forgets one removal; wanted() has to test all three.
fix: HashMap<i64, Fetch<MessageEffect>> (src/state/fetch.rs) as the single record per effect id.

title: Media file stage in MediaFacts is downloading and local bools plus Option<bool> tri-states
trigger: n/a: menu_media_facts (ui/message_menu_ui/mod.rs:208) builds downloading and local from two unrelated lookups, so both can be true (a re-download of a local file); media_actions then offers only Cancel Download and hides Show in Folder and Save As.
effect: The menu for a file that is on disk and being fetched again offers only Cancel Download; the favorite, gif_saved and in_profile Options mean 'unknown until loaded' beside a bool, a second pair of states.
fix: A MediaFile enum (Remote, Downloading, Local) and a Known<bool> for the loaded-later facts, built once from the session's file record.

title: Widget crash streak lives in a counter beside Lifecycle
trigger: A widget stops repeatedly (CPU/memory/validator limit)
effect: Whether a Stopped widget restarts depends on WidgetEntry::crashes (reset in widgets_ui.rs at content change and first frame, bumped on stop) and on runtime.is_none() in widget_bubble.rs, not on the Lifecycle value alone
