fix: Lifecycle::Stopped{reason, streak: u8} and Lifecycle::GaveUp{reason}, so the streak resets when the variant changes.

title: PollDraft keeps parallel vectors and two exclusive deadlines
trigger: Remove a middle option of a quiz draft, switch from a preset period to a custom date
effect: options, option_media and quiz_correct index the same rows and must be edited together; open_period and close_date are exclusive but both stored (PollClose already models it)
fix: Vec<DraftOption{text,media,correct}> and Option<PollClose> instead of parallel fields.

title: PullMachine encodes its stage as pulling/holding/committed/jumping/reached/expand_to/expand_pending/dwell_due/has_next/shown/ready/hint_on/hint_ready
trigger: Pull past the bottom of a channel on a trackpad, hold, release
effect: none by itself; but jumping has no exit except reset/reset_all called by the UI (see pull_next_ui.rs findings)
fix: enum Stage { Idle, Pulling{reached, committed, has_next}, Jumping } with the tweens as data of the stage; Jumping carries a deadline so it has its own way out.

title: Toggle keeps target, from and since in step by hand; since=None doubles as the 'settled' flag
trigger: Any online/badge change
effect: No bug today: settled() treats since older than DURATION as settled while since stays Some
fix: enum Toggle { Settled(bool), Easing { target, from, since } } that collapses to Settled when the ease ends.

title: Create Bot dialog stage is check_pending, creating, created, error and check options
trigger: Create Bot dialog: type username, create
effect: Stage spread over check_pending/creating/created/error/check; BotEditTexts likewise holds load_failed bool beside name/about options and loads vec
fix: enum CreateBot{Editing{check:Fetch<..>},Creating{gen},Created(user),Failed(msg)} and Fetch<(name,about)> for the edit texts

title: game_scores encodes closed/loading/loaded as map presence and Option
trigger: Open and close a game's high-score panel
effect: absent = closed, Some(None) = loading, Some(Some) = loaded; callers insert and remove entries by hand (ui/message_games.rs) and the answer fills only an existing entry
fix: HashMap<(chat,msg), Fetch<Vec<GameHighScore>>> with an explicit Closed removal

title: PendingBotMessage stop stage is can_stop, stopped and stop_failed bools
trigger: Stop a bot's streaming message.
effect: UpdatePendingMessage rebuilds the value from stopped and resets stop_failed=false and can_stop by hand.
fix: enum Stop { Available, Stopping, Stopped, Failed }.

title: Message link answer is result + is_public + error, three one-shot fields
trigger: Share link on a message then another before the UI drains
effect: message_link_public describes message_link_result but is a separate bool; error and result can both be set
fix: One Option<Result<MessageLink,String>> where MessageLink carries is_public.

title: Instant View fallback is a url plus a from-agent bool plus request sets
trigger: Open an Instant View link that 404s, from the agent and from the user
effect: instant_view_fallback_from_agent must describe instant_view_fallback_url; a second failure overwrites the url but the bool is from whichever came last
fix: Store Fallback{url,from_agent} as one Option and key the request table by RequestId to a struct holding url and origin.

title: Forward progress is an Option plus a Vec plus a last-result Option
trigger: Share a message to several chats at once
effect: First flight in in_flight_forward, the rest in queued_forward_flights, outcome in last_forward; kept in step by hand
fix: One Vec<Forward> where each entry is an enum Sending{request}/Done(result)/Failed, keyed by RequestId.

title: Sponsored report flow is two Options that must change together
trigger: Report a sponsored message, pick an option, or hit a TDLib error
effect: error.rs:266-269 clears both by hand; any other writer that clears one leaves the other
fix: enum SponsoredReport{Idle,Asking{target,flight},Done(outcome)}.

title: Quick replies: shortcuts_requested bool and messages_requested/messages_failed sets
trigger: n/a
effect: Failed message loads stay in both sets until reopen() drains messages_failed.
fix: Fetch<Vec<..>> for shortcuts and HashMap<i32, Fetch<Vec<QuickReplyMessage>>> for messages.

title: Sticker set edits: pending counter + refresh_needed + deleted flags
trigger: n/a
effect: finish_sticker_set_edit decrements and sets refresh_needed; accept_sticker_set_view overwrites refresh_needed from busy().
fix: enum SetEditStage { Idle, InFlight(HashSet<RequestId>), NeedsRefresh, Deleted }.

title: Emoji panel: failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, pending_status_emoji, status_note
trigger: n/a
effect: One failed flag shared by three tab lists and the set mutation; error arm sets several fields by hand.
fix: Per-list Fetch and enum EmojiMutation { Idle, Changing(set), Failed }.

title: GIF panel: loading, loaded, failed, stale, search_loading, search_failed bools
trigger: n/a
effect: Error arms set failed/loaded together by hand (GetSavedAnimations sets loading=false, loaded=true, failed=true, stale=false).
fix: Fetch<Vec<Animation>> for saved and for search.

title: Stickers manager: open flag in the Session plus a commit queue stepped by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: open is set by the UI and cleared by finish_manager/farewell; commits advance only via advance_manager_commit after each answer.
fix: Move open to SettingsUi; model a commit as enum CommitStage { Removing(queue), Reordering, Done }.

title: Masks panel: open, failed, installed_loaded, archived_loaded, strip_wanted, confirm_remove
trigger: n/a
effect: finish_mask_mutation resets six fields by hand; fail_mask_request sets one shared failed.
fix: Fetch per list and an enum for the confirm box; open belongs to the screen, not the Session.

title: Direct messages topic loading is requested + exhausted sets; a failed first load is never asked again
trigger: maybe_preload_direct_topics inserts requested when the first send succeeded; a non-404 error only sets chat_action_error (threads/error.rs:55).
effect: The first page failing leaves requested set, so the preload never retries; only a scroll to the tabs end calls load_more.
fix: Per-chat enum Idle/Loading/Ready/Exhausted/Failed; clear Asked on error.

title: Saved Messages sublist load is topics_requested + retry_when_online + topics_exhausted
trigger: LoadSavedMessagesTopics error sets topics_requested = false and retry_when_online = true; 404 sets topics_exhausted; common/apply.rs:217 and session_chatlist.rs:198 clear retry_when_online elsewhere.
effect: Three bools changed from four places; a missed reset leaves the pump asking or never asking.
fix: enum SavedTopicsLoad { Idle, Loading, Retry, Exhausted }.

title: Forum topic list stage is forum_topics + forum_row_asked + forum_topics_failed + topic_load_failed
trigger: forum_row_asked is inserted when the send succeeded, forum_topics_failed on error (never retried: 'rows show No chats and do not ask again'), forum_topics on success removes failed.
effect: Three collections encode Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed per chat; topic_load_failed is the same idea per topic page.
fix: HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<Vec<ForumTopic>>>.

title: PendingBotMessage stage is four hand-synced fields (can_stop, keep_on_stop, stopped, stop_failed)
trigger: Stop a streaming bot reply: finish_pending_bot_stop sets can_stop=false, stopped=true, stop_failed=false by hand; the error arm sets stop_failed elsewhere.
effect: No bug today; a stop that fails after stopped could leave contradictory flags.
fix: enum BotDraftStage { Streaming{can_stop}, Stopping, Stopped, StopFailed } with keep_on_stop as a constant of the draft.

title: Forward progress is in_flight_forward, queued_forward_flights and a one-slot last_forward
trigger: Forward to several destinations from the share box.
effect: A flight lives in one of two places (the Option or the Vec) and finish_forward finds it by trying both; its result goes to a single Option that the poll takes, so two answers in one ingest batch overwrite each other and the first destination's note is lost (S4).
fix: One Vec<ForwardFlight { extra, stage: Queued|Sent }> and a results queue (Vec<ForwardResult>) drained by the UI.

title: MessageReportFlow keeps trail and previous as parallel vectors beside stage
trigger: Walk the report through sub-reasons and press Back.
effect: message_report_sending pushes to trail and previous together and message_report_back pops both; a path that pushes only one would misalign the breadcrumb and the Back target. Sending/Checking have no request id, so no way to tell which request they wait for.
fix: A single Vec<ReportStep { chosen_text, title, options }> and stage variants Checking(RequestId) / Sending(RequestId).

title: MessageAudience tabs keep Audience stage per list plus a separate more_loading set
trigger: Open the reactions dialog, switch tabs, press Load more.
effect: A tab that is Ready and also in more_loading is two facts about one list held in two collections; fail and accept must remove the key by hand in each arm.
fix: Audience::Ready { value, more: Idle|Loading } so the next page is part of the tab's stage.

title: StickerSetView has files_requested: bool and edits flags (refresh_needed, busy) beside its stage enum
trigger: Open View Sticker Set, edit an owned set while the set refetches.
effect: Whether files were asked for and whether a refetch is owed are separate flags that must follow stage by hand (accept_sticker_set_view sets refresh_needed from busy(); a Failed refetch leaves it).
fix: Move files_requested into StickerSetViewStage::Ready { files: FilesAsked } and make the refetch a stage (Ready { refreshing }).

title: ReplyTarget::Loading is written by the driver after the send, not by the request
trigger: connect/message_actions.rs:38 inserts Loading after send_json; accept and reject replace it; prune_reply_targets can evict it mid-flight.
effect: Entry and pending request are two records kept in step by the caller; an answer that is neither a message nor an error (settled request) leaves Loading forever.
fix: Register the target as Loading{request} and drop it when the request is settled (lost-request path).

title: Reply keyboard fetch is inferred from markup_message_ids, by_chat and the loaded history
trigger: reply_markup_message_to_fetch returns an id while by_chat has no entry and the message is not loaded; the in-flight state is only has_purpose_for_chat in the driver.
effect: A failed getMessage (GetChatReplyMarkupMessage has no error arm) leaves by_chat empty, so the chat asks again at every re-select of the open chat. No loop: it is called from select_chat_open only.
fix: by_chat: HashMap<i64, KeyboardFetch{Wanted(id), Loading(request), Known(ChatKeyboard), Gone}>.

title: StickerPanel stages are loading_sets, installed_loaded, loading_set, failed, set_request, failed_set_id, loaded_set_id
trigger: Installed sets and the selected set each have a loading flag plus loaded marker plus failure marker, written in connect/stickers.rs, error.rs and session_stickers.rs.
effect: The flags can disagree (see the loading_set bug); invalidate_installed_sticker_sets, select_sticker_set and select_sticker_tab each reset a different subset.
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> for installed, one SetView enum for the selected set.

title: GifPanel stages are loading, loaded, failed, stale and a second set search_loading, search_failed, search_mode
trigger: accept_saved_animations and accept_gif_search_results reset the flags; open_gif_panel copies search_failed into search_loading by hand (connect/stickers.rs:701).
effect: Two parallel flag groups; a switch between saved GIFs and search sets the pair differently in show_saved_gifs and search_gifs.
fix: GifPanel.saved: Fetch<Vec<AnimationItem>> and GifPanel.search: enum { Off, Resolving, Loading{query}, Ready{query,more}, Failed{query} }.

title: A message translation in flight lives in two maps kept in step
trigger: Translate a message.
effect: jobs holds the request and messages holds Translation::Pending for the same key; begin, finish, abandon and forget_message_translations must change both.
fix: Keep the job id inside Translation::Pending{job} and drop the separate jobs map for message targets.

title: StickerPanel load stages are a cluster of bools and options
trigger: Sticker panel installed sets, selected set, attached sets, suggestions.
effect: loading_sets/installed_loaded/failed, loading_set/set_request/failed_set_id/loaded_set_id, greeting_loaded, suggest_waiting_for_sets and the *_stale flags are each kept in step by hand across connect, error and session code.
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> for the installed sets and one SetLoad enum (None | Loading{request,set} | Loaded(set) | Failed(set)) for the selected set.

title: GifPanel holds loaded/loading/failed and search_loading/search_failed/search_mode
trigger: GIF panel saved list and search.
effect: Two fetches (saved, search) are each three bools plus a mode bool, reset field by field in gifs.rs and session_stickers.rs.
fix: enum GifView { Saved(Fetch<Vec<AnimationItem>>), Search{query, page: Fetch<..>} }.

title: ChatDraft holds text vs rich as two fields and the reply as three loose fields
trigger: Code reading: parse_chat_draft sets text empty when rich is Some; quote and item are meaningful only with reply_to_message_id Some.
effect: Mutually exclusive content and a reply split across reply_to_message_id/quote/item that must change together.
fix: enum DraftContent { Text(String), Rich(RichDraft) } and reply: Option<DraftReply { message_id, quote, item }>.

title: MessageReplyTo encodes 'reply to message' versus 'reply to story' with sentinels (message_id 0 / story_id 0)
trigger: n/a: a story reply has message_id 0 and story_id > 0, and every message-only field (quote, origin, content) is left empty by hand.
effect: No bug today. A reader that checks message_id alone treats a story reply as a reply to message 0 in the poster's chat.
fix: Use enum ReplyTarget { Message { chat_id, message_id, quote, origin, content, .. }, Story { poster_chat_id, story_id } }.

title: One MessageTopic sum is split over four fields, two of which are duplicates
trigger: n/a: message.topic_id is parsed into ParsedMessage::topic_id, ParsedMessage::thread_id, MessageExtras::forum_topic_id (a second copy of topic_id) and MessageExtras::direct_messages_topic_id (0 = none).
effect: No bug today. Four values must agree on which variant is active, and a writer that updates one copy, for example a topic move or an edit, can leave the other copy stale.
fix: Use one `topic: Option<MessageTopic>` enum (Forum(i32) / Thread(i64) / DirectMessages(i64) / SavedMessages).

title: ParsedMessage keeps the send stage as send_state plus a separate can_retry flag
trigger: n/a: can_retry means something only when send_state is Failed, and the two are parsed and stored side by side.
effect: No bug today. A reducer that copies one field without the other, for example on updateMessageSendSucceeded or an optimistic resend, can leave can_retry true on a Sent or Pending message.
fix: Put can_retry inside the variant: MessageSendState::Failed { can_retry: bool }.

title: Self-destruct 'not opened yet' versus 'counting down' is a sentinel expires_in_ms == 0
trigger: n/a: MessageSelfDestruct uses expires_in_ms 0 for 'not scheduled', and fetched_at_ms (wall clock at parse) has meaning only in the counting stage.
effect: No bug today. remaining_secs reads the sentinel by hand, and the struct stamps a wall-clock time even when nothing is counting.
fix: Use enum SelfDestructClock { NotOpened, Counting { expires_in_ms, fetched_at_ms } } inside MessageSelfDestruct.

title: A checklist task's done state is completed_by plus completion_date kept in step
trigger: n/a: is_done() reads only completion_date != 0 while completed_by is a separate Option.
effect: No bug today. An optimistic toggle that sets one field without the other shows a task done with no author, or with an author but not done.
fix: Use `completion: Option<TaskCompletion { by: Option<MessageSender>, date: i32 }>`.

title: One chosen story reaction is split into reaction_emoji and reaction_extra Options
trigger: n/a: parse_story_chosen_reaction returns (emoji, extra) and both are stored. ParsedStory::chosen_reaction_emoji/extra has the same shape.
effect: No bug today. Both can be Some, and a writer that sets one must clear the other by hand.
fix: Use `reaction: Option<ReactionType>` (or a StoryReaction enum).

title: requires_premium and premium_animation are two copies of one fact that can disagree
trigger: n/a: requires_premium is true when full_type.premium_animation is non-null, while premium_animation is None when that file fails to parse or has id 0.
effect: No bug confirmed. A Premium sticker can be gated as Premium yet have no effect file, and a reader that checks premium_animation.is_some() reaches the opposite answer.
fix: Keep one `premium: Option<PremiumSticker { animation: Option<FileId> }>` field.

title: A poll's deadline is two fields, open_period and close_date, that must not both be set
trigger: Poll composer: pick a preset period, then 'Custom' date (or the reverse). PollDraft (src/poll.rs:407-412) keeps both values, and open_period_secs (src/poll.rs:451-455) and validate (src/poll.rs:495-505) decide by hand that close_date wins. PollSend passes both through to inputMessagePoll.
effect: No bug today: open_period_secs zeroes the period when close_date > 0. But every reader must repeat the 'close_date wins' rule, and a new caller that builds PollSend from the draft fields directly sends both, which TDLib rejects.
fix: One enum PollDeadline { None, Period(i32), Until(i32) } in PollDraft and PollSend; send_poll maps it to the two schema fields.

title: Create bot: dialog.submitted mirrors session create.creating and a 150 ms poll task drives it
trigger: Fill the dialog, press Create
effect: BotCreateDialog::submitted is set by hand and reset by poll_bot_create when CreateBotState::creating becomes None; created/error/creating/check_pending/check live in the Session and a spawn_screen timer loop polls them every 150 ms until settled
fix: One CreateStage enum (Editing, Creating, Failed(msg), Done(id)) in the dialog fed by the answer, no polling

title: Edit bot: dialog.filled plus session edit.name/about/load_failed plus a 150 ms fill loop
trigger: Open Edit bot for an owned bot
effect: BotEditDialog::filled says the fields hold the server texts and is set by a polling task (fill_bot_edit) from BotEditState::{name,about,load_failed}; Save enablement combines filled with the session state, and status text is a priority chain of load_failed/local_error/server_error/saving/saved/!loaded
fix: Fetch<BotEditTexts> in the dialog (Loading, Ready, Failed) filled by the answer; one SaveStage enum

title: Stop-generating stage is can_stop/stopped/stop_failed plus a request lookup
trigger: Bot streams a reply; user presses Stop
effect: The stage Streaming/Stopping/Stopped/StopFailed is encoded by PendingBotMessage::{can_stop,stopped,stop_failed} (state/session.rs:13) and by has_purpose_for_chat(StopPendingMessage) in the view; finish_pending_bot_stop and the error arm flip them by hand
fix: enum StopStage { Streaming, Stopping(RequestId), Stopped, Failed } on PendingBotMessage

title: Similar bots fetch: UI inserts Loading next to the request, section shows the same button while loading
trigger: Press 'Similar bots' on a bot card
effect: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading is written by the UI after the driver queued the request and removed by the error arm of the reducer; the panel treats Loading like absent (same fetch button, no progress, 'Already loading' note on repeat), with the Loading entry and the pending request as two copies of one stage
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> set by the driver when it sends, with the view showing a spinner for Loading and Retry for Failed

title: Chat look wallpaper choice is three Option/bool fields (background, file, remove_wallpaper) cleared by hand in 4 click handlers
trigger: Pick a gallery tile, then From file, then Remove: each handler (chat_look_ui.rs:238,611,772 and the grid) must reset the other two
effect: Any missed reset gives two choices at once; plan_changes silently prefers file over background over remove
fix: enum WallpaperChoice { Keep, Installed(i64), File(PathBuf), Remove } in ChatLookDialog.

title: Swipe poll Option<Task> used as a running flag
trigger: Swipe gesture start and end.
effect: poll.is_some() means the timer runs; it is cleared by the task's own last update and sticks if that update fails (screen replaced, so owner is dropped too).
fix: Derive running from the machine state (swiping/animating) and keep the Task only while it is, or hold it in the machine's phase enum.

title: Inline-mode dropdown is open/selected/armed/waiting fields plus a token in ComposerUi
trigger: Type @bot query, change text, switch chat, bot resolve answer lands.
effect: inline_results_open, inline_results_selected, inline_query_armed, inline_query_waiting (and composer_ui.inline_query_token) are stages of one query flow reset by hand in sync_inline_mode, close_inline_results, inline_grid and the timer.
fix: One enum InlineQuery { Closed, Resolving{username}, Armed{username,query,token}, InFlight/Waiting, Shown{selected} }.

title: edit_replace_as_file lives beside the edit it belongs to
trigger: toggle_edit_replace_as_file in an edit, then leave the edit by clear_edit, finish_edit_restore_draft or a chat change.
effect: composer_ui.edit_replace_as_file is reset only by begin_edit and clear_edit_replacement, not by leave_edit_mode or enter_chat_ui; it relies on the next begin_edit to reset it.
fix: Move it into EditMode (or ComposerEdit::media_edit) so leaving the edit drops it.

title: prev_text is hand-synced across nine writers beside markdown_revert
trigger: Programmatic set_value (set_composer_markup in begin_edit/clear_edit/cancel, rich editor, drafts) emits no Change.
effect: composer_ui.prev_text is updated only in the Change path and at some of the set_value sites (drafts.rs, rich_draft, system_replace, field revert); set_composer_markup does not, so the next keystroke diffs against a stale text for markdown/instant/system replacement.
fix: One 'field content changed' funnel (set_composer_markup) that sets prev_text and clears markdown_revert, or derive prev from the field's own undo state.

title: PendingSend.held_send and attachments[].extras.photo_render are two fields that must agree
trigger: Press Send while a photo edit renders (held_send set), then the render lands, fails, or the tray changes.
effect: release_idle_hold re-derives 'a render will land' after every update and land_attachment_edit clears the hold by hand on failure; the invariant held_send.is_some() implies renders_an_edit() is kept by calls, not by type. Works today.
fix: enum TraySend { Idle, WaitingForRender{ renders, held: (String, SendOnce) } } so a hold cannot exist without a render.

title: focus_on_mount bool on the link and Code Language dialogs is a one-shot 'mounted yet' stage
trigger: Open either box; the dialog panel's first frame takes the flag with take_link_focus / take_code_language_focus.
effect: If the box is never drawn (locked, hidden window) the flag stays set and focus is taken at an unexpected later frame. No bug found today.
fix: Dialog stage enum (Opening | Open) or move focus into the open call via a deferred focus handle.

title: edit_replace_as_file is state of the edit but lives in ComposerUi and is reset by hand
trigger: Start an edit (begin_edit resets it), toggle 'Send as a document', cancel the edit by any path other than clear_edit_replacement.
effect: The bool is cleared at copy_inline_text.rs:85 and :177 only; cancel_edit / chat change leave it set until the next begin_edit. Any new path that stages a replacement without begin_edit would start as a document.
fix: Move the flag into the edit's media_edit state (ChatUi EditMode) so ending the edit ends it.

title: send_silent_once / send_effect_once are one-shot arguments passed through fields
trigger: send_with_effect, silent shortcut, schedule-then-send set the fields, call submit, then reset to false/0 (send_effects/mod.rs:305-309, command_shortcuts.rs:89-91, scheduled.rs:399-401); with_send_once swaps them for a send that waited.
effect: Correct only because every caller resets after a synchronous call; the resets are unconditional (they also clobber an outer value) and an early return or a new async step between set and reset would leak the option into the next send.
fix: Pass SendOnce as a parameter of the submit path instead of stashing it in ComposerUi.

title: draft_restore_pending is a request flag taken by the next frame
trigger: A topic or thread switch from a menu calls request_draft_restore; restore_draft_if_pending runs in window_upkeep.
effect: The flag is not tied to the slot it was asked for: if the open slot changes again before the frame, the restore applies to the newest slot (usually right) and is lost if the window is locked or closed. No bug found today.
fix: Store Option<(ChatId, DraftTopic)> so the restore names what asked and is dropped when the slot differs.

title: drop_paths / drop_state / drop_preview are three fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Drag files over the conversation: drop_zones.rs sets drop_paths and clears drop_state, an async probe fills drop_state only if drop_paths still equals what was probed; leave/drop clear both.
effect: Matched by a path-list compare, so it works today; two fields must change together in four places (drop_zones.rs:41,65,77,91).
fix: enum DragOver { None, Probing(paths), Ready(paths, DragState) } plus the demo's fixed preview as its own variant.

title: slow_mode_tick_chat: Option<ChatId> doubles as 'task running' flag
trigger: Open gated chat A (tick task starts), switch to gated B then back to A within 1 s.
effect: Two tick tasks run for A until one sees the gate lift (ensure_slow_mode_tick sets the field to A again and spawns another, the first is still alive). Harmless extra redraws; the field is a hand-kept 'Some exactly while the task runs'.
fix: Hold the tick as Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)> so replacing it drops the old task (stage and owner in one value).

title: TextLimitCount holds known and running as two Cells kept in step by hand
trigger: Type or paste text over 16 KB in the composer
effect: known (last counted key and note) and running (key and task) are set and taken in set/is_counting; a state of 'known for K1, running for K2' exists by design and is guarded only by key comparison
fix: enum TextLimitCount { Idle, Known(key, note), Counting { key, task, last: Option<..> } }.

title: Schedule popup is schedule_popup_open: bool beside schedule_picker: Option<SchedulePicker>
trigger: n/a
effect: Five writers clear the bool (toggle_composer_silent.rs:107/393, composer/mod.rs:567, send_prep.rs:450, scheduled.rs:362) and leave the picker Some. Only scheduled.rs:298 clears both.
fix: One Option<SchedulePicker> whose Some is 'open' (the picker carries its target).

title: Chrome-notify pending flag and due list are two cells kept in step
trigger: Scroll a history with stale-chrome rows during a session change.
effect: chrome_notify_pending (Cell<bool>) says a deferred notify is scheduled while chrome_due holds the rows; finish_chrome_notify and clear_slot_chrome_notify must reset it for the right window or notifies stop.
fix: Make chrome_due an enum ChromeDue { Idle, Due(Vec<usize>), Notifying(Vec<usize>) } in one RefCell.

title: Custom emoji card stage spread over a per-window tap marker, a seen copy and a session-wide preview
trigger: Tap a custom emoji in a message.
effect: custom_emoji_tapped (window), custom_emoji_card_seen (window) and Session::stickers.custom_emoji_preview (session) are set, compared and cleared by hand in tap, render, timer and both buttons.
fix: One enum CustomEmojiCard { Hidden, Asked{emoji}, Shown{preview, shown_at} } per window, with the session preview only as the answer.

title: OptionAttach stage kept in menu_open + link_input + sticker_wait + emoji_wait + media
trigger: n/a: five mutually exclusive stages across bools and Options; choose_poll_option_sticker clears sticker_wait on all options but emoji_wait only on the sticker's own option, so an emoji pick can still route to an earlier option (polls/option_attach.rs:439-466, 470-484).
effect: n/a
fix: enum AttachStage { Idle, Menu, Link(Entity), WaitSticker, WaitEmoji } per option, with the waiting stage owned once by the poll dialog (one waiting target at a time).

title: PollDialog sub-pages kept as confirming_discard + deadline_box + country_box + limit_duration/close
trigger: n/a: the discard prompt, deadline picker and country picker are separate fields that must not coexist.
effect: n/a
fix: enum PollPage { Form, Deadline(DeadlineBox), Countries(CountryBox), ConfirmDiscard }; close as enum PollClose with None.

title: PollDialog's sub-boxes are separate Options/bools
trigger: New Poll: open the deadline box, the country box or the discard confirmation.
effect: deadline_box, country_box and confirming_discard can be set together; focus_question is a one-shot 'mounted' flag. No bug found today.
fix: One `PollOverlay { None, Deadline(DeadlineBox), Countries(CountryBox), ConfirmDiscard }`.

title: DraftTimer keeps due and running in step by hand
trigger: Every keystroke arms it; the task steps it.
effect: Two fields (Option due, bool running) encode idle/armed-waiting/fired; a task that ends without calling step would leave running true and no draft would ever commit.
fix: One enum: Idle, Waiting { token, due }, with arm returning whether to spawn from the Idle to Waiting transition.

title: File-drag probe is drop_paths + drop_state (+ drop_preview) cleared by hand in four places
trigger: Drag files over a chat, leave, drop elsewhere.
effect: drop_paths is the key the probe answer is matched to and drop_state the answer; both are reset in note_file_drag, visible_drop_state, drop_files_plain and drop_on_zone, and the answer is matched by path equality which repeats for the same files.
fix: enum FileDrag { None, Probing { paths, token }, Ready { paths, state } } and a preview variant for the demo.

title: Active effect kind is premium bool + message Option, stage is a view Option
trigger: Any effect
effect: premium: bool and message: Option<MessageEffectPlay> encode the kind (emoji, premium sticker, message effect) and are tested in many places; view: Option is waiting vs playing
fix: enum EffectKind {Emoji{seed}, Premium, Message(MessageEffectPlay)} and enum Stage {Waiting{queued}, Playing{view,given}}.

title: Emoji packs box stage is spread over failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, tab and emoji_set_return_tab
trigger: Any use of the box
effect: panel.failed and panel.mutation_failed are two bool failure flags beside mutating_set: Option<(i64,bool)>; the session tab must be kept in step by hand with PickerUi::emoji_set_return_tab and the search field; loading is derived from request purposes separately
fix: Per-list Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> for installed/trending/search and one enum Mutation {Idle, Changing{set,install}, Failed}; return tab derived from the last non-search view.

title: EmojiStyleUi keeps the download stage as started: bool plus download, download_task, failed, file_task and file_error Options, and detects cancel by comparing the message to "Cancelled."
trigger: Open Emoji set, start a download, start another (replaces it), install from file while one runs.
effect: download/download_task/failed/file_error must be cleared together by hand in download_emoji_set, install_emoji_set_file and the completion callbacks; the cancel arm is recognised by a string equal to download::fetch's literal.
fix: enum SetStage {Idle, Downloading{id, progress, task}, Failed{id, message}, Installing{task}} and a typed DownloadError::Cancelled instead of String.

title: Word bar is hovered + pinned + asked + pending kept in step by hand
trigger: Hover, menu or Esc on a highlighted word
effect: hovered: Option<(Highlight,items)> with pinned: bool (meaningful only when hovered is Some), asked: Option and pending: Option<(BarAim,Task)> are cleared together by unhover() and by several call sites
fix: enum WordBar {Closed, Asked{..}, Hover{word,items,leaving:Option<(BarAim,Task)>}, Pinned{word,items}}.

title: ForwardLift global bool marks a lifted message drag
trigger: Lift a message drag and release outside any window, or the drag is cancelled without a mouse-up reaching end_forward_lift.
effect: The bool can stay true; forward_lift_live also checks has_active_drag so nothing wrong shows today.
fix: Store Option<ForwardDrag> (the drag in flight) as the global, or derive it from cx.active_drag's type instead of a separate flag.

title: GIF list stage is spread over GifPanel loading, search_loading, failed, search_failed, loaded and search_mode
trigger: gifs_on_their_way ORs two loading bools; gif_panel_status chooses text from the combination of search_mode, search_failed, failed and an empty bot name
effect: Combinations such as loading + failed or loaded + search_loading are representable and decided only by writers in connect/gifs.rs and connect/stickers.rs
fix: Make the list one Fetch<GifList> keyed by GifWanted (Saved | Search(query)), with Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed per key

title: press_inline_results_button closes the panel by flipping two fields
trigger: Press the bot's button.
effect: inline_results_open=false and inline_query_armed=None are written beside the same pair in send_inline_pick/close_inline_results/sync_inline_mode (four writers).
fix: A single ChatUi::close_inline() or the InlineMode enum.

title: Inline-mode query flow is spread over six fields in three owners
trigger: Typing @bot query in the composer.
effect: inline_results_open, inline_results_selected, inline_query_armed (Option used as 'timer armed' flag), inline_query_waiting (pending bool, taken and re-set in progress_inline_mode_here), composer_ui.inline_query_token and pending_inline_bot_alert are kept in step by hand; the session holds one inline_bot_resolve and one inline_query slot for every window.
fix: One ChatUi enum InlineMode { Off, Resolving{username}, Waiting{bot,query}, Armed{bot,query,token}, Showing{selected} } with the session slots keyed by window/chat.

title: GIF playback stage is playing_animation + gif + gif_started_at + gif_decodes + autoplayed_gifs + intent
trigger: Autoplay or tap a GIF.
effect: Six fields in PlaybackUi are written by hand in stop_animation_playback, play_gif_file, gif_started, gif_decoded, leave_gifs_here and stop_gif_of_window.
fix: enum GifPlayback { Idle, Waiting{intent}, Decoding{key,cancel}, Playing{key,clip,started} }.

title: voice_tick is a bool 'task running' flag
trigger: Start a voice recording.
effect: Set before the task spawns and cleared only at the end of the task; it lives in RecordingUi (replaced on account switch) so it does not stick today.
fix: Hold Option<Task<()>> in the recording stage.

title: InlineReturn is a state machine in Option<String> pending_start plus baseline
trigger: Press an inline results switch-to-PM button
effect: Stages WaitingToOpen / StartSent{baseline} / Returned are pending_start.is_some() and baseline!=0 by hand
fix: enum InlineReturnStage { AwaitStart{param}, StartSent{baseline} }

title: Message menu mode is five fields cleared by ~40 call sites
trigger: Open the message menu (menu, menu_selection, menu_link, menu_item, menu_ui.page set in open_message_menu); pick an item.
effect: Each item sets `message_ui.menu = None` directly, leaving page/selection/link/item behind until the next open resets them; only some paths use close_message_menu.
fix: One `Option<OpenMessageMenu { target, position, page, link, item, selection }>`; closing is replacing it.

title: Chat peek is two Options (press and preview) plus a timer task matched by (chat, Instant)
trigger: Long-press a chat row: preview_press set, timer task, then preview set; release clears both from several handlers.
effect: Every release handler must clear preview_press by hand (chat_row, top_people, topic_titles, chat_list); a missed one lets the timer open a peek with the button already released.
fix: One `PeekStage { Idle, Pressing{chat,started}, Showing{chat,anchor} }` with a single `release()`.

title: Game score panel stage is a map entry plus a nested Option
trigger: Press Scores on a game card.
effect: Absent = closed, Some(None) = loading, Some(Some(rows)) = ready. Closing during load relies on a guard in apply to stay closed; a failed answer removes the entry (closes). Two windows showing the message share one panel.
fix: enum ScoresPanel { Closed, Loading(RequestId), Ready(Vec<GameHighScore>) } per ChatMessage, with the answer matched by request id.

title: Message menu mode is spread over menu, menu_item, menu_link, menu_selection, menu_ui.page and right_clicked_item
trigger: Right-click a poll option or task, or a link, then open the menu.
effect: open_message_menu resets each field by hand; right_clicked_item is only consumed by take_right_clicked_item, so a right press that opens no menu leaves it for a later menu at the exact same point.
fix: MessageMenu { target, item, link, selection, page } inside the open-menu variant, so closing the menu drops all of it.

title: Poll option menu facts are an Option holding an Option
trigger: Right-click a poll option.
effect: Session::messages::poll_option_menu is None (not asked), Some with properties None (asked) or Some (answered), matched by chat, message and option on each read.
fix: Fetch<PollOptionProperties> keyed by ChatMessage + option id.

title: Report dialog open flag kept in step with Session::messages::message_report by hand
trigger: Message menu, Report.
effect: MessageMenuUi::report_open (window) and MessageReportFlow (Session, one per account) are two sources of truth. A report in a chat window and one in the main window share one flow. Error paths reset report_open by hand.
fix: One ReportBox enum (Closed, Open(flow)) owned by the window slot, with the flow keyed by request id.

title: Report and sticker-set dialogs are open flags beside session state
trigger: Report a message: report_open=true is set before reportChat is sent; the flow itself lives in Session.messages.message_report. sticker_set_open likewise sits beside the session's sticker set view.
effect: Two sources of truth (window flag, session flow) with the box reading both: with the flag true and no flow the box renders an empty 'Report' title; with a flow and flag false it is invisible.
fix: Derive the open state from the flow (flow owns the window that asked) rather than a second bool.

title: Message menu is six fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Right-click a message: open_message_menu (reactions.rs:49) sets menu, menu_ui.page, menu_link, menu_item, menu_selection, reactions_expanded. Closing is `message_ui.menu = None` at 52 call sites; close_message_menu clears only menu.
effect: menu_selection (copied message text), menu_link, menu_item and menu_ui.page/audience_tab survive the close and are reset only by the next open; every reader must remember to also check menu.is_some().
fix: MessageUi::menu: Option<OpenMessageMenu { state, page, link, item, selection, audience_tab, reactions_expanded }> so closing drops all of it.

title: Drag poll loop is a bool kept beside the drag Option
trigger: Press a history row; start_selection_drag_loop sets selection_drag_loop=true and the loop task clears it only on its own exit.
effect: Two fields (selection_drag Some, selection_drag_loop) move in step by hand; a task that never reaches its last line leaves the loop flag set so no new loop starts.
fix: Make the drag one value, enum DragState { Idle, Pressed(DragSelect, Task<()>) }, so the poll task is owned by the drag and drops with it.

title: spoiler_revealed holds two meanings and is keyed by run index
trigger: Reveal a spoiler, or expand a long quote (quote_block inserts key with bit 63 set into the same HashSet).
effect: One set means 'spoiler revealed' and 'quote expanded', keyed (chat, message, run index, caption). Editing the message shifts run indexes so a reveal can land on a different run, and the set only grows for the life of the window slot.
fix: Two sets (or a map to enum Reveal) keyed by a stable run id, dropped when the message is edited or leaves the history.

title: Poll voters/stats dialog: show_stats bool + selected_option Option, fetch state in the session map
trigger: open_poll_voters_dialog / open_poll_stats_dialog set the same struct with show_stats true/false; selected_option None/Some drives which fetch is read.
effect: No bug today.
fix: enum PollDialogView { Voters{option}, Stats{option: Option<usize>} }.

title: Poll option attach UI mode is four fields resolved by a priority chain
trigger: OptionAttach holds link_input Option, emoji_wait, sticker_wait, menu_open next to media; poll_option_attach_area picks link > emoji > sticker > menu, and the choose_*/start_* starters clear the others by hand (choose_poll_option_sticker leaves emoji_wait, choose_poll_option_emoji leaves other rows' sticker_wait).
effect: Two modes can be set at once (hidden one still routes picks from the media panel); closing the panel without Done/Cancel leaves the wait on.
fix: enum AttachMode { Closed, Menu, Link(Entity<TextareaState>), PickingSticker, PickingEmoji } owned per option, plus media: OptionMediaSlot.

title: Poll box steps (poll / country picker / deadline picker / discard prompt) are separate Options and a bool
trigger: PollDialog has country_box Option, deadline_box Option and confirming_discard bool; panel and footer test them in order and Esc handling tests them in order.
effect: Both pickers or a picker plus the discard prompt can be set together; the later one is hidden but alive.
fix: enum PollStep { Editing, Country(CountryBox), Deadline(DeadlineBox), ConfirmDiscard }.

title: Pull-to-next stage kept by PullMachine plus target, next_chat, next_topic, window and jump Task kept in step by hand
trigger: Pull at the bottom, release on a ready pull, switch chat or topic during the 1.5 s jump wait
effect: machine.jumping() can stay set while jump/next_* were cleared by pull_sync (or the reverse); resets happen in pull_sync and ad hoc in pull_jump_when_ready
fix: Fold next_*, window and the jump Task into the machine's Jumping { next, task } variant so leaving it drops them together.

title: Quick replies dialog: view enum plus editing, confirm_delete, local_error and a watch Task cleared by hand per transition
trigger: Open a shortcut, start an edit, press Delete twice, go back
effect: editing/confirm_delete/local_error reset in quick_replies_go but toggled independently elsewhere; watch Option is a 'poll running' flag
fix: Put editing, confirm_delete and error inside View::Shortcut{..} so changing view drops them.

title: Message menu is menu + menu_ui.page + menu_link + menu_item + menu_selection + reactions_expanded + link_tooltip set by hand in open_message_menu
trigger: Right-click a message, expand reactions, pick one (reaction_cell sets menu = None directly), right-click again
effect: Close paths differ (close_message_menu, reaction_cell, close_context_menus); stale link/item/selection survive until the next open resets them
fix: MessageUi::menu: Option<OpenMenu{state,page,link,item,selection,expanded}> so closing drops all.

title: Rich draft stage is rich_editor_open bool + stored draft + composer text + rich_draft_box
trigger: Open a rich draft in the editor, send plain, close the editor, discard.
effect: rich_editor_open is set and cleared at call sites (open_rich_draft, close_rich_editor, send_rich_draft_plain, open_rich_editor_with_field, send paths) and decides whether the draft shows in place of the field; no failing path found.
fix: enum RichComposer { Field, Preview, Editor, Box(RichDraftBox) } in ChatUi.

title: Rich paste notice stage is shown_at Option + field Option
trigger: Paste markdown, wait 9 s, edit the field, click the toast action.
effect: No bug today: field is cleared in three places (timer, action, stale check) and shown_at gates the throttle and the timer by value.
fix: enum PasteNotice { Idle{last: Option<Instant>}, Showing{at, field} }.

title: selection_drag_loop is a 'started' flag kept beside message_ui.selection_drag
trigger: Press on a history row and drag
effect: Loop-running flag and drag Option must be kept in step by hand; the flag is cleared only at the end of the spawned task
fix: Hold the task in the DragSelect value (Option<Task>) so dropping the drag stops the loop.

title: Per-path read stages kept as a checking map plus a checked set, three times, per window
trigger: Attach a photo, a video or a picture-as-file to a tray.
effect: Each of sound_checking/sound_checked, thumbnailing/thumbnailed, media_checking/media_checked is an unseen/checking/done machine kept in step by hand, with job counters (sound_jobs, thumbnail_jobs, media_check_jobs) matching answers. forget() must clear all six by hand.
fix: One HashMap<PathBuf, TrayRead> with enum TrayRead { Reading{job}, Done(Outcome) } per read kind (or one per path holding all three), so a path has exactly one stage per kind.

title: Send menu stage is a set of bools and Options: expanded, search, _search_changed, preview, leaving, card_menu
trigger: Right-click Send, expand the effect list, pick an effect, right-click the card button.
effect: Closed/strip/expanded/card/card-menu is spread over expanded: bool, search+_search_changed (set together in expand_send_effects), preview/leaving Options and card_menu; a preview that finished fading stays Some(hiding) and keeps the strip paused.
fix: enum MenuStage { Strip, Expanded{search,query,_sub}, } with a separate Card enum { None, Shown(Preview), Fading{old,new}, Menu(..) } so each stage owns its data.

title: The set box's editing flow is spread over create, encoding, pick, pending_still, pending_video and four modal bools
trigger: Any create/adapt/rename/delete flow
effect: Stages (choosing, decoding still, downloading video, editing, naming emojis, encoding) are Options and bools reset by hand in reset(); reordering, rename_open, delete_set_open, remove_set_open and delete_sticker can be set together
fix: One enum SetEdit {Idle, Reordering, Renaming, ConfirmDeleteSticker(item), ConfirmDeleteSet, ConfirmRemoveSet, Picking(pick), DecodingStill(..), DownloadingVideo(..), Naming(create), Encoding{create,cancel}}

title: ManagerView.loading and failed are copies of session flags (installed_loaded, requests.has_purpose, panel.failed)
trigger: Open the manager and switch tabs
effect: Loading is derived from three sources by hand per tab; failed is one bool shared by all tabs (a failed Trending page shows 'could not update' on Installed)
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> in the panel state

title: greeting_loaded is set when the request is sent, not when answered
trigger: Open an empty private chat once while offline or the request fails
effect: The flag means 'requested'; a failure is never retried this session so the greeting never shows, and the UI cannot tell loading from loaded
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> for greeting with a retry on reconnect

title: The picker status line is built from loading_tab, loading_set, failed and search_has_more
trigger: Sticker panel in any tab
effect: failed is one bool for every tab and loading_set a second flag beside request purposes; an error in one tab shows in all and can sit beside loading
fix: Per-tab Fetch<T>

title: TranslateDialog modes are view + Option source + Option job + close_after_choose by hand
trigger: Open Translate from a message, the selection, the bar menu (chooser) or Settings (skip list); switch language, go back, close.
effect: No stuck state found, but the mode is spread over four fields: back_to_box is recomputed as `view==ChooseTo && source.is_some()`, close_after_choose is only meaningful for a ChooseTo with no source, and job is only meaningful for Selection. Each close path must remember to drop the job.
fix: enum TranslateDialog { Translating{source, to, job, expanded}, Choosing{back: Option<Translating>}, SkipList } so each variant carries only its data.

title: PumpScan is key Option + revision + wanted kept in step
trigger: Every pump pass.
effect: key: None means 'never scanned' and the revision/wanted pair is only valid together with that key; record sets all three, but nothing ties the revision to the HistoryMessages instance (correct only because next_revision is process-global).
fix: enum PumpScan { Fresh, Scanned{key, revision, wanted} }.

title: WidgetEntry keeps the runtime's stage in `lifecycle` and its per-runtime data in separate fields reset by hand
trigger: Read start_widget, the Stopped/Failed arm of widget_event, the release in start_waiting_widgets and the identity change in reconcile_widgets: each sets runtime, lifecycle, queries, theme, wants_frames, crashes, polled by hand, and each resets a different subset (pressed, hold, hovered, selection, cursor, frame and queries are left behind by some).
effect: No user-visible bug by itself today; it is how P3 widget findings (stale press, stale frame after a content change) arise.
fix: Carry the runtime and everything that belongs to it in the live variants: `Lifecycle::Loading(Live) | Running(Live)` with `Live { runtime, queries, theme, wants_frames, cursor, press: Option<Press> }`, so a stop, release or restart drops all of it at once.

title: Widget on-screen state is `visible: bool` plus `hidden_at` (0 while visible) plus `window`/`view`, kept in step by hand
trigger: hide_widgets sets visible=false and hidden_at=clock; reconcile_widgets sets visible=true and hidden_at=0; widgets_left_window moves window/view without touching the others.
effect: No bug found from this pairing alone.
fix: `enum Placement { Shown { window: Option<ChatId>, view: Option<EntityId>, width: f32 }, Hidden { since: u64 } }`.

title: `WidgetsUi::landing: bool` marks a detached landing loop as started
trigger: watch_widget_runtimes sets landing with mem::replace and detaches the spawn_screen task; nothing clears the flag, the loop ends only when the screen is replaced (which replaces the flag too).
effect: No bug today because WidgetsUi lives in OnScreen; a future owner change (or any other exit from the loop) would leave landing true and no frames or events would ever land again.
fix: Store the task: `landing: Option<Task<()>>`, so the loop's existence and the flag are one value and dropping the owner cancels it.

title: EmojiPlays keeps played, generations and replays as three sets/maps changed together by key
trigger: started, replay, leave_chat and clear each edit the three collections by hand; the key is a bare (chat id, message id) pair with no account in it, relying on stop_sticker_playback at an account switch.
effect: No bug found: all three are cleared together today, and the switch calls clear. A new writer missing one collection would replay or rest wrongly.
fix: One HashMap<MessageKey, Play> with Play { generation, state: Played|Replaying }, keyed by ChatMessage inside the per-account OnScreen players.

title: Rich HTML exports live in settings.rich_html_exports with outcome() Option as the stage
trigger: Save a message as HTML, switch account.
effect: The exports Vec is held in session.settings (per account, good) and the stage is outcome().is_none(); finished ones are reaped only when take_finished_rich_html_exports is called, so an export that finishes while the lock screen is shown or the driver is not polled keeps its worker handle.
fix: A RichHtmlExport stage enum (Running, Done, Failed) reaped in the per-account tick.

title: Birthday suggestion dismissal is an optimistic birthdays_hidden bool reverted by hand
trigger: Dismiss the birthday card: connect/privacy_data.rs:255 sets birthdays_hidden=true after sending; HideContactCloseBirthdays error resets it (session_privacy_data.rs:182); updateContactCloseBirthdays resets it (settings/apply.rs:262).
effect: Works today, but the stage (shown / hiding / hidden) is a bool plus a reset rule in three places, not matched to the dismiss request.
fix: enum BirthdayCard {Shown, Hiding{request}, Hidden} and apply the error only for that request id.

title: DiskState::confirmed takes the 'armed once' bool from the caller
trigger: Disk free space falls below the close floor
effect: DiskState, below_once (DiskUi::confirming), screen_refused, held_for_call and start_refused (ui/disk_state.rs) together describe one disk stage but are separate fields; DiskClients is rebuilt from them each reading
fix: enum DiskStage { Healthy, Low, FullPending, Full { held_for_call }, Refused } owned by DiskUi, with confirmed() a method on it

title: Process-wide CACHE + GENERATION + REFRESHING (+ the UI's WATCHING flag) form a fetch stage kept by hand
trigger: n/a (Settings > System draws state(); a stale answer starts a thread; the UI polls refreshing() every 100 ms)
effect: No bug found: RefreshDone clears REFRESHING on panic and spawn failure. A read that never returns (wedged xdg-mime/registry without the timeout) would leave REFRESHING true forever.
fix: One Fetch<LinkHandlerState> cell with Idle/Loading{gen}/Ready/Stale.

title: Do Not Disturb probe is three process-wide atomics (DND, CHECKED_AT_MS, REFRESHING)
trigger: Any alert decision calls dnd_active(); a stale answer starts a worker.
effect: No bug today: REFRESHING is cleared by a drop guard even on panic. The answer is false until the first refresh lands, so the very first notification after start in Do Not Disturb may still play (warm() mitigates).
fix: One Mutex<enum Dnd { Unknown, Known{on,at}, Refreshing{last} }>.

title: PinReorder stage is dragging Option + dropped Option + slides, and the owner keeps pin_reorder_archived beside it
trigger: Drag a pinned chat, release, drag another before the slide ends
effect: dragging/dropped/slides must agree; ChatListUi::pin_reorder and pin_reorder_archived must be set together (set in pin_drag_move only)
fix: enum Reorder { Dragging{..}, Dropping{..} } and put archived inside PinReorder.

title: PlaybackClock playing state is started_at Option beside base_secs
trigger: Let a track reach its end without the UI calling pause
effect: finished_at() stays true on every call while started_at is Some; the caller must pause to leave the state
fix: enum Clock { Paused{at}, Playing{from,since}, Ended } so the end is a stage with its own exit.

title: PsaAbout load is an enum but waiting: Option<ChatId>, toast: Option and dirty bool must stay in step with it
trigger: Open a chat before the background read of psa_about_seen.json finished
effect: none today; waiting is only meaningful while load != Done, dirty is cleared before the save thread runs so a save with no file path loses the flag
fix: Fold waiting into Load::Reading{slot, waiting} and make toast an enum Hidden/Showing/Waiting.

title: JoinedLines.started bool says whether a first line was pushed, next to text
trigger: join_blocks / quoted
effect: No bug today; started is false only before the first push so it could be derived from a line count
fix: Count lines (Option<usize> of pushed lines) or push into a Vec<String> and join at the end.

title: MarkupBlocks text and chunks, and PreviewBlocks source and shown, are parallel values that must agree index for index and byte for byte
trigger: Every keystroke in the rich editor
effect: No bug today (fuzz tests compare with a fresh parse); a caller that mutates one half or swaps the struct between editors would show stale blocks
fix: Keep the pair in one private struct per editor whose only mutator is parse/update, as now, and never share one instance between composers (owner: ChatUi).

title: Rich HTML export stage is an Option<RichHtmlOutcome> behind Arc<Mutex> that callers poll; running is None
trigger: Save as HTML on a rich message
effect: No bug today: OutcomeSlot::drop guarantees Failed on panic and start_rich_html_export treats None as running
fix: enum ExportStage { Running, Done(RichHtmlOutcome) } held by the export and taken once by the driver.

title: Heartbeat.beats Option<u64> is both the started flag (None before start and after stop) and the beat counter
trigger: Launch a second Quill before the link loop starts or after it stops.
effect: Owner acknowledges at once because mark/beats None means not running; correct today but the stage lives in an Option.
fix: enum Heartbeat { NotRunning, Running{beats:u64} }.

title: LinuxState keeps the background accent read's stage as value + running + failed
trigger: Code reading: linux_cached, ReadDone::drop and the spawn closure each write a subset of the three fields.
effect: Idle / Reading / Read(value) / Failed are spread over Option<u32> and two bools; ReadDone and the closure both write failed, and a successful read leaves the state Idle-with-value, so every later read() (the minute timer, window activation, and the poll's own read() right after the read lands) spawns gdbus+gsettings again; the read started from inside the poll's update is never applied until the next refresh.
fix: enum AccentRead { Idle { last: Option<u32> }, Reading { last: Option<u32> }, Failed }; read() starts a read only from Idle and only when asked to refresh, not on every cached lookup.

title: debug_confirm Option<bool> mirrors an open DebugModeConfirm box
trigger: run_secret_code sets debug_confirm = Some(enabled()) then open_box(DebugModeConfirm); only the box's on_close clears it.
effect: If the box is closed by a path other than its on_close (account switch, close-all), the Some stays until the next code; harmless today because the next open overwrites it.
fix: Carry the 'currently on' snapshot in the dialog kind (DialogKind::DebugModeConfirm{on}) so the box and its payload are one value.

title: slow_mode_tick_chat is an Option used as a 'task started' flag
trigger: Open a slow-mode chat X, open slow-mode chat Y, return to X within one second.
effect: The Option names one chat while the tasks are one per start; X to Y to X starts a second task for X while the first still loops (double notify each second). The flag is only cleared by the task itself.
fix: Keep the tick as a stored Task owned by the composer (dropped on chat change) instead of a name guard.

title: History width is probed/width/layout/pane_width cells set by the paint probe
trigger: Open a chat, resize the window.
effect: width_probed is a started flag deciding whether seed_history_width or the paint probe owns width; the cells are kept in step by canvas paint callbacks.
fix: One enum HistoryWidthSource { Seeded(w), Measured(w) } with the layout derived from it.

title: Clear-calls box is two fields: clear_calls_open and clear_calls_revoke, reset by hand
trigger: open_clear_calls sets open=true then revoke=false; the three closers (on_close, Cancel, confirm_clear_calls) clear only `open`, leaving revoke set until the next open.
effect: No wrong state today (revoke is reset on open), but the checkbox value of a closed box lives on and the box's mode is two fields.
fix: `clear_calls: Option<ClearCallsBox { revoke: bool }>`, so closing drops the checkbox with the box.

title: Silent send passes its option through a field set before and reset after the call
trigger: Silent send shortcut
effect: send_silent_once is set, submit_from_send_button runs, then it is reset to false instead of restored; correct today only because every waiting send copies SendOnce, any new deferred reader of the field sends loud
fix: Pass SendOnce as an argument of submit_composer instead of a field the caller toggles (with_send_once restores, this site resets).

title: Connection card is two fields written together at five sites: connection.status and auth_demo.demo_state (plus the note)
trigger: Start a connection, hit a blocker (no credentials, close unconfirmed, startup failure), retry
effect: start_connection sets Live+WaitTdlibParameters, open_client sets Blocked+StartupFailed or NeedCredentials+WaitPhoneNumber, the close-unconfirmed branch sets Blocked+StartupFailed; a site that sets one and not the other shows the wrong card; DiskFull and LockedStore leave Live+WaitTdlibParameters and a 'Connecting' note
fix: One enum ConnectStage { Connecting, NeedCredentials, Blocked(StartupFailure), Live } with the card and note derived from it.

title: ConnectionUi note, toasts and toast_wake are three fields changed together by clear_note/drop_toasts/advance_toasts
trigger: Show an error note, let its toast end, clear the note, switch windows
effect: clear_note resets note and toasts but not toast_wake; drop_toasts resets toasts and toast_wake but not note; advance_toasts drops note when the queue no longer holds it; each caller picks the variant that fits, so the pairs can disagree (a note with no toast, a pending wake with no toast)
fix: Make the toast queue own the current note and its wake deadline as one value.

title: DiskUi holds the disk stage as DiskState plus five bools
trigger: Disk falls below close with a call running, then the call ends; or the open client is refused below the open floor.
effect: confirming, screen_refused, held_for_call, start_refused and unwritable are modes of DiskState kept in step by apply_disk_reading/enter_disk_state/reconnect_after_disk; held_for_call is cleared only when the state leaves Full.
fix: A DiskStage enum (Healthy, Low, Confirming, Full { held_for_call }, Refused { screen | start }) owned by DiskUi.

title: First-run Welcome holds intro, writing and outro as independent fields
trigger: Skip while the clip is being written, then the write finishes
effect: writing stays true forever after a skip (intro_written only matches outro: None) and intro_transport keeps reporting Opening; correctness rests on outro being checked first everywhere
fix: enum Welcome { Writing, Playing(VideoPlayer), NoClip } plus an Option<Outro>, so a finished write cannot leave 'writing'.

title: Per-window glyph sweep is pending: Option, sweep_when_idle: bool, kept/seen counters in step
trigger: Idle trim begins a sweep (begin), the next render finishes it (start_frame), a window goes to the background (window_activation).
effect: No user-visible bug found. A pending sweep waits for a render of that window; a window that is hidden and never renders keeps pending (no new sweep for it) until it closes (forget_closed_windows) or draws.
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Marked(PendingSweep) } plus an idle-trigger enum; or clear Marked when the window reports it is hidden.

title: HistoryCalendar has loading bool with exhausted bool and generation
trigger: Open Jump to date, change month
effect: loading/exhausted/oldest_loaded are kept in step by hand (state/history_calendar.rs:54)
fix: enum Pages { Loading{gen}, More, Exhausted }

title: Shortcut capture is capture Option + error Option + applied bool reset by two free functions
trigger: Rebind a shortcut then leave the page or switch account
effect: capture/error/applied must be cleared in step (capture_active, invalidate_account_keybindings)
fix: enum Capture { Idle, Armed{id}, Rejected{id,msg} } plus keymap generation

title: LayerDraw ticked bool and redrawn Option<Instant> describe one of three stages
trigger: The frame clock ticks a layer, then it draws once for the tick, then redraws on a vsync.
effect: ticked and redrawn are kept in step by ticked()/drawn(); no bug found today.
fix: enum LayerStage { Idle, Ticked, Redrawn(Instant) }.

title: Gift code lookup is loading/applying/applied/error/info kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a giftcode link, press Use Link; GiftCodeLookup carries loading, applying, applied, error and info together; gift_code_body draws 'applied' and an error together and can_apply recomputes the stage from three of them.
effect: Applied and error can both be set so the box shows 'Premium is now active' and a red error together; the stage is re-derived in the view.
fix: enum GiftCodeStage { Checking, Known(info), Applying(info), Applied(info), Failed(err) }.

title: Language link lookup is loading plus info plus error
trigger: Open a setlanguage link; LanguageLinkLookup has loading, info and error read separately by language_body.
effect: Loading and error can be set together; no bug found today.
fix: Use Fetch<LanguagePackInfo>.

title: Deep link flow origin is spread over flow_window, pending_flow_window, pending_deep_link_ui, pending_deep_link_open and deep_link_invite
trigger: Click a t.me link in a chat window; the window travels in flow_window while the flow runs, then moves to pending_flow_window when the resolved link waits for render; each is taken by hand at each step.
effect: Origin fields must be moved/cleared in step with the payload; a missed take leaks the window to the next link.
fix: enum LinkFlow { Idle, Resolving{from}, Waiting{from, ui|open}, Asking{from, invite} } so the window cannot outlive its stage.

title: window_state_save_pending is a hand-kept in-flight flag
trigger: Move or resize the main window, toggle the sidebar.
effect: The flag is set before the 600 ms task and cleared only inside it; if update_in fails (window gone) it stays true and no later move schedules a save (the quit flush still writes the staged state). Already in the implicit-state baseline.
fix: enum WindowStateSave { Idle, Scheduled(Task<()>) } owned by FrameUi; dropping the task clears it.

title: AddContactDialog sent_name + sent_request + not_joined are one New Contact stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Window > Add Contact: Create, wait, Try someone else.
effect: Stages Form / Sending(request) / NotJoined are spread over three fields set in submit_new_contact (sent_name, sent_request, not_joined together, with a demo branch that sets not_joined and no request), take_new_contact_outcome and the retry button; the retry button must reset all three.
fix: enum NewContactStage { Form, Sending { request, name }, NotJoined { name } } on the dialog.

title: Mute box is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Open/close the per-chat Notifications box from header, row menu, or presets.
effect: mute_menu_open + mute_chat + mute_custom_open + notif_sound_picker_open + mute_time are one box's stage; mute_chat may be None while open (box for no chat), mute_time outlives close_mute_menu.
fix: Replace with Option<MuteBox> carrying the chat and sub-view as an enum.

title: Screen lifecycle is epoch + client_filled + goodbyes_due
trigger: Switch account, log out, full disk, restart.
effect: Empty / ClientOnScreen / GoodbyesDue are two bools beside the epoch, guarded only by debug_assert!, so a client put on screen in release builds before the deferred goodbyes ran is not refused.
fix: enum ScreenPhase { Empty, Filled, GoodbyesDue } with put_on_screen and take_live matching on it.

title: Width keeps paragraph, bytes, drawn and used in step
trigger: Scroll a long history.
effect: paragraph = None must leave bytes stale and only recount fixes the totals; drawn == 0 is the never-drawn stage.
fix: enum WidthState { SizeOnly, LaidOut{paragraph, bytes}, Drawn{..} }.

title: Seek drag held as seek_scrubbing bool plus seek_preview_secs Option plus seek_hover
trigger: Slider Change sets scrubbing=true and preview=Some; Release clears both; stop/start clear both. The tick (finished && !seek_scrubbing) and the bar (preview.is_some()) read different copies of the same stage.
effect: If a Release is ever lost the tick never ends a finished track while the bar still shows a drag.
fix: enum Seek { Idle, Hover(SeekHover), Scrubbing{preview_secs} }.

title: Progress tick task guarded by a bool (tick) next to tick_shown
trigger: spawn_playback_tick sets tick=true and the task clears it when it ends; a new track on a paused tick pokes CHROME instead.
effect: Works today because OnScreen is replaced whole and the old task ends on Gone, but the 'task running' stage is a hand-kept bool.
fix: enum Tick { Stopped, Running(Task) } owning the task so dropping the value ends it.

title: RequestShare stage is confirm bool + selected + locate Option + a separate request_locate task
trigger: Press a bot Location or Users request button, pick, go to confirmation, close the box while the lookup runs.
effect: No bug today: the closed box leaves MessageUi::request_locate running (its answer is dropped when request_share is None) and a retry replaces the task by hand.
fix: enum RequestStage { Picking{selected}, Confirm{selected}, Locating(Task), Located(GeoOutcome) } held inside RequestShare so the task is dropped with the box.

title: RequestShare::locate: None means searching, Some is the outcome
trigger: Open a Location request: locate=None is the in-flight stage, restart sets it back to None.
effect: A fetch stage encoded as Option<GeoOutcome> with the Task held elsewhere (MessageUi::request_locate); nothing ties answer to the share that asked, any later share receives it.
fix: Fetch<GeoOutcome> inside RequestShare that owns the Task (see previous entry).

title: Schedule picker is schedule_picker Option plus schedule_popup_open bool kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the schedule chip, click the chip again (popup_open=false), send, or open the scheduled list.
effect: schedule_popup_open is cleared in 5 places (chip toggle, send paths, open_scheduled_dialog) without clearing schedule_picker, so a picker with its target, slot, repeat and error stays live while hidden; no visible bug found because every opener replaces it.
fix: Drop schedule_popup_open: the popup is shown exactly when schedule_picker is Some; hiding means setting it to None.

title: Screen chooser stage is window + opening epoch + for_call + sources + selected + generation kept in step by hand
trigger: Press share screen in a call: listing, window open, closed, error, empty list, account switch.
effect: No bug confirmed: screen_chooser_closed resets all of it, but each branch of screen_chooser_listed clears a different subset (see the Err arm).
fix: enum Chooser { Closed, Listing{epoch, generation, for_call}, Open{window, for_call, sources, selected, audio} }.

title: ScreenShareUi is a hand-synced chooser state machine
trigger: Open the share chooser, cancel, switch call or account.
effect: window, opening, for_call, sources, selected, with_audio, generation, privacy_for, group_call must change together (closed by close_screen_chooser / goodbye by hand); stages (Closed/Listing/Open/PrivacyBox) are implied.
fix: enum ScreenChooser { Closed, Listing{epoch,gen,for_call}, Open{window,for_call,sources,selected,audio}, PrivacyBox{for_call} }.

title: Rename-device mode is a bool plus an input entity cleared at about ten sites
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Active sessions > this device > Rename.
effect: privacy.extra.renaming_device is set here and cleared by hand in security/mod.rs (3 sites), session_list.rs (4 sites) and save_device_name; the typed text lives in rename_input and is re-seeded on each begin.
fix: Session detail view as enum { Details, Renaming(Entity<InputState>) } owned by the session box.

title: ShareUi stages as flags and Options: focus_search, link_text, forward_result, content_dialog.focus_on_mount
trigger: Forward box opens (focus_search set, taken by whichever box mounts first), share-link chooser, forward result bar, contact chooser.
effect: focus_search is a one-shot 'just opened' flag consumed by two different boxes (forward_box, reply_elsewhere_box) and left set if the box never mounts (locked, hidden), so a later box takes focus unasked; focus_on_mount is the same shape.
fix: Put the 'focus on mount' stage inside the box's own enum (Mounting -> Shown) so the box that owns it consumes it, and give link_text and forward_result an owner enum with a way out on lock and chat change.

title: Which kit dialog a window shows is mirrored in QuillShell::open_dialog, the ChatWindows dialog map and the kit layer
trigger: sync_host_dialogs keeps open_dialog, windows.dialog_opened_in/closed_in and the kit dialog layer in step; main_window.dialogs_closed is a bool taken once to reset open_dialog after a switch.
effect: No bug today; any path that closes the kit dialog without on_close_kind or the sync leaves open_dialog naming a dialog that is gone.
fix: A single per-window DialogHost enum (None, Shown(kind)) owned by the window slot, with the kit layer driven only from it.

title: Calls and Contacts tabs are two bools set against each other
trigger: demo_showcase_calls and demo_showcase_contacts set calls_tab_open and contacts_tab_open and clear the other by hand (same pair as the chat list's real tab handlers).
effect: No bug in the demo; both true would draw two tabs.
fix: A ChatListTab enum (Chats, Calls, Contacts).

title: Sponsored report is sponsored_report: Option + last_sponsored_report: Option, each drawn when chat id matches
trigger: Report an ad: flight, then outcome.
effect: Flight and outcome can both exist (picker and outcome banner drawn together) after a second report.
fix: One enum SponsoredReport { None, Picking, Sending, Outcome }.

title: SyntheticKind::Image carries a loaded bool stage
trigger: Pre-login synthetic chat: photo row placeholder loads after a 900 ms timer.
effect: Image{loaded:bool} is a loading/loaded stage matched in three places (finish_image, message_bubble_with_quote height and label); demo only.
fix: SyntheticKind::{ImageLoading, ImageLoaded}.

title: What's New window held as window Option plus opening bool
trigger: Click What's New twice quickly.
effect: Closed/Opening/Open is two fields; no bug found.
fix: enum WhatsNewWindow { Closed, Opening, Open(AnyWindowHandle) }.

title: BoostBoxState keeps phase, note and reassigning in step by hand
trigger: Click Reassign: boost_flow sets phase=Working, note=None and reassigning=Some together; apply.rs, error.rs and the send-failure arm each reset phase and reassigning separately.
effect: No bug today, but reassigning is only valid while phase is Working and a missed reset leaves a stale summary that turns the next boost's note into a wrong 'N boosts are reassigned' line.
fix: Make the Working variant carry the optional ReassignSummary (Working{reassign: Option<ReassignSummary>}) so leaving Working drops it.

title: RtmpStart: info Option, failed bool and a request list encode the Stream-with stages
trigger: Open 'Stream with...', fail or revoke the key.
effect: Stages WaitingFirstAnswer, BoxOpen, Revoking and a transient error are derived from info.is_some(), failed and requests; failed is a one-shot flag cleared per frame by the UI.
fix: enum RtmpStage { Fetching{req}, Ready{info, revoke: Option<req>}, } with the error returned as an event, not a flag.

title: CollectibleLookup stage is loading: bool + info: Option + failed: Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a collectible box; the answer sets loading=false and info, an error sets loading=false and failed.
effect: Today all three can be set together or none (request lost leaves loading=true so a repeat tap on the same entity returns Ok(None) and never re-sends; request_collectible_info in connect/payments.rs:293 checks open.loading).
fix: Fetch<CollectibleInfo> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the request id in the loading variant.

title: Earn withdrawal / setup / join / revoke each hold stage flags beside Options
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, save program, join program, revoke link.
effect: Withdraw is matched by request id (waits_for) so no bug found; Password{sending:bool}, SetupPage.saving/confirm, EarnState.setup_closed, JoinBox.joining, Revoke.sending are stage bools.
fix: Make joining/sending part of the step enum (Idle/Sending{request}).

title: Recipients load is recipients Option + recipients_loading counter + pending_join + join_box
trigger: open_bot_affiliate_join / open_affiliate_program ask two requests and park the join box until both answered.
effect: If the second send fails after the first went out, recipients_loading is reset to 0 while the first answer later fills recipients with a partial list (user + channels, no bots) that is then cached for the session (S4).
fix: enum Recipients{Idle, Loading{chats,bots}, Ready(Vec)} and a join box that carries its own wait.

title: Gift management is gift_mutating + gifts_error + note, collections_loading/stale, export_unlocked and TransferStage::Password{sending}
trigger: Pin, upgrade, transfer, delete, export-to-Fragment.
effect: No bug found beyond the entry above; the reducer unlocks on the answer and settle_lost_request clears it.
fix: enum GiftMutation{Idle, InFlight{request, purpose}, Failed} and put export_unlocked into the transfer stage.

title: Gift market uses ResaleSearch loading/loaded/error, candidates_loading, auction_loading/ready/request, bidding, buy.sending, craft.crafting
trigger: Resale browsing, auctions, bidding, crafting.
effect: Answers are matched by stored request ids; no bug found beyond the replace case above.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list and a Purchase enum.

title: GiftValueLookup is request + loading + info + error + open
trigger: Tap the Value row's learn more.
effect: No bug found; answers match lookup.request and another gift replaces the lookup.
fix: enum GiftValue{Loading{request}, Ready{info, open}, Failed}.

title: AwardMembers has loading bool beside generation, offset and query
trigger: Search or scroll the 'Choose members' list.
effect: No bug found; answers are generation-matched.
fix: Fetch<Page> with generation inside.

title: Giveaway options keep premium_loading/stars_loading with premium_error/stars_error pairs
trigger: Open the giveaway form for a channel.
effect: Both loading+error pairs can be set; an answer for an earlier boosted chat is not keyed (S3 plausible if the form is reopened for another channel).
fix: Fetch<Options> keyed by boosted chat.

title: The boost box stage is BoostPhase plus reassigning, note and the session's boost_intent kept in step by hand
trigger: reassign_boosts, send_boost_chat failure, request_chat_boost, and error.rs:529-545 each set a different subset
effect: No bug proven; reassigning must be cleared together with phase at each exit
fix: Fold reassigning into BoostPhase::Working{reassign: Option<ReassignSummary>}; make the intent part of that variant.

title: BoostsListState is loading:bool + error + request:Option kept in step by hand
trigger: open_chat_boosts / load_more_chat_boosts / answer / error arms
effect: append path forgets loading (see 02-P6-001)
fix: enum BoostsPage { Loading{request,append}, Ready, Failed } with the loaded rows kept beside it

title: Paid trust file state is trust_loaded + trust_dirty bools; save errors are ignored
trigger: Press Do not ask again; the write fails (disk full, read-only).
effect: save_paid_trust drops the io error; the trust is kept in memory for the session only, silently lost on restart (user is asked again, no money risk). trust_loaded is a once flag, trust_dirty a pending flag.
fix: A TrustFile stage enum (NotLoaded, Clean, Dirty, SaveFailed) with an error shown on failure.

title: StarPacksState is open + loading + loaded + error
trigger: Open Buy more Stars.
effect: Four fields move together; the answer is not keyed, the error arm (error.rs:94) clears loading but leaves loaded false so each toggle retries (fine today).
fix: Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> plus open flag.

title: BankCardLookup is loading bool + info Option for one lookup
trigger: Tap a bank card number in a message.
effect: loading and info are changed together by hand; a second tap replaces the lookup while the first answer is in flight and the purpose carries no number to match.
fix: Fetch<BankCardInfo> inside the lookup, with the answer keyed by the number or RequestId.
