title: Star subscriptions list is loading + stale + mutating + error + offset bools next to an Option list
trigger: Open the subscriptions page, cancel one, refetch.
effect: Stages are kept in step by hand across star_subscriptions, _loading, _stale, _mutating, _error, _offset.
fix: Fetch<StarSubscriptions> plus a Mutation enum (Idle, Editing(RequestId)).

title: Premium hub stages are many bool pairs: tx_loading/tx_loaded/tx_error/tx_request, gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/gifts_stale/gifts_error, premium_loading/premium, business_features_loading, premium_stickers_asked/loading
trigger: Open Stars history, gifts, Premium explainer.
effect: Each resource keeps loading, loaded, error and request id as separate fields reset by hand (set_star_transactions_filter resets four fields; open_received_gifts resets nine).
fix: Fetch<T> per resource plus a Paged<T> for the two lists.

title: Gift Stars dialog stage is open + target Option + options Vec + loading bool + error Option
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick a contact, go back, pick another.
effect: Stage is inferred from field combinations kept in step by hand (clear_target resets four fields).
fix: enum StarsGiftStage { Closed, PickContact, LoadingPacks{target, request}, Packs{target, options}, Failed{target, error} }.

title: Paged<T> and MoneyPage keep loading/loaded/error as separate fields
trigger: n/a
effect: History and NFT lists carry loading, loaded and error that apply()/fail() keep in step; MoneyPage::close/open resets the whole page while an earlier page request is still in flight, so its late answer lands in the new page (append onto an empty list).
fix: Paged<T> holds a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{append}/Ready/Failed) and a page token compared with the answer.

title: EarnLimits.app_config_loaded is a 'asked once' flag with two writers
trigger: Open any profile or earn page
effect: The flag is set by the groups reducer on success and by the earn error arm, and ensure_earn_app_config also checks an in-flight GetBoostsPerGift; a failed send is never recorded so it is retried on every call
fix: Fetch<AppConfig> from src/state/fetch.rs

title: EarnPage.ton_unavailable bool beside ton: Load
trigger: BROADCAST_REQUIRED for a megagroup
effect: The reducer sets ton_unavailable=true and resets ton to Idle; Load has no 'not applicable' stage so the page needs the extra bool
fix: Add a Load::Unavailable stage (or Option<Load>)

title: WithdrawStep::Password carries sending: bool and error: Option<String> that can both be set
trigger: Submit the 2FA password of a Stars or TON withdrawal
effect: sending and error are kept in step by hand in connect/earn.rs and apply_withdrawal_error
fix: Split into Password { error: Option<String> } and PasswordSending; the sending stage carries the request id

title: JoinBox.joining and RevokeBox.sending are stage bools next to the box Option
trigger: Join Program or Revoke Link clicked, then the answer or error arrives
effect: Box stage is held as a bool beside the Option, reset by hand in connect/earn.rs and the error arm of state/domains/payments/earn.rs
fix: enum JoinStage { Choosing, Joining(RequestId) } and RevokeStage { Asking, Sending(RequestId) }, so an answer is matched to its request id and cannot clear a newer box

title: Recipients load is a u8 counter plus Option list plus parked join box
trigger: Open a program with choose_recipient, or the bot profile Affiliate Program row
effect: recipients_loading (counts two requests down), recipients (None or Some) and pending_join must change together across connect/earn.rs and the payments reducer
fix: enum Recipients { Idle, Loading { chats: Pending, bots: Pending, join: Option<JoinBox> }, Ready(Vec<EarnPeer>), Failed }

title: setup_closed is a one-shot bool next to setup: Option
trigger: Save or End the affiliate program
effect: The reducer sets setup=None and setup_closed=true; the UI consumes the bool in drain_earn and open_starref_setup resets it by hand
fix: Return the 'go back' effect from the reducer as an event (EarnEffect::SetupDone) instead of a latched bool

title: SendGiftState keeps the gift list and the send as bools and Options in step by hand
trigger: Open Send a Gift, pick a gift, press Send, close and reopen.
effect: gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/error, premium_loaded (written, never read), sending + request + done + open are separate fields; both loaded/loading and error can be set.
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableGift>> for the list, Fetch for premium options, and enum SendStage { Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent(String), Failed(String) }.

title: GiftManageState holds one-shot results and ask-once flags as bools and Options

trigger: An id moves visible -> viewing -> viewed by hand in begin_viewing/mark_viewed/commit_viewed/abort_viewing/reaction_unread; visible_reported switches which rule picks ids.
effect: See the viewing bug (same file, line 544); the stages of one id are not a value.
fix: `BTreeMap<i64, ViewStage>` with `ViewStage::{Due, InFlight(RequestId), Done}` and an enum for Unreported/Reported.

title: unread_anchor and opened_with_unread are two fields of one 'opened at unread' mode
trigger: Open a chat with unread messages; deleting the bar message clears unread_anchor but not opened_with_unread; jumping to latest clears both via end_unread_open; reset_window clears neither.
effect: No bug found; reset_window leaves a stale anchor by design.
fix: `enum OpenAt { Tail, Unread { anchor: MessageId, bar: Option<MessageId> } }`.

title: Main history window stage is load_failed, newer_failed, loaded_complete, newer_exhausted plus the in-flight requests and stale_history_requests
trigger: Open a chat, scroll, lose the network, jump around.
effect: history_loading(), history_load_failed() and history_has_newer() are derived from four bools/options on HistoryState and from the request registry; reset_window and trim clear them field by field, and a stale mark in stale_history_requests lives apart from the window it belongs to.
fix: A WindowEdge stage enum per edge (Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed, Complete) held by the window, so replacing the window drops its in-flight ids and stale marks with it.

title: Story card state is derived from three sets (stories, missing, reply_attempted) plus story_retry
trigger: story_card_state returns Loading when the story is in neither stories nor missing; candidates are filtered by reply_attempted; failures edit story_retry and reply_attempted by hand (story_fetch_failed).
effect: Loading is 'absence', so a story whose fetch was never started and one whose fetch failed look the same.
fix: HashMap<(i64,i32), StoryFetch{Loading(request), Ready, Gone, Retry{at}}>.

title: StoryPageOp is one value with state enum, but label and request Option are kept with it by hand
trigger: begin_story_page_op / begin_story_page_check
effect: request is Option though both constructors always set Some; Succeeded/Failed keep the request field alive
fix: Put the RequestId inside the Sending/Checking variants only.

title: Story insights forwards and the public story search hold loading bools beside error Options
trigger: Story statistics forwards; public story search paging.
effect: StoryInsightsState::forwards_loading/forwards_error and StorySearchState::loading/error/request are three fields of one stage kept in step by hand.
fix: One page enum per list: Idle | Loading{request} | Failed(String).

title: StoryViewersState keeps loading: bool beside error: Option<String> and rows/next_offset
trigger: Open the story viewers panel, let a page fail, press retry: get_story_interactions sets loading=true but never clears error
effect: loading and error can both be set; panel stage is derived from two fields kept in step by hand across posting.rs and session_stories.rs
fix: Replace loading/error with a Fetch-like enum (Idle, Loading{offset}, Ready, Failed(msg)) carrying the request id that asked.

title: StoryManageState: pending bool duplicates request Option
trigger: editStory / editStoryCover / setStoryPrivacySettings.
effect: pending is true exactly when request is Some; start, settle and fail_locally keep both in step. The slot is shared by the composer, the viewer's editors and albums, which read pending without a request.
fix: enum ManageCall { Idle, Pending{request, story}, Failed{story, error} }, and callers keep their own request id.

title: StripPull expanded bool beside reveal Option
trigger: Stories strip pull-down.
effect: reveal Some implies expanded; the methods keep the pair in step.
fix: enum StripPull { Collapsed, Revealing(Reveal), Expanded }.

title: StoryComposer stages are check_sent, post_sent, save_sent bools plus local_error
trigger: Story composer post or edit.
effect: Three in-flight bools and an error are cleared by frame upkeep reading session slots; nothing prevents two set at once, and edit_target/repost_source/as_chat_id form a second implicit mode.
fix: enum ComposerStage { Editing, Checking{request}, Posting{request}, Saving{request}, Failed(String) } and enum ComposerMode { New, Edit(story), Repost(story) }.

title: StoryPageOp: one session-wide slot for every chat's page loads and mutations, with request: Option beside the state
trigger: Code reading: Session::stories.page_op is overwritten by begin_story_page_op / begin_story_page_check for any chat; send_story_page sets Failed with request Some(extra) after taking the request back.
effect: A mutation replaces an in-flight page load's Checking op (the load is then no longer seen as loading), a load for chat B replaces chat A's; request is Option although Checking/Sending always need it.
fix: enum StoryPageOpState { Checking { request, chat, purpose }, Sending { request, chat, purpose }, Succeeded, Failed(String) }, with loads tracked per (chat, purpose) apart from the single mutation status.

title: StoryPlayback keeps Stopped/Running/Paused as two Options (started, paused_since)
trigger: Code reading: set_paused only sets paused_since when started is Some; stop clears both by hand.
effect: paused_since is meaningful only while started is Some; the invariant is kept by hand in start/stop/set_paused.
fix: enum StoryPlayback { Stopped, Running { started: Instant }, Paused { started: Instant, since: Instant } }.

title: StoryViewerItem says 'live' three times: kind == Live, is_live and live_call
trigger: Code reading: story_viewer_item sets kind, is_live and live_call together for each content arm.
effect: Three fields must agree (kind Live <=> is_live <=> live_call Some); duration_secs/video_file_id are likewise only meaningful for Video.
fix: Make StoryViewerKind carry its data: Photo, Video { duration_secs, clip }, Live(LiveStoryCall), Unsupported; derive is_live from it.

title: Story's chosen reaction split into two Options that must never both be Some
trigger: n/a
effect: No bug today (only the parser writes them, and it sets at most one), but the type allows an emoji and a custom/paid reaction at once and readers check them separately.
fix: chosen_reaction: Option<ReactionType> (the type message reactions already use).

title: History window anchoring is key + window_epoch + anchor_pending: bool + last_highlight, kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: anchor_pending (baseline debt) is set on a new window and cleared in rows_replaced, and is read by reselect_open_chat and remember_scroll.
fix: enum WindowAnchor { Anchoring { key, epoch }, Anchored { key, epoch } }.

title: Opened-history position is a set of loose fields: anchor_pending, landing, scroll_goal, last_highlight, window_epoch
trigger: Open a chat, replace a window (jump to latest, date jump), jump to a search hit, open a thread
effect: anchor_pending is a bool set in the Build branch and cleared in rows_replaced only when rows are non-empty (reselect_open_chat and remember_scroll silently return while it is set); landing, scroll_goal and last_highlight are cleared at different call sites (anchor_opened_history, reach_scroll_goal, advance_landing, mouse/scroll watchers)
fix: enum HistoryPosition { Settled, Anchoring, Landing(Landing), Goal(ScrollGoal) } replaced whole on a key change.

title: StorageScroll stage kept in pending + until_settled + placed
trigger: n/a: a scroll request, a repeat-once-settled request and the offset last placed are three fields kept in step in ensure_storage_scroll.
effect: n/a
fix: enum StorageScrollStage { Idle, Requested, WaitingSettled{placed}, Placed{offset} }.

title: Storage stats and auto-download presets are Option/seeded data beside loading bools
trigger: n/a
effect: storage_stats + storage_stats_loading, and data_storage.seeded + auto_download_presets_loading, are each kept in step by hand (error arms do clear them).
fix: `storage_stats: Fetch<StorageStats>` and `presets: Fetch<Presets>`.

title: Storage clear is a bool plus Option result plus error field
trigger: Settings > Data and Storage > Manage local storage > Clear.
effect: session.settings.storage_clearing, storage_freed and data_storage_error are kept in step by hand in connect/settings/storage.rs, settings/apply.rs and settings/error.rs; all three paths reset the flag today.
fix: `storage_clear: Fetch<i64>` (idle, clearing, freed, failed).

title: HistoryA11y holds focus stage as bar_focused bool + focused bool + announce_first Option beside ChatUi::selection_focus
trigger: Screen-reader focus moves between the bar and rows, the history gains/loses keyboard focus, an empty chat receives its first messages.
effect: Three fields and a second owner (selection_focus) must change together; bar_focused true makes selection_focus meaningless, announce_first must be cleared in four places by hand (set_history_a11y_focus, focus_in, rows_changed, chat change).
fix: enum HistoryFocus { Away, Idle, ArmedForFirst(ChatId), Bar, Row(MessageId) } owned by the chat's ChatUi / the window's slot.

title: ScrollDate keeps its stage in shown_at + last_scroll + hide_after + wake Option, with covered_row/top_label derived from probes
trigger: Scroll the history, stop, scroll again within the fade, switch chat.
effect: The stage (Hidden / Fading / Still) is recomputed from three timestamps by motion(), and wake: Option<Task> is a 'timer armed' flag that must be cleared by the task itself; covered_row is reset only when the pill is drawn.
fix: enum PillStage { Hidden, Showing{since,last_scroll,hold}, Armed{wake:Task} } replaced whole with HistoryUi on a chat change.

title: Scroller anchoring is spread over key, ends, window_epoch, anchor_pending, landing, last_highlight, highlight_fade, scroll_goal
trigger: Opening a chat, a jump, or a window replace.
effect: Each field is reset by hand in history_message_list.rs (key change resets last_highlight and scroll_date but not highlight_fade, landing, hit_rows, reported_visible).
fix: One enum Anchor { Idle, Pending{key,epoch}, Landing{..} } replaced whole on key change.

title: Row chrome refresh is a bool/Cell flag plus due list plus epoch stamps
trigger: Session change while rows are drawn.
effect: chrome_notify_pending (Cell<bool>) says a deferred notify is on its way; if the deferred task is dropped (window closed, screen replaced) the flag stays set and no further notify is queued.
fix: Replace the Cell<bool> with ChromeRefresh { Clean, Due(Vec<usize>), Notifying } owned by HistoryUi and cleared in the deferred task's drop path.

title: Tick tasks are tracked by Option<ChatId> 'Some exactly while the task runs'
trigger: Chat with self-destruct timers or a live location opens.
effect: self_destruct_tick_chat and live_location_tick_chat are cleared only from inside the task's own update closure; if the task's update fails (scope gone) the Some stays and the tick is never restarted for that chat in this HistoryUi.
fix: Hold the Task handle itself (Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)>) so dropping the owner stops the tick and the stage cannot outlive it.

title: width_probed/forum_column_shown/window_active are stage bools kept in step with paint
trigger: Resize, forum open, window focus.
effect: width_probed (Rc<Cell<bool>>) says whether the history measured itself; it is never reset when the pane changes, so seed_history_width only runs on first paint.
fix: enum HistoryWidthSource { Seeded(Pixels), Measured(Pixels) }.

title: Strip pull state is spread over strip.pull (expanded/revealing), strip.context Option as 'settled' token and the shared bounce Cell
trigger: pull the chat list down, change folder, open a chat while expanded
effect: expanded/collapsed/revealing decided in render by comparing a stored PullContext and mutating the list's scroll offset in step
fix: enum StripState { Collapsed, Revealing{since}, Expanded } with the context part of the Expanded variant

title: Viewer panels are eight independent bools/Options that must be mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: open stats, share, privacy editor, cover picker, viewers, report, close friends in the story viewer
effect: reaction_picker_open, reply_open, reply_panel, viewers_open, stats_open, report_open, share_open, menu_open, privacy_edit, cover, close_friends_edit are each cleared by some togglers and missed by others
fix: enum ViewerPanel { None, ReactionPicker, Reply{panel}, Viewers, Stats, Report, Share, CloseFriends(edit), Privacy(edit), Cover(picker) } plus menu_open as part of it

title: Close-friends editor: close_friends_edit Option + close_friends_saving bool + page_op Option<RequestId> change together
trigger: open Edit close friends from the menu or privacy editor and Save
effect: leave_item copies all three by hand to survive a story change; the saving flag and page_op can disagree
fix: CloseFriendsStage { Loading, Editing, Saving(RequestId) } (same enum as the bug entry)

title: tick_active bool guards the viewer tick task; stealth_box + stealth_tick + stealth_toast are three Options for one box stage
trigger: open the viewer; open Stealth Mode
effect: a started-flag next to the task it guards, and a box whose open Option, ticker Option and toast Option are set/cleared together by hand (close_stealth_box clears two, the toast is never cleared)
fix: enum StoryTick { Off, Running(Task) } and a StealthBox variant that owns its tick Task; toast owned by the viewer UI value

title: CoverPicker stage is duration_ms Option + unreadable bool + preview_job Option + dragging bool, plus cover_sent bool in StoryViewerUi
trigger: open the cover picker on a video story
effect: Loading/ready/unreadable and the save stage are separate fields kept in step by hand
fix: enum CoverStage { Probing, Ready{duration_ms}, Unreadable } and enum CoverSave { Idle, Sent(RequestId) } owned by the picker

title: Privacy editor stage is privacy_edit Option + privacy_sent bool matched against the global manage slot
trigger: edit a story's privacy and Save
effect: privacy_sent is cleared by frame_upkeep when manage.pending is false, not by the answer to this call
fix: PrivacyStage { Editing, Saving(RequestId) }

title: StoryComposer stage is open bool + check_sent + post_sent + save_sent + local_error + edit_target/repost_source modes
trigger: post, repost or edit a story
effect: checking, posting and saving are three bools plus an error string reconciled by story_frame_upkeep against session.stories.post and manage.pending
fix: enum ComposerStage { Editing{error}, Checking(RequestId), Posting(RequestId), Saving(RequestId), Posted } and enum ComposerMode { New, Repost(src), Edit(target) }

title: Statistics panel paging uses InsightsState.forwards_loading bool beside forwards_error, and Asked counters in the UI
trigger: scroll the public shares list
effect: loading and error are two fields; the 'asked at length' memo is a third
fix: Fetch<Page> for the shares list

title: StoryPage view is open_album Option + picker Option + delete_confirm Option kept in step by hand
trigger: use the chat story page
effect: album list, opened album, picker and the armed delete are separate fields; the picker can be Some with open_album None or Some
fix: enum StoryPageView { Albums, Album{id, delete_armed}, Picker{target} }

title: Viewers list paging reads StoryViewersState.loading bool beside next_offset
trigger: n/a
effect: story_viewers_scrolled loads the next page only if !loading and next_offset non-empty; loading is set on the driver's Ok send and must be cleared by the answer path by hand.
fix: A paged Fetch (Idle/Loading{offset}/Ready{next}/Failed) keyed by (chat, story, offset).

title: Live story state carries extras_requested bool (set by hand in the demo seed)
trigger: n/a
effect: A request-sent flag on the session's live story state that the demo sets directly; a real failed request cannot clear it.
fix: Fetch<T> for donors/levels extras instead of a requested bool.

title: Stars box flow is stars_box Option + then_send bool + stars_before_top_up Option + chosen_stars, reset together in reset()
trigger: n/a
effect: Several fields that must change together across box, top-up and send; see 13-TMP-004.
fix: One enum StarsFlow for the box and the top-up round trip; chosen_stars stays the composer's value.

title: Live join stage is `watching: Option` + `seen_call: bool` (+ the session's story_stream and pending join) kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: seen_call gives 'call was tracked' meaning to a missing story_stream; retry_live_story resets it by hand; join failure is not representable (see 13-TMP-001).
fix: enum LiveWatch { None, Joining(story), Joined(story), Failed(story) }.

title: Viewer panels are separate bools (reaction_picker_open, reply_open, share_open, report_open, viewers_open, stats_open, menu_open) plus Options and *_sent marks
trigger: n/a
effect: story_playback_paused ORs eleven fields. Opening is mutually excluded only by hand: toggle_story_viewers clears report_open but not stats_open/share_open/reaction_picker_open/reply_open, toggle_story_report clears viewers_open only, so two panels can show at once (S4).
fix: enum ViewerPanel { None, Reaction, Reply{panel}, Viewers, Report, Stats, Share, Cover, Privacy, CloseFriends } with `paused()` derived from it; *_sent become the editors' own stage enums.

title: StoryUi::tick_active bool guards the 100 ms tick task (Option<Task> in step by hand)
trigger: n/a
effect: Cleared only inside the task when the viewer is not open; a task that stops any other way (screen dropped, update Err) leaves it true. spawn_screen is replaced with OnScreen so today it is safe.
fix: Hold the tick as Option<Task> owned by StoryUi so dropping it stops it and the flag disappears.

title: Reply row is reply_open + reply_panel bools beside the shared media panel and the recorder purpose
trigger: n/a
effect: toggle_live_emoji sets reply_open=true, opens the panel, then resets reply_open by hand if the panel is not active; end_story_reply clears both bools separately; story_reply_panel_active needs reply_open && reply_panel && media_panel.is_open() agreeing. reply_panel stays true after the panel is closed elsewhere.
fix: enum ReplyRow { Closed, Typing, Panel(tab), Recording } on StoryViewerUi; the media panel reads it.

title: StoryPostState one-shot answers (eligibility, check_error, outcome) are unkeyed
trigger: Story composer check and post.
effect: The composer clears eligibility/check_error/outcome before asking and then waits for any of them to fill; nothing ties the answer to the canPostStory/postStory it sent.
fix: Carry the request id in a Checking{request}/Posting{request} stage and settle only from that answer.

title: ClosingSet: close_held_until Option in the driver + restart bool + unconfirmed set; close_all_within/Drop block the calling thread
trigger: Quit or drop a ClosingSet while clients are closing
effect: close sent either at once or after a hold timer that only drain_bridged releases; a client unconfirmed stays blocked for the process; Drop sleeps up to 1.5 s on whichever thread drops the set
fix: enum Closing { Holding{until}, Sent, Closed, Lost } per client; keep the blocking wait to the quit path only.

title: BatchState is open + three dirty bools + a waiting-file set kept in step by hand
trigger: Each envelope in a poll batch sets dirty flags; end_batch takes them and runs the passes.
effect: No bug today; end_batch takes the flag before the pass runs, so a send error in run_shown_media loses that pass until another update dirties it (S4).
fix: One enum Batch{Closed, Open{dirty: PassSet}} and take a pass only after it succeeded.

title: disk_resume_searched bool + disk_search_keys + SearchDiskPausedDownloads request + disk_resume_due form one search stage
trigger: Healthy disk with saved pauses starts the once-per-session search.
effect: No bug today (flag reset on send failure, but an error answer leaves it true by design).
fix: enum DiskSearch{Idle, Asked{keys}, Done}.

title: My Grams page is open + loading + loaded + error + request + probed + peers_dirty
trigger: Open My Grams, switch All/Incoming/Outgoing.
effect: No bug found; restart replaces the request id.
fix: Fetch<TxPage> per filter.

title: GiftCodeLookup carries applying:bool, applied:bool, apply:Option<RequestId>, error and checking request
trigger: request_gift_code_info / apply_gift_code / answers (payments/gift_code.rs)
effect: Answers appear matched by request id (tests in connect/tests/link_info.rs:206), but stage is still bool flags
fix: enum GiftCodeStage { Checking, Ready(info), Applying{req}, Applied, Failed }

title: MasksState keeps open, strip_wanted, failed, installed_loaded, archived_loaded, set_requested as independent flags
trigger: open_mask_sets, load_editor_masks, pump_masks on every ingest
effect: failed is shared by installed and archived lists; set_requested is cleared only on list change
fix: Per-list Fetch<T> for installed/archived plus a per-set Fetch for the strip; open/strip as one 'wanted' enum

title: Wearable gifts and default icon lists are a list + loaded/failed bool pair, with is_empty meaning not loaded
trigger: Open the color dialog, chat appearance, or the photo builder.
effect: background_emoji_icons, profile_photo_emoji_icons (profile_photo_sources.rs:50) and wearable_gifts use empty-list plus a _failed or _loaded bool as stage; an empty answer from TDLib re-asks on every open, and load_wearable_gifts sets wearable_gifts_loaded=false before the request so a refetch hides a loaded list.
fix: Fetch<Vec<..>> per list.

title: Proxy settings stage is loading + fetch_attempted + stale + mutating + error + pings map + proxy_ping_requests + SentStep{settled,refused}
trigger: Open the proxy box, add, edit, ping, use system proxy.
effect: Fetching and mutating are bools cleared in session_proxy.rs (lines 38, 102, 159, 164); pings are PingStatus plus a second map of request ids; system proxy uses SentStep with settled and refused bools.
fix: Fetch<ProxyList> with Stale, a Mutation enum, and a Ping{Checking(RequestId),Done} per slot.

title: Public-forwards stage is inferred from forwards.total>0 || !forwards.is_empty() plus a loading bool
trigger: Open statistics for a post with zero forwards.
effect: message_forwards_loaded is false for an answered empty list, so each fetch_message_statistics call while the statistics are in flight sends getMessagePublicForwards again.
fix: enum ForwardsFetch { Idle, Loading, Loaded{next_offset}, Failed }.

title: parameters_sent bool shadows the auth state it follows
trigger: n/a
effect: ConnectDriver::parameters_sent is set after setTdlibParameters is sent and gates both maybe_send_parameters and network_tick; the real stage is session.auth (WaitTdlibParameters, StartupFailed on error), so two values are kept in step.
fix: Handshake enum {NotSent, Sent(RequestId)} owned with the auth state, or derive from auth and the pending SetParameters request.

title: Draft save is a clock, a token, and an Option that must change together
trigger: n/a
effect: draft_clock, draft_save_token and pending_draft (token, chat, topic, content) are updated by hand in several driver methods; same shape for search_debounce_token with pending_typed_search and chat_search_debounce_token with pending_typed_chat_search.
fix: A Debounce<T> value {Idle|Armed{token,value}} that owns the token.

title: Coalesce is a dirty + running pair of atomics that must change together
trigger: Windows network change delivers dozens of callbacks on system threads
effect: Correct today (the loop re-checks dirty after clearing running); the stage is encoded by two bools instead of Idle/Running/RunningDirty
fix: A single AtomicU8 with states Idle, Running, RunningDirty and compare_exchange transitions.

title: Neighbour resolution is tracked in three places kept in step by hand
trigger: A gateway whose link-layer address is not yet resolved: Tracker::resolving (gateways asked), link::Resolving v4/v6 AtomicBools (resolve thread in flight) and Path::carried/settled (hardware carried over from the previous route)
effect: No bug today; a failed link::resolve (UDP bind failure) is never retried because Tracker::resolving already names the gateway, and a resolve thread that never returns holds its IP version flag forever
fix: One per-gateway enum Neighbour { Unasked, Asking{since}, Resolved(mac), GaveUp } owned by Tracker, replacing the flags.

title: ProxyState keeps the list fetch and the mutation as loading/stale/mutating/fetch_attempted bools beside error and list
trigger: Open Settings > Connection, add or remove a proxy; code in connect/proxy.rs sets loading/mutating before the send and the reducer clears them by purpose
effect: none today (settle_lost_request clears them via error.rs); loading+error and stale+loading can be set together
fix: Fetch<Vec<ProxyEntry>> for the list plus a Mutation enum (Idle, InFlight(RequestId), Failed(String)); stale becomes a Refetch variant of the fetch.

title: Proxy auto-switch is a hand-kept machine: disconnected_since_ms, pings map (Checking) and RotationAction results fed back by the caller
trigger: Enable auto-switch with 2+ proxies and lose the connection; the caller must insert Checking/Available into pings between steps
effect: none today; a Checking ping blocks rotation for every slot including LINK_PING_ID until that answer or error arrives
fix: enum Rotation { Watching, Disconnected{since}, Probing{id}, Switching{id} } owned by the rotation step instead of Checking entries in the shared ping map.

title: Shared carrier lifecycle is three atomics: ready, failed, closing, plus the child Option and queued count
trigger: Open, fail and close a web proxy carrier from different threads (writer, reader, UI)
effect: none today (fail() orders closing/failed with swap); the stage is implicit across threads
fix: AtomicU8-backed CarrierStage enum (Starting, Ready, Failed, Closing) advanced by compare_exchange so every transition is one place.

title: HelperCarrierHost claim state is generation: Option plus claim_after: Option kept in step by data_dir_arg
trigger: Account folder cannot be claimed (read-only data dir), then it becomes writable
effect: none today; carriers are refused for 10 s after each failed claim
fix: enum Folder { Claimed(Generation), RetryAfter(Instant), NotConfigured }.

title: Carrier table is kept in step with ProxyState::carrier_failed and Carriers::hosting by hand
trigger: A web proxy is enabled; its carrier is refused or fails; the user enables another proxy or the host capability flips
effect: none today; carrier_failed is cleared in apply_added_proxies and apply_web_proxy_carrier, hosting by apply_carrier_hosting
fix: Derive the row state from Carriers (carrier of the enabled proxy_id with phase Failed) and drop carrier_failed.

title: Chat list ordering sync is chat_order_sync.dirty + deferred + moved plus the driver's batch.open
trigger: Poll batch of updates
effect: begin_update_batch/end_update_batch and ConnectDriver::begin_batch/end_batch each keep an open flag in step by hand; if a batch is begun and never ended (an early return or panic between them) deferred stays true and the chat list never reorders
fix: One enum OrderSync { Live, InBatch { dirty, moved } } owned by the batch; drop the duplicate batch.open.

title: Own admin rights are seven Options set by separate setters next to my_member_status
trigger: Own status changes from administrator to member/creator in a channel
effect: set_member_status resets only my_admin_can_post_messages; the other six my_admin_can_* stay until their own setters run and are only hidden by the match on my_member_status
fix: ChannelMemberStatus::Administrator{rights: AdminRights} so rights exist only for an administrator

title: my_rights_fetched bool beside my_restriction option
trigger: Open a group chat; own member record arrives
effect: Three states (unknown, not restricted, restricted) are encoded as a bool plus an Option and kept in step by set_my_restriction
fix: enum OwnRestriction{Unknown,None,Restricted(MemberRestriction)}

title: ConferenceCall::link_open bool and upgrade option track the Add People/share-link stage
trigger: Upgrade a 1:1 call to a conference and pick Share link
effect: link_open, upgrade.share_link and migrated_from are kept consistent by hand
fix: enum ConferenceStage{Upgrading(ConferenceUpgrade),SharingLink,Running}

title: chat_look_oks u32 counter: the chat colors dialog counts oks to know the save finished
trigger: Save in the chat colors dialog sends 1 to 3 requests; each ok bumps the counter, the dialog compares to the number it sent
effect: Counter is not matched to the dialog or the requests it sent, and an error leaves it short of the target
fix: Track the dialog's own request ids (set of RequestId) and finish when all are answered.

title: Deep-link flow split over deep_link, deep_link_original, deep_link_seq and deep_link_from_agent
trigger: A link opens: start sets four fields; terminal states are reached through six paths (Notice, limit box, web fallback, error, Ui, text); each path must reset original and the agent flag by hand
effect: deep_link=None is set on the wallet-notice and limit-box paths without clearing deep_link_from_agent or deep_link_original; correct only because every start re-sets them
fix: Fold original and from_agent into the DeepLinkState variants (or a DeepLinkFlow struct with a generation) so ending the flow drops all of it.

title: Contacts list is contacts: Option + contacts_error: bool
trigger: Invalidation sets contacts = None and error = false (apply.rs:256,273); a getContacts error sets contacts_error = true; success sets both.
effect: Idle, loading, ready and failed are inferred from two fields; a retry has no Loading stage, so a second failing fetch looks identical to the first.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: New contact box stage is new_contact_request + new_contact_outcome (+ contacts invalidation)
trigger: Create sends importContacts and records the id; the answer writes an outcome keyed by that id only if new_contact_request still equals it; closing the box clears the request.
effect: An outcome written for an open box that is closed before it reads it stays in new_contact_outcome until the next box; the invalidation of contacts runs even when the box is gone.
fix: enum NewContact { Closed, Sending{request}, Done{request,outcome} } owned by the box.

title: Three emoji-icon lists each carry a hand-kept *_failed bool; wearable_gifts_loaded conflates answered and failed
trigger: Errors set the *_failed flags (users/error.rs:46-71); connect/* and session_peer_color.rs reset them before a retry; payments/error.rs:132 sets wearable_gifts_loaded = true on a failure.
effect: A failed wearable-gifts request is indistinguishable from an empty list, so the colour editor shows no gifts and no retry hint.
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> / Fetch<Vec<ReceivedGift>>.

title: CommonGroupsPaging is two bools (exhausted, loading_more) beside ProfileChatsFetch
trigger: Groups in common: first page sets exhausted from its length; a follow-up sets loading_more; the answer take()s loading_more to decide replace-or-extend.
effect: See the two bugs on this struct.
fix: `enum GroupsPaging { More, Asking(RequestId), End }` stored inside ProfileChatsFetch::Loaded.

title: InviteLinkMembersState holds loading: bool next to error and request: Option<RequestId>
trigger: Open a link's member list: loading=true,request=Some; answer sets loading=false,error=None,request=None; error sets loading=false,request=None,error=Some. Three fields change together in four places.
effect: No bug today (answers are matched on `request`); loading and request can disagree if a path forgets one.
fix: `page: Fetch<RequestId>`-style enum: Idle | Loading(RequestId) | Failed(String), members kept beside it.

title: OwnershipState is check_in_flight/check_error/can_transfer and transfer_in_flight/transfer_error/transferred as loose fields
trigger: begin_ownership_check, accept_can_transfer_ownership and the error arm each set three fields; begin/finish/fail_ownership_transfer set three more; the UI clears transfer_error/transferred by hand when the dialog opens.
effect: No bug found beyond the lost-answer case below; the stages are not a value.
fix: `Fetch<CanTransferOwnershipResult>` for the check and `enum Transfer { Idle, Sending(OwnershipTransfer), Failed(String), Done(OwnershipTransfer) }`.

title: PendingRequest correlates answers through ~12 optional key fields where the purpose decides which one is read
fix: Move the key into the purpose variant (a typed key per purpose).

title: RequestRegistry.window is ambient state that must follow the swapped SessionView (enter_view / with_view / apply_payload_in_asking_view)
fix: Pass the window as an argument to register, or hold the view and its window as one value.

title: SavedTagSearch: loaded + request + history.loaded_complete
fix: Page stage enum Idle | Asking(RequestId) | Done | Failed.

title: SavedMessagesState: topics_requested, topics_exhausted, retry_when_online, tags_loaded are a hand-kept fetch stage
fix: Fetch-like enum for topics and one for tags.

title: PendingBotMessage stop_failed + stopped + can_stop + keep_on_stop
fix: Stop stage enum Running | Stopping | Stopped | StopFailed.

title: open_chat + open_topic (+ threads.thread, saved views) are reset together by open_chat and leave_open_chat
fix: One OpenView enum: None | Chat{id, topic: TopicList|Topic|Thread|Saved}.

title: Call-history clearing is recent_calls_clearing + recent_calls_error + recent_calls_request set by hand
trigger: Clear call history: connect sets recent_calls_clearing=true; ok clears list, error, clearing and request together; the error arm clears clearing separately.
effect: No bug found; three fields must change together on every path.
fix: Fetch<Vec<CallRow>> plus a CallHistoryOp enum { Idle, Clearing } or a single enum CallHistory.

title: Settings lists share a stale + mutating + error triple per list (sessions, websites, account, auto-delete, read date, star subscriptions, gifts, terms)
trigger: Terminate a session, toggle a session, disconnect a website, set account TTL, accept terms, edit a star subscription, toggle/sell a gift. Each sets *_mutating in connect and apply_ok/error clear *_mutating/_error and set *_stale by hand.
effect: No bug today; sessions_mutating is shared by three different operations, so ok of one clears the guard for all.
fix: Each list is Fetch<T> plus an Option<MutationKind> naming the in-flight operation; staleness is Fetch::Stale.

title: Change-number flow is five hand-kept fields (phone, timeout, loading, checking, error)
trigger: Settings, Change number: send code, resend, check code. CheckPhoneNumberCode ok resets all five by hand and takes the send/resend purposes out of the request table.
effect: No bug found today; a missed reset on one path leaves the box loading or shows a stale error.
fix: enum ChangeNumber { Idle, SendingCode, AwaitingCode{phone,timeout}, Checking{phone}, Failed(err) }.

title: folder_invite_done is a bool set by the ok handler and by the UI, reset by two other places
trigger: Join a shared folder by invite link: take_folder_invite_answer then folder_invite_done=true; ui/folder_share also sets and clears it.
effect: No bug found; the stage is a bool beside the dialog's own state.
fix: A FolderInvite enum { Checking, Ready, Joining, Joined, Failed } in the folder-share dialog state.

title: ChatOrderSync is dirty + deferred + moved, with begin/end batch pairing kept by callers
trigger: Poll batches call begin_update_batch/end_update_batch; per-envelope code sets dirty or moved and flush_chat_order decides what to do from the combination.
effect: No bug found; a batch begun and never ended (an early return added later) would stop the chat list from re-sorting until the next batch.
fix: enum OrderSync { Live, Batching{full_sort: bool, moved}, } with a guard type whose Drop ends the batch.

title: Calendar fetch stage is loading + exhausted bools plus a generation, and the date jump is date_jump_pending + chat_search.jump + date_jump + date_jump_note
trigger: Open the calendar and page back; or start a date jump while a search jump is loading.
effect: Both can be set at once (loading and exhausted), and the jump pipeline has no single stage value; each writer clears the pieces it knows about (abandon_history_around clears pending and jump separately).
fix: HistoryCalendar::pages: enum { Idle, Loading(RequestId), Exhausted }; one DateJump enum { None, Waiting{chat,message,mode}, Landing(ViewJump), Failed(note) }.

title: Download tracking is split across media.downloads, download_extras, open_chat_media_downloads, avatar_downloads_due, avatar_claims and the request registry
trigger: Start, pause, cancel and retry a download while the chat changes.
effect: should_download, unstick_download, abort_download and upsert_file each consult or clear a different subset (requested, paused, cancelling, stalled, user, listed), so a request that is requested in one and absent in another can be sent twice or never.
fix: One per-file DownloadStage enum (Idle, Requested(origin, RequestId), Paused, Cancelling, Stalled, Done) owned by the download map, with avatar and chat-media demands as derived reads.

title: Call privacy loading is a u8 counter next to an error bool
trigger: fetch_call_privacy and set_call_privacy increment privacy_pending; apply_ok, apply and the error arm decrement via privacy_roundtrip_done; send failures zero it.
effect: A dropped continuation (stale generation) never decrements, leaving the pending state set.
fix: Per-rule Fetch<PrivacyWho> enum values; derive pending/error from them.

title: Emoji icon lists are Vec + *_failed bool with 'empty' standing for 'not loaded'
trigger: load_*_emoji_icons refetches whenever the list is empty or failed; accept_* sets failed=false.
effect: A successful empty answer is indistinguishable from not asked, so every open of the dialog asks again.
fix: Three Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> fields.

title: Proxy list fetch is loading + stale + mutating + error + Option list
trigger: getProxies sets proxy.loading, a mutation sets mutating, the answer sets stale and the driver refetches.
effect: Four flags plus Option<list> must agree; error is shared by list load, mutate and IPv6 toggle.
fix: Fetch<Vec<ProxyEntry>> for the list and a Save enum {Idle, Saving(RequestId), Failed(line)} for mutations.

title: ShareSearch searching state is two Option<RequestId> plus query and two result lists
trigger: begin sets both requests, accept clears each; is_searching is derived.
effect: No bug found: answers are matched by request id, errors call accept with an empty list (messages/error.rs:259) and session_updates.rs:51 resets it.
fix: Optional: enum ShareSearch { Idle, Searching{query, local: Part, server: Part} } with Part::{Waiting(RequestId), Done(Vec)}.

title: Sponsored report flow is three fields kept in step by hand
trigger: begin_sponsored_hide, begin_sponsored_report, accept_sponsored_report and dismiss_sponsored_report each reset a different subset of the three fields.
effect: No bug beyond the late-answer one, but every writer must remember all three.
fix: enum SponsoredReport { Idle, Asking{request, chat, message}, Picking(Flight), Outcome(Outcome) } in MessagesState.

title: Forum topic list stage is derived from two sets: forum_topics key present and forum_topics_failed membership
trigger: getForumTopics fails then later succeeds, or fails after a successful load
effect: RowForum.loaded is computed from map presence OR failed set; both can be set, and the failed set is cleared only by apply.rs on success
fix: Per-chat Fetch<Vec<ForumTopic>> (Idle, Loading, Ready, Failed) replacing the map-plus-set.

title: PublicForwardsList loading bool beside error Option
trigger: Message statistics forwards paging.
effect: Both can be set; forwards_requested and fail_message_forwards keep them in step by hand.
fix: A page enum (Idle | Loading{request} | Failed(String)) next to the accumulated forwards.

title: ThreadView's load stage is status plus three bools kept in step by hand
trigger: Any thread open: needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set by the reducer and cleared by the driver around ThreadStatus.
effect: Combinations like LoadingHistory + reading_started with no request in flight are representable: start_thread_in_open_chat sets reading_started before fetch_thread_history, so a send error leaves the thread loading with nothing to retry it (plausible stuck spinner).
fix: One enum: Resolving{request} | SwitchingChat | Starting | LoadingFirst{request} | Ready | ReloadNeeded | Failed(String), each with what leaves it.

title: SentStep holds its stage as two bools (refused, settled) beside an Instant
trigger: Code reading: system_proxy_tick sets settled=true then refused from a side channel; refused without settled is meaningless.
effect: Three valid stages (in flight, settled ok, refused at time T) encoded as four bool combinations kept in step by hand in connect/proxy.rs.
fix: enum SentStepState { InFlight { request: RequestId }, Done, Refused { at: Instant } } inside SentStep { step, state }.

title: ReceiveBridge lifecycle is spread over shutdown/stopped flags, thread: Option and route: Option
trigger: Code reading: shutdown() stores the flag, joins the thread and takes the route; StopGuard sets stopped only without shutdown; is_joined reads both Options.
effect: Running / ShuttingDown / Stopped / StoppedUnexpectedly are encoded across two atomics and two Options (a routed bridge never uses its shutdown flag).
fix: enum BridgeFeed { Injected { thread, shutdown }, Routed { hub, client_id }, Closed } plus one atomic stop reason shared with the loop.

title: Gift purchase offer stage held as a bare u8 (0 pending, 1 accepted, 2 rejected)
trigger: n/a
effect: No bug today; service_text matches the numbers by hand and any new TDLib giftPurchaseOfferState silently reads as pending.
fix: enum GiftOfferState { Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Unknown } parsed from giftPurchaseOfferState*.

title: Proxy link box stage is draft + warn bool + a ping slot in Session
trigger: Open a tg://proxy link, press Check status, accept the warning, connect
effect: Stages (shown, warning, checking, result) are spread over ProxyLinkBox::warn, the shared LINK_PING_ID entry and ProxyUi::ip_warning_acked
fix: enum LinkStep { Review, Warn, Checking, Result(PingStatus) } in ProxyLinkBox.

title: Notification delivery state is pending_notifications, shown_notification_chats and pending_notification_clears kept in step
trigger: queue_notification_with_sound inserts into shown before the UI shows anything; clear_chat_notifications removes from shown and queues a clear if it was there.
effect: A notification dropped from the queue before it was shown still queues a clear (harmless withdraw of nothing); the three sets are written by hand in both places.
fix: Per-chat enum NotifyState { Queued, Shown, ClearDue } in one map.

title: Story composer's post flow is three bools plus local_error kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a (check_sent -> post_sent, save_sent, local_error set and cleared in story_composer.rs and frame_upkeep.rs)
effect: check_sent, post_sent and save_sent are mutually exclusive stages of one send (checking eligibility, posting, saving an edit) with local_error beside them; each writer must clear the others. Listed as baseline debt in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt.
fix: enum ComposerSend { Idle, Checking { request }, Posting { request }, Saving { request }, Failed(String) } on the composer, matched to the answer's request id.

title: save_pending bool plus detached timer task
trigger: Move or close a chat window, then switch account or log out within 600 ms.
effect: save_pending is the stage of the debounce task; it is cleared only by the continuation, which is dropped on epoch change (harmless today because ChatWindows is replaced with the screen).
fix: Own the debounce as Option<Task> in ChatWindows (Idle|Scheduled(Task)) so dropping the task is the way out.

title: ChatWindowView::closed is a bool kept in step by hand with ChatWindows::open membership and Session::window_chats
trigger: Window lifecycle: closing(), mark_closed() (switch), render's !alive path and when_window_goes each set it; chat_window_closed removes the entry from ChatWindows.
effect: No bug found today, but 'bookkeeping ran' is stored in the view while the app's list is the truth; a missed mark_closed would run chat_window_closed for the new account's windows.
fix: One `WindowLife { Open, Closing, Gone }` owned by ChatWindows per window (the view asks it), or derive closed from ChatWindows::open membership.

title: MenuFocus keeps `was_open` and `previous` in step by hand
trigger: Open and close a context menu, including a close by account switch or window close
effect: previous is Some only while was_open; menu_focus_upkeep sets and clears both from a per-frame edge detection; a frame that never runs (window hidden) leaves previous focus stuck on the menu frame
fix: enum MenuFocusStage { Closed, Open { previous: Option<FocusHandle> } }.

title: Network usage is Option<NetworkUsage> + network_loading bool + a shared privacy_data.error
trigger: n/a
effect: Loading, ready and failed are three fields; the error is shared with other privacy-data requests.
fix: `network_usage: Fetch<NetworkUsage>`.

title: Export progress visibility is a bool beside the export box Option and the session's export
trigger: Start a chat or account export, close its box (progress hidden), start another export.
effect: chat_export_progress_hidden/account_export_progress_hidden are set and cleared by hand in about eight places (export_box.rs, export_progress.rs, account_export_*), next to the draft Option and the export_seen Option.
fix: One ExportView enum per export: Closed, BoxOpen(draft), ProgressShown(seen), ProgressHidden.

title: LayerFocus tracks focus return with base, open_focus and was_open updated together each frame
trigger: Open and close a tracked layer, change windows
effect: was_open bool and two weak handles are kept in step by hand in track_layer_focus
fix: enum LayerFocus { Closed{base}, Open{base, focus} }.

title: Frame clock run kept as a frame_clock_running bool beside a detached task
trigger: n/a
effect: FrameUi::frame_clock_running says a detached loop exists; the loop clears it on exit. Works today (every exit path ends with the clear, a dropped app ends via Ticked(0)), but the run and its flag are kept in step by hand and the task cannot be cancelled.
fix: `clock: Option<Task<()>>` (or a `ClockState::Idle | Running(Task)` enum) owned by FrameUi.

title: Frame clock running state is a Cell<bool> kept in step with a detached loop task
trigger: request_tick sets frame_clock_running then spawns the loop; the loop clears it on every exit path today
effect: None today; a new early return in the loop would leave it set and stop all animation until restart
fix: Hold the clock as Option<Task<()>> (None = stopped) so the flag cannot disagree with the task

title: Slider entities live in QuillApp.preferences, outside OnScreen
trigger: Open Data & Storage in account A, switch account.
effect: index_sliders (and AutoDelete slider) hold positions derived from account A's limits; dropped only by open_data_storage/forget_storage_sliders, not by an account swap.
fix: Move into the dialog's box state that is replaced with the account.

title: Main menu open flag, filter text and highlight index are kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the menu, type to filter, arrow down; closing resets highlight but not the filter, opening clears the filter and highlight in set_main_menu_open.
effect: highlight is an index into a filtered list recomputed each frame; archive appearing or disappearing shifts the tile under the highlight.
fix: enum MainMenu { Closed, Open{filter, highlight: Option<Entry>} } keyed by Entry, not index.

title: PolledRedraw owes a redraw as full: RedrawNeed + list: bool + conversation: bool
trigger: Every poll.
effect: Three owed-redraw flags that drawn() and decide() must clear together; a new flag needs each place edited.
fix: One Owed value (a small ordered set or enum of None/List/Conversation/Full(urgency)) with last-drawn times.

title: Notification window stage is unlinked + hiding + replying + waiting_for_input + hide_at, with the reply field mirrored in NotifyView
trigger: Any notification window.
effect: Live / Replying / Fading(slow|fast) / Gone is spread over five fields in Shown and Popup, plus NotifyView::reply and ::actions, kept in step by view events.
fix: enum WindowStage { WaitingForInput, Lingering(at), Replying, Fading{slow}, Gone } on Shown, set only by the manager; the view renders it.

title: NotifyWindows::ticking is a started flag for a detached clock task
trigger: Any notification window opens.
effect: ticking true means a task runs; it is reset only when the tick returns None, so a dropped task would leave the clock off forever.
fix: Hold the clock as Option<Task<()>> (idle = None) so dropping it is stopping it.

title: Your-color box apply stage is a bool plus two derived reads
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance > Your color, change a swatch, press Apply.
effect: PeerColorDialog.sent is set after the requests go and cleared by edit_peer_color; the status line also reads Session requests (busy) and users_state.profile_edit_error, so three sources pick one of four messages by priority.
fix: One enum ColorApply { Editing, Applying(request ids), Applied, Failed(reason) } on the dialog, set from the answer matched to the request.

title: hovered bool and Showing.running_since are the same stage in two places
trigger: Hover, dismiss, push, window_closed.
effect: hovered says whether the next toast starts paused; running_since says whether the visible one runs. They are updated in step in set_hovered, dismiss, show and window_closed.
fix: enum Timer { Running{since}, Paused{left} } on Showing plus a single Pointer state on the queue.

title: Touch Bar picker fill uses filled bool plus pending Option
trigger: Tap the sticker/emoji segment after the lists change; switch accounts.
effect: filled (ever filled) and pending (latest lists) are managed by offer_picker / fill_pending_picker; after an account switch the scrubbers keep the previous account's stickers until the next tap because only pending is replaced.
fix: enum PickerFill { Empty, Shown(lists), Shown+Waiting(lists,next) } and clear it on the account/lock change.

title: Sync throttle is a `pending: Cell<bool>` flag
trigger: Any app notify while a sync task is scheduled.
effect: No bug today (cleared before the update, cleared even when the window update fails), but it is a stage flag kept next to HOST.is_some() and enabled(): idle / scheduled.
fix: enum SyncStage { Idle, Scheduled(Task<()>) } holding the task, so dropping the owner cancels it.

title: Pinned panel gesture and animation stages are bools/Options kept in step
trigger: Press, drag, drop, cancel, order change while dragging, online dot animation.
effect: Drag{started: bool} inside Option<Drag> is Idle/Pressed/Dragging; ivars.timer Option<NSTimer> is an 'animating' flag next to Slide.started Option<Instant> in every entry; set_pins clears touch by hand when the order changes. If the timer block cannot borrow the slot (try_borrow_mut fails) the timer is invalidated but the slot stays Some, and animate_if_needed then never starts another (animations frozen).
fix: enum Gesture { Idle, Pressed, Dragging } and enum Animation { Still, Running(Retained<NSTimer>) } owned by the panel; one transition function for each.

title: UpdatePill tracks the last control kind with a downloading bool and a nested Option<Option<Instant>> for ready
trigger: Watch the title-bar pill go from download to Restart.
effect: No bug found. follow() keeps downloading, ready and since in step by hand to decide whether to ease and when the swap began.
fix: enum PillMotion { Still, Filling { from, to, since }, Swapping { since }, Ready } derived from the last UpdateControl.

title: The install receipt records its outcome as `failed: bool` (baseline debt)
trigger: write_result(.., failed) and startup_state read the bool; startup_state also compares the version to tell 'installed' from a stale receipt.
effect: No bug found.
fix: `enum Outcome { Installed, Failed }` serialized in the receipt (keeping `failed` readable for old receipts).
